// The render check.  A phone starts the game at 75% of its screen's pixels (device.ts deviceDefaults): most phones'
// GPUs do not fill all of them at the display's rate, but some do.  While the player drives (the game's status
// "drive": a race or free roam, not the menus), this counts the frames the game made against the rate it paces to
// (status "rate"; a cutscene's 30 fps does not count) and takes each frame's GPU time (submit to done, the renderer's
// doneMs: every browser has it).  The first warm-up of driving is left out (loading hitches, pipelines still being
// made); once there was enough driving (a few minutes, so a phone that slows down as it warms up has done so) it
// judges once, from what came in between:
//   at 75%: the game kept its rate (97% of the frames it paces to) and the GPU's p90 frame time, scaled to all the
//     pixels (/ 0.75²), stays within 2/3 of a frame: this phone starts at 100% from its next game
//   at 100% (the check's own earlier verdict): the game fell behind (under 95%) and the GPU's p90 takes more than
//     2/3 of a frame: back to 75%
// The verdict stays in this browser (device.ts rememberRender).  Only while render is this device's default: a
// render the player set (settings.ini, the page address) is theirs.  The figures go to the log either way.

import type { RendererSubsystem } from './contract';
import type { StatusReader } from './status';
import { rememberRender } from './device';

export interface RenderCheckTimes { warmupMs: number; decideMs: number }
export const RENDER_CHECK_TIMES: RenderCheckTimes = { warmupMs: 60_000, decideMs: 180_000 };

const TICK_MS = 250;
const MIN_RATE = 50;            // below: a cutscene's 30 fps, not the game's own rate (fps = 30: no verdict)
const UP_HELD = 0.97, DOWN_HELD = 0.95, GPU_SHARE = 2 / 3;
const MAX_SAMPLES = 1 << 16;

const pct = (x: number) => `${Math.round(x * 100)}%`;
const min = (ms: number) => ms >= 60_000 ? `${(ms / 60_000).toFixed(1)} min` : `${Math.round(ms / 1000)} s`;

export class RenderCheck {
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private readonly scale: number;
  /** the status block's last count, and the GPU times that came in since */
  private last: { frames: number; t: number; rate: number; drive: boolean } | null = null;
  private pend: number[] = [];
  /** driving so far; after the warm-up: its time, the frames made and the frames the rate asked for, GPU times */
  private drivingMs = 0;
  private windowMs = 0;
  private got = 0;
  private expected = 0;
  private gpu: number[] = [];
  private verdict: string | null = null;

  /** s: the running game (its status block and renderer attach later); render: the render value this device's
   *  default gave the game (scale:0.75, or backing after an earlier verdict) */
  constructor(private s: { status: StatusReader | null; renderer: RendererSubsystem | null }, render: string,
              private times: RenderCheckTimes, private log: (line: string) => void) {
    this.scale = render === 'backing' ? 1 : parseFloat(render.replace(/^scale:/, '')) || 1;
    this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), TICK_MS);
  }

  stop() { clearInterval(this.timer); }

  /** tests and the page */
  state() {
    return { scale: this.scale, drivingMs: this.drivingMs, windowMs: this.windowMs, held: this.expected ? this.got / this.expected : 0,
             gpuP90: quantile(this.gpu.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b), 0.9), verdict: this.verdict };
  }

  private tick() {
    if (this.verdict !== null) return;                 // one verdict a game
    const done = this.s.renderer?.doneMs?.() ?? [];
    const st = this.s.status?.read();                   // null while the game writes it: the next tick
    const frames = st?.get('frames'), t = st?.get('frames_t');
    if (!st || frames === undefined || t === undefined) return;
    for (const x of done) this.pend.push(x);
    if (this.last && t === this.last.t) return;         // the status thread counts every 250 ms: not again yet
    const rate = st.get('rate') ?? 0, drive = ((st.get('drive') ?? 0) & 3) > 0 && !document.hidden;
    const prev = this.last, pend = this.pend;
    this.last = { frames, t, rate, drive };
    this.pend = [];
    // only time spent driving all along, at the game's own rate
    if (!prev || !prev.drive || !drive || rate !== prev.rate || rate < MIN_RATE || frames < prev.frames) return;
    const dt = t - prev.t;
    this.drivingMs += dt;
    if (this.drivingMs <= this.times.warmupMs) return;
    this.windowMs += dt;
    this.got += frames - prev.frames;
    this.expected += dt * rate / 1000;
    for (const x of pend) if (this.gpu.length < MAX_SAMPLES) this.gpu.push(x);
    if (this.drivingMs >= this.times.decideMs) this.decide();
  }

  private decide() {
    clearInterval(this.timer);
    const held = this.got / this.expected, frameMs = this.windowMs / this.expected;
    const s = this.gpu.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b), p50 = quantile(s, 0.5), p90 = quantile(s, 0.9);
    const full = p90 / (this.scale * this.scale);
    let verdict: string;
    if (!s.length) verdict = 'no GPU frame times, no change';
    else if (this.scale < 1) {
      if (held >= UP_HELD && full <= frameMs * GPU_SHARE) { rememberRender('backing'); verdict = 'room to spare: this phone starts at 100% from its next game'; }
      else verdict = `no room to spare: it stays at ${pct(this.scale)}`;
    } else if (held < DOWN_HELD && p90 > frameMs * GPU_SHARE) { rememberRender(null); verdict = 'behind: this phone starts at 75% again from its next game'; }
    else verdict = held < DOWN_HELD ? 'behind, but not for the GPU: it stays at 100%' : 'keeps up: it stays at 100%';
    this.verdict = verdict;
    this.log(`[app] render check after ${min(this.drivingMs)} of driving at ${pct(this.scale)}: ${this.got} frames of ` +
             `${Math.round(this.expected)} (${pct(held)}), a frame ${frameMs.toFixed(1)} ms, GPU p50 ${p50.toFixed(1)} / p90 ` +
             `${p90.toFixed(1)} ms` + (this.scale < 1 ? ` (${full.toFixed(1)} ms at 100%)` : '') + `: ${verdict}`);
  }
}

function quantile(sorted: number[], p: number) {
  return sorted.length ? sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(p * sorted.length))] : 0;
}

// The save overlay as the page sees it: the OPFS directory the I/O worker
// mounts as /save (web/src/host/io-worker.ts).  Main-thread, async API only;
// nothing here ever touches /data (the game folder is served read-only by
// the local server and never written).
//
// Writes from the page happen only while no game runs in this tab (the
// shell enforces it), so they never race the I/O worker's sync handles.
// But an F12 screenshot (shots.ts saveScreenshot): a new file of its own,
// which the game never opens.  While a game plays without saving (shell.ts,
// setWritesOff) nothing here writes or removes anything at all.

import { BLOCK, CACHE_DIR } from '../host/datacache';
import { coverOf } from './profile';
import { crc32 } from './zip';

export const PROFILES_DIR = 'NFS Underground 2';   // what the game creates under the save root
/** an F12 screenshot: an image file at the top of the save folder (nfsu2000.tga ...) */

async function root(): Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle> { return navigator.storage.getDirectory(); }

export async function saveRoot(saveDir: string, create = true): Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle> {
  return (await root()).getDirectoryHandle(saveDir, { create });
}

function parts(path: string): string[] {
  const p = path.split('/').filter(x => x && x !== '.');
  if (p.some(x => x === '..')) throw new Error(`bad path ${path}`);
  return p;
}

async function dirOf(base: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, path: string[], create: boolean) {
  let d = base;
  for (const p of path) d = await d.getDirectoryHandle(p, { create });
  return d;
}

/**
 * Whether an error says the file or folder is not there (NotFoundError, in every browser).  Any other error is a
 * storage that did not answer, never "not there": Firefox 159 on a Mac answered every call in the save folder with
 * "UnknownError: Unknown failure" (Discord 2026-11-04), and the page took its settings.ini for missing and wrote the
 * template over it (the write failed too, that time).  So reads say null or false only for this, and throw otherwise.
 */
export const missing = (e: unknown) => (e as { name?: string } | null)?.name === 'NotFoundError';
/** what the page says where the save folder does not answer (Play, Saves, Settings, an invite's Join) */
export const UNREADABLE = N('This browser can\'t read or write your saves right now ({error}).');
/** what the page says while a game plays without saving (shell.ts askNoSave: as it starts; a screenshot, a setting) */
export const NO_SAVE = N('Playing without saving: nothing from this game is kept.');

// Only a look-up (getFileHandle, getDirectoryHandle) that answers NotFoundError says "not there".  A file or folder that
// was found and then does not read with NotFoundError is looked up again: gone meanwhile, it is not there; still there,
// the error is thrown.  (Firefox 159 answered "NotFoundError: Entry not found" for files its storage still listed:
// taken for missing, settings.ini would get the template written over it, and a listing would leave a profile out.)
/** whether name is (still) in d; throws what its look-up answered but NotFoundError */
async function found(d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string, kind: 'file' | 'directory'): Promise<boolean> {
  try { await (kind === 'file' ? d.getFileHandle(name) : d.getDirectoryHandle(name)); return true; }
  catch (e) { if (missing(e)) return false; throw e; }
}
/** what read makes of a file of d, or null where the file is not there (missing, found) */
async function readIn<T>(d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string, read: (f: File) => Promise<T>): Promise<T | null> {
  let h: FileSystemFileHandle;
  try { h = await d.getFileHandle(name); } catch (e) { if (missing(e)) return null; throw e; }
  try { return await read(await h.getFile()); }
  catch (e) { if (missing(e) && !await found(d, name, 'file')) return null; throw e; }
}
/** the folder at path under base, or null where one of them is not there */
async function dirIn(base: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, path: string[]): Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle | null> {
  try { return await dirOf(base, path, false); } catch (e) { if (missing(e)) return null; throw e; }
}

/**
 * Playing without saving (shell.ts: the save folder did not answer, and the player started the game anyway): nothing in
 * this file writes, moves or removes anything in the browser's storage until it is off again, whoever asks (Autosave, a
 * restore, cloud saves, Put back, a screenshot, a setting): each throws SavesOff instead.
 */
let writesOff = false;
export function setWritesOff(on: boolean) { writesOff = on; }
export const writesAreOff = () => writesOff;
export class SavesOff extends Error {
  constructor() { super('playing without saving: nothing is written'); this.name = 'SavesOff'; }
}
function writable() { if (writesOff) throw new SavesOff(); }

/** The text of a file in the save dir, or null if it (or the save dir) is not there.  Throws when it may be there but
 *  did not read (missing, found). */
export async function readText(saveDir: string, path: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const p = parts(path);
  const top = await dirIn(await root(), [saveDir]), d = top && await dirIn(top, p.slice(0, -1));
  return d ? readIn(d, p[p.length - 1], f => f.text()) : null;
}

/** Whether a file is at path (a folder there is none); throws when the storage did not say (missing). */
export async function exists(saveDir: string, path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const p = parts(path);
  try {
    const d = await dirOf(await saveRoot(saveDir, false), p.slice(0, -1), false);
    await d.getFileHandle(p[p.length - 1]);
    return true;
  } catch (e) { if (missing(e) || (e as DOMException)?.name === 'TypeMismatchError') return false; throw e; }
}

/** Write a whole file (creating its folders).  A file it made, whose write then failed (the browser's storage full),
 *  goes again: an empty profile left behind would be sent to the cloud as one.  Only a file it knows it made: one the
 *  storage would not say about (missing) may be the player's, and stays. */
export async function writeFile(saveDir: string, path: string, data: string | Uint8Array | Blob): Promise<void> {
  writable();
  const p = parts(path);
  if (!p.length) throw new Error('empty path');
  const d = await dirOf(await saveRoot(saveDir), p.slice(0, -1), true), name = p[p.length - 1];
  let had = true;
  try { await d.getFileHandle(name); } catch (e) { if (missing(e)) had = false; }
  await writeInto(d, name, data, had);
}
async function writeInto(d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string, data: string | Uint8Array | Blob, had: boolean) {
  try { const w = await (await d.getFileHandle(name, { create: true })).createWritable(); await w.write(data as FileSystemWriteChunkType); await w.close(); }
  catch (e) { if (!had) await d.removeEntry(name).catch(() => {}); throw e; }
}

/** Write a file only where none is, or an empty one (the game's own of that path, written meanwhile, stays): false when
 *  one was there.  Looked for again once made, just before the write. */
export async function writeIfAbsent(saveDir: string, path: string, data: string | Uint8Array): Promise<boolean> {
  writable();
  const p = parts(path);
  if (!p.length) throw new Error('empty path');
  const d = await dirOf(await saveRoot(saveDir), p.slice(0, -1), true), name = p[p.length - 1];
  const sized = () => readIn(d, name, async f => f.size);
  const was = await sized();
  if (was) return false;
  const had = was !== null;
  await d.getFileHandle(name, { create: true });
  // (a size that does not read now leaves no empty file this made)
  try { if (await sized()) return false; }
  catch (e) { if (!had) await d.removeEntry(name).catch(() => {}); throw e; }
  await writeInto(d, name, data, had);
  return true;
}

/** the folder beside a save folder where writeTogether stages its files (no listing, backup or cloud save sees it) */
export const stagingDir = (saveDir: string) => `${saveDir}~incoming`;
/** in the staging folder: the files of a writeTogether whose moves began (PlanFile; n<i>: file i staged, o<i>: the file
 *  it replaces, moved aside); gone once all of them are in place */
const PLAN = 'plan.json';
/** a file of a writeTogether's plan: its path in the save folder (dir: in that folder beside it instead), and its
 *  CRC-32 and size (what tells the incoming copy from a file written there since) */
interface PlanFile { path: string; crc: number; size: number; dir?: string }
/** a file a writeTogether writes into another folder beside the save folder (the copy Put back brings back) */
export interface BesideFile { dir: string; path: string; data: string | Uint8Array }
/** the folder a plan's file goes into */
async function baseOf(saveDir: string, f: { dir?: string }): Promise<FileSystemDirectoryHandle> {
  return f.dir ? (await root()).getDirectoryHandle(f.dir, { create: true }) : saveRoot(saveDir);
}
/** a staged file's name before f4e3f301's staging folder (beside the file it replaced): never listed */
const isStaged = (name: string) => name.endsWith('.incoming');

type MovableFile = FileSystemFileHandle & { move?(dir: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string): Promise<void> };
/** a file moved into another folder of the OPFS, under a name, over one there (refused for a file a worker holds open) */
async function moveFile(from: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string, to: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, as: string) {
  const h = await from.getFileHandle(name) as MovableFile;
  if (typeof h.move === 'function') { await h.move(to, as); return; }
  // (a browser without move(): copied, then removed; a file there that its look-up did not answer for stays)
  let had = true;
  try { await to.getFileHandle(as); } catch (e) { if (missing(e)) had = false; }
  await writeInto(to, as, new Uint8Array(await (await h.getFile()).arrayBuffer()), had);
  await from.removeEntry(name);
}
/** whether a file is there; throws what its look-up answered but NotFoundError (taken for none, a restore without
 *  move() wrote over a profile it had not moved aside, and the start's settle removed one it had) */
const there = (d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string) => found(d, name, 'file');
/** A file of the save dir renamed (moved over the one of the new name: no room needed). */
export async function renameFile(saveDir: string, from: string, to: string): Promise<void> {
  writable();
  const base = await saveRoot(saveDir);
  await moveFile(base, from, base, to);
}
/** the file there is the plan's incoming copy (its size and CRC): not one written there since */
async function incoming(d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string, f: PlanFile): Promise<boolean> {
  const b = await readIn(d, name, async x => new Uint8Array(await x.arrayBuffer()));    // (one that does not read: throws)
  return b !== null && b.length === f.size && crc32(b) === f.crc;
}

/**
 * A writeTogether whose moves did not all end, undone, the last first.  Each step says by itself what is left of it,
 * so an undo cut short and run again (the tab closed, a move refused) does only what is left: the incoming copy still
 * at its path (n<i> not staged, that file the plan's) goes back into the staging folder, and the file it replaced comes
 * back where nothing or only the incoming copy is.  Nothing is removed: a file written there since (a game's save)
 * stays.  False: some step failed (the plan and what is staged stay, for the next try).
 */
async function rollBack(saveDir: string, stage: FileSystemDirectoryHandle): Promise<boolean> {
  let text: string | null, plan: PlanFile[];
  try { text = await readIn(stage, PLAN, f => f.text()); } catch { return false; }    // (one that does not read: kept)
  if (text === null) return true;                      // no plan: no move began
  try { plan = JSON.parse(text) as PlanFile[]; } catch { return false; }             // (one that cannot be read: kept)
  // (a plan of paths only, cae4d8df's: no file there is known as its incoming copy, so none moves)
  plan = plan.map(f => typeof f === 'string' ? { path: f, crc: -1, size: -1 } : f);
  let ok = true;
  for (let i = plan.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    try {
      const f = plan[i], p = parts(f.path), name = p[p.length - 1], d = await dirOf(await baseOf(saveDir, f), p.slice(0, -1), true);
      if (!await there(stage, `n${i}`) && await incoming(d, name, f)) await moveFile(d, name, stage, `n${i}`);
      if (await there(stage, `o${i}`) && (!await there(d, name) || await incoming(d, name, f))) await moveFile(stage, `o${i}`, d, name);
    } catch { ok = false; }
  }
  if (ok) await stage.removeEntry(PLAN).catch(() => { ok = false; });
  await pruneSaveDir(saveDir, () => true).catch(() => {});   // the folders it made, empty again
  return ok;
}

/**
 * The staging folder at the page's start (by the tab that owns the saves), and before each writeTogether: a
 * writeTogether a closed tab left halfway through its moves is undone, then what it staged goes.  False: it could not
 * all be undone (the plan stays: tried again next time).
 */
export async function settleStaged(saveDir: string): Promise<boolean> {
  writable();
  let stage: FileSystemDirectoryHandle;
  try { stage = await (await root()).getDirectoryHandle(stagingDir(saveDir)); } catch (e) { if (missing(e)) return true; throw e; }
  if (!await rollBack(saveDir, stage)) return false;
  await (await root()).removeEntry(stagingDir(saveDir), { recursive: true }).catch(() => {});
  return true;
}

/** A restore refused while one that stopped halfway is not undone yet (settleStaged false): nothing was written. */
export class UndoPending extends Error {
  readonly why = N('a restore that stopped earlier is not undone yet, so nothing was written');
  readonly code = 'SAVES-UNDO-PENDING';
  constructor() { super('a restore that stopped earlier is not undone yet, so nothing was written'); }
}

/**
 * Write files all or none (a restore's, a cloud take's: a profile and its GARAGE.DAT of two versions lost the cars of
 * slots 6-10).  Each is written into the staging folder beside the save folder first (stagingDir); then, the files
 * noted there (PLAN), each file it replaces is moved aside and the new one moved into place.  A write that fails (the
 * browser's storage full) changes nothing here; a move refused (a file another tab's game holds open) undoes the
 * moves before it.  Either way it throws, the saves as they were.  The moves need no room, and a tab closed during
 * them is undone at the next page's start (settleStaged).  While an earlier one is not undone it writes nothing.
 */
export async function writeTogether(saveDir: string, files: { path: string; data: string | Uint8Array }[], beside: BesideFile[] = []): Promise<void> {
  writable();
  if (!await settleStaged(saveDir)) throw new UndoPending();
  const stage = await (await root()).getDirectoryHandle(stagingDir(saveDir), { create: true });
  const all: { path: string; data: string | Uint8Array; dir?: string }[] = [...files, ...beside];
  const clear = () => root().then(r => r.removeEntry(stagingDir(saveDir), { recursive: true })).catch(() => {});
  const enc = new TextEncoder(), plan: PlanFile[] = [];
  try {
    for (const [i, f] of all.entries()) {
      if (!parts(f.path).length) throw new Error('empty path');
      const b = typeof f.data === 'string' ? enc.encode(f.data) : f.data;
      await writeInto(stage, `n${i}`, b, false);
      plan.push({ path: f.path, crc: crc32(b), size: b.length, ...f.dir ? { dir: f.dir } : {} });
    }
    await writeInto(stage, PLAN, JSON.stringify(plan), false);
  } catch (e) {
    await clear();
    throw e;
  }
  try {
    for (const [i, f] of all.entries()) {
      const p = parts(f.path), name = p[p.length - 1], d = await dirOf(await baseOf(saveDir, f), p.slice(0, -1), true);
      if (await there(d, name)) await moveFile(d, name, stage, `o${i}`);
      await moveFile(stage, `n${i}`, d, name);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (await rollBack(saveDir, stage)) await clear();
    throw e;
  }
  await stage.removeEntry(PLAN);                       // all in place: nothing to undo from here on
  await clear();
}

export interface Entry { path: string; size: number; mtime: number }

/**
 * Every file under the save dir, depth first, sorted by path ([] with no save dir yet).  A file or folder gone while it
 * lists is left out; any other error throws (missing): a list with files left out would be a backup, a cloud version or
 * a "no profile here" that lacks them.  (Before 2026-11-04 any error ended the list where it was, quietly.)
 */
export async function listFiles(saveDir: string): Promise<Entry[]> {
  /** d's files, or null where d is gone meanwhile (its parent's look-up of name says so) */
  async function walk(parent: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string, d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, rel: string): Promise<Entry[] | null> {
    const out: Entry[] = [];
    try {
      for await (const [n, h] of d.entries()) {
        const r = rel ? rel + '/' + n : n;
        if (h.kind === 'directory') out.push(...await walk(d, n, h as FileSystemDirectoryHandle, r) ?? []);
        else if (!isStaged(n)) {
          let f: File;
          try { f = await (h as FileSystemFileHandle).getFile(); }
          catch (e) { if (missing(e) && !await found(d, n, 'file')) continue; throw e; }    // (gone meanwhile: left out)
          out.push({ path: r, size: f.size, mtime: f.lastModified });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { if (missing(e) && !await found(parent, name, 'directory')) return null; throw e; }
    return out;
  }
  const r = await root(), top = await dirIn(r, [saveDir]);
  if (!top) return [];
  return (await walk(r, saveDir, top, '') ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.path < b.path ? -1 : a.path > b.path ? 1 : 0);
}

export async function readBytes(saveDir: string, path: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const p = parts(path);
  const d = await dirOf(await saveRoot(saveDir, false), p.slice(0, -1), false);
  return new Uint8Array(await (await (await d.getFileHandle(p[p.length - 1])).getFile()).arrayBuffer());
}

/** Remove a file, or a folder with everything in it; nothing if it is not there. */
export async function removePath(saveDir: string, path: string): Promise<void> {
  writable();
  const p = parts(path);
  if (!p.length) throw new Error('empty path');
  const top = await dirIn(await root(), [saveDir]), d = top && await dirIn(top, p.slice(0, -1));
  if (!d) return;
  try { await d.removeEntry(p[p.length - 1], { recursive: true }); }
  catch (e) { if ((e as DOMException).name !== 'NotFoundError') throw e; }
}

/** The save dir's file functions, bound to it (profile.ts turnOnAutosave, renameProfile). */
export function filesOf(saveDir: string) {
  return {
    listFiles: () => listFiles(saveDir), readBytes: (path: string) => readBytes(saveDir, path),
    readText: (path: string) => readText(saveDir, path), writeFile: (path: string, data: string | Uint8Array) => writeFile(saveDir, path, data),
    remove: (path: string) => removePath(saveDir, path), exists: (path: string) => exists(saveDir, path),
    writeIfAbsent: (path: string, data: Uint8Array) => writeIfAbsent(saveDir, path, data),
  };
}

/** Remove everything inside the save dir, or its folder `under` (the folder itself stays), but what is at its top under
 *  a name `keep` takes. */
export async function clearSaveDir(saveDir: string, keep: (name: string) => boolean = () => false, under = ''): Promise<void> {
  writable();
  const top = await saveRoot(saveDir), d = under ? await dirIn(top, parts(under)) : top;
  if (!d) return;                                                                 // not there: nothing in it
  const names: string[] = [];
  for await (const [name] of d.entries()) if (!keep(name)) names.push(name);
  for (const n of names) await d.removeEntry(n, { recursive: true });
}

/** Remove every file of the save dir keep() does not take (its path), and the folders that leaves empty (the game
 *  would list an empty profile folder): what a restore replaced, after it wrote its own. */
export async function pruneSaveDir(saveDir: string, keep: (path: string) => boolean): Promise<void> {
  async function walk(d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, rel: string): Promise<boolean> {     // true: d is empty now
    const kids: [string, FileSystemHandle][] = [];
    for await (const e of d.entries()) kids.push(e);
    let empty = true;
    for (const [name, h] of kids) {
      const r = rel ? `${rel}/${name}` : name;
      if (h.kind === 'directory') { if (await walk(h as FileSystemDirectoryHandle, r)) await d.removeEntry(name, { recursive: true }); else empty = false; }
      else if (keep(r)) empty = false;
      else await d.removeEntry(name);
    }
    return empty;
  }
  writable();
  const d = await dirIn(await root(), [saveDir]);
  if (d) await walk(d, '');
}

/** A small file beside the save dirs (in none: no backup, cloud save or restore touches it), or null. */
export async function readBeside(name: string): Promise<string | null> { return readIn(await root(), name, f => f.text()); }
export async function writeBeside(name: string, text: string): Promise<void> {
  writable();
  const w = await (await (await root()).getFileHandle(name, { create: true })).createWritable();
  await w.write(text); await w.close();
}

/** what checkSaves found: after how many tries, and (not ok) the step and the error of the last one */
export interface SavesCheck { ok: boolean; tries: number; step?: 'list' | 'read' | 'write'; error?: unknown }
/** how long checkSaves asks at most, all its tries together: a call the browser never answers is a failed check */
export const CHECK_MS = 8000;
/** the files checkSaves writes and removes beside the save folder (in none: no listing, backup or cloud save sees them):
 *  a new name each try, as one left by a failed try may stay broken in a browser whose storage was (Firefox's "Entry
 *  not found"), and would fail every check after it */
const checkPrefix = (saveDir: string) => `${saveDir}~check`;
const checkFile = (saveDir: string) => `${checkPrefix(saveDir)}-${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
/** the names under the save folder, listed (no file read: a healthy folder of 300 files took Firefox 0.4-1.7 s to read
 *  every file's size); a folder gone meanwhile is left out, any other error thrown (missing, found) */
async function listNames(saveDir: string): Promise<number> {
  async function walk(parent: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, name: string, d: FileSystemDirectoryHandle): Promise<number> {
    let n = 0;
    try {
      for await (const [k, h] of d.entries())
        n += h.kind === 'directory' ? await walk(d, k, h as FileSystemDirectoryHandle) : 1;
    } catch (e) { if (missing(e) && !await found(parent, name, 'directory')) return 0; throw e; }
    return n;
  }
  const r = await root(), top = await dirIn(r, [saveDir]);
  return top ? walk(r, saveDir, top) : 0;
}

/**
 * Whether the save folder answers as one that works, before a game starts on it: its names listed, settings.ini and
 * registry.txt read, and a small file written and removed beside it (in the storage's top folder, not in the save
 * folder: nothing of the save folder is written or removed; those an earlier check left there go first).  One that does not is asked again after each
 * of waits, every handle fresh from navigator.storage (a lock another tab or a closing game still holds, a browser busy
 * for a moment); ok after any try.  All of it within limitMs: a call the browser never answers is a failed check
 * (TimeoutError).  Not there is no failure (a new player's folder), nor a full disk on the write (QuotaExceededError:
 * the game's own saves say that; a browser that says UnknownError for one fails the check, and the page's message says
 * to look at the disk's free space).
 * Firefox 159 on a Mac (Discord 2026-11-04) answered "UnknownError: Unknown failure" to every call there, after a
 * Firefox restart too: Play stopped with that bare error.  The day before, in the game that ran last, every file new to
 * its storage could not be opened ("NotFoundError: Entry not found"), so none of that game's new files was written.
 */
export async function checkSaves(saveDir: string, waits: number[] = [300, 1000, 2500],
    sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>(r => setTimeout(r, ms)), limitMs = CHECK_MS): Promise<SavesCheck> {
  const until = Date.now() + limitMs;
  for (let i = 0; ; i++) {
    let step: SavesCheck['step'] = 'list';
    const once = (async () => {
      await listNames(saveDir);
      step = 'read';
      for (const f of ['settings.ini', 'registry.txt']) await readText(saveDir, f);
      step = 'write';
      try {
        const r = await root(), name = checkFile(saveDir);
        // (what earlier checks left: gone if it goes; one that does not is left, and this check writes beside it)
        try {
          const old: string[] = [];
          const pre = checkPrefix(saveDir);
          for await (const k of (r as any).keys() as AsyncIterable<string>) if (k === pre || k.startsWith(`${pre}-`)) old.push(k);
          for (const k of old) await r.removeEntry(k).catch(() => {});
        } catch { /* not listed: left */ }
        const w = await (await r.getFileHandle(name, { create: true })).createWritable();
        await w.write('ok'); await w.close();
        await r.removeEntry(name).catch(() => {});
      } catch (e) { if ((e as DOMException)?.name !== 'QuotaExceededError') throw e; }
    })();
    once.catch(() => {});                              // (a try that answers after its time is up: no one waits for it)
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const late = new Promise<'late'>(r => { timer = setTimeout(() => r('late'), Math.max(0, until - Date.now())); });
    try {
      if (await Promise.race([once.then(() => 'done' as const), late]) === 'late')
        return { ok: false, tries: i + 1, step, error: new DOMException(`no answer in ${limitMs / 1000} s`, 'TimeoutError') };
      return { ok: true, tries: i + 1 };
    } catch (error) {
      if (i >= waits.length || Date.now() + waits[i] >= until) return { ok: false, tries: i + 1, step, error };
    } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
    await sleep(waits[i]);
  }
}

export async function removeSaveDir(saveDir: string): Promise<void> {
  writable();
  try { await (await root()).removeEntry(saveDir, { recursive: true }); } catch { /* absent */ }
}

export interface Profile { name: string; size: number; mtime: number; files: number }

/**
 * Profiles the game saved: "NFS Underground 2/<NAME>/<NAME>" (54,966 bytes
 * each).  A folder without its file is skipped:
 * the game would not list it either.  So are the cover shoots' saves beside
 * them ("<NAME> DVD 1", profile.ts coverOf): they belong to their profile.
 */
export async function listProfiles(saveDir: string, files?: Entry[]): Promise<Profile[]> {
  files ??= await listFiles(saveDir);
  const by = new Map<string, Profile>();
  for (const f of files) {
    const p = f.path.split('/');
    if (p.length < 3 || p[0] !== PROFILES_DIR || coverOf(p[1])) continue;
    const name = p[1];
    const pr = by.get(name) ?? { name, size: 0, mtime: 0, files: 0 };
    pr.files++;
    if (p.length === 3 && p[2].toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()) { pr.size = f.size; pr.mtime = f.mtime; }
    by.set(name, pr);
  }
  return [...by.values()].filter(p => p.size > 0).sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime);
}

/**
 * Game data the browser keeps locally (OPFS "cache/", host/datacache.ts), of
 * any version of the server's files: every file there is sparse, with a
 * ".have" map of one byte per 1 MiB block, so the cached amount is the number
 * of blocks present (the last block of a file may be shorter; the file size
 * bounds it).
 */
export async function cacheBytes(): Promise<{ bytes: number; files: number }> {
  let bytes = 0, files = 0;
  try {
    const d = await (await root()).getDirectoryHandle(CACHE_DIR);
    for await (const [name, h] of d.entries()) {
      if (h.kind !== 'file' || !name.endsWith('.have')) continue;
      const have = new Uint8Array(await (await (h as FileSystemFileHandle).getFile()).arrayBuffer());
      let n = 0; for (const b of have) n += b ? 1 : 0;
      if (!n) continue;
      let size = n * BLOCK;
      try { size = Math.min(size, (await (await d.getFileHandle(name.slice(0, -5))).getFile()).size); } catch { /* data file gone */ }
      bytes += size; files++;
    }
  } catch { /* no cache yet */ }
  return { bytes, files };
}

export async function clearCache(): Promise<void> {
  try { await (await root()).removeEntry(CACHE_DIR, { recursive: true }); } catch { /* absent */ }
}

// Limits for a restore, judged by each entry's declared size before anything is
// inflated, and held while inflating (zip.ts stops an entry at its declared
// size: a 4 MB zip that declares 100 bytes and inflates to 4 GB is refused
// after 100, the audit's PAGE-4).  Screenshots (F12, about 24 MB each at this Mac's native size) have
// their own budget, so however many a backup holds they never crowd out the
// profiles, registry.txt or settings.ini (phase-1 app review, finding 5).
const MAX_ENTRY = 64 << 20, MAX_SHOTS = 512 << 20, MAX_OTHER = 256 << 20;
export { isScreenshot };

/**
 * What a backup's settings.ini would change that a player should know before restoring it: the network
 * (free roam on, the name shown to others), variables set by their own names, and lines the page ignores
 * (files and automation are the page's own).  [] when it holds none of these.
 */
export function settingsWarnings(text: string): string[] {
  const r = resolveEnv(text, {}, {});
  const set = (k: string) => r.source[k] === 'settings.ini';
  const out: string[] = [];
  const net = Object.keys(r.env).filter(k => set(k) && /^NFSU2_(ROAM|NET|LAN)/.test(k)).map(k => `${k}=${r.env[k]}`);
  if (set('NFSU2_ROAM') && parseInt(r.env.NFSU2_ROAM, 10) === 1)
    out.push(set('NFSU2_ROAM_NAME') ? t('It turns on free-roam multiplayer: your profile name (shown as "{name}"), car and position go to the other players on this server.', { name: r.env.NFSU2_ROAM_NAME })
      : t('It turns on free-roam multiplayer: your profile name, car and position go to the other players on this server.'));
  if (net.length) out.push(t('Network settings: {list}', { list: net.join(', ') }));
  const raw = r.other.filter(o => !o.refused).map(o => `${o.key} = ${o.value}`);
  if (raw.length) out.push(t('Variables set by their own names: {list}', { list: raw.slice(0, 6).join(', ') + (raw.length > 6 ? ' …' : '') }));
  const ignored = r.other.filter(o => o.refused === 'only the page sets it').map(o => o.key);
  if (ignored.length) out.push(t('Ignored, only the page sets them: {list}', { list: ignored.join(', ') }));
  return out;
}

/** A path from a backup that may be written into the save overlay, or null. */
export function safeEntryPath(name: string): string | null { return entryPath(name, false); }
/**
 * safeEntryPath's rules; loose: control characters but NUL let through.  A profile the game named with heap bytes (a
 * failed cover shoot's save before 2e9ecee, 2026-10-27) lives in a folder of them (0x1D, 0x1E), which the browser
 * keeps: a restore takes it in loose, and renames it (backupIn, profilesIn: fixedName) before finalPaths checks the
 * paths it writes as safeEntryPath does.
 */
function entryPath(name: string, loose: boolean): string | null {
  const n = name.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (n.startsWith('/') || /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(n)) return null;
  const parts = n.split('/').filter(p => p !== '' && p !== '.');
  if (!parts.length || parts.some(p => p === '..' || p.length > 255 || (loose ? /\x00/ : /[\x00-\x1f]/).test(p))) return null;
  return parts.join('/');
}
/** A restore's entries whose path, as it would be written, safeEntryPath does not take (control characters left in
 *  what the restore did not rename): skipped. */
function finalPaths(r: Restore): Restore {
  const ok: Restore['entries'] = [];
  for (const e of r.entries) if (safeEntryPath(e.path) === e.path) ok.push(e); else r.skipped.push(e.path);
  r.entries = ok;
  return r;
}

export async function exportSaves(saveDir: string): Promise<{ zip: Uint8Array; files: number; name: string; shotBytes: number }> {
  const files = await listFiles(saveDir);
  const entries: ZipEntry[] = [];
  let shotBytes = 0;
  for (const f of files) {
    if (f.path === 'autotest-script.txt') continue;          // a test run's input script, not a save
    const data = await readBytes(saveDir, f.path);
    if (isScreenshot(f.path)) shotBytes += data.length;
    entries.push({ name: f.path, data, mtime: f.mtime });
  }
  return { zip: zip(entries), files: entries.length, name: `nfsu2-saves-${stamp()}.zip`, shotBytes };
}

export interface Restore {
  /**
   * 'backup': a backup of this page's (registry.txt or settings.ini at its top), which replaces everything here;
   * 'profiles': profiles alone, as the PC game keeps them (its NFS Underground 2 folder zipped in any shape, or one
   * profile's file), added beside the ones here (addProfiles)
   */
  kind: 'backup' | 'profiles';
  entries: { path: string; data: Uint8Array; mtime?: number }[];
  profiles: string[];
  /** entries left out: unsafe names, over the size limits, or (profiles) none of a profile's */
  skipped: string[];
  /** profile files the game would not load (profile.ts profileName), left out with their cover shoots */
  refused: { name: string; why: string }[];
  /** profiles with cars a mod added (profile.ts modCars), restored with a warning */
  modded: string[];
  /** profiles a save editor changed (profile.ts profileName's edited): sealed again, restored with a warning */
  edited: string[];
  /** profiles whose only fault was the name inside (not one the game's field makes, or not their file's): they come in
   *  as `to` (profile.ts fixedName), that name written inside and their checksums made again, with a note; name: as
   *  found (their folder's, or their own file's) */
  repaired: { name: string; to: string }[];
}

export type FileIn = { path: string; data: Uint8Array; mtime?: number };
const lower = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase();

/** A zip of this page's backup or of the PC game's profiles, or a profile's own file (fileName: its name, for the
 *  messages); here: the profiles in this browser, whose names a profile added beside them with its name mended does not take.
 *  A name the game's own box does not make (isGivenName: a longer one from NFSU2 Extra Options, or another browser's) is
 *  mended, so the game lists it; cloud saves keep every name (readVault). */
export async function readBackup(buf: Uint8Array, fileName = 'the file', here: string[] = []): Promise<Restore> {
  if (isProfileFile(buf)) return finalPaths(profilesIn([{ path: fileName, data: buf }], [], here, isGivenName));
  // a backup zipped from a folder ("saves/NFS Underground 2/...") still restores: strip one common top folder
  const listed = await listZip(buf);
  const names = listed.map(n => entryPath(n, true)).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
  const top = names.length && names.every(n => n.includes('/') && n.split('/')[0] === names[0].split('/')[0]) &&
    !names.some(n => n.startsWith(PROFILES_DIR + '/')) ? names[0].split('/')[0] + '/' : '';
  const local = (name: string) => { let p = entryPath(name, true); if (p && top && p.startsWith(top)) p = p.slice(top.length); return p; };
  let shots = 0, other = 0;
  const refused: string[] = [];
  const all = await unzip(buf, (name, size) => {
    const p = local(name);
    if (!p || size > MAX_ENTRY) return false;
    if (isScreenshot(p)) return (shots += size) <= MAX_SHOTS || ((shots -= size), false);
    return (other += size) <= MAX_OTHER || ((other -= size), false);
  }, refused);
  const files = all.map(e => ({ path: local(e.name)!, data: e.data, mtime: e.mtime }));
  return finalPaths(files.some(e => e.path === 'registry.txt' || e.path === 'settings.ini') ? backupIn(files, refused, isGivenName) : profilesIn(files, refused, here, isGivenName));
}

/**
 * A backup of this page's: every entry, but a profile the game would not load and its cover shoots.  A profile whose
 * only fault is the name inside (not one `takes`, or not its folder's) comes in under fixedName's name, with its
 * folder's other files and its cover shoots.
 */
function backupIn(files: FileIn[], skipped: string[], takes: (name: string) => boolean = isProfileName): Restore {
  const out: Restore = { kind: 'backup', entries: [], profiles: [], skipped, refused: [], modded: [], edited: [], repaired: [] };
  // by each profile's folder as it is (two may differ in case only: each its own)
  const gone = new Set<string>(), moved = new Map<string, string>();
  const mains = files.filter(e => { const s = e.path.split('/'); return s.length === 3 && s[0] === PROFILES_DIR && lower(s[2]) === lower(s[1]) && !coverOf(s[1]); });
  const mend: { e: FileIn; folder: string; inside: string; edited: boolean }[] = [];
  const garageOf = (folder: string) => files.find(f => lower(f.path) === lower(`${PROFILES_DIR}/${folder}/GARAGE.DAT`))?.data;
  for (const e of mains) {
    const folder = e.path.split('/')[1], r = profileInside(e.data);
    if ('bad' in r) { out.refused.push({ name: folder, why: r.bad }); gone.add(folder); continue; }
    if (!takes(r.inside) || lower(r.inside) !== lower(folder)) { mend.push({ e, folder, inside: r.inside, edited: r.edited }); continue; }
    out.profiles.push(folder);
    if (r.edited) { out.edited.push(folder); e.data = sealed(e.data); }
    if (modCars(e.data) || garageModCars(garageOf(folder))) out.modded.push(folder);
  }
  // the names taken: every folder of the profiles' (a profile's, a cover shoot's profile, files without a profile:
  // an orphan GARAGE.DAT), but those of the profiles mended
  const mending = new Set(mend.map(m => m.folder)), taken = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of files) {
    const s = e.path.split('/');
    if (s.length < 3 || s[0] !== PROFILES_DIR) continue;
    const of = coverOf(s[1])?.profile ?? s[1];
    if (!mending.has(of)) taken.add(lower(of));
  }
  for (const { e, folder, inside, edited } of mend) {
    const to = fixedName(folder, inside, taken);
    taken.add(lower(to)); moved.set(folder, to);
    e.data = withName(e.data, to);
    out.profiles.push(to); out.repaired.push({ name: folder, to });
    if (edited) out.edited.push(to);
    if (modCars(e.data) || garageModCars(garageOf(folder))) out.modded.push(to);
  }
  out.entries = files.flatMap(e => {
    const s = e.path.split('/');
    if (s.length < 3 || s[0] !== PROFILES_DIR) return [e];
    const c = coverOf(s[1]), of = c?.profile ?? s[1];
    if (gone.has(of)) return [];
    const to = moved.get(of);
    if (to === undefined) return [e];
    // a mended profile's folder and cover shoots under its new name, each folder's own file named as it
    const folder = c ? `${to} ${c.cover}` : to;
    return [{ ...e, path: [PROFILES_DIR, folder, ...s.length === 3 && lower(s[2]) === lower(s[1]) ? [folder] : s.slice(2)].join('/') }];
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Profiles found by what they hold, wherever they are in the zip: each one the game
 * would load goes to "NFS Underground 2/<the name inside>/", and its cover shoots
 * ("<NAME> DVD 1/<NAME> DVD 1" anywhere) beside it.  Everything else is left out.
 * One whose only fault is the name inside (one the game's field does not make) comes
 * in under fixedName's name, which neither those nor the profiles here have.
 */
function profilesIn(files: FileIn[], skipped: string[], here: string[] = [], takes: (name: string) => boolean = isProfileName): Restore {
  const out: Restore = { kind: 'profiles', entries: [], profiles: [], skipped, refused: [], modded: [], edited: [], repaired: [] };
  const found = new Map<string, FileIn & { name: string; edited: boolean; mended?: boolean }>();
  const mend: (FileIn & { own: string; inside: string; edited: boolean })[] = [];
  const covers: (FileIn & { profile: string; cover: string })[] = [];
  // the files a profile's folder has beside it (this page's: slots 6-10, the parts kept beside it), taken with it
  const sides: (FileIn & { dir: string; name: string })[] = [];
  const dirOf = (path: string) => lower(path.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/'));
  for (const e of files) {
    const s = e.path.split('/'), file = s[s.length - 1], folder = s.length > 1 ? s[s.length - 2] : '';
    const side = SIDE_FILES.find(n => lower(n) === lower(file));
    if (side && s.length > 1) { sides.push({ ...e, dir: dirOf(e.path), name: side }); continue; }
    const c = coverOf(file);                            // named as its folder; "20CM" too, but no profile
    if (c) { covers.push({ ...e, ...c }); continue; }
    if (!isProfileFile(e.data)) { out.skipped.push(e.path); continue; }
    const r = profileInside(e.data);
    if ('bad' in r) out.refused.push({ name: folder || file, why: r.bad });
    else if (!takes(r.inside)) mend.push({ ...e, own: file, inside: r.inside, edited: r.edited });
    else if (found.has(lower(r.inside))) out.skipped.push(e.path);          // a second copy of one
    else found.set(lower(r.inside), { ...e, name: r.inside, edited: r.edited });
  }
  // the mended ones' names: none of the others', none here (an added profile of a name here replaces it)
  const taken = new Set([...found.keys(), ...here.map(lower)]), was = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const m of mend) {
    const to = fixedName(m.own, m.inside, taken);
    taken.add(lower(to)); was.set(lower(m.own), lower(to));
    found.set(lower(to), { ...m, name: to, data: withName(m.data, to), mended: true });
    out.repaired.push({ name: m.own, to });
  }
  const took = new Set<FileIn>();
  for (const p of found.values()) {
    out.entries.push({ path: `${PROFILES_DIR}/${p.name}/${p.name}`, data: p.edited && !p.mended ? sealed(p.data) : p.data, mtime: p.mtime });
    out.profiles.push(p.name);
    if (p.edited) out.edited.push(p.name);
    // its folder's GARAGE.DAT and MODPARTS.DAT (a profile alone, at the zip's top or picked as a file: none)
    const dir = p.path.includes('/') ? dirOf(p.path) : null, mine = sides.filter(f => dir !== null && f.dir === dir);
    for (const f of mine) { out.entries.push({ path: `${PROFILES_DIR}/${p.name}/${f.name}`, data: f.data, mtime: f.mtime }); took.add(f); }
    if (modCars(p.data) || garageModCars(mine.find(f => f.name === 'GARAGE.DAT')?.data)) out.modded.push(p.name);
  }
  for (const f of sides) if (!took.has(f)) out.skipped.push(f.path);
  for (const c of covers) {
    const p = found.get(lower(c.profile)) ?? found.get(was.get(lower(c.profile)) ?? '');
    if (!p) { out.skipped.push(c.path); continue; }
    const folder = `${p.name} ${c.cover}`;
    out.entries.push({ path: `${PROFILES_DIR}/${folder}/${folder}`, data: c.data, mtime: c.mtime });
  }
  return out;
}

/** the files beside a profile in its folder that come with it from a zip of the PC game's folder (a page's save folder
 *  copied there, played there): slots 6-10 (runtime/garage.c) and the parts kept beside it (runtime/modpacks.c) */
const SIDE_FILES = ['GARAGE.DAT', 'MODPARTS.DAT'];

/** the restores of the save folder, one at a time: a backup's restore and a cloud take at once pruned what the other
 *  wrote */
let writer: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
export function oneWriter<T>(job: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const p = writer.then(job, job);
  writer = p.catch(() => {});
  return p;
}
/** every restore asked for so far has ended (a game starts after them: shell.ts startGame, SavesPanel.settled) */
export const writesDone = (): Promise<void> => writer.then(() => {});

/** A backup of this page's in place of everything here: its files written all or none (savefs.ts writeTogether: a write
 *  that fails, the browser's storage full, leaves the saves here as they were), then what it does not have goes. */
export function restoreSaves(saveDir: string, r: Restore): Promise<void> {
  return oneWriter(async () => {
    await writeTogether(saveDir, r.entries);
    const theirs = new Set(r.entries.map(e => e.path));
    await pruneSaveDir(saveDir, path => theirs.has(path));
  });
}

/**
 * A keyphrase's saves (vault.ts kept(): a zip of the save folder but the screenshots, the covers, the graphics options,
 * the LAN server's file and the device's own settings) as a backup of this page's, whatever is at their top:
 * restoreVault puts them in place of everything here.  The same checks as a backup's; what a keyphrase does not keep is
 * left out (in one sent before 2026-10-25: covers, black ones as they were then, and the other browser's graphics
 * options and device settings; before 2026-10-28: the other browser's gamefile.bin).
 */
export async function readVault(buf: Uint8Array): Promise<Restore> {
  const refused: string[] = [];
  let other = 0;
  const all = await unzip(buf, (name, size) => {
    const p = entryPath(name, true);
    return !!p && !isScreenshot(p) && size <= MAX_ENTRY && ((other += size) <= MAX_OTHER || ((other -= size), false));
  }, refused);
  const files = all.map(e => ({ path: entryPath(e.name, true)!, data: e.data, mtime: e.mtime }));
  return finalPaths(backupIn(kept(files), refused));
}

/**
 * The profiles of a keyphrase's version (its files as vault.ts kept() has them) that readVault would leave out (another
 * version's, a path it cannot write): a version taken by itself (VaultSync.pull) must not lose one, so the player is
 * asked instead.  Their folders.
 */
export function leftOut(files: FileIn[]): string[] {
  const r = restoredOf(files);
  const came = new Set([...r.profiles, ...r.repaired.map(x => x.name)]);
  return files.map(f => f.path.split('/'))
    .filter(s => s.length === 3 && s[0] === PROFILES_DIR && lower(s[1]) === lower(s[2]) && !coverOf(s[1]) && !came.has(s[1])).map(s => s[1]);
}

/** what a restore makes of a version's files (readVault's paths, as restoreVault writes them) */
function restoredOf(files: FileIn[]) {
  const loose = files.flatMap(f => { const p = entryPath(f.path, true); return p ? [{ ...f, path: p }] : []; });
  return finalPaths(backupIn(loose, []));
}
/** The profiles a restore of a version's files brings, by the names they come in under (a broken name mended). */
export function profilesComing(files: FileIn[]): string[] { return restoredOf(files).profiles; }

/**
 * The profiles here that a version brings under another name, each with that name: renamed in another browser
 * (profile.ts renameProfile) or mended there by a page of before 2026-11 (mendedBefore: it renamed a name of up to 15
 * with spaces), so that this browser's own covers of it (a keyphrase keeps none) go with it instead of going.  Of the
 * profiles here with covers that the version does not have, each goes with one it has that is not here: the same
 * career whatever the name (sameCareer: renamed, not played since); and on a take by itself of the link's own newer
 * version (auto), the name an older page makes of it, when exactly one of those here and one of the version's fit
 * each other (two names here with the same first 7 letters and digits: the older page's order decides, unknown here).
 * Nothing else: careers of different players hold mostly the same bytes, so a profile deleted there, one played
 * since its rename there, or another keyphrase's (Load) never takes a cover here; those go, as they did.
 */
async function renamedHere(saveDir: string, here: { path: string }[], r: Restore, stays: Set<string>, auto: boolean): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const out = new Map<string, string>(), names = new Set(r.profiles.map(lower));
  const mains = here.map(f => f.path.split('/')).filter(s => s.length === 3 && s[0] === PROFILES_DIR && lower(s[1]) === lower(s[2]) && !coverOf(s[1]));
  const withCovers = new Set(here.map(f => coverOf(f.path.split('/')[1] ?? '')?.profile).filter((p): p is string => !!p).map(lower));
  const gone = mains.filter(s => !names.has(lower(s[1])) && !stays.has(s[1]));
  const hereNames = new Set(mains.map(s => lower(s[1])));
  const fresh = r.profiles.filter(p => !hereNames.has(lower(p)));
  if (!gone.some(s => withCovers.has(lower(s[1]))) || !fresh.length) return out;
  const entry = (p: string) => r.entries.find(e => e.path === `${PROFILES_DIR}/${p}/${p}`)?.data;
  const left = new Set(fresh);
  const pair = (g: string, p: string) => { out.set(g, p); left.delete(p); };
  for (const s of gone) {                                   // the same career
    const mine = await readBytes(saveDir, s.join('/')).catch(() => null);
    const p = mine && [...left].find(q => { const d = entry(q); return !!d && sameCareer(mine, d); });
    if (p) pair(s[1], p);
  }
  if (auto) for (const s of gone) {                         // an older page's mend, when nothing else fits it either way
    if (out.has(s[1])) continue;
    const fits = [...left].filter(q => mendedBefore(s[1], q));
    if (fits.length === 1 && gone.filter(g => !out.has(g[1]) && mendedBefore(g[1], fits[0])).length === 1) pair(s[1], fits[0]);
  }
  for (const g of [...out.keys()]) if (!withCovers.has(lower(g))) out.delete(g);
  return out;
}

/**
 * readVault's saves in place of the ones here: everything goes but what a keyphrase does not keep (vault.ts kept()):
 * the screenshots (and a test's input script), the DVD and magazine covers of the profiles they bring (those of a
 * profile whose name the restore mends, or that the version brings under another name (renamedHere), under its new
 * name), the game's graphics options, the LAN server's file, and the device's own settings, which settings.ini keeps
 * from the one here (settings.ts withDevice).  Their files are written first, then what they replace goes: a write
 * that fails (the browser's storage full) leaves the saves here.  auto: a take by itself of the link's newer version
 * (VaultSync.pull, the one that passes still), not a keyphrase loaded, Use the cloud's or Put back.
 */
export function restoreVault(saveDir: string, r: Restore, still?: () => Promise<boolean>, beside: BesideFile[] = [], auto = still !== undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  return oneWriter(async () => {
    if (still && !await still()) return false;             // (the saves here changed since it was decided: VaultSync.take)
    const names = new Set(r.profiles.map(lower)), dec = new TextDecoder(), mended = new Map(r.repaired.map(x => [x.name, x.to]));
    const ini = r.entries.find(e => e.path === 'settings.ini');
    const settings = withDevice(ini ? dec.decode(ini.data) : null, await readText(saveDir, 'settings.ini'));
    const here = await listFiles(saveDir), files: FileIn[] = [];
    // a profile it leaves out (one this game cannot load: 'drops') stays here, its covers too
    const stays = new Set(r.refused.map(x => x.name));
    for (const p of r.skipped) { const s = p.split('/'); if (s.length === 3 && s[0] === PROFILES_DIR && lower(s[1]) === lower(s[2])) stays.add(s[1]); }
    for (const [from, to] of await renamedHere(saveDir, here, r, stays, auto)) if (!mended.has(from)) mended.set(from, to);
    // every folder here and of the version: a cover moved under a mended profile's name takes the next free number
    const folders = new Set([...here.map(f => f.path), ...r.entries.map(e => e.path)].map(p => p.split('/'))
      .filter(s => s.length >= 3 && s[0] === PROFILES_DIR).map(s => s[1]));
    for (const f of here) {                                  // the covers here of a profile it mends or renames, renamed
      const s = f.path.split('/'), c = s.length === 3 && s[0] === PROFILES_DIR ? coverOf(s[1]) : null, to = c && mended.get(c.profile);
      if (!c || !to) continue;
      const [kind, num] = [c.cover.replace(/ \d+$/, ''), +c.cover.replace(/^\D+/, '')];
      let n = num, folder = `${to} ${kind} ${n}`;
      while (folders.has(folder)) folder = `${to} ${kind} ${++n}`;
      folders.add(folder);
      files.push({ path: `${PROFILES_DIR}/${folder}/${lower(s[2]) === lower(s[1]) ? folder : s[2]}`, data: await readBytes(saveDir, f.path) });
    }
    files.push(...r.entries.filter(e => e !== ini));
    if (settings !== null) files.push({ path: 'settings.ini', data: new TextEncoder().encode(settings) });
    await writeTogether(saveDir, files, beside);
    // what it replaces goes, but what stays (above)
    const written = new Set(files.map(f => f.path));
    await pruneSaveDir(saveDir, path => {
      const s = path.split('/'), of = s.length >= 3 && s[0] === PROFILES_DIR ? coverOf(s[1])?.profile ?? s[1] : null;
      return written.has(path) || isScreenshot(path) || path === 'autotest-script.txt' || path === 'registry.txt' || path === GAMEFILE ||
        (of !== null && stays.has(of)) || (isCover(path) && names.has(lower(coverOf(s[1])!.profile)));
    });
    return true;
  });
}

/** The save folder as a game's start has it, for refillSaves: all but the screenshots, the covers (1 MB each) and a
 *  test's input script; a player's is some 100 KB. */
export async function snapshotSaves(saveDir: string): Promise<FileIn[]> {
  const out: FileIn[] = [];
  for (const f of await listFiles(saveDir))
    if (snapshotted(f.path) && f.size <= MAX_ENTRY) out.push({ path: f.path, data: await readBytes(saveDir, f.path), mtime: f.mtime });
  return out;
}
/** what a snapshotSaves keeps: not the screenshots, the covers, a test's input script, nor a file written to be renamed
 *  (registry.txt.tmp: the runtime's registry, renamed to registry.txt once written) */
const snapshotted = (path: string) => !isScreenshot(path) && !isCover(path) && path !== 'autotest-script.txt' && !/\.tmp$/i.test(path);

/** A file the game (or the page) wrote during the game into a snapshotSaves of its start, so the start's saves that
 *  come back after the browser deleted the folder are as the game last saved them (shell.ts onSaved). */
export async function snapshotFile(start: FileIn[], saveDir: string, path: string, data?: Uint8Array) {
  if (!snapshotted(path)) return;
  const d = data ?? await readBytes(saveDir, path).catch(() => null);
  if (!d || d.length > MAX_ENTRY) return;
  const i = start.findIndex(f => f.path === path), f = { path, data: d, mtime: Date.now() };
  if (i >= 0) start[i] = f; else start.push(f);
}

/**
 * The saves back in a save folder the browser deleted during a game (shell.ts saveGone, io-worker.ts recover): cloud,
 * a keyphrase's version (readVault's entries), with every file of start (the folder as the game's start had it,
 * snapshotSaves) it lacks, this device's settings in settings.ini among them; without cloud saves, start.  A file the
 * folder has already stays (the game wrote it since: the newest), looked for again just before each write.  A write
 * that fails is tried once more after the others; failed: those that failed again (none left half there).
 */
export async function refillSaves(fs: { writeIfAbsent(path: string, data: Uint8Array): Promise<boolean> }, cloud: FileIn[] | null,
    start: FileIn[]): Promise<{ written: number; failed: { path: string; error: unknown }[] }> {
  const files: FileIn[] = [];
  if (cloud) {
    const dec = new TextDecoder(), ini = cloud.find(e => e.path === 'settings.ini'), mine = start.find(e => e.path === 'settings.ini');
    const settings = withDevice(ini ? dec.decode(ini.data) : null, mine ? dec.decode(mine.data) : null);
    files.push(...cloud.filter(e => e !== ini));
    if (settings !== null) files.push({ path: 'settings.ini', data: new TextEncoder().encode(settings) });
    const have = new Set(files.map(f => f.path));
    files.push(...start.filter(f => !have.has(f.path)));
  } else files.push(...start);
  let written = 0, again: FileIn[] = [];
  const failed: { path: string; error: unknown }[] = [];
  for (const round of [1, 2]) {
    const todo = round === 1 ? files : again;
    again = [];
    for (const f of todo)
      try { if (await fs.writeIfAbsent(f.path, f.data)) written++; }
      catch (error) { if (round === 1) again.push(f); else failed.push({ path: f.path, error }); }
  }
  return { written, failed };
}

/** What a restore says of the profiles whose name inside it mends (Restore.repaired), one line each. */
export function repairNotes(r: Pick<Restore, 'repaired'>): string[] {
  return r.repaired.map(x => t('{from}: its name inside was broken, so it comes in as {to}.', { from: x.name, to: x.to }));
}

/** What a restore's question says of its profiles' state: a name mended, changed by a save editor, mod cars, left out, skipped. */
function restoreNotes(r: Restore): string[] {
  const items: string[] = [...repairNotes(r)];
  const refused = r.refused.map(x => `${x.name}: ${x.why}`).join('; ');
  if (r.edited.length) items.push(tn(r.edited.length, '{names} was edited with a save editor: values the game wouldn\'t make can crash it or break the career.',
    '{names} were edited with a save editor: values the game wouldn\'t make can crash it or break the career.', { names: listOf(r.edited) }));
  if (r.modded.length) items.push(tn(r.modded.length, '{names} has cars from a modded game: here they show as stock cars, and your save keeps them as they are unless you change them here.',
    '{names} have cars from a modded game: here they show as stock cars, and your save keeps them as they are unless you change them here.', { names: listOf(r.modded) }));
  if (refused) items.push(tn(r.refused.length, 'Left out, as the game would not load it: {list}.', 'Left out, as the game would not load them: {list}.', { list: refused }));
  const skipped = r.skipped.slice(0, 3).join(', ') + (r.skipped.length > 3 ? ' …' : '');
  if (r.skipped.length) items.push(r.kind === 'profiles' ? tn(r.skipped.length, '{n} other file is left out: {list}', '{n} other files are left out: {list}', { list: skipped })
    : tn(r.skipped.length, '{n} entry is skipped (an unsafe name, or over the size limits): {list}', '{n} entries are skipped (unsafe names, or over the size limits): {list}', { list: skipped }));
  return items;
}

/** What a backup's restore brings (or a keyphrase's, vault-ui.ts: the game's options stay), its profiles, the game's
 *  options, settings.ini, restoreNotes. */
export function backupItems(r: Restore, vault = false): string[] {
  const ini = r.entries.find(e => e.path === 'settings.ini');
  const warn = ini ? settingsWarnings(new TextDecoder().decode(ini.data)) : [];
  return [
    r.profiles.length ? t('Profiles: {names}', { names: r.profiles.join(', ') }) : t('No profiles'),
    ...vault ? [] : [r.entries.some(e => e.path === 'registry.txt') ? t('The game\'s options (registry.txt)') : t('No registry.txt: the next launch starts with fresh game options')],
    ini ? (warn.length ? `settings.ini. ${warn.join(' ')}` : 'settings.ini') : t('No settings.ini: the defaults apply'),
    ...restoreNotes(r),
  ];
}

/**
 * Add the profiles of a Restore of kind 'profiles'.  A profile of the same name here (in
 * any case: the I/O worker finds names so) goes, with its cover shoots; nothing else
 * changes.  The new folders are written before the old ones go.  Their names leave
 * AUTOSAVE_SEEN, so the page's Autosave comes to them as to new profiles.
 */
export function addProfiles(fs: RenameFiles, r: Restore): Promise<void> {
  return oneWriter(() => addProfilesNow(fs, r));
}
async function addProfilesNow(fs: RenameFiles, r: Restore) {
  const names = new Set(r.profiles.map(lower));
  const written = new Set(r.entries.map(e => e.path.split('/')[1]));
  const paths = new Set(r.entries.map(e => e.path));
  const folderOf = (path: string) => lower(path.split('/').slice(0, 2).join('/'));
  // the folders whose MODPARTS.DAT the restore brings (any case): the one here and its MODPARTS.NEW are the old one's
  const parts = new Set(r.entries.filter(e => lower(e.path.split('/')[2] ?? '') === 'modparts.dat').map(e => folderOf(e.path)));
  const old = new Set<string>(), stale: string[] = [];
  // (read before anything is written: one that does not read refuses the restore whole)
  const seen = await fs.readText(AUTOSAVE_SEEN);
  for (const { path } of await fs.listFiles()) {
    const s = path.split('/');
    if (s.length < 3 || s[0] !== PROFILES_DIR || !names.has(lower(coverOf(s[1])?.profile ?? s[1]))) continue;
    if (!written.has(s[1])) old.add(s[1]);
    // a folder of the same name, written over: the old profile's MPWINS.DAT goes too, if the new one brings none (the old
    // career's wins waiting for its garage would go to the new one's); its MODPARTS.DAT and MODPARTS.NEW stay unless the
    // restore brings its own (each part there is the car's of its fingerprint alone: a part of another car is not put
    // on), and a GARAGE.DAT has its fingerprint
    else if (!paths.has(path) && (lower(s[2]) === 'mpwins.dat' ||
      (['modparts.dat', 'modparts.new'].includes(lower(s[2])) && parts.has(folderOf(path))))) stale.push(path);
  }
  for (const e of r.entries) await fs.writeFile(e.path, e.data);
  for (const f of old) await fs.remove(`${PROFILES_DIR}/${f}`);
  for (const p of stale) await fs.remove(p);
  const kept = seen?.split('\n').filter(l => !names.has(lower(l.trim()))).join('\n');
  // (not written: the page's Autosave leaves these profiles' Save choice as it is; they are in either way)
  if (seen != null && kept !== seen) await fs.writeFile(AUTOSAVE_SEEN, kept!).catch(() => {});
}

/** "about 3 min left" */
function eta(s: number): string {
  if (!isFinite(s)) return '';
  if (s < 60) return t('less than a minute left');
  if (s < 3600) return t('about {n} min left', { n: Math.round(s / 60) });
  return t('about {n} h left', { n: (s / 3600).toFixed(1) });
}
const QUIT_TO_CHANGE = N('Quit the game (or close the other tab that runs it) to change the game data.');
const QUIT_TO_DELETE = N('Quit the game (or close the other tab that runs it) to delete a profile.');
const QUIT_TO_RENAME = N('Quit the game (or close the other tab that runs it) to rename a profile or restore a backup.');

export class SavesPanel {
  /** root: the Saves tab; dataPanel: Game data on this device */
  constructor(private root: HTMLElement, private dataPanel: HTMLElement, private deps: SavesDeps) {
    root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#export')!.onclick = () => void this.doExport();
    const inp = root.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('#import')!;
    inp.onchange = () => { const f = inp.files?.[0]; inp.value = ''; if (f) void this.doImport(f); };
    dataPanel.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#clear-cache')!.onclick = () => void this.doClearCache();
    dataPanel.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#fetch-all')!.onclick = () => void this.doDownload();
    this.shots = new ScreenshotsPart(root, { saveDir: deps.saveDir, confirm: deps.confirm, changed: () => void this.refresh(), say: text => this.msg(text) });
  }

  private shots: ScreenshotsPart;

  /** the section's messages, drawn again when the page's language changes (a Msg); said: which English text each says
   *  (the "quit the game first" ones, which go once the game ended) */
  private said = { saves: '', data: '' };
  private msg(s: string | Msg, en = '') { this.said.saves = en; live(this.root.querySelector('#saves-msg')!, typeof s === 'string' ? () => s : s); }
  private dataMsg(s: string | Msg, warn = false, en = '') {
    const m = this.dataPanel.querySelector('#data-msg')!;
    this.said.data = en; live(m, typeof s === 'string' ? () => s : s); m.classList.toggle('warn', warn);
  }

  /** the game data in this browser: of the server's files (null: their list did not load), and all that is kept */
  private data: { have: number; total: number } | null = null;
  private kept = { bytes: 0, files: 0 };
  private counted = 0;                     // the latest count wins (one may start while the data is deleted)
  private shownState: DownloadState = 'idle';
  private profiles: Profile[] = [];
  /** the profile whose name is being edited; focusName: whose Rename button gets the focus when the list is shown */
  private renaming: string | null = null;
  private focusName: string | null = null;
  /** what the section is writing into the saves (a rename, a restore): settled() waits for it */
  private writing: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();

  /** Resolves when the section writes nothing into the saves: a game starts after that. */
  settled(): Promise<void> { return Promise.all([this.writing.catch(() => {}), writesDone()]).then(() => {}); }
  private write<T>(job: Promise<T>): Promise<T> { this.writing = job; return job; }

  /** Show the profiles, the screenshots and the downloaded game data as they are now. */
  async refresh() {
    let files: Entry[];
    // a save folder that does not answer (savefs.ts missing): said, and what is shown stays (never "no profiles")
    try { files = await listFiles(this.deps.saveDir); }
    catch (e) { this.msg(() => t(UNREADABLE, { error: String(e) }), UNREADABLE); return; }
    if (this.said.saves === UNREADABLE) this.msg('');
    this.profiles = await listProfiles(this.deps.saveDir, files);
    this.shots.show(files.filter(f => isScreenshot(f.path)));
    this.showPlayed();
    const busy = this.deps.busy();
    // a name being typed stays as it is (the list is shown again when the edit ends)
    if (!this.profiles.some(p => p.name === this.renaming)) { this.renaming = null; this.showProfiles(); }
