    this.root.querySelector<HTMLLabelElement>('.file-btn')!.toggleAttribute('aria-disabled', busy);
    this.root.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('#import')!.disabled = busy;
    this.dataPanel.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#clear-cache')!.disabled = busy;
    if (busy) { this.msg(() => t(QUIT_TO_RENAME), QUIT_TO_RENAME); this.dataMsg(() => t(QUIT_TO_CHANGE), false, QUIT_TO_CHANGE); }
    else {
      if (this.said.saves === QUIT_TO_RENAME) this.msg('');
      if (this.said.data === QUIT_TO_CHANGE) this.dataMsg('');
    }
    this.root.dataset.files = String(files.length);
    if (this.deps.download.running) { this.showData(); return; }     // it counts as it goes
    const n = ++this.counted;
    const [kept, data] = await Promise.all([cacheBytes(), gameDataKept(this.deps.download.language(), this.deps.download.packs()).catch(() => null)]);
    if (n !== this.counted) return;
    this.kept = kept; this.data = data;
    this.showData();
  }

  /** the play counted in this browser (playtime.ts), beside the Profiles heading; nothing under a minute.  "At least" where the
   *  count began before it counted all play */
  private showPlayed() {
    const el = this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#played')!, ms = playedMs(), least = playedAtLeast();
    el.hidden = !playedText(ms);
    live(el, () => least ? t('at least {time} played', { time: playedText(ms) }) : t('{time} played', { time: playedText(ms) }));
  }

  /** The download's progress (Predownload's onChange), or what is kept when none runs. */
  showData(st: DownloadStatus = this.deps.download.status) {
    const active = st.state === 'running' || st.state === 'paused';
    if (active && st.total) this.data = { have: st.have, total: st.total };
    if (st.state !== this.shownState) {
      this.shownState = st.state;
      if (st.state === 'done') { this.data = { have: st.have, total: st.total }; this.dataMsg(() => t('The game data is on this device now.')); }
      if (st.state === 'error') { const e = st.error; this.dataMsg(() => t('Preloading stopped: {error}. What\'s done is kept.', { error: e ?? '' }), true); }
      if (!active) void this.refresh();                         // counted again; shown now with what is known
    }
    const info = this.dataPanel.querySelector('#cache-info')!, bar = this.dataPanel.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#data-bar')!;
    const fetchBtn = this.dataPanel.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#fetch-all')!;
    const d = this.data, rest = d ? d.total - d.have : 0;
    bar.hidden = !active;
    fetchBtn.disabled = this.deps.busy() && !active;
    if (active) {
      const f = d?.total ? d.have / d.total : 0;
      (bar.firstElementChild as HTMLElement).style.width = `${(f * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
      bar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(Math.floor(f * 100)));
      fetchBtn.hidden = false;
      fetchBtn.textContent = t('Stop preloading');
      fetchBtn.disabled = st.state === 'paused';
      info.textContent = st.state === 'paused' ? (d ? t('Preloading paused while you play: {have} of {total}.', { have: fmtBytes(d.have), total: fmtBytes(d.total) })
          : t('Preloading paused while you play.'))
        : !d ? t('Preloading: checking what\'s here already.')
        : t('Preloading: {have} of {total} ({pct} %){speed}. You can play meanwhile: it pauses while you do.',
          { have: fmtBytes(d.have), total: fmtBytes(d.total), pct: Math.floor(f * 100), speed: st.rate ? `, ${fmtBytes(st.rate)}/s, ${eta(rest / st.rate)}` : '' });
      return;
    }
    fetchBtn.textContent = d && d.have ? t('Preload the rest ({size})', { size: fmtBytes(rest) }) : d ? t('Preload the game data ({size})', { size: fmtBytes(d.total) }) : t('Preload the game data');
    fetchBtn.hidden = !!d && rest <= 0;
    if (d && rest <= 0)
      info.textContent = 'serviceWorker' in navigator
        ? t('All game data ({size}) is on this device; only the movies stream from the server. The game starts offline too, without movies.', { size: fmtBytes(d.total) })
        : t('All game data ({size}) is on this device; only the movies stream from the server.', { size: fmtBytes(d.total) });
    else if (d ? d.have : this.kept.bytes)
      info.textContent = (d ? t('{have} of {total} is on this device (movies not included).', { have: fmtBytes(d.have), total: fmtBytes(d.total) })
        : t('{have} is on this device.', { have: fmtBytes(this.kept.bytes) })) + ' ' +
        t('Preload the rest so loading never waits on the network.');
    else
      info.textContent = t('Nothing here yet: the game downloads data as it needs it. Preload it now so loading never waits on the network.');
  }

  /** The profiles, each with its Rename and Delete icons, or the name being edited; how to save in the game while
   *  there is none. */
  private showProfiles() {
    const ul = this.root.querySelector('#profiles')!, busy = this.deps.busy();
    let focus: HTMLElement | null = null;
    ul.replaceChildren();
    this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#save-how')!.hidden = this.profiles.length > 0;
    if (!this.profiles.length) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'); li.className = 'empty';
      li.textContent = t('No profiles yet. Create one in the game.');
      ul.append(li);
    }
    for (const p of this.profiles) {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      if (p.name === this.renaming) {
        const { form, input } = this.renameForm(p.name, busy);
        const help = document.createElement('p'); help.className = 'hint'; help.id = 'rename-help';
        help.textContent = t('Letters and digits, up to {n}, as in the game.', { n: GIVE_MAX });
        const m = document.createElement('p'); m.className = 'msg warn'; m.id = 'rename-msg'; m.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
        li.className = 'renaming'; li.append(form, help, m); ul.append(li);
        focus = input;
        continue;
      }
      const n = document.createElement('span'); n.className = 'name'; n.textContent = p.name;
      const m = document.createElement('span'); m.className = 'meta';
      m.textContent = when(p.mtime);
      const b = iconButton('rename-btn', t('Rename {name}', { name: p.name }), PENCIL); b.disabled = busy;
      b.onclick = () => { this.renaming = p.name; this.showProfiles(); };
      const d = iconButton('delete-btn', t('Delete {name}', { name: p.name }), TRASH); d.disabled = busy;
      d.onclick = () => void this.doDelete(p.name);
      if (p.name === this.focusName) focus = b;
      const acts = document.createElement('span'); acts.className = 'acts'; acts.append(b, d);
      li.append(n, m, acts); ul.append(li);
    }
    this.focusName = null;
    if (focus) { focus.focus(); if (focus instanceof HTMLInputElement) focus.select(); }
  }

  private renameForm(name: string, busy: boolean) {
    const form = document.createElement('form'); form.className = 'row';
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'text'; input.value = name; input.maxLength = GIVE_MAX; input.spellcheck = false; input.autocomplete = 'off';
    input.setAttribute('aria-label', t('New name for {name}', { name })); input.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'rename-help rename-msg');
    // what the game's field keeps: other characters never appear
    input.oninput = () => {
      const v = input.value, keep = (t: string) => t.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '');
      if (keep(v) === v) return;
      const at = keep(v.slice(0, input.selectionStart ?? v.length)).length;
      input.value = keep(v); input.setSelectionRange(at, at);
    };
    const ok = document.createElement('button'); ok.type = 'submit'; ok.className = 'btn'; ok.textContent = t('Rename'); ok.disabled = busy;
    const cancel = document.createElement('button'); cancel.type = 'button'; cancel.className = 'text-btn'; cancel.textContent = t('Cancel');
    cancel.onclick = () => this.endRename(name);
    form.append(input, ok, cancel);
    form.onsubmit = e => { e.preventDefault(); void this.doRename(name, input.value); };
    form.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); this.endRename(name); } };
    return { form, input };
  }

  private endRename(name: string) { this.renaming = null; this.focusName = name; this.showProfiles(); }

  private async doRename(from: string, to: string) {
    const say = (s: string) => { this.root.querySelector('#rename-msg')!.textContent = s; };
    if (to === from) { this.endRename(from); return; }
    if (this.deps.busy()) { say(t('Quit the game (or close the other tab that runs it) to rename a profile.')); return; }
    const ok = this.root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.profiles .renaming [type="submit"]')!;
    if (ok.disabled) return;
    ok.disabled = true;
    let r: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof renameProfile>>;
    try { r = await this.write(oneWriter(() => renameProfile(filesOf(this.deps.saveDir), PROFILES_DIR, from, to))); }
    catch (err) { this.renaming = null; this.msg(() => t('Renaming {name} stopped: {error}', { name: from, error: String(err) })); await this.refresh(); return; }
    if ('refused' in r) { ok.disabled = this.deps.busy(); say(r.refused); return; }
    this.renaming = null; this.focusName = to;
    this.msg(() => t('Renamed {from} to {to}.', { from, to }));
    this.deps.onChanged?.();
    await this.refresh();
  }

  /** A profile and its cover shoots out of this browser, after a question (a Delete that is not the default). */
  private async doDelete(name: string) {
    if (this.deps.busy()) { this.msg(() => t(QUIT_TO_DELETE)); return; }
    if (!await this.deps.confirm(t('Delete {name}?', { name }),
      t('Its career and cars are deleted, here and in cloud saves. Download backup first to keep a copy.'), t('Delete'), true)) return;
    if (this.deps.busy()) { this.msg(() => t(QUIT_TO_DELETE)); return; }
    let r: { folders: number };
    // (stopped halfway: its covers may have gone, the profile never before them; the cloud is told either way)
    try { r = await this.write(oneWriter(() => deleteProfile(filesOf(this.deps.saveDir), PROFILES_DIR, name))); }
    catch (err) { this.msg(() => t('Deleting {name} stopped: {error}', { name, error: String(err) })); this.deps.onChanged?.(); await this.refresh(); return; }
    this.msg(() => r.folders ? t('Deleted {name}.', { name }) : t('There is no profile {name} in this browser.', { name }));
    this.deps.onChanged?.();
    await this.refresh();
  }

  private async doDownload() {
    const dl = this.deps.download;
    if (dl.running) { await dl.stop(); this.dataMsg(() => t('Preloading stopped. What\'s done is kept.')); return; }
    if (this.deps.busy()) return;
    this.dataMsg('');
    dl.start();
  }

  private async doExport() {
    try {
      const e = await exportSaves(this.deps.saveDir);
      downloadBlob(e.zip as BlobPart, e.name, 'application/zip');
      this.msg(() => tn(e.files, 'Downloaded {name}: {n} file, {size}.', 'Downloaded {name}: {n} files, {size}.', { name: e.name, size: fmtBytes(e.zip.length) }) + (e.shotBytes > MAX_SHOTS
        ? ' ' + t('It holds {shots} of screenshots: a restore keeps only the first {max} of them.', { shots: fmtBytes(e.shotBytes), max: fmtBytes(MAX_SHOTS) }) : ''));
    } catch (err) { this.msg(() => t('The backup failed: {error}', { error: String(err) })); }
  }

  private async doImport(file: File) {
    if (this.deps.busy()) { this.msg(() => t('Quit the game first: restoring replaces the saves it is using.')); return; }
    let r: Restore;
    try { r = await readBackup(new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()), file.name, this.profiles.map(p => p.name)); }
    catch (err) {
      const name = file.name;
      this.msg(() => err instanceof ZipError ? t('{file} cannot be restored: {why}.', { file: name, why: err.message === 'not a zip file' ? t('it is neither a backup (a zip) nor a profile of the game\'s') : err.message })
        : t('{file} cannot be read: {error}', { file: name, error: String(err) }));
      return;
    }
    const refused = r.refused.map(x => `${x.name}: ${x.why}`).join('; ');
    if (!r.profiles.length && (r.kind === 'profiles' || !r.entries.length)) {
      const one = r.refused.length === 1 ? r.refused[0] : null;
      const covers = r.skipped.length && r.skipped.every(s => coverOf(s.split('/').pop()!));
      const name = file.name;
      this.msg(() => one ? (one.name === name ? t('{file} cannot be restored: {why}.', { file: name, why: one.why }) : t('The profile {name} in {file} cannot be restored: {why}.', { name: one.name, file: name, why: one.why }))
        : refused ? t('{file} has no profile the game can load: {list}.', { file: name, list: refused })
        : covers ? t('{file} holds only covers: restore them with their profile, in a zip of the NFS Underground 2 folder.', { file: name })
        : t('{file} has no save files.', { file: name }));
      return;
    }
    const list = listOf;
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    const p = document.createElement('p');
    const items: string[] = [];
    const here = new Map(this.profiles.map(x => [x.name.toLowerCase(), x.name]));
    const replaced = r.profiles.map(n => here.get(n.toLowerCase())).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
    if (r.kind === 'profiles') {
      p.textContent = tn(r.profiles.length, 'Adds the profile in {file}. Other profiles, the game\'s options and settings.ini stay as they are.',
        'Adds the profiles in {file}. Other profiles, the game\'s options and settings.ini stay as they are.', { file: file.name });
      items.push(t('Profiles: {names}', { names: r.profiles.map(n => {
        const covers = r.entries.filter(e => coverOf(e.path.split('/')[1])?.profile === n).length;
        return covers ? tn(covers, '{name} (with its cover shoot)', '{name} (with its {n} cover shoots)', { name: n }) : n;
      }).join(', ') }));
      if (replaced.length) items.push(tn(replaced.length, 'Replaces {names} here, with its career and cover shoots',
        'Replaces {names} here, with their careers and cover shoots', { names: list(replaced) }));
      items.push(...restoreNotes(r));
    } else {
      p.textContent = tn(r.entries.length, 'Replaces every profile, the game\'s options and settings.ini here with the {n} file in {file}.',
        'Replaces every profile, the game\'s options and settings.ini here with the {n} files in {file}.', { file: file.name });
      items.push(...backupItems(r));
    }
    const ul = document.createElement('ul');
    for (const t of items) { const li = document.createElement('li'); li.textContent = t; ul.append(li); }
    body.append(p, ul);
    const adding = r.kind === 'profiles';
    const many = r.profiles.length > 1, name = file.name;
    if (!await this.deps.confirm(adding ? (many ? t('Add these profiles?') : t('Add this profile?')) : t('Restore this backup?'), body,
      adding ? (many ? t('Add profiles') : t('Add profile')) : t('Restore backup'), !adding || replaced.length > 0)) { this.msg(() => t('Nothing changed.')); return; }
    try {
      if (adding) {
        await this.write(addProfiles(filesOf(this.deps.saveDir), r));
        this.msg(() => t('Added {names} from {file}.', { names: list(r.profiles), file: name }));
      } else {
        await this.write(restoreSaves(this.deps.saveDir, r));
        this.msg(() => tn(r.entries.length, 'Restored {n} file from {file}.', 'Restored {n} files from {file}.', { file: name }));
        this.deps.onRestored();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      this.msg(() => err instanceof UndoPending ? t('An earlier restore stopped halfway and is not undone yet, so nothing was changed. Reload the page, then try again.')
        : adding ? t('Adding stopped halfway: {error}. Add the profiles again before playing.', { error: String(err) })
        : t('Restoring stopped halfway: {error}. Restore the backup again before playing.', { error: String(err) }));
    }
    this.deps.onChanged?.();
    await this.refresh();
  }

  private async doClearCache() {
    if (this.deps.busy()) return;
    const dl = this.deps.download;
    if (!await this.deps.confirm(t('Delete the game data on this device?'), (dl.running ? t('This stops preloading.') + ' ' : '') +
      t('The game downloads it again as needed. Your saves stay.'), t('Delete game data'), true)) return;
    await dl.stop();
    await clearCache();
    await this.refresh();
    this.dataMsg(() => t('Game data on this device deleted.'));
  }
}

// settings.ini, read and written for the whole page (the settings panel, settings-ui.ts; Play, the menu and invite
// links, shell.ts), which keeps what it read and wrote here.  It keeps two views of it:
//  - text: the file as last read or written (what the panel shows and changes)
//  - forGame: the file as this tab's game goes by it, null until this tab read it as the owner of the saves (load) or
//    wrote it.  The panel reading again (read) leaves it as it was: a tab that does not own the saves keeps the
//    defaults for its game, and a file gone from under a running game (the browser deleting the site's data) is still
//    known for putting back (shell.ts saveGone).
// A read that does not work (savefs.ts missing) throws and leaves both views as they were, so nothing is written over
// a file that did not read.
import { readText, writeFile } from './savefs';
import { settingsUpgrade, TEMPLATE } from './settings';

const FILE = 'settings.ini';

export class SettingsFile {
  private shown: string | null = null;
  private played: string | null = null;
  /** dir: the save folder (it may change before the page reads it: a test page's address) */
  constructor(private readonly dir: () => string, private readonly log: (s: string) => void) {}

  /** the file as last read or written here (null: not read yet, or there is none) */
  get text(): string | null { return this.shown; }
  /** the file as this tab's game goes by it (null: not read by the owner of the saves yet, nor written) */
  get forGame(): string | null { return this.played; }

  /** the file as it is now, kept nowhere; throws where it did not read */
  peek(): Promise<string | null> { return readText(this.dir(), FILE); }

  /** read again, as the panel shows it; throws where it did not read */
  async read(): Promise<string | null> {
    this.shown = await this.peek();
    return this.shown;
  }

  /** read for the game; in the tab that owns the saves (owner) the template written where there is none, and the new
   *  options added (commented out) where it lacks them.  Throws where it did not read, and then writes nothing
   *  (savefs.ts missing: Firefox's "UnknownError" was taken for no file, and the template went over the player's) */
  async load(owner: boolean): Promise<string | null> {
    let text = await this.peek();
    if (text === null && owner) {
      text = TEMPLATE;
      await writeFile(this.dir(), FILE, text);
      this.log(`[app] settings: wrote template /save/settings.ini`);
    } else if (text !== null && owner) {
      const up = settingsUpgrade(text);
      if (up) { text = up.text; await writeFile(this.dir(), FILE, text); this.log(`[app] settings: added the new options ${up.added.join(', ')} to /save/settings.ini (commented out, defaults unchanged)`); }
    }
    this.played = text;
    return text;
  }

  /** the whole file written: both views have it.  It gives what forGame was before (shell.ts: another language or pack
   *  counts other game data) */
  async write(text: string): Promise<string | null> {
    await writeFile(this.dir(), FILE, text);
    const was = this.played;
    this.shown = this.played = text;
    return was;
  }

  /** the file changed by edit, on top of the file as it is now (the template where there is none): never on top of a
   *  view alone, which is null where the file did not read.  Throws where it did not read or write (nothing written
   *  then). */
  async edit(edit: (text: string) => string): Promise<string> {
    const text = edit(await this.peek() ?? TEMPLATE);
    await this.write(text);
    return text;
  }
}

  /** the flag before the name (flags.ts): a drop-down list of none, the country this connection comes from (the
   *  server's /country), then every flag by its name in the page's language */
  | { t: 'flag' };

/** link: the words of help that link to a page (a mod's, say), opened in a new tab; several for help that names several */
interface Link { text: string; href: string }
/** deviceOpt: a choice offered first, and with its own help, only where it is this device's default (device.ts):
 *  Players' cars shown's Auto, a computer's */
/** mod: the Mods tab's row (mods.ts, the id of its entry): its label and help are the row's (mods-ui.ts rowName, rowHelp:
 *  a mod's name as it is, the line translated), and an (i) right after its name opens the mod's popup */
interface Item { key: string; label: string; help: string; link?: Link | Link[]; c: Control; more?: boolean; deviceOpt?: { value: string; label: string; help: string }; mod?: string }
/** own: the group has no heading of its own, its tab's name says it (Online; Friends & crews' Crews; Mods); at: the id of
 *  the element it goes in (Crews in Friends & crews, the Controls tab's Controller part, Mods), else the Online tab's
 *  (own) or the Game tab's; head: its heading, else its title; more: the title of its "more" part; mods: the Mods tab's,
 *  drawn in its sections (mods-ui.ts).  The texts are English (N), translated where they are drawn. */
interface Group { title: string; more: string; items: Item[]; own?: boolean; at?: string; head?: string; mods?: true }

/** the World list's Own name (no room's name: one cannot start with #, invite.ts checkRoom) */
const OWN_WORLD = '#own';
/** the World list's words: each world's name and how many are in free roam there (where the server says), Own name with
 *  its world's count while the file names one (cur: the Room setting) */
function worldOptions(sel: HTMLSelectElement, cur: string, counts: Map<number, number>) {
  for (const o of sel.options) {
    const own = o.value === OWN_WORLD;
    if (own && !isOwn(cur)) { o.textContent = t('Own name…'); continue; }
    const n = counts.get(roomHash(own ? cur : o.value));
    const name = own ? t('Own name') : worldName(o.value);
    o.textContent = n === undefined ? name : `${name} · ${countText(n)}`;
  }
}

/** a small button with a drawn sign (the Crews row's Join and Leave), its name for a screen reader and as its tooltip */
export function iconButton(cls: string, name: string, path: string): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = `icon-btn ${cls}`;
  b.setAttribute('aria-label', name); b.title = name;
  const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg'); svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24'); svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  const p = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path'); p.setAttribute('d', path);
  svg.append(p); b.append(svg);
  return b;
}
/** a bin (friends' Remove, a profile's Delete) and a pencil (a profile's Rename) */
export const TRASH = 'M4 7h16M10 11v6M14 11v6M9 7V4h6v3M6 7l1 13h10l1-13', PENCIL = 'M4 20h4L19 9l-4-4L4 16zM13 7l4 4';
/** a setting's Reset: the arrow going back round (the touch controls' reset, touch.ts) */
const RESET = 'M6 13a6 6 0 1 0 2-5.2M5 4v4h4';
const PLUS = 'M12 5v14M5 12h14', CROSS = 'M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18', PERSON = 'M12 12a4 4 0 1 0 0-8 4 4 0 0 0 0 8zM4 21c0-4 3.6-7 8-7s8 3 8 7';
const LINK = 'M10 14a4 4 0 0 0 5.7 0l3-3a4 4 0 0 0-5.7-5.7l-1 1M14 10a4 4 0 0 0-5.7 0l-3 3a4 4 0 0 0 5.7 5.7l1-1';

/** An invite link onto the clipboard from its button `at`, and a toast at the button says so (copy.ts); where the
 *  browser refused (an older WebView, a page without the focus), what to tell the player instead (in the page's
 *  language), the link in it to copy by hand.  null: copied. */
export async function copyLink(link: string, at: HTMLElement): Promise<string | null> {
  if (await copyText(link, at)) { copyToast(at); return null; }
  return t('Copy this invite link: {link}', { link });
}


/** What a crews control shows and does: the Crews row's, and the page menu's while a game is in free roam */
export interface CrewControl {
  /** the crews now, in the player's order, with their colours */
  list: readonly Crew[];
  /** the field's id (a label names it), and the label's (it names the list too) */
  id: string; labelId: string;
  placeholder: string;
  /** how many are in free roam in each crew, by hash (none: not shown) */
  counts?: Map<number, number>;
  /** what the field held when it was last drawn, and each change of it */
  draft: string; onDraft(v: string): void;
  /** the crews after a Leave, a Join or a colour picked; focus(root): where the keyboard goes once they are drawn
   *  again in root */
  change(list: Crew[], focus: (root: HTMLElement) => Element | null | undefined): void;
  /** a crew's invite link (invite.ts: with the room the player is in), for its chip's link button; said: where what
   *  the copy did is told (none: the note under the box) */
  link(name: string): string;
  said?(msg: string): void;
}

/**
 * A crews control into ctl: one line of pills that wraps, a chip per crew in the player's order (its colour in the
 * game, a button that opens the palette under the line; its name, how many are in free roam in it when the server
 * says, a button that copies an invite link to it, and Leave), then a value box with Join in it (or Enter).  Join
 * waits for a name that can join (crews.ts checkCrew), and the note under the box says why one cannot (and what a
 * link's copy did, without o.said); with 4 crews the box waits for one to be
 * left.  A Leave keeps the others' colours; a Join takes the first colour no crew has.  A line under the chips names a crew counted with more than
 * CREW_BIG players (showCrewCounts).  Returns the box's field.
 */
export function crewControl(o: CrewControl, ctl: HTMLElement): HTMLInputElement {
  const list = o.list;
  const ul = document.createElement('ul'); ul.className = 'crews'; ul.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', o.labelId);
  list.forEach((c, i) => {
    const li = document.createElement('li'); li.className = 'crew'; li.dataset.hash = String(roomHash(c.name)); li.title = c.name;
    li.style.setProperty('--crew', `#${c.rgb}`);
    const what = t('Colour of {name}', { name: c.name }), change = t('Change the colour of {name}', { name: c.name });
    const dot = document.createElement('button'); dot.type = 'button'; dot.className = 'crew-dot';
    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', change); dot.title = change; dot.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    dot.onclick = () => palette(dot, c, i, what);
    const text = document.createElement('span'); text.className = 'crew-text';
    const nm = document.createElement('span'); nm.className = 'crew-name'; nm.textContent = c.name;
    const n = document.createElement('span'); n.className = 'crew-count';
    text.append(nm, n);
    const share = iconButton('crew-link', t('Copy an invite link to crew {name}', { name: c.name }), LINK);
    share.onclick = async () => {
      const said = await copyLink(o.link(c.name), share);
      if (said === null) return;
      if (o.said) { o.said(said); return; }
      note.textContent = said; note.classList.remove('warn');
    };
    const leave = iconButton('crew-leave', t('Leave crew {name}', { name: c.name }), CROSS);
    // the keyboard goes on to the next crew's Leave (the last one's: the one before), or to the box
    leave.onclick = () => o.change(list.filter((_, k) => k !== i), root => root.querySelectorAll('.crew-leave')[Math.min(i, list.length - 2)]);
    li.append(dot, text, share, leave);
    ul.append(li);
  });
  const line = document.createElement('div'); line.className = 'crew-line';
  /** crew i's palette, under the line (the chips stay where they are), one open at a time: a radio group of the 8
   *  colours, its own marked; the arrows move along it, Enter, Space or a tap picks one and closes it, Esc (or the dot
   *  again) closes it.  Esc stays here: in the menu's Crews popup it does not close the popup too. */
  const palette = (dot: HTMLButtonElement, c: Crew, i: number, what: string) => {
    const was = ctl.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.crew-colours');
    was?.remove();
    for (const d of ul.querySelectorAll('.crew-dot')) d.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    if (was?.dataset.crew === String(i)) { dot.focus(); return; }
    const g = document.createElement('div'); g.className = 'crew-colours'; g.id = `${o.id}-colours`; g.dataset.crew = String(i);
    g.setAttribute('role', 'radiogroup'); g.setAttribute('aria-label', what);
    dot.setAttribute('aria-controls', g.id); dot.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    const close = () => { g.remove(); dot.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); dot.focus(); };
    const sw = CREW_PALETTE.map((rgb, k) => {
      const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'swatch'; b.setAttribute('role', 'radio');
      b.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(rgb === c.rgb)); b.tabIndex = rgb === c.rgb ? 0 : -1;
      const name = t(CREW_COLOUR_NAMES[k]); b.setAttribute('aria-label', name); b.title = name;
      b.style.setProperty('--sw', `#${rgb}`);
      b.onclick = () => {
        if (rgb === c.rgb) { close(); return; }
        o.change(list.map((x, j) => j === i ? { ...x, rgb } : x), root => root.querySelectorAll('.crew-dot')[i]);
      };
      return b;
    });
    if (!sw.some(b => b.tabIndex === 0)) sw[0].tabIndex = 0;          // a colour from the file the palette lacks
    g.onkeydown = e => {
      const at = sw.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
      const to = e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? at + 1 : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? at - 1
        : e.key === 'Home' ? 0 : e.key === 'End' ? sw.length - 1 : null;
      if (to !== null) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const next = sw[(to + sw.length) % sw.length];
        for (const b of sw) b.tabIndex = b === next ? 0 : -1;
        next.focus();
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); close(); }
    };
    g.append(...sw);
    line.after(g);
    sw.find(b => b.tabIndex === 0)!.focus();
  };
  const big = document.createElement('p'); big.className = 'set-note warn crews-big'; big.hidden = true;
  const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'crew-add';
  const inp = document.createElement('input'); inp.type = 'text'; inp.id = o.id; inp.placeholder = t(o.placeholder);
  inp.autocomplete = 'off'; inp.spellcheck = false; inp.enterKeyHint = 'done';
  inp.value = o.draft;
  const join = iconButton('crew-join', t('Join crew'), PLUS);
  const note = document.createElement('p'); note.className = 'set-note'; note.id = `${o.id}-note`; note.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
  const check = () => {
    const r = checkCrew(inp.value, list.map(c => c.name)), full = list.length >= CREW_MAX;
    inp.disabled = full; join.disabled = !r.ok;
    const why = r.ok || !r.why ? '' : t(r.why, { name: r.name ?? '' });
    note.textContent = why;
    note.classList.toggle('warn', !!why && !full);
    return r;
  };
  const add = () => {
    const r = check();
    if (!r.ok) return;
    o.onDraft('');
    // the keyboard stays in the box for one more (with 4: on the last crew's Leave)
    o.change([...list, { name: r.name, rgb: freeColour(list) }], root => root.querySelector('.crew-add input:enabled') ?? [...root.querySelectorAll('.crew-leave')].pop());
  };
  inp.oninput = () => { o.onDraft(inp.value); check(); };
  inp.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); add(); } };
  join.onclick = add;
  box.append(inp, join);
  line.append(ul, box);
  ctl.append(line, big, note);
  if (o.counts) showCrewCounts(ctl, o.counts);
  check();
  return inp;
}

/** the counts on a crews control's chips: a figure by a person's outline (a screen reader gets "{n} in free roam"), the
 *  chip's tooltip its name and that; nothing for a crew counts lacks.  Under the chips, the crews counted with more
 *  than CREW_BIG: the server's hub no longer links them first (in one room; the count is of every room). */
export function showCrewCounts(root: ParentNode, counts: Map<number, number>) {
  for (const ul of root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('ul.crews')) {
    const line = ul.closest('.crew-line')?.parentElement?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.crews-big');
    if (!line) continue;
    const big = [...ul.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.crew[data-hash]')].filter(li => (counts.get(Number(li.dataset.hash)) ?? 0) > CREW_BIG)
      .map(li => t('{name} has over 64 players, so far-away crew-mates no longer always show. A less common name works better.',
        { name: li.querySelector('.crew-name')?.textContent ?? '' }));
    line.textContent = big.join(' '); line.hidden = !big.length;
  }
  for (const li of root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.crew[data-hash]')) {
    const n = counts.get(Number(li.dataset.hash)), el = li.querySelector('.crew-count')!, name = li.querySelector('.crew-name')!.textContent ?? '';
    if (n === undefined) { el.replaceChildren(); li.title = name; continue; }
    const said = t('{n} in free roam', { n });
    const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg'); svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24'); svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    const p = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path'); p.setAttribute('d', PERSON); svg.append(p);
    const fig = document.createElement('span'); fig.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); fig.textContent = String(n);
    const sr = document.createElement('span'); sr.className = 'vh'; sr.textContent = said;
    el.replaceChildren(svg, fig, sr);
    li.title = `${name} · ${said}`;
  }
}

/** an option's label in the page's language (a language: its name there, and its own name beside it) */
function optLabel(it: Item, value: string, label: string): string {
  if (it.key !== 'language') return t(label);
  const own = NATIVE[value as Language] ?? value, here = t(label);
  return here === own ? own : `${here} · ${own}`;
}

/** A value as the panel shows it: the option's label, on/off, or the value with its unit. */
function shown(it: Item, v: string): string {
  const c = it.c;
  if (c.t === 'switch') return v === 'on' ? t('on') : t('off');
  if (c.t === 'seg' || c.t === 'select') {
    const opts: [string, string][] = it.deviceOpt ? [[it.deviceOpt.value, it.deviceOpt.label], ...c.opts] : c.opts;
    const o = opts.find(([x]) => x.toLowerCase() === v.toLowerCase());
    return o ? optLabel(it, o[0], o[1]) : v;
  }
  if (c.t === 'phrases') return phrasesOf(v).map(p => t(PHRASES[p].text)).join(', ');
  if (c.t === 'flag') { const f = flagCode(v); return f ? flagName(f) : t('No flag'); }
  if (v === '') return t('empty');
  return c.t === 'num' && c.unit ? `${v} ${c.unit}` : v;
}

export interface SettingsDeps {
  /** settings.ini (the panel reads and writes it there) */
  file: SettingsFile;
  /** the page address's environment (overrides the file) */
  environment: Record<string, string>;
  /** keys whose default is another on this device (device.ts), shown when the file does not set them */
  defaults?: Record<string, string>;
  /** after every write (it applies at the next Play, which reads the file again); was: the file as the game went by it
   *  before (SettingsFile.forGame) */
  onSaved?(text: string, was: string | null): void;
  /** true in a tab that does not own the saves: the panel shows the file but does not write it */
  readOnly?(): boolean;
  /** a short message for the page: what was saved, or why not (a Msg: drawn again if the page's language changes) */
  say?(msg: string | Msg): void;
  /** after settings.ini was read again (refresh) */
  onLoaded?(): void;
  /** the page's question box (Reset all settings asks first) */
  confirm?(title: string, body: string, ok: string, danger?: boolean): Promise<boolean>;
  /** Your name's row as made: its claim line and button go in (claim-ui.ts NameRow) */
  nameRow?(row: HTMLElement, input: HTMLInputElement, ctl: HTMLElement): void;
  /** a value saved that its row's own line explains, with no "applies the next time you press Play" (Your name: another
   *  name than the passphrase's claimed one, which Play does not use: claim-ui.ts) */
  quietSave?(key: string, value: string | null): boolean;
  /** a row of another part of the page that goes after this key's row (the Last.fm row after the songs': lastfm-ui.ts) */
  rowAfter?(key: string): HTMLElement | null;
}

export class SettingsPanel {
  private resolved!: Resolved;
  /** the file alone (no page address): what each row shows */
  private fileOnly!: Resolved;
  private saves = 0;                       // writes so far (tests wait on data-saved)
  private openMore = new Set<string>();    // "More ... settings" kept open across re-renders
  private worldCounts = new Map<number, number>();  // how many are in free roam in each world, by its room's hash (setWorldCounts)
  private worldOwn = false;                // Own name picked in the World list, its name not typed yet
  private crewCounts = new Map<number, number>();   // how many are in free roam in each crew, by hash (setCrewCounts)
  private crewDraft = '';                  // the crew name being typed, kept across re-renders
  private phrasesOpen = false;             // Your phrases' Choose phrases open, kept across re-renders
  private country: FlagCode | '' = '';     // the country this connection comes from (/country), first in Your flag's list
  private countryAsked = false;
  /** root: the big panel, every tab of it (index.html #settings); online: its Online tab (#online) */
  constructor(private root: HTMLElement, private deps: SettingsDeps, private online: HTMLElement) {
    root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#settings-text-save')!.onclick = () => void this.saveRaw();
    root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#settings-reset-all')!.onclick = () => void this.resetAll();
  }

  /** settings.ini as read or written last (SettingsFile.text) */
  private get text() { return this.deps.file.text; }

  /** settings.ini as read last; one that did not read (savefs.ts missing) leaves the copy before, and the panel read-only
   *  until it reads (unread): a change made on the template's copy would be written over the player's file */
  async load(): Promise<string | null> {
    try { await this.deps.file.read(); this.unread = null; }
    catch (e) { this.unread = e; }
    this.resolve(this.text);
    return this.text;
  }
  private resolve(text: string | null) {
    this.resolved = resolveEnv(text, this.deps.environment, {});
    this.fileOnly = resolveEnv(text, {}, {});
  }

  /** Read settings.ini again and show it. */
  async refresh() {
    await this.load();
    this.render();
    this.deps.onLoaded?.();
  }

  /** One setting set as its row would set it (the language list at the top of the page). */
  set(key: string, value: string | null) { return this.put(key, value); }

  /** What the file makes of a key's variable (on/off for booleans), else the template default.  The variable may
   *  be set by the key's own line or by a line with the variable's name (NFSU2_ROAM = 1): the row shows what
   *  applies either way (the audit's PAGE-2: such a line turned free roam on behind an "off" switch).  A raw
   *  value is read as the runtime reads it (an integer for NFSU2_ROAM, "starts with 0" for NOMOVIES). */
  current(key: string): string {
    const d = keyDef(key)!, r = this.fileOnly;
    if (r?.source[d.env] === 'settings.ini') {        // (not read yet: the defaults; the Site tab's rows ask early)
      const v = r.env[d.env];
      if (d.kind === 'bool') return parseInt(v, 10) === 1 ? 'on' : 'off';
      if (d.kind === 'boolInv') return v === '' || v.startsWith('0') ? 'on' : 'off';
      return v;
    }
    return this.deps.defaults?.[key] ?? DEFAULTS.get(key) ?? '';
  }

  /** why settings.ini did not read last (load), else null */
  private unread: unknown = null;
  /** settings.ini did not read last (load): the panel is read-only until it is read again (refresh) */
  get unreadable() { return this.unread !== null; }
  private ro() { return !!this.deps.readOnly?.() || this.unread !== null || writesAreOff(); }
  /** what the panel says while it is read-only (a game playing without saving: savefs.ts setWritesOff) */
  private roText() { return this.unread !== null ? t(UNREADABLE, { error: String(this.unread) }) : writesAreOff() ? t(NO_SAVE) : t(READ_ONLY); }

  /** key's line, and also's (a row's second key: COMPANION) in the same write */
  /** Your name written (a claim made under it: claim-ui.ts) */
  async putName(name: string) { await this.put('roam_name', name); }

  private async put(key: string, value: string | null, also: [string, string | null][] = []) {
    if (this.ro()) { this.deps.say?.(this.roText()); return; }
    let next = this.text ?? TEMPLATE, removed = 0;
    for (const [k, v] of [[key, value] as [string, string | null], ...also]) { const r = putKey(next, k, v); next = r.text; removed += r.removed; }
    const was = await this.deps.file.write(next);
    this.resolve(next);
    this.deps.onSaved?.(next, was);
    // (our controls' rows are the Site tab's, which draws them again itself: sitekeys.ts)
    const site = SITE_KEYS.includes(key);
    if (removed) this.render(); else { if (!site) this.rerow(key); this.syncRaw(); }
    // (the World and Crews rows say whether free roam is on; Ghost mode whether the world keeps it off)
    if (key === 'roam' && !removed) for (const k of ROAM_ROWS) this.rerow(k);
    if ((key === 'roam' || key === 'roam_room') && !removed) this.rerow('roam_collide');
    this.root.dataset.saved = String(++this.saves);
    const it = ITEMS.get(key), cur = this.current(key);
    if (!site && !this.deps.quietSave?.(key, value)) this.deps.say?.(() => {
      const v = { what: it ? labelOf(it) : key, value: it ? shown(it, cur) : value ?? '' };
      return value === null ? t('Saved: {what}, {value} (the default). Applies the next time you press Play.', v) : t('Saved: {what}, {value}. Applies the next time you press Play.', v);
    });
  }

  render() {
    if (!this.fileOnly) return;                  // not read yet (the page's language came first): load() draws it
    const ro = this.ro();
    this.root.toggleAttribute('data-readonly', ro);
    this.root.querySelector('#settings-note')!.textContent = ro ? this.roText() : t(NOTE);
    const modsNote = this.root.querySelector('#mods-note');
    if (modsNote) modsNote.textContent = ro ? this.roText() : t(MODS_NOTE);
    this.online.toggleAttribute('data-readonly', ro);
    const note = this.online.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#online-note')!;
    note.textContent = ro ? this.roText() : ''; note.hidden = !ro;
    const focusKey = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.closest<HTMLElement>('.set')?.dataset.key;
    this.root.querySelector('#settings-body')!.replaceChildren(...GROUPS.filter(g => !g.own && !g.at).map(g => this.group(g)));
    for (const g of GROUPS.filter(g => g.at)) this.root.querySelector(`#${g.at}`)?.replaceChildren(...g.mods ? modSections(key => this.row(ITEMS.get(key)!)) : [this.group(g)]);
    this.root.querySelector('#settings-lines')!.replaceChildren(...this.others());
    this.online.querySelector('#online-body')!.replaceChildren(...GROUPS.filter(g => g.own && !g.at).map(g => this.group(g)));
    this.syncRaw();
    const row = focusKey ? this.find<HTMLElement>(`.set[data-key="${focusKey}"]`) : null;
    if (row) this.focusRow(row);
  }

  /** an element of the panel (the Online tab is in it) */
  private find<T extends Element>(sel: string): T | null { return this.root.querySelector<T>(sel) ?? this.online.querySelector<T>(sel); }

  /** How many are in free roam in each world now, by its room's hash (players.ts worldCounts; 0 the main world; a world
   *  it lacks: not known), in the World list; kept across re-renders. */
  setWorldCounts(counts: Map<number, number>) {
    this.worldCounts = counts;
    const sel = this.find<HTMLSelectElement>('#set-roam_room');
    if (sel) worldOptions(sel, this.current('roam_room'), counts);
  }

  /** How many are in free roam in each crew now, by its hash (players.ts crewCounts; a crew it lacks: not known),
   *  on the Crews row's lines; kept across re-renders. */
  setCrewCounts(counts: Map<number, number>) {
    this.crewCounts = counts;
    for (const r of [this.root, this.online]) showCrewCounts(r, counts);
  }

  private group(g: Group): HTMLElement {
    const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'group';
    // a group in a tab of its own has that tab's name
    if (!g.own) {
      const h = document.createElement('h3'); h.id = `group-${g.title.toLowerCase().replace(/\W+/g, '-')}`; h.textContent = t(g.head ?? g.title);
      box.setAttribute('role', 'group'); box.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', h.id);
      box.append(h);
    }
    box.append(...g.items.filter(i => !i.more).flatMap(i => { const after = this.deps.rowAfter?.(i.key); return after ? [this.row(i), after] : [this.row(i)]; }));
    const more = g.items.filter(i => i.more);
    if (more.length) {
      const d = document.createElement('details'); d.className = 'more';
      d.open = this.openMore.has(g.title);
      d.ontoggle = () => { if (d.open) this.openMore.add(g.title); else this.openMore.delete(g.title); };
      const s = document.createElement('summary'); s.textContent = this.moreLabel(g);
      d.append(s, ...more.map(i => this.row(i)));
      box.append(d);
    }
    return box;
  }

  /** "More ... settings", with how many of them the file changes: a changed setting is not out of sight unnoticed. */
  private moreLabel(g: Group): string {
    const n = g.items.filter(i => i.more && this.resolved.file[i.key]?.raw).length;
    return n ? t('{label} ({n} changed)', { label: t(g.more), n }) : t(g.more);
  }

  /** The lines with keys outside the table, and those of table keys the panel has no row for (roam_rate and the
   *  other tuning knobs, the Mac app's): listed, so nothing in the file acts unseen (the audit's PAGE-2). */
  private others(): HTMLElement[] {
    const unshown = Object.entries(this.fileOnly.file).filter(([k, f]) => !ITEMS.has(k) && !COMPANIONS.has(k) && f.raw !== '')
      .map(([key, f]) => ({ phys: f.phys, key, env: key, value: f.raw, refused: f.refused, why: f.why }));
    const other = [...this.fileOnly.other, ...unshown].sort((a, b) => a.phys - b.phys);
    if (!other.length) return [];
    const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'group'; box.id = 'settings-other';
    const h = document.createElement('h3'); h.id = 'group-other'; h.textContent = t('Other settings in this file');
    box.setAttribute('role', 'group'); box.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', h.id);
    const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = 'set-help';
    p.textContent = t('Lines without a control on this page. They apply at Play; edit the file as text below to change them.');
    const ul = document.createElement('ul');
    for (const o of other) {
      const li = document.createElement('li'); li.className = 'set-help';
      const line = t('line {line}: {key} = {value}', { line: o.phys, key: o.key, value: o.value.length > 80 ? o.value.slice(0, 80) + '…' : o.value });
      li.textContent = o.refused ? t('{line} (ignored: {why})', { line, why: o.why ? tvars(o.why.t, o.why.v) : o.refused })
        : o.env !== o.key ? t('{line} (sets {env})', { line, env: o.env }) : line;
      const r = iconButton('reset-btn', t('Reset {label}', { label: o.key }), RESET);
      const def = DEFAULTS.get(keyDef(o.key)?.key ?? '');
      if (def !== undefined) r.title = t('Back to the default ({value})', { value: def === '' ? t('empty') : def });
      r.disabled = this.ro();
      r.onclick = () => void this.resetLine(o.phys, o.key, r);
      li.append(' ', r);
      ul.append(li);
    }
    box.append(h, p, ul);
    return [box];
  }

  /** One row again, after its key changed (the rest of the panel, and the focus, stay where they are). */
  /** the country this connection comes from (the server's /country: Cloudflare's guess, for this page only), then
   *  first in Your flag's list; nothing from a server without it */
  private async askCountry() {
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/country', { cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
      const c = r.ok ? flagCode(String((await r.json() as { country?: unknown }).country ?? '')) : '';
      if (!c) return;
      this.country = c;
      if (this.find('.set[data-key="roam_flag"]')) this.rerow('roam_flag');
    } catch { /* none */ }
  }

  private rerow(key: string) {
    const old = this.find<HTMLElement>(`.set[data-key="${key}"]`);
    const it = ITEMS.get(key);
    if (!old || !it) { this.render(); return; }
    const focused = old.contains(document.activeElement), was = focused ? document.activeElement!.id : '';
    const fresh = this.row(it);
    old.replaceWith(fresh);
    if (it.more) fresh.parentElement!.querySelector('summary')!.textContent = this.moreLabel(GROUP_OF.get(key)!);
    // the same control again where it has an id (Your phrases' lists), else the row's first
    const same = was ? fresh.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#${CSS.escape(was)}`) : null;
    if (same) same.focus(); else if (focused) this.focusRow(fresh);
  }

  private focusRow(row: HTMLElement) {
    row.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input[type="radio"]:checked, input:not([type="radio"])')?.focus();
  }

  private syncRaw() {
    const ro = this.ro();
    const ta = this.root.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>('#settings-text')!;
    if (document.activeElement !== ta) ta.value = this.text ?? TEMPLATE;
    ta.readOnly = ro;
    this.root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#settings-text-save')!.disabled = ro;
    // nothing to reset: the file is the template already, but for the name and language
    this.root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#settings-reset-all')!.disabled = ro || resetAll(this.text) === (this.text ?? TEMPLATE);
  }

  private row(it: Item): HTMLElement {
    const def = keyDef(it.key)!;
    const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'set'; row.dataset.key = it.key;
    const id = `set-${it.key}`;
    const cur = this.current(it.key);
    const f = this.resolved.file[it.key], comp = COMPANION[it.key], f2 = comp ? this.resolved.file[comp] : undefined;
    const setInFile = (!!f && f.raw !== '') || (!!f2 && f2.raw !== '');   // set (or refused): Reset puts the template line back
    const c = it.c;
    // a choice is a radio group named by this label; any other control is labelled by it directly.  A mod's row: its
    // label holds the mod's (i) too (mods-ui.ts modName), so its control takes the name as its aria-label
    const label = document.createElement(c.t === 'seg' || it.mod ? 'span' : 'label'); label.className = 'set-label'; label.id = `${id}-label`;
    label.textContent = labelOf(it);
    if (label instanceof HTMLLabelElement) label.htmlFor = id;
    const help = document.createElement('p'); help.className = 'set-help'; help.id = `${id}-help`;
    // each link on its words where they first stand in the help (in this language's text), in their order there
    const devOpt = it.deviceOpt && this.deps.defaults?.[it.key] === it.deviceOpt.value ? it.deviceOpt : undefined;
    const helpText = it.mod ? rowHelp(it.mod) : t(devOpt ? devOpt.help : it.help);
    const links = (it.link ? Array.isArray(it.link) ? it.link : [it.link] : [])
      .map(l => ({ href: l.href, text: t(l.text), at: helpText.indexOf(t(l.text)) })).filter(l => l.text && l.at >= 0)
      .sort((x, y) => x.at - y.at);
    let pos = 0;
    for (const l of links) {
      if (l.at < pos) continue;
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = l.href; a.target = '_blank'; a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; a.textContent = l.text;
      help.append(helpText.slice(pos, l.at), a);
      pos = l.at + l.text.length;
    }
    help.append(helpText.slice(pos));
    const ctl = document.createElement('div'); ctl.className = 'set-control';
    let described: HTMLElement;                      // what aria-describedby goes on
    if (c.t === 'switch') {
      const on = boolOn(cur || 'off');
      const v = document.createElement('span'); v.className = 'val'; v.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); v.textContent = on ? t('On') : t('Off');
      const b = document.createElement('input'); b.type = 'checkbox'; b.className = 'switch'; b.id = id;
      b.setAttribute('role', 'switch');
      b.checked = on;
      b.onchange = () => void this.put(it.key, b.checked ? 'on' : 'off');
      if (it.mod) {
        // the name turns it on or off, as a label's would (but the (i) in it)
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', labelOf(it));
        label.onclick = e => { if (!(e.target as Element).closest('.mod-about')) b.click(); };
      }
      ctl.append(v, b);
      described = b;
    } else if (c.t === 'seg') {
      const seg = document.createElement('div'); seg.className = 'seg';
      seg.setAttribute('role', 'radiogroup');
      if (it.mod) seg.setAttribute('aria-label', labelOf(it)); else seg.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', label.id);
      const opts: [string, string][] = [...(devOpt ? [[devOpt.value, devOpt.label] as [string, string]] : []), ...c.opts];
      if (cur && !opts.some(([v]) => v.toLowerCase() === cur.toLowerCase())) opts.push([cur, cur]);   // a value set in the file
      opts.forEach(([v, l], i) => {
        const o = document.createElement('label'); o.className = 'opt';
        const r = document.createElement('input'); r.type = 'radio'; r.name = id; r.value = v;
        if (i === 0) r.id = id;
        r.checked = v.toLowerCase() === (cur || '').toLowerCase();
        r.onchange = () => { if (r.checked) void this.put(it.key, v); };
        o.append(r, optLabel(it, v, l));
        seg.append(o);
      });
      ctl.append(seg);
      described = seg;
    } else if (c.t === 'select') {
      const sel = document.createElement('select'); sel.id = id;
      const opts = [...c.opts];
      if (cur && !opts.some(([v]) => v.toLowerCase() === cur.toLowerCase())) opts.push([cur, cur]);   // a value set in the file
      for (const [v, l] of opts) {
        const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v; o.textContent = optLabel(it, v, l);
        o.selected = v.toLowerCase() === (cur || '').toLowerCase();
        sel.append(o);
      }
      sel.onchange = () => void this.put(it.key, sel.value);
      ctl.append(sel);
      if (c.preview) {

        b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'listen'; show(false);
        b.onclick = () => {
          if (b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true') { pv.stop(); return; }

        };

    } else if (c.t === 'flag') {
      const sel = document.createElement('select'); sel.id = id;

      const add = (v: string, label: string) => {
        const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v; o.textContent = label;
        if (!picked && v === code) { o.selected = true; picked = true; }
        sel.append(o);
      };
      add('', t('No flag'));
      if (this.country) add(this.country, flagName(this.country));
      for (const f of flagsByName()) add(f.code, f.name);
      // the picked flag on the list's left, as the game draws it (/flags.png), in a box like Your horn's Listen; none
      // with No flag
      const pic = document.createElement('span'); pic.className = 'flag-pic'; pic.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      const flag = document.createElement('span'); pic.append(flag);
      flag.style.background = `url(/flags.png) 0 0 / ${FLAG_SHEET_COLS * FLAG_W * FLAG_SHOWN}px `
        + `${Math.ceil(FLAG_CODES.length / FLAG_SHEET_COLS) * FLAG_H * FLAG_SHOWN}px`;
      const show = (v: string) => {
        const at = flagAt(v);
        pic.hidden = !at;
        if (at) flag.style.backgroundPosition = `${-at[0] * FLAG_SHOWN}px ${-at[1] * FLAG_SHOWN}px`;
      };
      show(sel.value);
      sel.onchange = () => { show(sel.value); void this.put(it.key, sel.value || null); };
      ctl.append(pic, sel);
      described = sel;
      if (!this.countryAsked) { this.countryAsked = true; void this.askCountry(); }
    } else if (c.t === 'crews') {
      row.classList.add('set-list');
      described = crewControl({ list: crewsOf(cur, this.current('roam_crew_colours')), id, labelId: label.id, placeholder: c.placeholder, counts: this.crewCounts,
        draft: this.crewDraft, onDraft: v => { this.crewDraft = v; }, change: (list, focus) => void this.setCrews(list, focus),
        // with the room this file sets, if any: crew-mates meet within one room
        link: name => inviteLink(location.origin, { crew: name, room: this.current('roam_room') }), said: msg => this.deps.say?.(msg) }, ctl);
    } else if (c.t === 'world') {
      described = this.worldControl(ctl, row, id, it.key, cur, t(c.placeholder));
    } else if (c.t === 'phrases') {

    } else {

      inp.type = c.t === 'num' ? 'number' : 'text';
      if (c.t === 'num') { if (c.min !== undefined) inp.min = String(c.min); if (c.max !== undefined) inp.max = String(c.max); if (c.step !== undefined) inp.step = String(c.step); }
      else if (c.placeholder) inp.placeholder = t(c.placeholder);

      inp.value = cur;
      inp.onchange = () => {

        if (it.key === 'roam_name' && v) v = onlineName(v) ?? v;
        if (it.key === 'license_plate') inp.value = v = plateUpper(v);
        if (v === this.current(it.key) && (v !== '' || !this.resolved.file[it.key]?.raw)) return;   // unchanged (a late change event)
        if (v === '') { void this.put(it.key, null); return; }
        const chk = checkSetting(it.key, v);
        if (chk && !chk.ok) {
          const msg = t('Not saved: {key} = {why}.', { key: it.key, why: tvars(chk.why, chk.v) });
          this.state(row, msg, 'bad'); this.describe(inp, row); this.deps.say?.(msg);
          return;
        }
        void this.put(it.key, v);
      };
      ctl.append(inp);
      if (c.t === 'num' && c.unit) { const u = document.createElement('span'); u.className = 'unit'; u.textContent = c.unit; ctl.append(u); }
      described = inp;
    }
    if (setInFile && c.t !== 'crews' && c.t !== 'phrases' && c.t !== 'world') {   // (the Crews row has none: each crew's x
                                                               // leaves it; Your phrases has its own, beside Choose
                                                               // phrases; World's list has the main world)
      const r = iconButton('reset-btn', t('Reset {label}', { label: labelOf(it) }), RESET);
      r.title = t('Back to the default ({value})', { value: shown(it, DEFAULTS.get(it.key) ?? '') });

      .map(([k, x]) => t('settings.ini line {line}: {key} = {why}, so the default is used.', { line: x!.phys, key: k!, why: x!.why ? tvars(x!.why.t, x!.why.v) : x!.refused! }));

    const by = this.fileOnly.byEnv[def.env];
    if (by && keyDef(by.key)?.key !== it.key) this.state(row, t('settings.ini line {line} sets {env} = {value} by its own name: that is what applies.', { line: by.phys, env: def.env, value: this.fileOnly.env[def.env] }), 'env');

    this.describe(described, row);
    // (a link copies what is there, and a mod's (i) shows it: read only or not)
    if (this.ro()) for (const el of row.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement | HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>('button:not(.room-link):not(.crew-link):not(.mod-about), input, select')) el.disabled = true;
    return row;
  }

  /** The World row's control into ctl (worlds.ts): the list of the main world, World 1 to 4 and Own name, each with how
   *  many are in free roam there now (setWorldCounts); Own name opens a box under it for the name, with the link button
   *  in it (an invite link to that world, as the cloud saves' passphrase box has its eye), shown while it holds a name.
   *  The list saves a pick at once (the main world: the line out of the file), the box its name once typed. */
  private worldControl(ctl: HTMLElement, row: HTMLElement, id: string, key: string, cur: string, placeholder: string): HTMLSelectElement {
    row.classList.add('set-world');
    const own = isOwn(cur) || this.worldOwn;
    const sel = document.createElement('select'); sel.id = id;
    for (const v of ['', ...WORLDS, OWN_WORLD]) { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v; sel.append(o); }
    sel.value = own ? OWN_WORLD : isMain(cur) ? '' : WORLDS[worldOf(cur) - 1];
    worldOptions(sel, cur, this.worldCounts);
    const inp = document.createElement('input'); inp.type = 'text'; inp.id = `${id}-own`; inp.placeholder = placeholder;
    inp.setAttribute('aria-label', placeholder);
    inp.value = isOwn(cur) ? cur : '';
    const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'keybox linkbox'; box.hidden = !own;
    const share = iconButton('room-link', t('Copy an invite link to this world'), LINK);
    const showLink = () => { share.hidden = !inp.value.trim(); };
    inp.addEventListener('input', showLink); showLink();
    const refused = (why: string, v?: Vars) => {
      const msg = t('Not saved: {key} = {why}.', { key, why: tvars(why, v ?? {}) });
      this.state(row, msg, 'bad'); this.describe(inp, row); this.deps.say?.(msg);
    };
    share.onclick = async () => {
      const r = checkRoom(inp.value);
      if (!r.ok) { if (r.why) refused(r.why, r.v); return; }
      const said = await copyLink(inviteLink(location.origin, { room: r.name }), share);
      if (said !== null) this.deps.say?.(said);
    };
    box.append(inp, share);
    sel.onchange = () => {
      if (sel.value === OWN_WORLD) { this.worldOwn = true; box.hidden = false; inp.focus(); return; }
      this.worldOwn = false;
      void this.put(key, sel.value || null);
    };
    // a name as an invite link takes one (invite.ts): tidied, and refused where settings.ini would cut it short; World 2
    // typed is World 2, none the main world
    inp.onchange = () => {
      const r = checkRoom(inp.value);
      if (!r.ok && r.why) { refused(r.why, r.v); return; }
      const v = r.ok ? r.name : '';
      this.worldOwn = false;
      if (v === this.current(key) && (v !== '' || !this.resolved.file[key]?.raw)) return;   // unchanged (a late change event)
      void this.put(key, v || null);
    };
    ctl.append(sel, box);
    return sel;
  }

  /**
   * Your phrases into ctl: "Choose phrases" opens four columns, one for each of 1 to 4, of the group's name and its
   * four phrases, each a drop-down list (the phrases in the library's categories).  A change saves both lines at once
   * (the default: both back to the template's); reset: the row's Reset, or null when the file sets neither.
   */
  private phraseControl(ctl: HTMLElement, id: string, layout: number[], groups: string[], reset: (() => void) | null, label: string): HTMLElement {
    const det = document.createElement('details'); det.className = 'phrases'; det.open = this.phrasesOpen;
    det.ontoggle = () => { this.phrasesOpen = det.open; };
    const sum = document.createElement('summary'); sum.id = id; sum.textContent = t('Choose phrases');
    const grid = document.createElement('div'); grid.className = 'phrase-grid';
    const save = () => {
      const p = [...grid.querySelectorAll<HTMLSelectElement>('select[data-slot]')].map(s => +s.value);
      const g = [...grid.querySelectorAll<HTMLSelectElement>('select[data-group]')].map(s => s.value);
      const dflt = p.every((x, i) => x === DEFAULT_PHRASES[i]) && g.every((x, i) => x === DEFAULT_GROUPS[i]);
      void this.put('quick_chat_phrases', dflt ? null : p.join(','), [['quick_chat_groups', dflt ? null : g.join(',')]]);
    };
    for (let g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
      const col = document.createElement('div'); col.className = 'phrase-col';
      col.setAttribute('role', 'group'); col.setAttribute('aria-label', t('Group {n}', { n: g + 1 }));
      const head = document.createElement('div'); head.className = 'phrase-head';
      const key = document.createElement('kbd'); key.textContent = String(g + 1); key.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      const name = document.createElement('select'); name.id = `${id}-g${g}`; name.dataset.group = String(g);
      name.setAttribute('aria-label', t('Group {n}: its name', { n: g + 1 }));
      for (const c of CATS) name.append(new Option(t(c.name), c.id, false, c.id === groups[g]));
      name.onchange = save;
      head.append(key, name);
      col.append(head);
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const s = document.createElement('select'); s.id = `${id}-${g * 4 + i}`; s.dataset.slot = String(g * 4 + i);
        s.setAttribute('aria-label', t('Group {n}, phrase {i}', { n: g + 1, i: i + 1 }));
        // the special ones (the countdown) in a group of their own, first; then the categories'
        for (const c of [{ id: null, name: N('Special') }, ...CATS]) {
          const og = document.createElement('optgroup'); og.label = t(c.name);
          PHRASES.forEach((p, n) => {
            if (c.id === null ? !!p.special : !p.special && p.cat === c.id) og.append(new Option(t(p.text), String(n), false, n === layout[g * 4 + i]));
          });
          s.append(og);
        }
        s.onchange = save;
        col.append(s);
      }
      grid.append(col);
    }
    det.append(sum, grid);
    if (reset) {
      const r = iconButton('reset-btn', t('Reset {label}', { label }), RESET);
      r.title = t('Back to the default ({value})', { value: DEFAULT_PHRASES.slice(0, SLOTS).map(p => t(PHRASES[p].text)).join(', ') });
      r.onclick = reset;
      det.append(r);
    }
    ctl.append(det);
    return sum;
  }

  /** the control is described by its help line, its own note (the Crews box's) and any state line under it */
  private describe(el: HTMLElement, row: HTMLElement) {
    el.setAttribute('aria-describedby', [...row.querySelectorAll('.set-help, .set-note, .set-state')].map(p => p.id).join(' '));
  }

  /** The crews as a Leave, Join or colour left them, saved (names and colours in one write; none left: both lines
   *  back to the template's); then, if the row had the focus, it goes where focus() says. */
  private async setCrews(list: Crew[], focus: (row: HTMLElement) => Element | null | undefined) {
    const had = !!this.find('.set[data-key="roam_crew"]')?.contains(document.activeElement);
    await this.put('roam_crew', list.length ? crewsValue(list.map(c => c.name)) : null, [['roam_crew_colours', list.length ? rgbsValue(list) : null]]);
    const row = this.find<HTMLElement>('.set[data-key="roam_crew"]');
    if (had && row) ((focus(row) ?? row.querySelector('input:enabled')) as HTMLElement | null)?.focus();
  }

  private state(row: HTMLElement, msg: string, cls: string) {
    let p = row.querySelector<HTMLParagraphElement>(`.set-state.${cls}`);
    if (!p) { p = document.createElement('p'); p.id = `set-${row.dataset.key}-${cls}`; row.append(p); }
    p.className = `set-state ${cls}`; p.textContent = msg;
  }

  private async saveRaw() {
    const ta = this.root.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>('#settings-text')!;
    const msg = this.root.querySelector('#settings-text-msg')!;
    if (this.ro()) { msg.textContent = this.roText(); return; }
    const next = ta.value.endsWith('\n') ? ta.value : ta.value + '\n';
    const r = resolveEnv(next, this.deps.environment, {});
    const bad = r.notes.filter(n => /ignored$|only the page sets it$/.test(n) && !/is set in the environment|already set/.test(n));
    await this.write(next);
    msg.textContent = bad.length ? tn(bad.length, 'Saved. {n} line is ignored: {first}', 'Saved. {n} lines are ignored: {first} …', { first: bad[0] }) : t('Saved.');
  }

  /** "Reset all settings", once the player said yes */
  private async resetAll() {
    if (this.ro()) { this.deps.say?.(this.roText()); return; }
    if (this.deps.confirm && !await this.deps.confirm(t('Reset all settings?'),
      t('Every setting here goes back to its default, and other settings.ini lines are removed. Your name, crews, language and in-game options stay.'),
      t('Reset'), true)) return;
    if (this.ro()) { this.deps.say?.(this.roText()); return; }       // another tab took the saves meanwhile
    await this.write(resetAll(this.text));
    this.deps.say?.(() => t('Settings are back to their defaults. Applies the next time you press Play.'));
  }

  /** a line of "Other settings in this file" back to its default; a keyboard's focus goes on to the next one */
  private async resetLine(phys: number, key: string, btn: HTMLButtonElement) {
    if (this.ro()) { this.deps.say?.(this.roText()); return; }
    const at = [...this.root.querySelectorAll('#settings-other .reset-btn')].indexOf(btn), focused = document.activeElement === btn;
    await this.write(resetLine(this.text ?? TEMPLATE, phys));
    if (focused) {
      const rest = this.root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('#settings-other .reset-btn');
      (rest[Math.min(at, rest.length - 1)] ?? this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#settings-raw > summary'))?.focus();
    }
    this.deps.say?.(() => t('Saved: {key} is back to its default. Applies the next time you press Play.', { key }));
  }

  /** settings.ini as a whole (the text editor, a reset), and the panel drawn again */
  private async write(next: string) {
    const was = await this.deps.file.write(next);
    this.resolve(next);
    this.deps.onSaved?.(next, was);
    this.render();
    this.root.dataset.saved = String(++this.saves);
  }
}

// settings.ini for the browser: a port of runtime/bundle.m's settings table,
// validation, template, settings_put and the upgrade of older files.
//
// The file lives in the save overlay (OPFS <saveDir>/settings.ini, which the
// game sees as /save/settings.ini).  It is read once when Play is pressed and
// becomes the process environment, with the Mac app's precedence:
//   environment (here: the page address, ?env=NAME=value, on a development server only) > settings.ini > built-in default.
// Neither may set the mounts (HOST_FIXED) or the page's own variables (PATH_VARS: files of the saves, automation).
// "key = value" lines, '#' or ';' starts a comment line, [sections] are
// ignored, quotes around a value are stripped.  Known keys are validated and
// mapped to their variable; an UPPER_CASE key is passed on verbatim and any
// other lower_case key foo_bar becomes NFSU2_FOO_BAR, so runtime options
// that are not in this table still work.  A value an option does not take is
// noted and ignored, so a typo never silently selects something else.
//
// This module is pure (no DOM, no OPFS) so it can be checked under node.
import { blockedName, blockedPlate } from './names.mjs';
import { onlineName } from './claim';
import { crewsOk, rgbsOk } from './crews';
import { groupsOk, phrasesOk } from './phrases';
import { flagCode } from './flags';
import { plateUpper, plateValid } from './plates';
import { fill, LANGUAGES, N, type Vars } from './i18n';
export { LANGUAGES };

/** bundle.m's K_* kinds, and the browser's own crews (a list of names: crews.ts), blocked players (names: a list of
 *  players' names) and flag (one of flags.ts's codes).  ic: K_IC, "value ; comment" (the free-roam keys).  room:
 *  K_ROOM, text that does not read as a slur (names.mjs, as a player's name).  key: one of our controls' key, the
 *  browser's name of it (KeyboardEvent.code: sitekeys.ts), or off.  plate: a license plate's text (plates.ts), small
 *  letters as capitals, none that reads as a slur. */
export type Kind = 'raw' | 'bool' | 'boolInv' | 'enum' | 'num' | 'id' | 'token' | 'int' | 'name' | 'peers'
  | 'path' | 'text' | 'room' | 'wxh' | 'fixes' | 'ifname' | 'ipv4' | 'mac' | 'host' | 'parts' | 'dump' | 'crews' | 'rgbs'
  | 'phrases' | 'sayGroups' | 'names' | 'key' | 'flag' | 'plate';

export interface KeyDef {
  key: string;
  env: string;
  kind: Kind;
  /** enum: '|'-separated values ("#" = any number, "scale:#" = prefix + number); int: "lo..hi" */
  vals?: string;
  ic?: boolean;
  /** 'mac': only the Mac app uses it (a Mac settings.ini restored into the browser keeps working;
   *  the line is noted and ignored).  'web': meaningful in the browser. */
  scope: 'web' | 'mac';
  /** a setting of this device (its screen, GPU, sound output, controller, address on the LAN), not the player's: a
   *  keyphrase's saves leave it out, and each browser keeps its own (withoutDevice, withDevice) */
  device?: boolean;
}

// bundle.m's table (mac/v12na-port 5170908: 59 keys), in its order and with its
// validation (web/tools/settings-diff.mjs runs bundle.m's own C against this
// table), plus the browser's own keys at the end (audio_latency, online: web-only).
// Keys the browser build does not act on are scope 'mac': the graphics options
// (enhance.c is compiled in, but whether the WebGPU renderer honours them is
// the gfx track's, UNVERIFIED), the texture packs (texrep.m is not ported: the
// tex track's), the Metal HUD, the BSD-socket LAN interface and address (the
// browser's address comes from the server's switch), free roam's peers and port
// (every browser has an address of its own on that switch, which the page never
// shows, and the server's free-roam hub picks the players near it; the test
// tools set NFSU2_ROAM_PORT and NFSU2_ROAM_PEERS in the page address), Discord
// and the background controller.  The LAN keys the browser's runtime reads (network:
// on/lan = the server's virtual LAN, off = none; lan_adapter_id, lan_host_name,
// lan_timing) are 'web' but have no template paragraph: the player's page does
// not offer the game's LAN races yet (PLAYING.md).
/** the horns (runtime/horn.c), the setting's values; dual is the default */
export const HORNS = ['dual', 'single', 'truck', 'train', 'klaxon', 'cucaracha', 'clown', 'trombone', 'dixie', 'oldcar', 'broken',
  'sputter', 'thecar', 'thecar_long'] as const;

export const KEYS: readonly KeyDef[] = [
  // app
  { key: 'game_folder', env: 'NFSU2_DATA', kind: 'path', scope: 'mac' },
  { key: 'movies', env: 'NOMOVIES', kind: 'boolInv', scope: 'web' },
  { key: 'intro', env: 'NFSU2_INTRO', kind: 'enum', vals: 'skippable|original|off', scope: 'web' },
  { key: 'sound', env: 'NOSOUND', kind: 'boolInv', scope: 'web' },
  { key: 'background', env: 'NFSU2_BACKGROUND', kind: 'enum', vals: 'pause|run', scope: 'web' },
  { key: 'quit_grace', env: 'NFSU2_QUIT_GRACE', kind: 'num', scope: 'web' },
  { key: 'seed_registry', env: 'NFSU2_SEED_REGISTRY', kind: 'bool', scope: 'web', device: true },
  // stall report in the log
  { key: 'watchdog', env: 'NFSU2_WATCHDOG', kind: 'num', scope: 'web' },
  // display
  { key: 'fullscreen', env: 'NFSFULL', kind: 'bool', scope: 'web', device: true },
  { key: 'native_resolution', env: 'NFSNATIVE', kind: 'bool', scope: 'web', device: true },
  { key: 'resolution', env: 'NFSRES', kind: 'wxh', scope: 'web', device: true },

/** strcasecmp's and toupper's folding: ASCII letters only (String.toLowerCase would also fold the Kelvin sign to 'k') */
const lower = (v: string) => v.replace(/[A-Z]/g, c => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0) + 32));
const upper = (v: string) => v.replace(/[a-z]/g, c => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0) - 32));
const BY_KEY = new Map(KEYS.map(k => [k.key, k]));
export function keyDef(key: string): KeyDef | undefined { return BY_KEY.get(lower(key)); }

// The first line is the Mac template's, on purpose: a settings.ini written by
// the Mac app and restored into the browser (or the other way round) is
// recognised as "ours" and gets missing options appended (settingsUpgrade).
export const TEMPLATE = `# NFSU2 settings, read at every launch.
#
# One "key = value" per line; lines starting with '#' are comments.  Every
# option below is commented out and shows its built-in default: remove the
# '#' to change it (or use Settings on the start page, which edits this file).
# In the browser this file lives in the save storage of this browser for this
# server, next to registry.txt and the profiles; "Download backup" in Saves
# includes it.  On a development server, an environment variable of the same
# meaning (shown in brackets) can be given in the page address,
# ?env=NAME=value, and overrides this file.  Any other runtime variable can be
# set here too, by its own name in capitals (e.g. NFSU2_STATUS_EVERY = 600),
# and a lower-case key foo_bar is passed on as NFSU2_FOO_BAR; not the ones
# that name files or drive the game, which the page sets.  A value that an
# option does not accept is ignored and noted in the log.  Changes apply the
# next time you press Play.

# ---- Game ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Intro, story and FMV movies.  [NOMOVIES, inverted]
#movies = on

# The movies at startup (EA and THX logos, the PSA, the intro): skippable =
# Enter, Escape, Space, a left click or a controller's A, B or Start ends each
# one; original = as in the game, where only the intro ends early; off = they
# are not played.  [NFSU2_INTRO]
#intro = skippable

# The game's language: english, french, german, italian, spanish, dutch,
# swedish, danish, korean, chinese, japanese, russian, thai, portuguese
# (Brazil's), polish, turkish, hungarian, ukrainian, czech, slovak or
# greek.  French, German, Italian, Spanish, Japanese and Russian come with
# their dubbed voices and movies where the server has the language packs;
# Russian, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Hungarian, Ukrainian, Czech, Slovak
# and Greek take their text from them too.
# [NFSU2_LANGUAGE]
#language = english

# The movies' subtitles: the PSA, the tutorials and the story, in every
# language but French, German, Italian and Spanish (whose movies are dubbed).
# English's are VileStuff's English Subtitles Fixed (nfsmods.xyz/mod/5286),
# with who says each line, where the server has its language pack.
# [NFSU2_SUBTITLES]
#subtitles = on

# The EA Trax songs: uncensored = unedited, some in longer versions than
# the game's (xGMVx's Uncensored & Restored Soundtrack,
# nfsmods.xyz/mod/3649); original = the versions the game shipped with,
# where the server has them.  Its key (key_song, F7) plays the next song
# while you play.
# [NFSU2_SONGS]
#songs = uncensored

# Music in drag and drift races: on = the EA Trax songs (or the Radio's
# tracks) play there too, as in the other races, at the game's music volume;
# off = as in the original game, which has none there, so you hear the
# engine for shifting.  [NFSU2_RACE_MUSIC]
#race_music = off

# Sound output.  [NOSOUND, inverted]
#sound = on

# Autosave: before Play, every profile still on the game's own default, Save
# = Prompt (whose "save?" question opens on No), is set to Autosave once, so
# the game saves by itself after races, purchases and changes.  A profile
# gets it at the first Play after it was saved; pick Prompt or Off in the
# game's Options, Gameplay, Save and that choice stays.  off = profiles keep
# what the game has.  [NFSU2_AUTOSAVE]
#autosave = on

# The career's 33 hidden races on the world map and the radar like the
# others, as MaxHwoy's Show Hidden Races Mod (nfsmods.xyz/mod/1583) has
# them, and the map offers up to 8 races of each kind at once (the original
# 1 to 4), so the ones once hidden take no others off it.  off = the
# original game: a hidden race shows only when you drive near it.
# [NFSU2_SHOW_HIDDEN_RACES]
#show_hidden_races = off

# The distance to the GPS destination under its arrow, in metres or feet as
# Speedometer Units has it (Mods: GPS Distance).
# [NFSU2_GPS_DISTANCE]
#gps_distance = off

# The car's visual rating set by the career's stage, not by its parts, as
# thelink2012's Visual Reputation Remover (github.com/thelink2012/novisualrep)
# has it: every DVD cover shoot of the stage is offered at the next free-roam
# load, a cover pays by that rating, and the shops show no Visual Rating box.
# off = the original game.
# [NFSU2_VISUAL_REP_REMOVER]
