// The screenshots part of the Saves section.  F12 while the game runs saves the
// next frame as a PNG at the top of the save folder (shell.ts screenshot,
// saveScreenshot here), so a backup carries it with the saves.  Shown newest
// first: the newest across the section, the next four in a row under it.  One opens in the #shot-view dialog
// to page through all of them (the arrow keys too), download or delete.  Delete
// all in the section's head deletes every one, after a question that says how
// many and how much (2026-11-05: a player's backup was too large to download).
// Thumbnails are made one at a time (a 4K PNG takes about 0.1 s to decode) and
// kept while the page lives.  TGA files (what the game's own F12 wrote before
// the page took the key, black in this port, and the PC game's) are decoded
// here: browsers show no TGA.

import { exists, removePath, saveRoot, writeFile, type Entry } from './savefs';
import { downloadBlob, stamp } from './logs';
import { fmtBytes } from './checks';
import { dateLocale, t, tn } from './i18n';

export interface ShotsDeps {
  saveDir: string;
  confirm(title: string, body: Node | string, ok: string, danger?: boolean): Promise<boolean>;
  /** a screenshot was deleted: the section lists the save folder again */
  changed(): void;
  /** a line for the player in the section (Delete all's trouble) */
  say(text: string): void;
}

/** the newest across the section, four under it; the dialog pages through the rest */
const SHOWN = 5;
/** thumbnails' widths: the four's, the newest's (the section is at most 664 px wide, 1328 on a 2x screen) */
const THUMB_W = 384, BIG_W = 1344;
const MIME: Record<string, string> = { png: 'image/png', jpg: 'image/jpeg', jpeg: 'image/jpeg', bmp: 'image/bmp', tga: 'image/x-tga' };
const ext = (name: string) => name.slice(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase();
const key = (s: Entry, w = THUMB_W) => `${s.path}|${s.size}|${s.mtime}|${w}`;

/** Write an F12 screenshot at the top of the save folder as nfsu2-<date>_<time>.png; returns its name. */
export async function saveScreenshot(saveDir: string, png: Blob, d = new Date()): Promise<string> {
  const base = `nfsu2-${stamp(d)}`;
  let name = `${base}.png`;
  for (let n = 2; await exists(saveDir, name); n++) name = `${base}-${n}.png`;
  await writeFile(saveDir, name, png);
  return name;
}

/**
 * A TGA's pixels: true colour, uncompressed or RLE (types 2 and 10), 24 or 32 bits, either row order.  Alpha is
 * left out (the game's are X8R8G8B8, alpha 0).  null: another kind, or cut short.
 */
export function decodeTga(b: Uint8Array): ImageData | null {
  if (b.length < 18) return null;
  const type = b[2], w = b[12] | b[13] << 8, h = b[14] | b[15] << 8, bpp = b[16], top = (b[17] & 0x20) !== 0;
  if (b[1] !== 0 || (type !== 2 && type !== 10) || (bpp !== 24 && bpp !== 32) || !w || !h) return null;
  const px = bpp >> 3, out = new ImageData(w, h), d = out.data;
  let p = 18 + b[0], x = 0, y = 0, o = top ? 0 : (h - 1) * w * 4;
  const put = (s: number) => {
    d[o] = b[s + 2]; d[o + 1] = b[s + 1]; d[o + 2] = b[s]; d[o + 3] = 255; o += 4;
    if (++x === w) { x = 0; y++; o = (top ? y : h - 1 - y) * w * 4; }
  };
  if (type === 2) {
    if (p + w * h * px > b.length) return null;
    for (; y < h; p += px) put(p);
    return out;
  }
  while (y < h) {
    if (p >= b.length) return null;
    const c = b[p++], n = (c & 127) + 1;
    if (p + (c & 128 ? 1 : n) * px > b.length) return null;
    if (c & 128) { for (let i = 0; i < n && y < h; i++) put(p); p += px; }
    else for (let i = 0; i < n && y < h; i++, p += px) put(p);
  }
  return out;
}

/** "Today, 14:03", "Yesterday, 22:17", "20 Oct, 21:44" (with the year when it is not this one) */
export function when(at: number, now = new Date()): string {
  const d = new Date(at), time = d.toLocaleTimeString(dateLocale(), { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  const day = (x: Date) => Date.UTC(x.getFullYear(), x.getMonth(), x.getDate());
  const ago = Math.round((day(now) - day(d)) / 864e5);
  if (ago === 0) return t('Today, {time}', { time });
  if (ago === 1) return t('Yesterday, {time}', { time });
  const year = d.getFullYear() !== now.getFullYear() ? { year: 'numeric' as const } : {};
  return `${d.toLocaleDateString(dateLocale(), { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', ...year })}, ${time}`;
}

async function fileOf(saveDir: string, name: string): Promise<File> {
  return (await (await saveRoot(saveDir, false)).getFileHandle(name)).getFile();
}

/** a screenshot decoded (resizeWidth: made that wide on the way) */
async function bitmap(saveDir: string, name: string, resizeWidth?: number): Promise<ImageBitmap> {
  const f = await fileOf(saveDir, name);
  const o: ImageBitmapOptions = resizeWidth ? { resizeWidth, resizeQuality: 'medium' } : {};
  if (ext(name) !== 'tga') return createImageBitmap(f, o);
  const img = decodeTga(new Uint8Array(await f.arrayBuffer()));
  if (!img) throw new Error('not a TGA this page reads');
  return createImageBitmap(img, o);
}

async function encode(bmp: ImageBitmap, type: string): Promise<Blob> {
  const c = new OffscreenCanvas(bmp.width, bmp.height);
  c.getContext('2d')!.drawImage(bmp, 0, 0);
  bmp.close();
  return c.convertToBlob({ type, quality: 0.85 });
}

export class ScreenshotsPart {
  private shots: Entry[] = [];
  /** thumbnails: key -> object URL of a small JPEG, null when the file cannot be drawn */
  private thumbs = new Map<string, Promise<string | null>>();
  private queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
  private dlg: HTMLDialogElement;
  /** the one in the dialog, its object URL; seq: the latest open() wins */
  private open: string | null = null;
  private url: string | null = null;
  private seq = 0;

  constructor(private root: HTMLElement, private deps: ShotsDeps) {
    this.dlg = root.ownerDocument.querySelector<HTMLDialogElement>('#shot-view')!;
    root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('#shots-clear')!.onclick = () => void this.removeAll();
    this.dlg.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const a = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-act]')?.dataset.act;
      if (a === 'newer') this.step(-1); else if (a === 'older') this.step(1);
      else if (a === 'download') void this.download(); else if (a === 'delete') void this.remove();
    });
    this.dlg.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && e.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
      e.preventDefault();
      this.step(e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 1);
    });
    this.dlg.addEventListener('close', () => {
      this.open = null; this.seq++;
      this.$<HTMLImageElement>('#shot-img').removeAttribute('src');
      if (this.url) { URL.revokeObjectURL(this.url); this.url = null; }
    });
  }

  private $<T extends HTMLElement>(sel: string): T { return this.dlg.querySelector<T>(sel)!; }

  /** The screenshots as the save folder has them now (saves-ui.ts refresh). */
  show(files: Entry[]) {
    this.shots = [...files].sort((a, b) => b.mtime - a.mtime || (a.path < b.path ? 1 : -1));
    const keep = new Set(this.shots.flatMap(s => [key(s), key(s, BIG_W)]));
    for (const [k, p] of this.thumbs) if (!keep.has(k)) { this.thumbs.delete(k); void p.then(u => u && URL.revokeObjectURL(u)); }
    this.render();
    if (!this.open) return;
    if (this.at() < 0) this.dlg.close(); else this.showPlace();
  }

  private at() { return this.shots.findIndex(s => s.path === this.open); }

  private render() {
    const n = this.shots.length;
    this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#shots-info')!.hidden = n > 0;
    this.root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#shots-clear')!.hidden = n === 0;
    const ul = this.root.querySelector<HTMLUListElement>('#shots')!;
    ul.replaceChildren(...this.shots.slice(0, SHOWN).map((s, i) => {
      const b = this.tile(s, i ? THUMB_W : BIG_W);
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', t('Screenshot, {when}', { when: when(s.mtime) }));
      b.title = when(s.mtime);
      b.onclick = () => void this.view(i);
      const li = document.createElement('li'); li.append(b);
      return li;
    }));
  }

  /** a tile with the screenshot's thumbnail, once it is made (its kind in words if it cannot be drawn) */
  private tile(s: Entry, w: number): HTMLButtonElement {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'shot';
    void this.thumb(s, w).then(u => {
      if (u) b.prepend(Object.assign(document.createElement('img'), { src: u, alt: '', decoding: 'async' }));
      else b.prepend(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { className: 'kind', textContent: ext(s.path).toUpperCase() }));
    });
    return b;
  }

  private thumb(s: Entry, w: number): Promise<string | null> {
    let p = this.thumbs.get(key(s, w));
    if (!p) {
      p = this.queue.then(() => bitmap(this.deps.saveDir, s.path, w))
        .then(bmp => encode(bmp, 'image/jpeg')).then(b => URL.createObjectURL(b), () => null);
      this.queue = p;
      this.thumbs.set(key(s, w), p);
    }
    return p;
  }

  /** open screenshot i in the dialog (or show it there in place of the one open) */
  private async view(i: number) {
    const s = this.shots[i], seq = ++this.seq, img = this.$<HTMLImageElement>('#shot-img');
    this.open = s.path;
    this.$('#shot-when').textContent = when(s.mtime);
    this.showPlace();
    if (!this.dlg.open) this.dlg.showModal();
    img.removeAttribute('src');
    let url: string;
    try {
      url = URL.createObjectURL(ext(s.path) === 'tga' ? await encode(await bitmap(this.deps.saveDir, s.path), 'image/png')
        : await fileOf(this.deps.saveDir, s.path));
    } catch (e) {
      if (seq === this.seq) this.$('#shot-meta').textContent = t('{place}. It cannot be shown here ({error}): Download keeps it as it is.', { place: this.place(), error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
      return;
    }
    if (seq !== this.seq) { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); return; }
    if (this.url) URL.revokeObjectURL(this.url);
    this.url = url;
    img.alt = t('Screenshot, {when}', { when: when(s.mtime) });
    img.src = url;
    try { await img.decode(); } catch { /* shown as the browser can */ }
    if (seq === this.seq && img.naturalWidth) this.$('#shot-meta').textContent = `${this.place()} · ${img.naturalWidth} × ${img.naturalHeight} · ${fmtBytes(s.size)}`;
  }

  private place() { return t('{n} of {total}', { n: this.at() + 1, total: this.shots.length }); }

  /** the open one's place in the list, and which way the dialog can go from it */
  private showPlace() {
    const i = this.at(), s = this.shots[i];
    this.$('#shot-meta').textContent = `${this.place()} · ${fmtBytes(s.size)}`;
    this.$<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-act="newer"]').disabled = i <= 0;
    this.$<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-act="older"]').disabled = i >= this.shots.length - 1;
  }

  private step(d: number) {
    const i = this.at() + d;
    if (this.open && i >= 0 && i < this.shots.length) void this.view(i);
  }

  private async download() {
    const s = this.shots[this.at()];
    if (s) downloadBlob(await fileOf(this.deps.saveDir, s.path), s.path, MIME[ext(s.path)]);
  }

  private async remove() {
    const i = this.at(), s = this.shots[i];
    if (!s || !await this.deps.confirm(t('Delete this screenshot?'), t('{file} is deleted from this browser; downloaded backups keep their copy.', { file: s.path }), t('Delete'), true)) return;
    try { await removePath(this.deps.saveDir, s.path); }
    catch (e) { this.$('#shot-meta').textContent = t('It was not deleted: {error}', { error: String(e) }); return; }
    this.shots.splice(i, 1);
    this.render();
    if (!this.shots.length) this.dlg.close();
    else void this.view(Math.min(i, this.shots.length - 1));
    this.deps.changed();
  }

  /** Delete all: every screenshot, after the question */
  private async removeAll() {
    const all = [...this.shots], size = all.reduce((a, s) => a + s.size, 0);
    if (!all.length || !await this.deps.confirm(tn(all.length, 'Delete {n} screenshot ({size})?', 'Delete {n} screenshots ({size})?', { size: fmtBytes(size) }),
      t('They are deleted from this browser; downloaded backups keep their copies.'), t('Delete all'), true)) return;
    let failed = 0, error = '';
    for (const s of all) {
      try { await removePath(this.deps.saveDir, s.path); }
      catch (e) { failed++; error = String(e); }
    }
    if (this.dlg.open) this.dlg.close();
    this.deps.changed();
    if (failed) this.deps.say(tn(failed, '{n} screenshot was not deleted: {error}', '{n} screenshots were not deleted: {error}', { error }));
  }
}

// settings.ts, this device's); the runtime reads the ones it handles (runtime/dinput_kbd.c dikbd_site_key: drift mode,
// the hood, trunk and doors, the horn, the headlights, hiding the HUD (photo.c), and Message a friend's and Add
// friend's, whose clashes it tells the page: gamekeys.ts; dinput_pad.c the buttons), the page the others at Play
// (applySiteKeys with the game's environment) and on the start page as they change.  (The headlights' controller has
// no button to set: the look's stick pushed straight up, runtime/lightkey.c; the free look has no key, only its
// switch: Auto or Off, a click on its cap, runtime/dinput_pad.c pad_look_stick, which the headlights' stick goes with.)
//   offered   a key the game has one of its controls on by default (its driving map's keys, unless the player gave
//             that control another key in its Options, Controls; its menus' for the ones that work in the menus too),
//             the browser's F5 and F11, quick chat's 1 to 4 and another of ours are refused; the ones that work in the menus too (the page's menu, photo mode, the next song, the counter)
//             take only keys that type nothing (F6 to F12, Page Up, Page Down, Pause, Scroll Lock, Delete), and the
//             page's menu is never off.  A controller's: a D-pad direction held a second (drift mode, the hood,
//             trunk and doors: a short press stays the game's) or a stick's click (the horn, quick chat), and the free
//             look Auto or Off; Home and both sticks pressed in always open the menu.  Hiding the HUD works only while
//             driving, so its key need not be one that types nothing (F10 by default: the game has nothing on it, and
//             the page keeps it from the browser's menu bar).
//   bound     a key the player put one of the game's controls on (its Options, Controls: the game keeps those in
//             registry.txt, runtime/dinput_kbd.c's user maps) stays the game's: its row says so.
import { CODE_OF_DIK, CODES } from '../input/keymap';
import { allPads } from '../input/steampad';
import { N, t } from './i18n';

export type OurId = 'drift' | 'showoff' | 'horn' | 'lights' | 'look' | 'chat' | 'message' | 'friend' | 'lobby' | 'lobbyNew' | 'lobbyPrivate' | 'lobbyInvite' |
  'photo' | 'hud' | 'menu' | 'song' | 'fps';
export type ButtonKey = 'button_hold' | 'button_horn' | 'button_chat' | 'button_look';

export interface Our {
  id: OurId;
  /** its name (in what a refusal says, and for a screen reader) and what it does (its row's); English, translated where
   *  drawn */
  name: string; line: string;
  /** settings.ini's key for its key and the default (a KeyboardEvent.code); none: its keys are fixed (quick chat's) */
  key?: string; def?: string;
  /** what stands for its keys where they are fixed */
  fixed?: string;
  /** it works in the menus too: only keys that type nothing */
  menus?: boolean;
  /** never off (the page's menu: the way back) */
  always?: boolean;
  /** its controller button's settings.ini key */
  button?: ButtonKey;
  /** its button is a switch: a click on its cap is the next of its choices (BUTTONS), no press waited for */
  toggle?: boolean;
}

/** ours, in the rows' order (each one's settings.ini key is in settings.ts too) */
export const OURS: readonly Our[] = [
  { id: 'drift', name: N('Drift mode'), line: N('Drift mode (in free roam)'), key: 'key_drift', def: 'KeyX', button: 'button_hold' },
  { id: 'showoff', name: N('Hood, trunk, doors'), line: N('Open hood, then trunk, then doors, then all (parked, in free roam)'), key: 'key_showoff',
    def: 'KeyO', button: 'button_hold' },
  { id: 'horn', name: N('Horn'), line: N('Horn (with other players)'), key: 'key_horn', def: 'KeyN', button: 'button_horn' },
  { id: 'lights', name: N('Headlights'), line: N('Headlights off or on; hold for high beam'), key: 'key_lights', def: 'KeyG' },
  { id: 'look', name: N('Free look'), line: N('Right stick looks round the car (Off: stick up no longer switches the headlights)'), button: 'button_look',
    toggle: true },
  { id: 'chat', name: N('Quick chat'), line: N('Quick chat (with other players): group, then phrase'), fixed: '1–4', button: 'button_chat' },
  { id: 'message', name: N('Message a friend'), line: N('Message a friend (in free roam)'), key: 'key_message', def: 'KeyI' },
  { id: 'friend', name: N('Add friend'), line: N('Add a friend (front bumpers touching)'), key: 'key_friend', def: 'KeyF' },
  { id: 'lobby', name: N('Next race lobby'), line: N('Next race lobby at a start (in free roam)'), key: 'key_lobby', def: 'KeyE' },
  { id: 'lobbyNew', name: N('New race lobby'), line: N('A race lobby of your own beside the others at a start (in free roam)'), key: 'key_lobby_new', def: 'KeyB' },
  { id: 'lobbyPrivate', name: N('Who can join'), line: N('Your race lobby: who can join it (your stage and below, friends & crew, or everyone)'),
    key: 'key_lobby_private', def: 'KeyV' },
  { id: 'lobbyInvite', name: N('Invite to a race'), line: N('Invite friends to your race lobby, join a friend\'s invite, leave a race you joined from afar'),
    key: 'key_lobby_invite', def: 'KeyZ' },
  { id: 'photo', name: N('Photo mode'), line: N('Photo mode, then the photo'), key: 'key_photo', def: 'F12', menus: true },
  { id: 'hud', name: N('Hide HUD'), line: N('Hide or show the HUD while driving (names and chat over cars too)'), key: 'key_hud', def: 'F10' },
  { id: 'menu', name: N('Menu'), line: N('Menu: full screen, controls, log, quit'), key: 'key_menu', def: 'F9', menus: true, always: true },
  { id: 'song', name: N('Next song'), line: N('Next song'), key: 'key_song', def: 'F7', menus: true },
  { id: 'fps', name: N('Frame-rate counter'), line: N('Frame-rate counter'), key: 'key_fps', def: 'F8', menus: true },
];
export const OUR = Object.fromEntries(OURS.map(o => [o.id, o])) as Record<OurId, Our>;
/** each button's choices, the default first, and what each is in the controller's own words */
export const BUTTONS: Record<ButtonKey, readonly string[]> = {
  button_hold: ['ddown', 'dup', 'dleft', 'dright'],
  button_horn: ['ls', 'rs'],
  button_chat: ['rs', 'ls'],
  button_look: ['auto', 'off'],
};
/** settings.ini's keys of ours (settings.ts has them too) */
export const SITE_KEYS: readonly string[] = [...OURS.flatMap(o => o.key ? [o.key] : []), ...Object.keys(BUTTONS)];

// ---- what is set now ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/** settings.ini key -> its environment variable's name (key_drift -> NFSU2_KEY_DRIFT: settings.ts envNameOf's way) */
const envOf = (k: string) => `NFSU2_${k.toUpperCase()}`;
let now: Record<string, string> = {};
const listeners: (() => void)[] = [];
/** the game's environment (or the start page's settings resolved): what ours are from now on */
export function applySiteKeys(env: Record<string, string | undefined>) {
  const next: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const k of SITE_KEYS) { const v = env[envOf(k)]; if (v) next[k] = v; }
  if (JSON.stringify(next) === JSON.stringify(now)) return;
  now = next;
  for (const f of listeners) f();
}
/** f after every change of ours (the hints that name a key) */
export function onSiteKeys(f: () => void) { listeners.push(f); }
/** a control's key now (a KeyboardEvent.code), null: off or none */
export function siteKey(id: OurId): string | null {
  const o = OUR[id];
  if (!o.key) return null;
  const v = now[o.key] ?? o.def!;
  if (v === 'off') return o.always ? o.def! : null;
  return CODES[v] ? v : o.def!;
}
/** the control a key is now (one of ours that works in the menus too: they are the page's at any time) */
export function menuKeyOf(code: string): OurId | null {
  for (const id of ['menu', 'photo', 'song', 'fps'] as const) if (siteKey(id) === code) return id;
  return null;
}
/** a button's setting now ('off': none) */
export function siteButton(k: ButtonKey): string {
  const v = now[k], ok = BUTTONS[k];
  return v === 'off' ? 'off' : v && ok.includes(v) ? v : ok[0];
}

// ---- names ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const PUNCT: Record<string, string> = {
  Minus: '-', Equal: '=', BracketLeft: '[', BracketRight: ']', Semicolon: ';', Quote: '\'', Backquote: '`', Backslash: '\\',
  IntlBackslash: '<', Comma: ',', Period: '.', Slash: '/', NumpadAdd: 'Num +', NumpadSubtract: 'Num -', NumpadMultiply: 'Num *',
  NumpadDivide: 'Num /', NumpadDecimal: 'Num .', PageUp: 'Page Up', PageDown: 'Page Down', ScrollLock: 'Scroll Lock',
};
/** a key's name on its cap: X, 5, F12, Num 7, Page Up (the US layout's) */
export function keyName(code: string): string {
  if (/^Key[A-Z]$/.test(code)) return code.slice(3);
  if (/^Digit\d$/.test(code)) return code.slice(5);
  if (/^Numpad\d$/.test(code)) return `Num ${code.slice(6)}`;
  return PUNCT[code] ?? code;
}
/** a controller button's name: the D-pad's arrows, a stick as Xbox or PlayStation names it */
export function buttonName(v: string, ps = false): string {
  switch (v) {
    case 'ddown': return t('D-pad {arrow}', { arrow: '↓' });
    case 'dup': return t('D-pad {arrow}', { arrow: '↑' });
    case 'dleft': return t('D-pad {arrow}', { arrow: '←' });
    case 'dright': return t('D-pad {arrow}', { arrow: '→' });
    case 'ls': return ps ? 'L3' : 'LS';
    case 'rs': return ps ? 'R3' : 'RS';
    case 'auto': return t('Auto');
    default: return t('Off');
  }
}
/** a D-pad direction's cap: a small cross with that arm filled (kbd .glyph, as controls.ts draws the pad's names), the
 *  same in every language, its name said (buttonName); a stick's its name; none: Off, dimmed */
const DPAD = 'M5.5 1.5h3v4h4v3h-4v4h-3v-4h-4v-3h4z';
const ARM: Record<string, string> = { dup: 'M5.5 1.5h3v4h-3z', ddown: 'M5.5 8.5h3v4h-3z', dleft: 'M1.5 5.5h4v3h-4z', dright: 'M8.5 5.5h4v3h-4z' };
export function buttonCap(v: string, ps = false): HTMLElement {
  if (v === 'off') return offCap();
  if (!(v in ARM)) return kbd(buttonName(v, ps));
  const k = document.createElement('kbd'), NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const svg = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('class', 'glyph'); svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 14 14'); svg.setAttribute('role', 'img');
  svg.setAttribute('aria-label', buttonName(v));
  for (const [d, fill] of [[DPAD, ''], [ARM[v], 'currentColor']]) {
    const p = document.createElementNS(NS, 'path'); p.setAttribute('d', d);
    if (fill) p.setAttribute('fill', fill);
    svg.append(p);
  }
  k.append(svg);
  return k;
}
function offCap(): HTMLElement { const k = kbd(t('Off')); k.classList.add('off'); return k; }
/** the standard mapping's buttons for a button choice (navigator.getGamepads: 10 LS, 11 RS, 12-15 the D-pad) */
const PAD_INDEX: Record<string, number> = { ls: 10, rs: 11, dup: 12, ddown: 13, dleft: 14, dright: 15 };

// ---- what may be picked ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/** the game's driving map (0x7fcac0, 53 actions): each row's default key, in the map's order (a row's number is its
 *  index in registry.txt's "DIMap.{map}.53.<row>"): Throttle, Brake, Left, Right, Shift Up, Shift Down, Handbrake,
 *  Nitrous, HUD, Camera, Look Back, Pause, Respot, Engage, WorldMap, SMS, Legend, Hydraulic Bounce, Hydraulic Pressurize
 *  (two keys each), Drop.  Rows 39 to 52 are its debug camera's (Numpad 1-4 and 6-9, L, [, ], G ...), which the game
 *  never reads (runtime/dinput_kbd.c ACT_DEBUG): their keys are free. */
const DRIVING_ROWS = ['ArrowUp', 'KeyW', 'ArrowDown', 'KeyS', 'ArrowLeft', 'KeyA', 'ArrowRight', 'KeyD', 'ShiftLeft', 'Semicolon',
  'ControlLeft', 'Period', 'Space', 'End', 'AltLeft', 'AltRight', 'KeyQ', 'Equal', 'KeyC', 'Insert', 'KeyB', 'KeyK', 'Escape', 'KeyP',
  'KeyR', 'Home', 'Enter', 'F1', 'KeyM', 'F2', 'Tab', 'F3', 'KeyT', 'F4', 'KeyJ', 'KeyU', 'KeyH', 'KeyY', 'Digit5'];
/** and for ours that work in the menus too, its menus' (0x7fd7e0) */
const GAME_MENUS = ['NumpadEnter', 'Comma'];
/** ours that work in the menus too take only these: they type nothing in the game's text fields */
const NO_TEXT = ['F6', 'F7', 'F8', 'F9', 'F10', 'F12', 'F13', 'F14', 'F15', 'PageUp', 'PageDown', 'Pause', 'ScrollLock', 'Delete'];
/** never: the browser's (reload, full screen), the modifiers, keys that are the system's */
const NEVER = ['F5', 'F11', 'ShiftRight', 'ControlRight', 'MetaLeft', 'MetaRight', 'OSLeft', 'OSRight', 'CapsLock', 'NumLock',
  'PrintScreen', 'ContextMenu', 'Backspace', 'NumpadEnter'];
/** quick chat's, fixed */
const CHAT_KEYS = ['Digit1', 'Digit2', 'Digit3', 'Digit4', 'Numpad1', 'Numpad2', 'Numpad3', 'Numpad4'];

/** why our control cannot have this key ('' it can); others: the keys the other rows have now; game: the driving keys
 *  the game keeps (gameDrivingKeys) */
export function refusal(id: OurId, code: string, others: (id: OurId) => string | null = siteKey,
                        game: ReadonlySet<string> = gameDrivingKeys(null)): string {
  // (its own default always may: the headlights' G is one of the game's debug camera's)
  const o = OUR[id], k = keyName(code), own = code === o.def;
  if (!CODES[code] || NEVER.includes(code)) return t('{key} can\'t be used here.', { key: k });
  if (CHAT_KEYS.includes(code)) return t('{key} is quick chat\'s.', { key: k });
  if (!own && game.has(code)) return t('{key} is one of the game\'s keys: move its control to another key in the game\'s Options, Controls first.', { key: k });
  if (!own && o.menus && GAME_MENUS.includes(code)) return t('{key} is one of the game\'s keys.', { key: k });
  if (o.menus && !NO_TEXT.includes(code)) return t('This one works in menus too: pick a key that types nothing, such as F6 to F12.');
  for (const p of OURS) if (p.id !== id && others(p.id) === code) return t('{key} is already {what}.', { key: k, what: t(p.name) });
  return '';
}
/** why a button cannot have this choice ('' it can): the horn and quick chat on one click */
export function buttonRefusal(k: ButtonKey, v: string, others: (k: ButtonKey) => string = siteButton): string {
  const other = k === 'button_horn' ? 'button_chat' : k === 'button_chat' ? 'button_horn' : null;
  if (other && v !== 'off' && others(other) === v)
    return t('{button} is already {what}.', { button: buttonName(v), what: t(other === 'button_horn' ? 'Horn' : 'Quick chat') });
  return '';
}

/** the driving map's default keys the game keeps: all but those whose row the player gave another key, or none, in
 *  the game's Options, Controls (registry.txt's user map for that row: gameBoundKeys); the runtime then has no action
 *  on such a key (dinput_kbd.c rebound), so ours may have it */
export function gameDrivingKeys(registry: string | null): Set<string> {
  const moved = new Set<number>();
  for (const m of (registry ?? '').matchAll(/^s DIMap\.[^=\n]*\.53\.(\d+)=\s*[0-9a-f]{8} [0-9a-f]{8} ([0-9a-f]{8})\s*$/gim)) {
    const row = Number(m[1]), dik = (parseInt(m[2], 16) >>> 8) & 0xff;
    if (row < DRIVING_ROWS.length && CODE_OF_DIK[dik] !== DRIVING_ROWS[row]) moved.add(row);
  }
  return new Set(DRIVING_ROWS.filter((_, row) => !moved.has(row)));
}

/** the keys the player put one of the game's controls on (registry.txt's user maps, runtime/dinput_kbd.c:
 *  "s DIMap.{map}.<actions>.<action>=<semantic> <action id> <key's object>", the key in its second byte) */
export function gameBoundKeys(registry: string | null): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const m of (registry ?? '').matchAll(/^s DIMap\.[^=\n]*=\s*[0-9a-f]{8} [0-9a-f]{8} ([0-9a-f]{8})\s*$/gim)) {
    const dik = (parseInt(m[1], 16) >>> 8) & 0xff, code = dik ? CODE_OF_DIK[dik] : undefined;
    if (code) out.add(code);
  }
  return out;
}

// ---- the rows ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export interface SiteKeysDeps {
  /** settings.ini's line of a key (settings-ui.ts SettingsPanel set: null is the default), and what it says now */
  set(key: string, value: string | null): Promise<void> | void;
  current(key: string): string;
  /** another tab has the saves: nothing can be changed here */
  readOnly(): boolean;
  /** registry.txt of the saves (the game's own controls' keys), null: none */
  registry(): Promise<string | null>;
  /** PlayStation names for the sticks */
  ps(): boolean;
}

/**
 * The rows into box (the Controls sheet's Site tab), as the keys' list: what each of ours does, its key's cap and its
 * button's at the right.  editable: the start page's, where each cap is a button: a press waits for the new key (Esc:
 * as it was; Off: none) or the controller's press; else (the menu's copy while a game runs) only what they are.  On
 * touch screens too: phones and tablets play with controllers.
 */
export class SiteKeysView {
  private box: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private editable = false;
  private bound = new Set<string>();
  private game = gameDrivingKeys(null);
  private waiting: { id: OurId; button: boolean } | null = null;
  private note: { id: OurId; text: string; cls: string } | null = null;
  private stopWait: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(private deps: SiteKeysDeps) {}

  /** draws into box (again: a change of language, of settings.ini) */
  render(box?: HTMLElement, editable?: boolean) {
    if (box) { this.box = box; this.editable = !!editable; }
    if (!this.box) return;
    if (this.editable) void this.deps.registry().then(r => {
      const b = gameBoundKeys(r), g = gameDrivingKeys(r);
      if ([...b].join() !== [...this.bound].join() || [...g].join() !== [...this.game].join()) { this.bound = b; this.game = g; this.draw(); }
    });
    this.draw();
  }

  /** the key's setting now (as the file says: the start page's own view of it) */
  private keyNow(o: Our): string | null {
    if (!o.key) return null;
    const v = this.deps.current(o.key) || o.def!;
    return v === 'off' ? (o.always ? o.def! : null) : CODES[v] ? v : o.def!;
  }
  private buttonNow(k: ButtonKey): string {
    const v = this.deps.current(k) || BUTTONS[k][0];
    return v === 'off' || BUTTONS[k].includes(v) ? v : BUTTONS[k][0];
  }

  private draw() {
    const box = this.box!;
    const root = Object.assign(document.createElement('dl'), { className: 'keys site-keys' });
    for (const o of OURS) root.append(this.row(o));
    // (Home or both sticks for the menu, and holding Esc to leave full screen, are not set here: index.html's lines
    // under the box)
    box.replaceChildren(root);
    if (this.editable) {
      const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = 'hint';
      p.textContent = t('Click a key or a button, then press the new one. Applies the next time you press Play.');
      box.prepend(p);
    }
  }

  /** a row: what it does, the caps at the right (the keys' list's look) */
  private row(o: Our): HTMLElement {
    const row = document.createElement('div'); row.dataset.our = o.id;
    const dt = document.createElement('dt'), dd = document.createElement('dd');
    dt.append(...this.cells(o));
    dd.textContent = t(o.line);
    row.append(dt, dd);
    this.state(row, o);
    return row;
  }

  /** the key's and the button's caps (a button each that can be set; a plain cap for quick chat's fixed keys) */
  private cells(o: Our): HTMLElement[] {
    const out: HTMLElement[] = [];
    const k = this.keyNow(o);
    if (o.fixed) out.push(kbd(o.fixed));
    else if (o.key) out.push(this.cap_(o, false, k ? keyName(k) : t('Off'), k ? kbd(keyName(k)) : offCap()));
    if (o.button) {
      const b = this.buttonNow(o.button);
      out.push(this.cap_(o, true, buttonName(b, this.deps.ps()), buttonCap(b, this.deps.ps())));
    }
    return out;
  }
  /** a cap: text its name (said), cap what it shows (a key's name, the D-pad's glyph: buttonCap); a button round it
   *  where it can be set, its frame lime while it waits for a press (a switch's: a click is its next choice) */
  private cap_(o: Our, button: boolean, text: string, cap: HTMLElement): HTMLElement {
    const waiting = this.waiting?.id === o.id && this.waiting.button === button;
    const what = button ? t('{what}: controller button', { what: t(o.name) }) : t('{what}: key', { what: t(o.name) });
    if (!this.editable) { cap.setAttribute('aria-label', `${what}: ${text}`); return cap; }
    const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'keycap';
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', `${what}: ${waiting ? '' : text}`);
    if (waiting) {
      b.classList.add('selected');
      b.append(kbd(button ? t('Press a button') : t('Press a key')));
    } else b.append(cap);
    b.disabled = this.deps.readOnly();
    if (button && o.toggle) {
      const vals = BUTTONS[o.button!];
      b.onclick = () => { this.cancel(); this.note = null; void this.take(o, true, vals[(vals.indexOf(this.buttonNow(o.button!)) + 1) % vals.length]); };
    } else b.onclick = () => { if (waiting) this.cancel(); else this.wait(o, button); };
    return b;
  }
  /** under the row: why the last press was not taken, or that the game has its key */
  private state(row: HTMLElement, o: Our) {
    let text = '', cls = '';
    if (this.note?.id === o.id) ({ text, cls } = this.note);
    else if (this.waiting?.id === o.id) {
      text = this.waiting.button ? t('Press D-pad or a stick on the controller. Esc: as it was.') : t('Esc: as it was.');
      cls = 'free';
    } else {
      const k = this.keyNow(o);
      if (k && (this.bound.has(k) || this.game.has(k))) { text = t('One of the game\'s controls is on {key} (its Options, Controls): the game gets it.', { key: keyName(k) }); cls = 'env'; }
    }
    if (!text && !(this.waiting?.id === o.id)) return;
    const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = `set-state ${cls}`; p.textContent = text;
    if (this.waiting?.id === o.id && this.editable && !(OUR[o.id].always && !this.waiting.button)) {
      const off = document.createElement('button'); off.type = 'button'; off.className = 'text-btn'; off.textContent = t('Off');
      off.onclick = () => { const w = this.waiting!; this.cancel(); void this.take(o, w.button, 'off'); };
      p.append(' ', off);
    }
    row.append(p);
  }

  /** a press on a box: the next key (or controller button) is the control's */
  private wait(o: Our, button: boolean) {
    this.cancel();
    this.waiting = { id: o.id, button }; this.note = null;
    this.draw();
    const keydown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.repeat || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (e.code === 'Escape') { this.cancel(); return; }
      if (button) return;
      this.cancel();
      void this.take(o, false, e.code);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', keydown, { capture: true });
    let raf = 0;
    const was = new Set<string>();
    const poll = () => {
      // a controller's press of a choice it offers (the standard mapping's places), not one held since the wait began
      const pads = allPads();
      const down = new Set<string>();
      for (const g of pads) if (g?.connected) for (const [v, i] of Object.entries(PAD_INDEX)) if (g.buttons[i]?.pressed) down.add(v);
      const fresh = [...down].find(v => !was.has(v) && BUTTONS[o.button!].includes(v));
      for (const v of [...was]) if (!down.has(v)) was.delete(v);
      if (!fresh) { for (const v of down) was.add(v); raf = requestAnimationFrame(poll); return; }
      this.cancel();
      void this.take(o, true, fresh);
    };
    if (button) { for (const g of allPads()) if (g?.connected) for (const [v, i] of Object.entries(PAD_INDEX)) if (g.buttons[i]?.pressed) was.add(v);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(poll); }
    this.stopWait = () => { window.removeEventListener('keydown', keydown, { capture: true }); cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
    (this.box?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-our="${o.id}"] .selected`))?.focus();
  }
  private cancel() {
    this.stopWait?.(); this.stopWait = null;
    if (this.waiting) { this.waiting = null; this.draw(); }
  }

  /** the key (a code, or off) or the button picked: saved, or why not under the row */
  private async take(o: Our, button: boolean, v: string) {
    if (button) {
      const why = v === 'off' ? '' : buttonRefusal(o.button!, v, k => this.buttonNow(k));
      if (why) { this.note = { id: o.id, text: why, cls: 'bad' }; this.draw(); return; }
      this.note = null;
      await this.deps.set(o.button!, v === BUTTONS[o.button!][0] ? null : v);
    } else {
      const why = v === 'off' ? '' : refusal(o.id, v, id => this.keyNow(OUR[id]), this.game);
      if (why) { this.note = { id: o.id, text: why, cls: 'bad' }; this.draw(); return; }
      this.note = null;
      await this.deps.set(o.key!, v === o.def ? null : v);
    }
    this.draw();
  }
}

function kbd(text: string): HTMLElement { const k = document.createElement('kbd'); k.textContent = text; return k; }

/** the keys' list (index.html's Keyboard tab, and its copy in the menu): each row of ours (data-key-of) with the key
 *  the player gave it, hidden without one */
export function siteKeyList(root: ParentNode) {
  for (const row of root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-key-of]')) {
    const k = siteKey(row.dataset.keyOf as OurId), cap = row.querySelector('kbd');
    row.hidden = !k;
    if (k && cap) cap.textContent = keyName(k);
  }
}

// Reader for HOST_KIND_STATUS (runtime/web/status_proto.h): a table of named
// counters the runtime publishes in shared memory.  A sequence lock keeps a
// copy consistent: the copy counts only if seq was even and unchanged.
import type { GameMemory } from '../host/memory';

export const HOST_STATUS_MAGIC = 0x31545453;
// (MAX is the runtime's HOST_STATUS_MAX: a game of another build has its radio's words elsewhere, which radio-link.ts
// checks, and at most MAX names, which this reads)
const MAX = 48, NAME = 16, ITEM = 24, HEAD = 16;

export class StatusReader {
  private td = new TextDecoder();
  constructor(private memory: GameMemory, readonly ptr: number) {}

  /** The counters, or null if the block is not (yet) valid or was being written. */
  read(): Map<string, number> | null {
    const buf = this.memory.buffer;
    if (this.ptr + HEAD + MAX * ITEM > buf.byteLength) return null;
    const i32 = new Int32Array(buf, this.ptr, 4);
    if ((Atomics.load(i32, 0) >>> 0) !== HOST_STATUS_MAGIC) return null;
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 4; tries++) {
      const s0 = Atomics.load(i32, 1);
      if (s0 & 1) continue;
      const n = Math.min(Atomics.load(i32, 2), MAX);
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf, this.ptr + HEAD, n * ITEM).slice();
      if (Atomics.load(i32, 1) !== s0) continue;
      const dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
      const out = new Map<string, number>();
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const nb = bytes.subarray(k * ITEM, k * ITEM + NAME);
        const z = nb.indexOf(0);
        out.set(this.td.decode(nb.subarray(0, z < 0 ? NAME : z)), dv.getFloat64(k * ITEM + NAME, true));
      }
      return out;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

/* touch controls (touch.ts) while the player drives: see-through, lighter than the menu's button (which, with the

 * The menus' arrows and OK/Back, in the black bars beside the menus, keep the darker fill.  The small round ones in a row after the menu's button (the mode button and tilt's straight-ahead top
 * right), the steering's group bottom left, the pedals' bottom right; free roam adds a row's end and Start.
 * The two groups are placed from the inline start (the steering's side) and end (the pedals'): steering on the right
 * (touch.ts position, [data-right]) turns the direction round, so they swap sides as mirror images, and their
 * margins (--start, --end) swap with them; moved in adds --in to both (--steer, --pedal; touch.ts placeIn).  The

export const attachRenderer: AttachRenderer = async (proc, canvas, o) => {
  const r = await gpuAttach(proc, canvas, { log: o.log, artifacts: o.artifacts, dumpScale: o.dumpScale, onLost: o.onLost, onMarks: o.onMarks,
    pixelated: o.env.NFSU2_PIXELATED_TEXTURES === '1', aniso: o.env.NFSU2_ANISOTROPIC === '1' });
  return {
    detach: () => r.detach(),
    imageRect: () => r.imageRect(),

    stats: () => {

    },
  };
};

{"id": "AT001801", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/src/app/tabs.ts", "originalBytes": 6881, "originalSha256": "749fc22f9cef36ee4e25786653d10e0d7c28f3c1fe3deb709f24892fbcf7894b", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 6881, "utf8TotalBytes": 6881}

// A panel's own tabs on the start page (index.html .tabs.big): the big panel's Saves, Online, Friends, Game, Mods and
// Controls, and About's About, Credits and Translations.  The tabs are the panel's heading: words on a divider, the
// open one lime and underlined (the Controls sheet's tabs, controls.ts, at a heading's size).  Where they do not fit
// on one line (a narrow column, another language's longer words) they are the sheet's size (data-fit="small"), and
// where that does not fit either, or on a phone, in rows of three (data-fit="rows").  Every panel's tabs take the same
// step, so both panels' tabs look alike.
import { onLanguage } from './i18n';
import { localStore } from './prefs';

/** the page's tab lists, sized together (fitAll) */
const lists: { list: HTMLElement; tabs: HTMLButtonElement[] }[] = [];
const STEPS = ['', 'small', 'rows'] as const;
const PHONE = '(max-width: 559px)';

/** wider than the line: the tabs' own widths and the gaps between them */
function over(l: typeof lists[number]): boolean {
  const room = l.list.clientWidth;
  if (!room) return false;
  const gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(l.list).columnGap) || 0;
  return l.tabs.reduce((w, b) => w + b.scrollWidth, 0) + gap * (l.tabs.length - 1) > room;
}

/** each list at the first step where every list fits on its line (rows on a phone) */
function fitAll() {
  const at = (i: number) => { for (const l of lists) { if (STEPS[i]) l.list.dataset.fit = STEPS[i]; else delete l.list.dataset.fit; } };
  let i = 0;
  if (matchMedia(PHONE).matches) i = STEPS.length - 1;
  else for (; i < STEPS.length - 1; i++) { at(i); if (!lists.some(over)) break; }
  at(i);
}
let fitting = false;
/** a tab's words changed (the Friends & crews tab's count came or went): every list sized again */
export const refitTabs = (): void => fitAll();

/** what panelTabs() gives: show(the tab, whether it takes the focus), the open one, and settled(): the panel's panes
 *  are drawn, so the place an address named at the start (#other: the Game tab's game data) can be scrolled to */
export interface PanelTabs { show(tab: string, focus?: boolean): void; readonly tab: string; settled(): void }

/** a tab that is gone: the tab its contents went to, and where in it (a selector) */
export interface Moved { tab: string; at?: string }

/**
 * Wires the tabs of panel (its tab list and the panes after it, each with the data-tab of its tab).  store: where the
 * open tab is kept between visits (localStorage; none: the first tab each time).  hash: a page address ending in
 * #<a tab> (#friends) opens that tab, also later (an address with = in it is an invite link: invite.ts), and so does a
 * link on the page to #<a tab> (About's Credits: #mods), the panel scrolled into sight.  moved: tabs that are gone, by
 * name (Other, 2026-11-05: its contents are at the Game tab's end): kept or named, they open the tab they went to, at
 * their place in it.
 */
export function panelTabs(panel: HTMLElement, opts: { store?: string; hash?: boolean; moved?: Record<string, Moved> } = {}): PanelTabs {
  const list = panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>(':scope > .tabs')!;
  const tabs = [...list.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(':scope > [role="tab"]')];
  const panes = [...panel.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(':scope > [role="tabpanel"]')];
  const names = tabs.map(b => b.dataset.tab!);
  const prefix = panel.id || 'tabs';
  // (a pane keeps the id the page's code knows it by: #saves, #online, #friends)
  for (const p of panes) { p.id ||= `${prefix}-pane-${p.dataset.tab}`; p.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `${prefix}-tab-${p.dataset.tab}`); }
  for (const b of tabs) { b.id = `${prefix}-tab-${b.dataset.tab}`; b.setAttribute('aria-controls', panes.find(p => p.dataset.tab === b.dataset.tab)!.id); }

  let tab = names[0];
  /** where the address at the start asked to be (settled() scrolls there once) */
  let startAt: string | undefined;
  const ui: PanelTabs = {
    get tab() { return tab; },
    show(t, focus) {
      if (!names.includes(t)) return;
      tab = t;
      for (const b of tabs) { const on = b.dataset.tab === t; b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(on)); b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; if (on && focus) b.focus(); }
      for (const p of panes) p.hidden = p.dataset.tab !== t;
    },
    settled() {
      const at = startAt; startAt = undefined;
      if (at) panel.querySelector(at)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
    },
  };
  /** a tab's name, or a moved one's: the tab to open and where in it */
  const find = (name: string | null): Moved | null => {
    const n = name?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
    return names.includes(n) ? { tab: n } : opts.moved?.[n] && names.includes(opts.moved[n].tab) ? opts.moved[n] : null;
  };
  /** the panel (or the place in it) into sight, where it is not: a link from far down the page (a phone's About) */
  const reveal = (to: Moved) => {
    const el = (to.at && panel.querySelector(to.at)) || panel;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (to.at || r.top < 0 || r.top > innerHeight - 48) el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
  };
  const pick = (t: string, focus = false) => {
    ui.show(t, focus);
    if (opts.store) localStore.set(opts.store, t);        // (storage off: the first tab next time)
  };
  for (const b of tabs) b.onclick = () => pick(b.dataset.tab!);
  // the arrow keys between the tabs, Home and End to the first and last (a tab list's keys)
  list.onkeydown = e => {
    const i = names.indexOf(tab);
    const to = e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (i + 1) % names.length : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? (i + names.length - 1) % names.length
      : e.key === 'Home' ? 0 : e.key === 'End' ? names.length - 1 : -1;
    if (to < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    pick(names[to], true);
  };

  let first = names[0];
  // (a tab kept that is gone, Other: the tab its contents went to)
  if (opts.store) first = find(localStore.get(opts.store))?.tab ?? first;
  const fromHash = () => find(location.hash.slice(1));
  if (opts.hash) {
    const h = fromHash();
    if (h) { first = h.tab; startAt = h.at; }
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => { const to = fromHash(); if (to) { pick(to.tab); reveal(to); } });
    // a link on the page to a tab: that tab (also when the address names it already, which no hashchange would say)
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const a = (e.target as Element | null)?.closest?.('a[href^="#"]');
      const to = a && !(e as MouseEvent).ctrlKey && !(e as MouseEvent).metaKey ? find(a.getAttribute('href')!.slice(1)) : null;
      if (!to) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      pick(to.tab); reveal(to);
    });
  }
  ui.show(first);

  lists.push({ list, tabs });
  fitAll();
  if (!fitting) {
    fitting = true;
    window.addEventListener('resize', fitAll);
    onLanguage(fitAll);
    void document.fonts?.ready.then(fitAll);
  }
  return ui;
}

{"id": "AT001803", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/src/app/textentry.ts", "originalBytes": 6186, "originalSha256": "19024ecbe3694fc618187c3d495a1dea09a39c67d720068fe858f6fbe5d56e8c", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 6186, "utf8TotalBytes": 6186}

// Typing on a phone or tablet: the game's text entry (a new profile's name, the LAN name) takes characters from a
// keyboard, and a phone's keyboard only comes up for a text field of the page.  So while the game's text entry is up
// (runtime/web/input_web.c) and a finger has touched the game (at once on a touch screen), a field of the page's own
// shows at the top of the game with the game's text in it, selected, and takes the focus: the phone's keyboard comes
// up (where the browser wants a tap for that, a tap on the field).  Each change of the field goes to the game as
// characters (WM_CHAR, input/index.ts text()): backspaces back to where the two texts part, then the rest.  The field
// keeps only what the game's takes (its kind's characters, its length), so the two stay the same; Enter (the
// keyboard's Done) accepts, as on a keyboard.  At the top, the keyboard coming up from below leaves it in sight.
// It goes when the game's text entry does, and when a key goes to the game instead (a keyboard), until the next touch.
import type { GameSession } from './game';
import type { TextEntry } from '../input/index';
import { cp1252 } from '../input/keymap';
import { touchFirst } from './device';
import { t } from './i18n';

/** the punctuation the game's kinds 0 and 3 take besides letters and digits (0x7FA3D0) */
const PUNCT = ' .,_@-`=[]\\;\'/<>?:"{}|+()*&%#!~';

/** whether the game's text entry of this kind takes the character (0x4FF310) */
export function takes(kind: number, ch: string): boolean {
  const c = ch.length === 1 ? cp1252(ch.charCodeAt(0)) : -1;
  if (c < 0x20 || c === 0x7F) return false;
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9]$/.test(ch)) return true;
  if (kind === 4 && '@._'.includes(ch)) return true;
  if (kind === 5 && ' ,@.'.includes(ch)) return true;
  return (kind === 0 || kind === 3) && ((c >= 0xC0 && c <= 0xFF) || PUNCT.includes(ch));
}

/** what the game's text entry of this kind keeps of s: the characters it takes, max of them */
export function fit(s: string, kind: number, max: number): string {
  return [...s].filter(ch => takes(kind, ch)).slice(0, max).join('');
}

/** the characters (cp1252) that turn the game's text from into to: a backspace (8) for each character after the
 *  part they share, then the rest of to */
export function edits(from: string, to: string): number[] {
  let p = 0;
  while (p < from.length && p < to.length && from[p] === to[p]) p++;
  const out: number[] = Array(from.length - p).fill(8);
  for (const ch of to.slice(p)) out.push(cp1252(ch.charCodeAt(0)));
  return out;
}

export class TextField {
  private root: HTMLFormElement;
  private field: HTMLInputElement;
  private session: GameSession | null = null;
  private raf = 0;
  private entry: TextEntry | null = null;
  /** the game's text: as the field sent it, or as the game had it when the field took it */
  private sent = '';
  /** a finger touched the game; a key went to the game after the last touch */
  private seen = touchFirst();
  private away = false;
  private shown = false;

  constructor(stage: HTMLElement, private deps: { log(s: string): void }) {
    const root = this.root = document.createElement('form');
    root.className = 'type'; root.hidden = true; root.dataset.nfsu2Ui = '';
    const f = this.field = document.createElement('input');
    f.type = 'text'; f.autocomplete = 'off'; f.spellcheck = false; f.enterKeyHint = 'done';
    f.setAttribute('autocapitalize', 'off'); f.setAttribute('autocorrect', 'off');
    f.setAttribute('aria-label', t('Text for the game'));
    root.append(f);
    stage.append(root);
    f.addEventListener('input', () => this.onInput());
    f.addEventListener('focus', () => this.take());
    f.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.isComposing) { e.preventDefault(); this.accept(); } });
    root.addEventListener('submit', e => { e.preventDefault(); this.accept(); });
    stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
      if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') return;
      this.seen = true; this.away = false; this.update();
    }, { capture: true });
    addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.isTrusted && this.session && e.target !== f) { this.away = true; this.update(); } }, { capture: true });
  }

  /** a game started: the field follows its text entry until stop() */
  start(s: GameSession) {
    this.session = s;
    const tick = () => { this.update(); this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  /** the game ended */
  stop() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
    this.close();
    this.session = null; this.entry = null;
  }

  /** for tests and logs */
  state() { return { shown: this.shown, entry: this.entry, field: this.field.value, focused: document.activeElement === this.field }; }

  private update() {
    this.entry = this.session?.input?.textEntry?.() ?? null;
    const show = !!this.entry && this.seen && !this.away;
    if (show && !this.shown) this.open();
    else if (!show && this.shown) this.close();
    else if (show && document.activeElement !== this.field) this.take();     // the game's text, as a keyboard left it
  }

  private open() {
    this.shown = true; this.root.hidden = false;
    this.take();
    this.field.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    this.field.select();
    this.deps.log(`[app] the game asks for text (up to ${this.entry?.max} characters): the page's field for the phone's keyboard is up`);
  }

  private close() {
    if (document.activeElement === this.field) this.field.blur();
    this.shown = false; this.root.hidden = true;
  }

  /** the field starts from the game's text */
  private take() {
    const e = this.entry;
    if (!e) return;
    this.sent = e.text;
    if (this.field.value !== e.text) this.field.value = e.text;
    this.field.maxLength = e.max;
  }

  private onInput() {
    const e = this.entry;
    if (!e) return;
    const v = fit(this.field.value, e.kind, e.max);
    if (v !== this.field.value) this.field.value = v;
    const c = edits(this.sent, v);
    if (c.length) this.session?.input?.text?.(c);
    this.sent = v;
  }

  private accept() {
    this.onInput();
    this.session?.input?.text?.([13]);
  }
}

// The site's address on the title screen ("Press Enter Key"), under EA's copyright in the band at its bottom, in the
// look and at the size of the mark on F12 pictures (gpu/mark.ts): the game's own font has no bold italic, so the page
// draws it over the picture, as an image (the stage's canvas is the game's).  The game says where the copyright is
// and how far it has faded in (runtime/intro.c, status "title_a": its alpha 0..1, 0 off the title; "title_x",
// "title_y": its middle in HUD units, 640x480 about the picture's middle; "title_s": its size, 0.89 there), so the
// address fades in and out with it.  On a loading screen (the game's status "loading": into a race or free roam, or
// free roam's world catching up, runtime/intro.c loading_tell; and the race lobby's trip cover, lobby.ts) it sits in
// the picture's bottom right corner as on F12 pictures (png-worker.ts: 2.6 % of its height, as far in).  Not over a
// dialog of the page's.
import type { GameSession } from './game';
import { drawMark, markBox } from '../gpu/mark';
import { pageDialog } from './padnav';

/** per unit of the copyright's size: the address's size, and its ink's middle under the copyright's middle, in HUD
 *  units (28 px and 13.6 units at 1080p, where the copyright is 0.89 at y 194) */
const PX_U = 13.93, DY_U = 15.22;

export class TitleMark {
  private img: HTMLImageElement;
  private c = document.createElement('canvas');  // where it is drawn, not on the page
  private session: GameSession | null = null;
  private raf = 0;
  private drawn = '';                            // the size and pixel ratio the image holds
  private mid = { x: 0, y: 0 };                  // its ink's middle in the image, in CSS px
  private ink = { r: 0, base: 0 };               // ...its ink's right edge and its baseline in it
  private cover: HTMLElement | null;             // the race lobby's trip cover (a loading screen of its own)

  constructor(stage: HTMLElement) {
    const img = this.img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'title-mark'; img.alt = ''; img.hidden = true; img.draggable = false;
    stage.append(img);
    this.cover = stage.querySelector('#lobby-cover');
  }

  /** a game started: the address follows its title screen until stop() */
  start(s: GameSession) {
    this.session = s;
    const tick = () => { this.update(); this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  /** the game ended */
  stop() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
    this.session = null;
    this.img.hidden = true;
  }

  private update() {
    const s = this.session;
    const st = s?.status?.read();
    if (!s || !st) return;                       // null while the game writes it: as it was
    const a = st.get('title_a') ?? 0, v = s.viewRect(), loading = (st.get('loading') ?? 0) > 0 || this.cover?.hidden === false;
    if (!(a > 0 || loading) || !v.w || !v.h || pageDialog()) { this.img.hidden = true; return; }
    const style = this.img.style;
    this.img.classList.toggle('corner', !(a > 0));
    if (!(a > 0)) {
      const m = v.h * 0.024;
      this.draw(Math.max(12, v.h * 0.026));
      style.left = `${v.x + v.w - m - this.ink.r}px`;
      style.top = `${v.y + v.h - m - this.ink.base}px`;
      style.opacity = '1';
      this.img.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    const u = Math.min(v.w / 640, v.h / 480), size = st.get('title_s') ?? 0.89;
    this.draw(PX_U * size * u);
    const cx = v.x + v.w / 2 + (st.get('title_x') ?? 0) * u;
    const cy = v.y + v.h / 2 + ((st.get('title_y') ?? 194) + DY_U * size) * u;
    style.left = `${cx - this.mid.x}px`;
    style.top = `${cy - this.mid.y}px`;
    style.opacity = String(Math.min(1, a));
    this.img.hidden = false;
  }

  /** the address at size px (CSS px), the shadow's margin round its ink */
  private draw(px: number) {
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1, key = `${px.toFixed(2)}|${dpr}`;
    if (key === this.drawn) return;
    this.drawn = key;
    const c = this.c, g = c.getContext('2d');
    if (!g) return;
    const b = markBox(g, px), pad = Math.ceil(px * 0.6) + 1;
    const w = b.l + b.r + 2 * pad, h = b.a + b.d + 2 * pad;
    c.width = Math.ceil(w * dpr); c.height = Math.ceil(h * dpr);
    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    drawMark(g, px, pad + b.l, pad + b.a);
    this.img.src = c.toDataURL('image/png');
    this.img.style.width = `${c.width / dpr}px`; this.img.style.height = `${c.height / dpr}px`;
    this.mid = { x: pad + (b.l + b.r) / 2, y: pad + (b.a + b.d) / 2 };
    this.ink = { r: pad + b.l + b.r, base: pad + b.a };
  }
}

function sizeSetting(store: string, values: readonly Size[], auto: () => number): SizeSetting {
  let now: Size = (() => { const n = Number(localStore.get(store)); return values.includes(n) ? n : 'auto'; })();
  let autoNow = 0;

  const self: SizeSetting = {
    values,
    get: () => now,
    set(to) {
      if (to === now || !values.includes(to)) return;
      now = to;

      changed();
    },

    check() { const a = auto(); if (a !== autoNow) { autoNow = a; changed(); } },

/** the px the controls take between their margins at 100 % (style.css), the most they do (free roam with a manual
 *  gearbox): across, the row of small buttons; down, that row over the controls under the steering's thumb (nitro:
 *  more with Nitro there, a round button where Start's pill was); sides, the steering's group beside the pedals' with
 *  a gap (what moved in leaves them); hyd, what Pressurize and Bounce add to the row while they show in free roam
 *  (a race's row is shorter with them).  Upright, the space under the picture: across, the steering beside the
 *  pedals (free roam's second row, with them, as wide); down, two rows over the steering thumb's */
const ROOM = { across: 664, down: 324, nitro: 20, sides: 360, hyd: 112 },
  ROOM_UPRIGHT = { across: 384, down: 372, nitro: 8, sides: 384, hyd: 0 };
/** the controls' root, once there: its padding is their margins */
let edges: HTMLElement | null = null;
const upright = () => document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-touch') && innerHeight >= innerWidth;
/** the touch controls' auto: 100 % (the size they were made at) on a phone, more on a tablet (125 % from 750 px
 *  across), but no more than fits on this screen: in steps of 5 %, 80 % at the least */
function autoTouchSize(): number {
  const w = innerWidth, h = innerHeight;
  const want = Math.min(1.25, Math.max(1, Math.min(w, h) / 600));
  // their margins: the root's padding (style.css .touch), 12 px before it is there; upright, the top's under the picture
  const m = edges ? getComputedStyle(edges) : null, px = (v?: string) => parseFloat(v ?? '') || 12;
  const room = upright() ? ROOM_UPRIGHT : ROOM;
  const hyd = edges?.hasAttribute('data-hyd') && edges.hasAttribute('data-roam') ? room.hyd : 0;
  const fit = Math.min((w - px(m?.paddingLeft) - px(m?.paddingRight)) / (room.across + hyd),
    (h - px(m?.paddingTop) - px(m?.paddingBottom)) / (room.down + (nitroSteerSide.get() ? room.nitro : 0)));
  return Math.max(0.8, Math.floor(Math.min(want, fit) * 20 + 1e-9) / 20);
}
/** the touch controls' size (style.css --ts) */
export const touchSize = sizeSetting(TOUCH_SIZE, ['auto', 0.8, 0.9, 1, 1.1, 1.25, 1.5], autoTouchSize);

/** the game's menus' help bar buttons and scroller arrows, their height in the menus' 640 x 480 units: the bar's
 *  frames, 24 (the arrows are 26) */
const MENU_BUTTON_UNITS = 24, MENU_BUTTON_PX = 36;
/** the menus' auto, on a touch screen: big enough that a help bar button is MENU_BUTTON_PX high, in steps of 25 %,
 *  up to 200 %; with a mouse, the game's own size.  The menus fill the picture's height, or its width where it is
 *  narrower than 4:3 (upright: a 4:5 picture at the top, style.css) */
function autoMenuSize(): number {
  if (!touchFirst()) return 1;
  let w = innerWidth, h = innerHeight;
  if (upright()) { h = Math.min(1.25 * w, 0.6 * h); w = 0.8 * h; }
  const unit = Math.min(w / 640, h / 480);
  return Math.min(2, Math.max(1, Math.floor(MENU_BUTTON_PX / (MENU_BUTTON_UNITS * unit) * 4 + 1e-9) / 4));
}
/** the game's menus' small buttons: the help bar's and the scrollers' arrows (runtime/menusize.c) */
export const menuSize = sizeSetting(MENU_SIZE, ['auto', 1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2], autoMenuSize);

/** label: what a screen reader says (English, translated where drawn); text: the words on it, if any; keys: the keys
 *  it holds (two controls may hold the same one: it is down while either is) */
interface Ctl {
  id: string; el: HTMLElement; label: string; text?: string;
  keys?: string[]; bit?: number; act?: () => void;
  /** keys a hold presses for as long as it lasts (from LONG_MS); a tap presses the control's own as it lifts */
  hold?: string[];
  /** what a long press does (from PRESS_MS), instead of act as it lifts */
  long?: () => void;
  /** a finger slides between the controls of a group */
  group?: 'steer' | 'pedal';
  fingers: Set<number>; downAt: number; upTimer: number; holdTimer: number; held: boolean;
}

/** which controls show: the driving ones, the menu's, or none */
type Mode = 'drive' | 'menu' | '';

/** the phone's gesture took three fingers off the controls and the player was told (once in a page) */
let toldCancel = false;

const path = (d: string) => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${d}</svg>`;
const ICONS = {
  left: '<path class="fill" d="M16 5L7 12l9 7z"/>',
  right: '<path class="fill" d="M8 5l9 7-9 7z"/>',

  buttons: '<path d="M10 7l-5 5 5 5M14 7l5 5-5 5"/>',

  lift: '<path d="M3 13h18M5 13l2-3h10l2 3"/><circle cx="7" cy="20" r="1.5"/><circle cx="17" cy="20" r="1.5"/><path d="M7 13.5v5M17 13.5v5M12 8V3M9.5 5.5 12 3l2.5 2.5"/>',
