// HQ vinyls (runtime/hqvinyls.c, the Mods tab's "HQ Vinyls & Doorlines" by AdrienShadow, nfsmods.xyz/mod/8064): a car
// skin the game has just painted at 512x512 (DUMMY_SKIN<n>: base paint, vinyl layers, doorline) is painted again here
// at 1024x1024 from the mod's pictures, with the game's own arithmetic (0x611F10, 0x611B00), and shown in its place
// (encoder.ts texFor) until the game paints that texture again.
//
// The pictures: HQVINYLS/CARS/<car>.hqv in the game folder (tools/hqvinyls.py: rows by name hash, AVIF pictures), each
// read as a byte range of its own (the I/O worker; a vinyl's picture and mask ~30 KB, where the game data's 1 MiB
// blocks would fetch ~1 MB for each), kept here for the session, and decoded by the browser.  Offline, or where the
// pack is not there, the game's skins stay.
// The game's 512 skin stays on the GPU under it: the paint swatches (the parts painted in the body's colour take it
// from there) are copied from it, and it is what shows until the 1024 one is ready, or for good when a picture is
// missing (Art Factory 28 to 34 are not the mod's) or the pack is not there.
import type { GwSkinHqLayout } from './proto';

export type DataReader = (path: string, off: number, len: number) => Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>>;

const SIDE = 1024, GAME = 512, LEVELS = 11;
const MAGIC = 0x31565148;                 // "HQV1"
const ROW = 16, ROWS_MAX = 4096;
const PLANE = 0x100;                      // a layer's alpha: the game's 512 plane (GW_SKIN_HQ_PLANE)
const BYTES_KEPT = 8 << 20;               // pictures' bytes kept for the next paint (a shop's previews repaint often)
const AT_ONCE = 2;                        // paints decoding at once
const LOG_MAX = 40;
const RETRY_MS = 60_000;                  // a car's pack that did not come: asked again after this

/** a 1x1 AVIF: whether this browser decodes AVIF */
const TINY_AVIF = '';
export async function avifDecodes(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const b = Uint8Array.from(atob(TINY_AVIF), ch => ch.charCodeAt(0));
    const bmp = await createImageBitmap(new Blob([b], { type: 'image/avif' }));
    const ok = bmp.width === 1 && bmp.height === 1;
    bmp.close();
    return ok;
  } catch { return false; }
}

// One pass over the 1024 target.  u: [0] base paint RGBA, [1].x layers, then per layer 4 words: (remap, alpha,
// plane, 0), colours 0, 1, 2 as RGBA (0..255).  The arithmetic is the game's, in integers (0x611B00's float form
// equals it for every byte pair): a REMAP layer's colour is sum(colour_i * w_i / 255) with the picture's R, G, B as
// w (0 and 1 dropped), each term truncated, clamped to 255, alpha the largest colour_i.a * w_i / 255; a mask of
// 1..127 blends by m/128, more is drawn as it is.  Rows 1016-1023 from x 968: the swatches, the game's 512 skin's.
const WGSL = /* wgsl */`
@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> u: array<vec4<u32>, 34>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var pics: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var masks: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var planes: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var game: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(5) var smp: sampler;

@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) i: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4<f32> {
  let p = vec2<f32>(f32((i << 1u) & 2u), f32(i & 2u));
  return vec4<f32>(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
fn b8(x: f32) -> u32 { return u32(clamp(x, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5); }
@fragment fn fs(@builtin(position) fp: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
  let p = vec2<i32>(fp.xy);
  if (p.y >= 1016 && p.x >= 968) { return textureLoad(game, p / 2, 0); }
  var d = u[0];
  let n = u[1].x;
  for (var i = 0u; i < n; i++) {
    let li = i32(i);
    let m = b8(textureLoad(masks, p, li, 0).r);
    if (m == 0u) { continue; }
    let L = u[2u + 4u * i];
    let px = textureLoad(pics, p, li, 0);
    var s = vec4<u32>(b8(px.r), b8(px.g), b8(px.b), 255u);
    if (L.x != 0u) {
      let v = select(vec3<u32>(0u), s.rgb, s.rgb >= vec3<u32>(2u));
      let c0 = u[3u + 4u * i]; let c1 = u[4u + 4u * i]; let c2 = u[5u + 4u * i];
      let rgb = (c0.rgb * v.x) / 255u + (c1.rgb * v.y) / 255u + (c2.rgb * v.z) / 255u;
      let a = max(max((c0.a * v.x) / 255u, (c1.a * v.y) / 255u), (c2.a * v.z) / 255u);
      s = vec4<u32>(min(rgb, vec3<u32>(255u)), min(a, 255u));
    } else if (L.y == ${PLANE}u) {
      s.a = b8(textureSampleLevel(planes, smp, fp.xy / ${SIDE}.0, i32(L.z), 0.0).r);
    } else {
      s.a = L.y;
    }
    if (m > 127u) { d = s; }
    else { d = ((s * m) >> vec4<u32>(7u)) + ((d * (128u - m)) >> vec4<u32>(7u)); }
  }
  return vec4<f32>(d) / 255.0;
}`;

interface Row { off: number; size: number }
interface Layer { hash: number; mask: number; remap: boolean; alpha: number; col: number[] }
interface Recipe { serial: number; car: string; base: number; layers: Layer[] }
/** a skin to paint: the recipe's bytes, the alpha planes after it; game() = the game's 512 skin's view while it is
 *  still the one this recipe painted (null once it is not: the paint is dropped) */
export interface SkinJob { id: number; recipe: Uint8Array; planes: Uint8Array; nplanes: number; game: () => GPUTextureView | null }

export class HqSkins {
  private packs = new Map<string, Promise<Map<number, Row> | null>>();
  private kept = new Map<string, Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>>();
  private keptBytes = 0;
  private waiting: { job: SkinJob; done: (t: GPUTexture | null) => void }[] = [];
  private running = 0;
  private logged = 0;
  private missing = new Set<string>();
  private pipe: GPURenderPipeline | null = null;
  private bgl: GPUBindGroupLayout | null = null;
  private smp: GPUSampler;
  painted = 0; failed = 0;

  constructor(private device: GPUDevice, private read: DataReader, private log: (s: string) => void,
              private mips: (enc: GPUCommandEncoder, tex: GPUTexture) => void, private layout: GwSkinHqLayout) {
    this.smp = device.createSampler({ minFilter: 'linear', magFilter: 'linear' });
  }

  /** paint a skin at 1024: the texture (LEVELS levels, bgra8unorm), or null (left to the game's) */
  paint(job: SkinJob): Promise<GPUTexture | null> {
    return new Promise(done => { this.waiting.push({ job, done }); this.next(); });
  }

  private next(): void {
    while (this.running < AT_ONCE && this.waiting.length) {
      const w = this.waiting.shift()!;
      this.running++;
      this.run(w.job).then(w.done, e => { this.failed++; this.say(`[hqskin] t${w.job.id}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`); w.done(null); })
        .finally(() => { this.running--; this.next(); });
    }
  }

  private say(s: string): void {
    if (this.logged < LOG_MAX) { this.logged++; this.log(this.logged === LOG_MAX ? `${s} (no more of these lines)` : s); }
  }

  private parse(b: Uint8Array): Recipe | null {
    const L = this.layout, v = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
    if (b.byteLength < L.size || v.getUint32(L.magic, true) !== L.MAGIC) return null;
    const n = v.getUint32(L.n, true);
    if (n < 1 || n > L.LAYERS) return null;
    let car = '';
    for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) { const ch = b[L.car + k]; if (!ch) break; car += String.fromCharCode(ch); }
    if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{1,15}$/.test(car)) return null;
    const layers: Layer[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const o = L.layer + i * L.layerSize;
      layers.push({ hash: v.getUint32(o + L.lHash, true), mask: v.getUint32(o + L.lMask, true), remap: v.getUint32(o + L.lRemap, true) !== 0,
        alpha: v.getUint32(o + L.lAlpha, true), col: [0, 1, 2, 3].map(k => v.getUint32(o + L.lCol + 4 * k, true)) });
    }
    return { serial: v.getUint32(L.serial, true), car, base: v.getUint32(L.base, true), layers };
  }

  /** a car's pack's rows: name hash -> its picture; null when it is not there */
  private pack(car: string): Promise<Map<number, Row> | null> {
    let p = this.packs.get(car);
    if (!p) {
      const path = `HQVINYLS/CARS/${car}.hqv`;
      p = (async () => {
        try {
          const h = await this.read(path, 0, 16), v = new DataView(h.buffer, h.byteOffset, h.byteLength);
          if (h.byteLength < 16 || v.getUint32(0, true) !== MAGIC || v.getUint32(4, true) !== 1) throw new Error('not a HQV1 file');
          const n = v.getUint32(8, true), start = v.getUint32(12, true);
          if (n < 1 || n > ROWS_MAX || start < 16 + ROW * n) throw new Error(`${n} rows from ${start}`);
          const r = await this.read(path, 16, ROW * n), rv = new DataView(r.buffer, r.byteOffset, r.byteLength);
          if (r.byteLength !== ROW * n) throw new Error('cut short');
          const rows = new Map<number, Row>();
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const off = rv.getUint32(ROW * i + 4, true), size = rv.getUint32(ROW * i + 8, true);
            if (off >= start && size > 0 && size < (4 << 20)) rows.set(rv.getUint32(ROW * i, true), { off, size });
          }
          return rows;
        } catch (e) {
          // asked again after a while (the network may be back; a pack the folder lacks costs a 404 a minute)
          this.say(`[hqskin] ${path}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}; this car keeps the game's skins for now`);
          setTimeout(() => { if (this.packs.get(car) === p) this.packs.delete(car); }, RETRY_MS);
          return null;
        }
      })();
      this.packs.set(car, p);
    }
    return p;
  }

  private async bytes(car: string, hash: number, row: Row): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>> {
    const key = `${car}/${hash}`, hit = this.kept.get(key);
    if (hit) { this.kept.delete(key); this.kept.set(key, hit); return hit; }
    const b = await this.read(`HQVINYLS/CARS/${car}.hqv`, row.off, row.size);
    if (b.byteLength !== row.size) throw new Error(`${car} 0x${(hash >>> 0).toString(16)}: cut short`);
    this.kept.set(key, b); this.keptBytes += b.byteLength;
    for (const [k, v] of this.kept) { if (this.keptBytes <= BYTES_KEPT) break; this.kept.delete(k); this.keptBytes -= v.byteLength; }
    return b;
  }

  private async run(job: SkinJob): Promise<GPUTexture | null> {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const r = this.parse(job.recipe);
    if (!r) throw new Error('a recipe this page does not read');
    const rows = await this.pack(r.car);
    if (!rows) return null;
    const want = r.layers.flatMap(l => [l.hash, l.mask]);
    for (const h of want) if (!rows.has(h)) {
      const k = `${r.car}/${h}`;
      if (!this.missing.has(k)) { this.missing.add(k); this.say(`[hqskin] ${r.car}: picture 0x${(h >>> 0).toString(16)} not in its pack (not the mod's): this skin stays the game's`); }
      return null;
    }
    const got = await Promise.all(want.map(h => this.bytes(r.car, h, rows.get(h)!)));
    const bmps = await Promise.all(got.map(b => createImageBitmap(new Blob([b], { type: 'image/avif' }),
      { premultiplyAlpha: 'none', colorSpaceConversion: 'none' })));
    try {
      if (bmps.some(b => b.width !== SIDE || b.height !== SIDE)) throw new Error('a picture not 1024x1024');
      const game = job.game();
      if (!game) return null;                                     // painted again (or gone) meanwhile
      const tex = this.compose(r, bmps, job, game);
      this.painted++;
      this.say(`[hqskin] t${job.id} ${r.car}: 1024 in ${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)} ms (${r.layers.length} layer(s), ` +
        `${Math.round(got.reduce((a, b) => a + b.byteLength, 0) / 1024)} KB)`);
      return tex;
    } finally { for (const b of bmps) b.close(); }
  }

  private compose(r: Recipe, bmps: ImageBitmap[], job: SkinJob, game: GPUTextureView): GPUTexture {
    const d = this.device, n = r.layers.length;
    const arr = (format: GPUTextureFormat, side: number, layers: number, label: string) => d.createTexture({ label, format,
      size: [side, side, Math.max(1, layers)], usage: GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING | GPUTextureUsage.COPY_DST | GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT });
    const pics = arr('rgba8unorm', SIDE, n, 'hqskin pics'), masks = arr('r8unorm', SIDE, n, 'hqskin masks');
    const planes = arr('r8unorm', GAME, job.nplanes, 'hqskin planes');
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      d.queue.copyExternalImageToTexture({ source: bmps[2 * i] }, { texture: pics, origin: [0, 0, i] }, [SIDE, SIDE]);
      d.queue.copyExternalImageToTexture({ source: bmps[2 * i + 1] }, { texture: masks, origin: [0, 0, i] }, [SIDE, SIDE]);
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < job.nplanes; k++)
      d.queue.writeTexture({ texture: planes, origin: [0, 0, k] }, job.planes.subarray(k * GAME * GAME, (k + 1) * GAME * GAME),
        { bytesPerRow: GAME }, [GAME, GAME]);
    const u = new Uint32Array(34 * 4), rgba = (c: number, o: number) => { u[o] = c & 255; u[o + 1] = (c >>> 8) & 255; u[o + 2] = (c >>> 16) & 255; u[o + 3] = c >>> 24; };
    rgba(r.base, 0); u[4] = n;
    let plane = 0;
    r.layers.forEach((l, i) => {
      const o = (2 + 4 * i) * 4;
      u[o] = l.remap ? 1 : 0; u[o + 1] = l.remap ? 0 : l.alpha; u[o + 2] = !l.remap && l.alpha === PLANE ? plane++ : 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) rgba(l.col[k], o + 4 + 4 * k);
    });
    const ubuf = d.createBuffer({ size: u.byteLength, usage: GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST });
    d.queue.writeBuffer(ubuf, 0, u);
    const out = d.createTexture({ label: `hqskin t${job.id}`, format: 'bgra8unorm', size: [SIDE, SIDE], mipLevelCount: LEVELS,
      usage: GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING | GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT | GPUTextureUsage.COPY_SRC });
    if (!this.pipe) {
      const mod = d.createShaderModule({ label: 'hqskin', code: WGSL });
      this.bgl = d.createBindGroupLayout({ entries: [
        { binding: 0, visibility: GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT, buffer: { type: 'uniform' } },
        { binding: 1, visibility: GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT, texture: { viewDimension: '2d-array', sampleType: 'float' } },
        { binding: 2, visibility: GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT, texture: { viewDimension: '2d-array', sampleType: 'float' } },
        { binding: 3, visibility: GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT, texture: { viewDimension: '2d-array', sampleType: 'float' } },
        { binding: 4, visibility: GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT, texture: { viewDimension: '2d', sampleType: 'float' } },
        { binding: 5, visibility: GPUShaderStage.FRAGMENT, sampler: {} }] });
      this.pipe = d.createRenderPipeline({ label: 'hqskin', layout: d.createPipelineLayout({ bindGroupLayouts: [this.bgl] }),
        vertex: { module: mod, entryPoint: 'vs' }, fragment: { module: mod, entryPoint: 'fs', targets: [{ format: 'bgra8unorm' }] },
        primitive: { topology: 'triangle-list' } });
    }
    const bg = d.createBindGroup({ layout: this.bgl!, entries: [
      { binding: 0, resource: { buffer: ubuf } },
      { binding: 1, resource: pics.createView({ dimension: '2d-array' }) },
      { binding: 2, resource: masks.createView({ dimension: '2d-array' }) },
      { binding: 3, resource: planes.createView({ dimension: '2d-array' }) },
      { binding: 4, resource: game },
      { binding: 5, resource: this.smp }] });
    const enc = d.createCommandEncoder({ label: 'hqskin' });
    const pass = enc.beginRenderPass({ colorAttachments: [{ view: out.createView({ baseMipLevel: 0, mipLevelCount: 1 }), loadOp: 'clear',
      clearValue: [0, 0, 0, 0], storeOp: 'store' }] });
    pass.setPipeline(this.pipe); pass.setBindGroup(0, bg); pass.draw(3); pass.end();
    this.mips(enc, out);
    d.queue.submit([enc.finish()]);
    pics.destroy(); masks.destroy(); planes.destroy(); ubuf.destroy();
    return out;
  }
}

// The WebGPU renderer, page side.  attachRenderer() finds the control block the
// game's recorder registered (runtime/web/gpu_web.c, HOST_KIND_GPU), and from
// then on:
//   - drains the resource queue (textures, mirror pool, shaders),
//   - takes each handed-off frame (GwCtl.state), encodes it (encoder.ts) into
//     the back buffer at the game's device size, composites that aspect-fit
//     onto the canvas at the canvas's own resolution, and submits;
//   - publishes a display clock from requestAnimationFrame (HOST_KIND_VSYNC)
//     that the game's frame pacer locks to;
//   - reads frames back for the autotest "dump" command and F12 (dump()), as
//     PNGs made in png-worker.ts, and textures for the game (a frame's rb_*:
//     the DVD and magazine covers' pictures, which it waits for in LockRect).
// Triggers: Atomics.waitAsync on the game's doorbell, every rAF, and every
// finished GPU frame.  The main thread never blocks.

 *  (a key held: the frame as it is), or still adding up frames (a slow GPU and the most blur) */
const PHOTO_MOVING_MS = 600, PHOTO_WAIT_MS = 8000;

  /** false: at a render scale below 1 the canvas stays at the view's size and the picture is composited over it (the
   *  path before fitPicture; A/B and diagnostics) */
  cssScale?: boolean;

  maxInFlight?: number;

  summaryMs?: number;
  /** false: always draw into the back buffer and composite it (the path before direct
   *  canvas drawing; default in Firefox, which shows half-drawn frames otherwise; A/B and diagnostics) */
  direct?: boolean;

  noBC?: boolean;

   *  (A/B and diagnostics) */
  noASTC?: boolean;

   *  of a 512x512 target in every frame (tests frame pacing on GPUs slower than this one) */
  gpuBurn?: number;
  /** the GPU device was lost (the graphics driver reset, the browser's graphics process crashed; device.lost, or
   *  in Safari every WebGPU call failing frame after frame): nothing is drawn from then on, and only a new game
   *  process can show the game again (see detach), in Safari only after a reload of the page (requestAdapter
   *  gives no adapter until then).  why: the browser's reason and message, as the log has it */

  onMarks?: (n: number, m: Float32Array, ids: Uint32Array) => void;
  log?: (s: string) => void;
}

/** how much of the textures' MB the log's lines give is DXT unpacked or as ASTC: " (40 unpacked from DXT, 30 DXT1 as
 *  ASTC)", '' with BC */
export function texSplit(unpacked: number, astc: number): string {
  const MB = (b: number) => (b / 1048576).toFixed(0);
  const parts = [unpacked ? `${MB(unpacked)} unpacked from DXT` : '', astc ? `${MB(astc)} DXT1 as ASTC` : ''].filter(Boolean);
  return parts.length ? ` (${parts.join(', ')})` : '';
}

 *  module are of different builds (the page from offline mode's copies, sw.ts, the module from the server) */

/** WebGPU calls that failed this many times in a row (one try per frame, a second at 60 fps): the device is gone */
const LOST_AFTER = 60;
/** an exception for the log: Safari's stack has no line with the message, Chrome's starts with it */
const errText = (x: unknown) => {
  if (!(x instanceof Error)) return String(x);
  const head = `${x.name}: ${x.message}`;
  return x.stack?.startsWith(head) ? x.stack : x.stack ? `${head}\n${x.stack}` : head;
};

export async function attachRenderer(proc: GameProcess, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, opts: RendererOptions = {}): Promise<Renderer> {
  const log = opts.log ?? ((s: string) => console.log(s));
  const attachedAt = performance.now();
  if (!navigator.gpu) throw new Error('WebGPU is not available in this browser');
  const adapter = await navigator.gpu.requestAdapter({ powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
  if (!adapter) throw new Error('no WebGPU adapter');
  // without BC the encoder unpacks the DXT textures as they upload (dxt.ts), but for DXT1 on a GPU with ASTC (Apple's),
  // which it rewrites as ASTC 4x4 (astc.ts): a quarter of the memory unpacked takes
  const bc = adapter.features.has('texture-compression-bc') && !opts.noBC;
  const astc = !bc && adapter.features.has('texture-compression-astc') && !opts.noASTC;
  if (!bc) log(`[gpu] ${opts.noBC ? 'noBC' : 'no texture-compression-bc'}: ${astc ? 'DXT1 textures go up as ASTC 4x4, DXT3 and DXT5 (and DXT1 with transparent texels) unpacked to BGRA8' : 'DXT textures are unpacked to BGRA8 as they upload'}`);
  const want: GPUFeatureName[] = bc ? ['texture-compression-bc'] : astc ? ['texture-compression-astc'] : [];
  for (const f of ['texture-component-swizzle', 'texture-compression-unaligned', 'timestamp-query'])
    if (adapter.features.has(f as GPUFeatureName)) want.push(f as GPUFeatureName);
  const device = await adapter.requestDevice({ requiredFeatures: want, requiredLimits: {
    maxBufferSize: adapter.limits.maxBufferSize, maxStorageBufferBindingSize: adapter.limits.maxStorageBufferBindingSize } });
  let errors = 0;
  const onError = (e: Event) => {
    errors++;
    if (errors <= 20) log(`[gpu] WebGPU error: ${(e as GPUUncapturedErrorEvent).error.message}`);
  };
  device.addEventListener('uncapturederror', onError);
  // the device is gone (onLost, once): device.lost, or frames that cannot be encoded any more (pump)
  let ownDestroy = false, lostSaid = false;
  const lost = (why: string) => {
    if (ownDestroy || lostSaid) return;
    lostSaid = true;
    log(`[gpu] ${why}`);
    opts.onLost?.(why);
  };
  // our own destroy() (detach, or giving up before it) says nothing, whatever reason the browser gives
  device.lost.then(i => lost(`device lost: ${i.reason} ${i.message}`));
  // Until the renderer holds the control block, every way out gives the device
  // and the canvas back (a game stopped before it registered its blocks included).
  let configured: GPUCanvasContext | null = null;
  const giveUp: (e: unknown) => never = (e) => {
    try { configured?.unconfigure(); } catch { /* not configured */ }
    device.removeEventListener('uncapturederror', onError);
    ownDestroy = true; device.destroy();
    throw e;
  };

  const ctx = canvas.getContext('webgpu') ?? giveUp(new Error('no webgpu canvas context'));
  const canvasFormat = navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat();
  // in the encoder's format the game draws its screen straight into the canvas
  // texture whenever the sizes match (Encoder.encodeFrame), so the canvas texture
  // takes every use the back buffer has.  Not in Firefox: it shows the canvas texture
  // while the next frame draws into it (Firefox 158 on a Mac, a race: 3 of 25
  // screenshots a third to a half black, the rest of the picture half drawn).  From
  // the back buffer the canvas gets each picture whole, in one copy (0 of 25).
  const firefox = /\bFirefox\//.test(navigator.userAgent);
  const direct = canvasFormat === 'bgra8unorm' && (opts.direct ?? !firefox);
  const canvasUsage = GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT
    | (direct ? GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING | GPUTextureUsage.COPY_SRC | GPUTextureUsage.COPY_DST : 0);
  try { ctx.configure({ device, format: canvasFormat, alphaMode: 'opaque', usage: canvasUsage }); }
  catch (e) { giveUp(e); }
  configured = ctx;

  // a game that ends (exit, crash, Stop) before it registers its blocks never
  // will: the wait ends with it
  const untilExit = <T>(p: Promise<T>) => Promise.race([p,
    proc.exited.then((code): never => { throw new Error(`the game ended (code ${code}) before it registered its graphics`); })]);
  const [reg, vreg] = await Promise.all([untilExit(proc.registered(HostKind.Gpu)), untilExit(proc.registered(HostKind.Vsync))]).catch(giveUp);
  const mem = proc.memory;
  const i32 = () => new Int32Array(mem.buffer), u32 = () => new Uint32Array(mem.buffer);
  const cw = reg.ptr >>> 2;   // (unsigned: the runtime's memory may be at 2 GB or more, runtime/guest_span.h)
  {
    const u = u32();
    if (u[cw + C.magic] !== P.GW_MAGIC || u[cw + C.layout] !== P.LAYOUT) {
      const what = `GPU control block mismatch: magic ${u[cw + C.magic].toString(16)} layout ${u[cw + C.layout].toString(16)} (page ${P.LAYOUT.toString(16)})`;
      giveUp(u[cw + C.magic] === P.GW_MAGIC ? new OtherBuild(what) : new Error(what));
    }
    // one renderer per control block, ever: a second one (or one after a detach) would
    // not have the textures and shaders queued before it.  The game marks the block
    // detached itself when it stopped waiting for a renderer (30 s, gpu_web.c)
    const was = Atomics.load(i32(), cw + C.attached);
    if (was !== 0)
      giveUp(new Error(`this game process ${was === P.DETACHED ? 'takes no renderer any more (one detached, or the game stopped waiting for one)' : 'already has a renderer'}: start a new game to show it again`));
  }
  let enc: Encoder;
  try { enc = new Encoder(device, mem, reg.ptr, log); } catch (e) { giveUp(e); }
  enc.logShaders = !!opts.logShaders;
  enc.pointTex = !!opts.pixelated;
  if (enc.pointTex) log('[gpu] pixelated textures');
  enc.aniso = !!opts.aniso;
  if (enc.aniso) log('[gpu] anisotropic filtering where the game asks for it');
  for (const id of opts.watchTex ?? []) enc.watchTex.add(id);
  if (opts.trace === 'dumps') enc.traceDumps = true; else for (const f of opts.trace ?? []) enc.traceSeq.add(f);
  // pipelines of earlier sessions, created asynchronously as their shaders arrive
  const warm = localStore.getJSON(GPU_PIPELINES) as Parameters<Encoder['loadWarm']>[0] | null;
  if (warm) try { enc.loadWarm(warm); } catch { /* not a list of them: no warm-up */ }
  /** the pipelines made so far, for the next session's warm-up (the latest 4000; full or off: not kept) */
  const keepWarm = () => { if (enc.warmDirty) localStore.setJSON(GPU_PIPELINES, enc.warmEntries().slice(-4000)); };
  const vw = vreg.ptr >>> 2, vf = vreg.ptr >>> 3;

  // page -> game: view size, pixel ratio, features.  The view is the canvas element's box in device pixels (what
  // canvas.width/height are when the page sizes the canvas), kept apart from canvas.width/height, which follow the
  // game's picture at a render scale below 1 (fitPicture).
  let viewW = canvas.width, viewH = canvas.height;
  let hqSkin = false;                // HQ vinyls: this page paints the cars' skins again (hqskin.ts), set below
  const publishView = () => {
    const u = u32();
    u[cw + C.viewW] = viewW; u[cw + C.viewH] = viewH;
    u[cw + C.dpr1000] = Math.round(devicePixelRatio * 1000);
    u[cw + C.features] = P.FEAT_BC | (device.features.has('texture-component-swizzle') ? P.FEAT_SWIZZLE : 0) | (hqSkin ? P.FEAT_HQSKIN : 0);
  };
  publishView();
  const won = Atomics.compareExchange(i32(), cw + C.attached, 0, P.ATTACHED);
  if (won !== 0)
    giveUp(new Error(won === P.DETACHED ? 'the game stopped waiting for a renderer just now: start a new game to show it'
      : 'another renderer attached to this game process first'));
  Atomics.notify(i32(), cw + C.attached);
  const warmTimer = setInterval(keepWarm, 5000);
  const maxInFlight = opts.maxInFlight ?? 2;
  let imgRect: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null = null;
  // quick chat's places of the frame being drawn (onMarks): id, x, y, scale each, the same words as two views
  const markF = new Float32Array(4 * P.MARKS_MAX), markI = new Uint32Array(markF.buffer);
  let inFlight = 0, alive = true, pumping = false;
  let frames = 0, encMsTotal = 0, encMsLast = 0, drawsLast = 0, passesLast = 0, directFrames = 0;
  // the benchmark window (Renderer.window): per-frame samples, bounded
  const WIN_MAX = 1 << 17;
  let winEnc: number[] = [], winGpu: number[] = [], winDraws = 0, winPasses = 0, winCalls = { ...enc.calls };
  let done: number[] = [];
  const dumpWaiters: { name: string; mark?: boolean; resolve: (b: Blob) => void }[] = [];
  // photo mode (photo-picture.ts): its picture, made at the first frame of photo mode; the look; photo() waiting
  let pic: PhotoPicture | null = null, look: PhotoLook = PLAIN_LOOK, picState = PH_OFF;
  // photo() asks the game for its picture (GwPhoto want: id, the most tiles a side this page puts together): the game
  // says it saw it (tile's echo) and whether it takes it in tiles or over a shutter's time; last: when it last went on
  const photoWaiters: { name: string; mark?: boolean; since: number; last: number; id: number; resolve: (b: Blob) => void }[] = [];
  let wantSeq = 0, bbW = 0, bbH = 0, progSeen = -1;
  // a picture being taken in tiles: each read out as it is whole and put in its place by the PNG worker (pic), then the
  // whole made into the PNG; for a photo() waiting, or (tests: photo take) the artifacts as take_<id>
  type Taking = { id: number; pic: number; n: number; w: number; h: number; got: Set<number>; posted: Promise<void>[];
    crop: [number, number, number, number]; mark?: boolean; name: string; resolve?: (b: Blob) => void; ended: boolean };
  let taking: Taking | null = null, bigNext = 1;
  const phone = /iPhone|iPad|Android|Mobile/.test(navigator.userAgent) || (navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1 && /Macintosh/.test(navigator.userAgent));
  // HQ vinyls (runtime/hqvinyls.c, hq_vinyls = on): on a PC (BC compression, not a phone: a 1024 skin is 5.6 MB) whose
  // browser decodes AVIF; the runtime sends skins to paint only then
  if (!phone && enc.hqCapable) void avifDecodes().then(ok => {
    if (!ok || !alive) return;
    enc.hqSkins((path, off, len) => proc.readData(path, off, len, true));
    hqSkin = true; publishView();
  });
  /** the most tiles a side this page puts together, for the back buffer's size */
  const maxTiles = () => {
    let n = phone ? 2 : 4;
    while (n > 1 && n * n * bbW * bbH * 4 > (phone ? TILES_BYTES_PHONE : TILES_BYTES)) n--;
    return bbW ? n : 1;
  };
  const pending = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();

  // A frame waiting for a slot.  Firefox runs onSubmittedWorkDone callbacks only when its GPU
  // process polls the device: in every queue submit, and otherwise on a 100 ms timer
  // (WebGPUParent POLL_TIME_MS).  A frame submitted while the one before it was still on the GPU
  // leaves that one unreported, and the next frame then waits for the timer: two frames per
  // 100 ms.  The game, late from then on, hands its frames over back to back, so it stays at
  // 20-30 fps until the queue empties (a minimized window).  An empty submit polls as well
  // (wgpu-core's Queue::submit runs Device::maintain), so while a frame waits the pump sends one
  // at once and then every 1-2 ms (Firefox's Atomics.waitAsync times out that finely; its
  // setTimeout takes 4.5 ms).  Chrome reports done work on its own: no pokes there.
  const poke = opts.poke ?? firefox;
  const pokeCell = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4));
  let waitingSince = 0, poking = false, slotWaits = 0, slotWaitMsMax = 0, pokes = 0;
  let winWaits = 0, winWaitMax = 0, winWaitT = performance.now();
  // Firefox names no adapter (the start page's GPU check names its graphics)
  const named = [adapter.info?.vendor, adapter.info?.architecture].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'adapter not named';
  log(`[gpu] renderer attached: ${named}, canvas ${canvas.width}x${canvas.height} ${canvasFormat}, features ${want.join(' ')}${poke ? ', poke' : ''}`);
  const pokeLoop = async () => {
    if (poking) return;
    poking = true;
    try {
      while (alive && waitingSince) {
        device.queue.submit([]); pokes++;
        const w = Atomics.waitAsync(pokeCell, 0, 0, 1);
        if (w.async) await w.value;
      }
    } finally { poking = false; }
  };
  const waiting = (on: boolean) => {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (on && !waitingSince) { waitingSince = now; if (poke) void pokeLoop(); }
    else if (!on && waitingSince) {
      const ms = now - waitingSince;
      waitingSince = 0;
      if (ms > 20) { slotWaits++; winWaits++; if (ms > slotWaitMsMax) slotWaitMsMax = ms; if (ms > winWaitMax) winWaitMax = ms; }
    }
    // frames held up for the GPU go to the log, at most every 30 s
    if (winWaits && now - winWaitT > 30_000) {
      log(`[gpu] ${winWaits} frame(s) waited over 20 ms for the GPU in the last ${((now - winWaitT) / 1000).toFixed(0)} s, ` +
          `the longest ${winWaitMax.toFixed(0)} ms (${frames} frames, ${pokes} pokes${poke ? '' : ', poke off'})`);
      winWaits = 0; winWaitMax = 0; winWaitT = now;
    } else if (!winWaits) winWaitT = now;
  };

  // Safari's graphics process went away (it starts again by itself, for other pages): from then on every call into
  // it throws (createCommandEncoder: InvalidStateError) and device.lost never comes, so the picture would stay
  // frozen while the game plays on.  So many failures in a row are a lost device.
  let failRun = 0;
  const failed = (what: string, x: unknown) => {
    errors++; failRun++;
    log(`[gpu] ${what} failed: ${errText(x)}`);
    if (failRun === LOST_AFTER) lost(`device gone: ${LOST_AFTER} times in a row the WebGPU calls failed`);
  };
  const pump = () => {
    if (!alive || pumping) return;
    pumping = true;
    try {
      for (;;) {
        enc.views();
        const I = i32(), U = u32();
        // the queue head before the state: a frame published after this read has
        // rq_end >= head, so draining to head never applies a later frame's uploads
        const head = Atomics.load(I, cw + C.rqHead) >>> 0;
        const s = Atomics.load(I, cw + C.state), r = s & 3, e = (s >> 2) & 3;
        // a pending frame is taken while fewer than maxInFlight are on the GPU: claimed first, so the game, which
        // waits for this claim (gpu_web.c wait_taken), records its next frame while this one uploads and encodes
        const take = !!r && !e && inFlight < maxInFlight;
        if (take) {
          if (Atomics.compareExchange(I, cw + C.state, s, s | (r << 2)) !== s) continue;
          Atomics.notify(I, cw + C.state);
        }
        // a pending frame: its resources first, nothing recorded after it
        const limit = r && !e ? U[cw + C.frame + (r - 1) * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2) + F.rqEnd] : head;
        try { enc.drain(limit); } catch (x) {
          failed('resource upload', x);
          // the frame stays pending, as if not taken (only the page changes a claimed state)
          if (take) { Atomics.store(I, cw + C.state, s); Atomics.notify(I, cw + C.state); }
          break;
        }
        waiting(!!r && !e && !take);
        if (!take) break;
        try { encodeAndSubmit(r - 1); failRun = 0; } catch (x) { failed('encode', x); }
        Atomics.store(I, cw + C.state, 0); Atomics.notify(I, cw + C.state);
      }
    } finally { pumping = false; }
  };

  // gpuBurn: busy work in every frame's command buffer
  let burn: ((ce: GPUCommandEncoder) => void) | null = null;
  if (opts.gpuBurn) {
    const m = device.createShaderModule({ code: `override N: u32 = 1u;
@vertex fn vs(@builtin(vertex_index) i: u32) -> @builtin(position) vec4f {
  return vec4f(vec2f(f32((i << 1u) & 2u), f32(i & 2u)) * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
@fragment fn fs(@builtin(position) p: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f {
  var x = p.x * 0.001 + p.y;
  for (var k = 0u; k < N; k++) { x = fract(sin(x) * 43758.5453 + 0.37); }
  return vec4f(x, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}` });
    const pipe = device.createRenderPipeline({ layout: 'auto', vertex: { module: m, entryPoint: 'vs' },
      fragment: { module: m, entryPoint: 'fs', targets: [{ format: 'rgba8unorm' }], constants: { N: opts.gpuBurn } } });
    const view = device.createTexture({ size: [512, 512], format: 'rgba8unorm', usage: GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT }).createView();
    burn = ce => {
      const p = ce.beginRenderPass({ colorAttachments: [{ view, loadOp: 'clear', storeOp: 'store' }] });
      p.setPipeline(pipe); p.draw(3); p.end();
    };
    log(`[gpu] gpuBurn ${opts.gpuBurn}: busy work in every frame`);
  }

  // GPU timing: a ring of query pairs, each resolved into its own mappable buffer
  const timing = opts.gpuTiming && device.features.has('timestamp-query');
  const TQ = 8;
  const qs = timing ? device.createQuerySet({ type: 'timestamp', count: 2 * TQ }) : null;
  const qResolve = timing ? device.createBuffer({ size: 256 * TQ, usage: GPUBufferUsage.QUERY_RESOLVE | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_SRC }) : null;
  const qRead: GPUBuffer[] = [], qBusy: boolean[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; timing && i < TQ; i++) { qRead.push(device.createBuffer({ size: 16, usage: GPUBufferUsage.MAP_READ | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST })); qBusy.push(false); }
  let qNext = 0, gpuMsTotal = 0, gpuMsN = 0, gpuMsMax = 0;
  let tsTarget: GPUTextureView | null = null;
  const tsView = () => tsTarget ??= device.createTexture({ size: [1, 1], format: 'bgra8unorm', usage: GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT }).createView();

  // A rendering update (an rAF) shows the canvas once: of the frames submitted between two of them only the last is
  // ever on the screen (counted in raf).  The canvas texture tells nothing here: WebKit gives every frame a texture of
  // its own (at 120 fps on its 30 Hz rAF, 1 of 3,571 frames got the one before it).
  let sinceRaf = 0, unshown = 0, winUnshown = 0, winUnshownFrames = 0, winUnshownT = performance.now();
  // A line a minute for the log (what a phone's log is read for): frames, the browser's rAF rate, frames drawn over
  // unseen, how long the GPU took to finish a frame (submit to onSubmittedWorkDone: GPU-bound as it nears the frame
  // time, a hot phone as it climbs), frames that waited for the GPU, and the textures' memory on the GPU (a phone's
  // graphics process runs out of memory first).
  const SUMMARY_MS = +(opts.summaryMs ?? 60_000);
  let winDone: number[] = [], winWaits0 = 0;
  const MB = (b: number) => (b / 1048576).toFixed(0);
  const pct = (a: number[], p: number) => a.length ? a[Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.floor(p * a.length))].toFixed(1) : '-';
  // Input age (runtime/framerate.c, GwLat in the frame's constants): how old the input a frame simulates with is when
  // the game hands the frame off, when the page submits it, when the GPU has done it, and at the first rAF after that
  // (the rendering update that puts it on the screen, which the compositor shows a refresh or two later).  The
  // player's press waits up to a frame more for the game's next read.
  const T0 = performance.timeOrigin;
  const age = { hand: [] as number[], sub: [] as number[], done: [] as number[], raf: [] as number[] };
  let ageDone: number[] = [];       // input times of frames the GPU has done since the last rAF
  const ageLine = () => {
    const n = age.sub.length;
    if (!n) return;
    for (const a of Object.values(age)) a.sort((x, y) => x - y);
    const pq = (a: number[]) => `${pct(a, 0.5)} / ${pct(a, 0.9)}`;
    log(`[gpu] input age p50 / p90: handed off ${pq(age.hand)}, submitted ${pq(age.sub)}, GPU done ${pq(age.done)}, ` +
        `next rAF ${pq(age.raf)} ms (${n} frames)`);
    for (const a of Object.values(age)) a.length = 0;
  };
  const summary = (now: number) => {
    const d = winDone.sort((a, b) => a - b), q = (p: number) => pct(d, p);
    log(`[gpu] ${((now - winUnshownT) / 1000).toFixed(0)} s to t=${((now - attachedAt) / 1000).toFixed(0)} s: ${winUnshownFrames} frames, rAF ${rafHz.toFixed(1)} Hz, ` +
        `${winUnshown} drawn over unseen, GPU done p50 ${q(0.5)} / p90 ${q(0.9)} / max ${d.length ? d[d.length - 1].toFixed(0) : '-'} ms, ` +
        `${slotWaits - winWaits0} waited for the GPU, textures ${MB(enc.texBytes)} MB${texSplit(enc.unpackBytes, enc.astcBytes)}${errors ? `, ${errors} WebGPU errors so far` : ''}`);
    // the textures that came and went: what a phone's GPU process has to give back (iOS kills the page when it does not)
    log(`[gpu] textures: ${enc.texMade} made (${MB(enc.texMadeBytes)} MB), ${enc.texFreed} freed (${MB(enc.texFreedBytes)} MB); ` +
        `${enc.bindGroups} bind groups cached`);
    enc.texMade = enc.texMadeBytes = enc.texFreed = enc.texFreedBytes = 0;
    ageLine();
    winUnshown = 0; winUnshownFrames = 0; winUnshownT = now; winDone = []; winWaits0 = slotWaits;
  };
  // A render scale below 1 (a phone's 75 %): the game draws a picture smaller than the view, and the composite drew it
  // stretched over the whole canvas, a pass over every screen pixel a frame.  When the picture has the view's shape
  // (within 2 pixels, as the composite's aspect-fit would have it fill the canvas), the canvas's own size becomes the
  // picture's, the frame draws straight into it (Encoder.encodeFrame's direct path), and CSS stretches the canvas over
  // its box: the browser's compositor scales it as it puts the page on the screen anyway.  Another shape (a picture
  // pillarboxed in the view) or the full scale: the canvas at the view's size, as before.  The full scale includes an
  // odd view's picture, a row or column short (the game draws even sizes, gpu_web.c view_wh): stretched by that one
  // pixel, every row of the picture was resampled, 1-pixel lines grey in the middle of the screen (a player's
  // 2560x1305 window showed shimmering lines).
  const fitPicture = (b: number) => {
    if (opts.cssScale === false) return;
    const U = u32(), fw = cw + C.frame + b * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2), bw = U[fw + F.bbW], bh = U[fw + F.bbH];
    let w = viewW, h = viewH;
    if (bw > 0 && bh > 0 && (bw < (viewW & ~1) || bh < (viewH & ~1))) {
      const sc = Math.min(viewW / bw, viewH / bh);
      if (Math.abs(Math.round(bw * sc) - viewW) <= 2 && Math.abs(Math.round(bh * sc) - viewH) <= 2) { w = bw; h = bh; }
    }
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
      log(`[gpu] canvas ${w}x${h} for the view's ${viewW}x${viewH}${w !== viewW || h !== viewH ? ': the picture stretched by CSS, no composite' : ''}`);
    }
  };
  // Exposure and White Level (runtime/tonemenu.c): the frame's GwTone (mult, white, knee), or null while they leave
  // the picture as drawn (or the module has none), when the frame may draw straight into the canvas
  let toneSaid = '';
  const toneOf = (b: number): Float32Array | null => {
    const U = u32(), fw = cw + C.frame + b * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2), at = U[fw + F.k] + P.K_TONE;
    const t = U[at >>> 2] === P.TONE_MAGIC ? new Float32Array(mem.buffer, at + 4, 3) : null;
    const on = !!t && t[0] > 0 && t[1] > 0 && t[2] >= 0 && t[2] < 1 && (Math.abs(t[0] - 1) > 1e-4 || t[1] < 0.9999);
    const said = on ? `x${t![0].toFixed(2)}, white ${Math.round(t![1] * 100)} %` : 'off';
    if (said !== toneSaid && (toneSaid || on)) log(`[gpu] Exposure and White Level: ${said}`);
    toneSaid = said;
    return on ? t : null;
  };
  // photo mode's picture (GwPhoto): state, n, target, gen, or null while photo mode is off (or the module has none)
  const photoOf = (b: number): [number, number, number, number] | null => {
    const U = u32(), fw = cw + C.frame + b * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2), at = (U[fw + F.k] + P.K_PHOTO) >>> 2;
    if (U[at] !== P.PHOTO_MAGIC || U[at + 1] === PH_OFF || U[at + 1] > PH_NOW) return null;
    return [U[at + 1], U[at + 2], U[at + 3], U[at + 4]];
  };
  // ...its tile word (the tile drawn, tiles a side, what is being taken, the last picture asked for the game saw), the
  // field of view it is drawn with and the lens
  const photoMore = (b: number) => {
    const U = u32(), at = U[cw + C.frame + b * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2) + F.k] + P.K_PHOTO, tw = U[(at + P.PHOTO_TILE) >>> 2];
    return { tile: tw & 0xff, n: Math.max(1, tw >>> 8 & 0xf), mode: tw >>> 12 & 0xf, echo: tw >>> 16,
      fov: new Float32Array(mem.buffer, at + P.PHOTO_FOV, 1)[0], lens: U[(at + P.PHOTO_LENS) >>> 2] };
  };
  // ...and the frames of still picture gen the average has, back to the game in both buffers' blocks (GwPhoto ack)
  const photoAck = (gen: number, n: number) => {
    const U = u32();
    for (let s = 0; s < P.GW_NBUF; s++) {
      const k = U[cw + C.frame + s * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2) + F.k];
      if (k) Atomics.store(U, (k + P.K_PHOTO + P.PHOTO_ACK) >>> 2, ((gen & 0xffff) << 16 | (n & 0xffff)) >>> 0);
    }
  };
  // ...a picture asked for, in both buffers' blocks (GwPhoto want)
  const photoWant = (v: number) => {
    const U = u32();
    for (let s = 0; s < P.GW_NBUF; s++) {
      const k = U[cw + C.frame + s * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2) + F.k];
      if (k) Atomics.store(U, (k + P.K_PHOTO + P.PHOTO_WANT) >>> 2, v >>> 0);
    }
  };
  // the label of frame b's autotest dump, or null without one
  const dumpLabel = (b: number): string | null => {
    const fw = cw + C.frame + b * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2);
    if (!u32()[fw + F.dump]) return null;
    return new TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(mem.buffer).slice((fw + F.dumpLabel) * 4, (fw + F.dumpLabel) * 4 + 64)).replace(/\0.*$/s, '');
  };
  const encodeAndSubmit = (b: number) => {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const ce = device.createCommandEncoder();
    const slot = timing && !qBusy[qNext] ? qNext : -1;
    if (slot >= 0) { qNext = (qNext + 1) % TQ; enc.firstPassTs = { querySet: qs!, beginningOfPassWriteIndex: 2 * slot }; }
    fitPicture(b);
    const cur = ctx.getCurrentTexture();
    sinceRaf++; winUnshownFrames++;
    if (t0 - winUnshownT > SUMMARY_MS) summary(t0);
    const tone = toneOf(b), ph = photoOf(b), more = ph ? photoMore(b) : null;
    if (!ph && picState !== PH_OFF) { pic?.destroy(); pic = null; }           // photo mode ended: its textures go
    picState = ph ? ph[0] : PH_OFF;
    const tileReads: { rb: Readback; t: Taking; x: number; y: number }[] = [];
    const st = enc.encodeFrame(b, ce, direct && !tone && !ph ? cur : undefined);
    burn?.(ce);
    const scr = enc.screen!;   // the canvas texture itself, or the back buffer
    const tsEnd: GPURenderPassTimestampWrites | undefined = slot >= 0 ? { querySet: qs!, endOfPassWriteIndex: 2 * slot + 1 } : undefined;
    if (slot >= 0 && enc.firstPassTs) {   // the frame had no render pass: time the composite alone
      enc.firstPassTs = undefined; tsEnd!.beginningOfPassWriteIndex = 2 * slot;
    }
    if (st.direct) {
      // the screen is already in the canvas texture
      directFrames++;
      imgRect = { x: 0, y: 0, w: cur.width, h: cur.height };
      // GPU timing ends with a pass of its own that reads one texel of the screen, so it
      // waits for every pass that drew there (a pass without that dependency may run early)
      if (tsEnd) enc.copyQuad(ce, enc.screenView!, tsView(), 'bgra8unorm', nearest, undefined, true, tsEnd);
    } else {
      // composite: the back buffer aspect-fit into the canvas at its own resolution, with Exposure and White Level
      const cvw = cur.width, cvh = cur.height;
      const sc = Math.min(cvw / scr.width, cvh / scr.height);
      const w = Math.round(scr.width * sc), h = Math.round(scr.height * sc);
      const one = w === scr.width && h === scr.height;
      const rect: [number, number, number, number] = [Math.floor((cvw - w) / 2), Math.floor((cvh - h) / 2), w, h];
      imgRect = { x: rect[0], y: rect[1], w, h };
      if (ph) {
        // photo mode: the frame into the picture's average, which shows with the picture's look (a fisheye bent round);
        // while a picture is taken in tiles the canvas keeps the whole view as it was, and each tile once whole is read
        // out for the PNG worker
        pic ??= new PhotoPicture(device);
        bbW = scr.width; bbH = scr.height;
        pic.fisheye = more!.lens === P.LENS_FISHEYE && more!.fov > 0 ? { fov: more!.fov, aspect: scr.width / scr.height } : null;
        const tiles = more!.mode === P.CAP_TILES;
        if (tiles && !pic.holding) pic.hold(ce);
        else if (!tiles && pic.holding) pic.release();
        pic.add(ce, enc.screenView!, scr.width, scr.height, linear, ph[0], ph[1], ph[2], ph[3]);
        if (pic.gen) photoAck(pic.gen, pic.count);
        if (tiles) {
          if (!taking || taking.id !== more!.echo) taking = takeTiles(more!.echo, more!.n, scr.width, scr.height);
          const t = taking, tl: PhotoTile = { x: more!.tile % t.n, y: Math.floor(more!.tile / t.n), n: t.n };
          if (pic.done && ph[3] === pic.gen && !t.got.has(more!.tile)) {
            t.got.add(more!.tile);
            const sh = pic.shot(ce, linear, look, tl);
            if (sh) tileReads.push({ rb: copyOut(ce, sh.tex), t, x: tl.x * t.w, y: tl.y * t.h });
          }
        }
        pic.show(ce, cur.createView(), canvasFormat, one ? nearest : linear, rect, look, tone, tsEnd);
      }
      // the back buffer's own view: its bind group is made once (Encoder.copyBg), not every frame
      else if (tone) enc.toneQuad(ce, enc.screenView!, cur.createView(), canvasFormat, one ? nearest : linear, tone, rect, tsEnd);
      else enc.copyQuad(ce, enc.screenView!, cur.createView(), canvasFormat, one ? nearest : linear, rect, true, tsEnd);
    }
    if (slot >= 0) {
      ce.resolveQuerySet(qs!, 2 * slot, 2, qResolve!, 256 * slot);     // resolve offsets are 256-aligned
      ce.copyBufferToBuffer(qResolve!, 256 * slot, qRead[slot], 0, 16);
    }
    // autotest dump or a dump() request: read this frame's back buffer
    const U = u32(), fw = cw + C.frame + b * (P.FRAME_BYTES >> 2);
    const lab = dumpLabel(b);
    const dumpName = lab === null ? null : `nfsu2_g${String(U[fw + F.dumpFrame]).padStart(6, '0')}_${lab}`;
    // photo mode's picture: the first frame with the whole still picture (or one past PHOTO_WAIT_MS) keeps it, and the
    // autotest's dumps get it as kept (photo() with photo mode off: dump()'s, the next frame)
    // a picture asked for: once the game saw it (its echo; a module that never says: after PHOTO_ECHO_MS), taken in tiles
    // (taking has it), over a shutter's time (waits while it goes on), or the still picture as it is
    if (!ph) dumpWaiters.push(...photoWaiters.splice(0));
    const w0 = photoWaiters[0], seen = !!w0 && !!more && more.echo === w0.id;
    if (w0 && seen && more!.mode !== P.CAP_NONE) {
      const prog = pic ? pic.gen * 0x10000 + pic.count : 0;
      if (prog !== progSeen) { progSeen = prog; w0.last = t0; }
      if (more!.mode === P.CAP_TILES && taking?.id === w0.id && !taking.resolve) {
        photoWaiters.shift(); taking.name = w0.name; taking.mark = w0.mark; taking.resolve = w0.resolve;
      }
    }
    // (over a shutter's time: kept the moment its last frame is in, before the world as the shutter left it replaces it)
    const waiting = !!w0 && !!more && seen && (more.mode === P.CAP_TILES || (more.mode === P.CAP_SHUTTER && !pic?.done));
    const waited = w0 ? t0 - w0.last : 0;
    const pw = ph && w0 && !waiting && (seen || t0 - w0.since > PHOTO_ECHO_MS) &&
      (pic!.done || (ph[0] !== PH_ADD && ph[0] !== PH_DONE && waited > PHOTO_MOVING_MS) || waited > PHOTO_WAIT_MS) ? photoWaiters.shift() : undefined;
    if (w0 && waiting && waited > PHOTO_WAIT_MS * 4) {
      log(`[gpu] photo mode's picture: the game took more than ${PHOTO_WAIT_MS * 4 / 1000} s without going on: kept as it is`);
      photoWaiters.shift(); dumpWaiters.push(w0);
    }
    const shot = ph && (pw || dumpName) ? pic!.shot(ce, linear, look) : null;
    if (pw && !pic!.done) log(`[gpu] photo mode's picture kept as it is (${pic!.count} of ${pic!.target} frames)`);
    const waiter = pw ?? dumpWaiters.shift();
    const reads: { name: string | null; rb: Readback; waiter?: (b: Blob) => void; mark?: boolean }[] = [];
    // an autotest dump keeps its frame-numbered name; a dump(name) request names its own
    if (dumpName || waiter) reads.push({ name: dumpName ?? waiter!.name, rb: shot ? copyOut(ce, shot.tex, shot) : copyOut(ce, scr), waiter: waiter?.resolve, mark: waiter?.mark });
    if (dumpName) for (const id of opts.dumpTex ?? []) {
      const sn = enc.snapshot(ce, id);
      if (sn) { log(`[gpu] dump texture ${id}: ${sn.info}`); reads.push({ name: `${dumpName}_tex${id}`, rb: copyOut(ce, sn.tex) }); }
    }
    // a texture the game waits for (gpu_web.c metal_read_texture), drawn by this very frame
    const rbId = U[fw + F.rbId], rbTex = rbId ? enc.readable(ce, U[fw + F.rbTex]) : null;
    const rbRead = rbTex ? copyOut(ce, rbTex) : null;
    device.queue.submit([ce.finish()]);
    enc.afterSubmit();
    for (const r of tileReads) tileOut(r.rb, r.t, r.x, r.y);
    // tests (play.html pixelated=dump): an autotest dump labelled <name>_px is the frame as the game set it, and the
    // same frame drawn again into the back buffer with pixelated textures is <name>_px1: the same moment in both looks
    // (the next frame would not be, and the game replaces a frame the page is slow to take).  Drawn after the submit
    // above: drawing writes the frame's constants into the queue
    if (opts.pixelatedDump && lab?.endsWith('_px')) {
      enc.pointTex = true;
      const ce2 = device.createCommandEncoder();
      enc.encodeFrame(b, ce2, undefined);
      reads.push({ name: `${dumpName}1`, rb: copyOut(ce2, enc.screen!) });
      device.queue.submit([ce2.finish()]);
      enc.afterSubmit();
      enc.pointTex = false;
    }
    if (opts.anisoDump && lab?.endsWith('_af')) {
      enc.aniso = !enc.aniso;
      const ce2 = device.createCommandEncoder();
      enc.encodeFrame(b, ce2, undefined);
      reads.push({ name: `${dumpName}1`, rb: copyOut(ce2, enc.screen!) });
      device.queue.submit([ce2.finish()]);
      enc.afterSubmit();
      enc.aniso = !enc.aniso;
    }
    if (rbId) readForGame(rbId, rbRead, U[fw + F.rbDst], U[fw + F.rbPitch], U[fw + F.rbRows]);
    // quick chat's places over the cars in this very frame (GwMarks in its constants, from a module that writes them)
    if (opts.onMarks) {
      const k = (U[fw + F.k] + P.K_MARKS) >>> 2;
      const n = U[k] === P.MARKS_MAGIC ? Math.min(U[k + 1], P.MARKS_MAX) : 0;
      if (n) markI.set(U.subarray(k + 4, k + 4 + 4 * n));
      opts.onMarks(n, markF, markI);
    }
    if (slot >= 0) {
      qBusy[slot] = true;
      qRead[slot].mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ).then(() => {
        const t = new BigUint64Array(qRead[slot].getMappedRange());
        const ms = Number(t[1] - t[0]) / 1e6;
        qRead[slot].unmap(); qBusy[slot] = false;
        if (ms > 0 && ms < 1000) { gpuMsTotal += ms; gpuMsN++; if (ms > gpuMsMax) gpuMsMax = ms; if (winGpu.length < WIN_MAX) winGpu.push(ms); }
      }).catch(() => { qBusy[slot] = false; });
    }
    inFlight++;
    const tSub = performance.now();
    // the frame's input age (a module with GwLat; ages over 2 s are a stall, a load, a hidden tab: left out)
    const la = U[fw + F.k] + P.K_LAT;
    let tIn = 0;
    if (U[la >>> 2] === P.LAT_MAGIC && age.sub.length < 16384) {
      const lt = new Float64Array(mem.buffer, la + 8, 2);
      if (lt[0] > 0 && T0 + tSub - lt[0] < 2000) { tIn = lt[0]; age.hand.push(lt[1] - tIn); age.sub.push(T0 + tSub - tIn); }
    }
    device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone().then(() => {
      inFlight--;
      const now = performance.now(), dms = now - tSub;
      if (done.length < 4096) done.push(dms);
      if (winDone.length < 16384) winDone.push(dms);
      if (tIn) { age.done.push(T0 + now - tIn); ageDone.push(tIn); }
      pump();
    });
    const ms = performance.now() - t0;
    frames++; encMsTotal += ms; encMsLast = ms; drawsLast = st.draws; passesLast = st.passes;
    if (winEnc.length < WIN_MAX) { winEnc.push(ms); winDraws += st.draws; winPasses += st.passes; }
    const C2 = u32();
    C2[cw + C.framesDone] = frames; C2[cw + C.stDraws] = enc.totalDraws >>> 0; C2[cw + C.stPasses] = enc.totalPasses >>> 0;
    C2[cw + C.stEncUs] = Math.round(encMsTotal * 1000) >>> 0; C2[cw + C.stErrors] = errors; C2[cw + C.stPipelines] = enc.pipelinesMade;
    for (const r of reads) {
      const job = readback(r.rb, r.mark).then(async png => {
        r.waiter?.(png);
        if (!r.name) return;
        let where = '';
        if (opts.artifacts) {
          const res = await fetch(`${opts.artifacts}${r.name}.png`, { method: 'PUT', body: png });
          where = res.ok ? ` -> ${opts.artifacts}${r.name}.png` : ` (upload failed: ${res.status})`;
        }
        log(`[gpu] dump ${r.name}.png ${r.rb.w}x${r.rb.h}${where}`);
        if (r.name === dumpName) { const C3 = u32(); C3[cw + C.dumpsDone]++; }
      }).catch(x => log(`[gpu] dump failed: ${x}`));
      pending.add(job); job.finally(() => pending.delete(job));
    }
  };

  // a picture in tiles: begun when the game starts drawing them (the crop's rectangle of the whole picture, from the
  // look), each tile to the worker as it is read back, the PNG once all n x n are there
  const takeTiles = (id: number, n: number, w: number, h: number): Taking => {
    const W = w * n, H = h * n, c = look.crop;
    const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - 1, Math.round(c[0] * W))), y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - 1, Math.round(c[1] * H)));
    const cw2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(W - x, Math.round((c[2] - c[0]) * W))), ch2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(H - y, Math.round((c[3] - c[1]) * H)));
    log(`[gpu] photo mode's picture in ${n} x ${n} tiles: ${W}x${H}${cw2 !== W || ch2 !== H ? `, cropped to ${cw2}x${ch2}` : ''}`);
    return { id, pic: bigNext++, n, w, h, got: new Set(), posted: [], crop: [x, y, cw2, ch2], name: `take_${id}`, ended: false };
  };
  const tileOut = (rb: Readback, t: Taking, x: number, y: number) => {
    const job = (async () => {
      await rb.buf.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ);
      const px = rb.buf.getMappedRange().slice(0);
      rb.buf.unmap(); rb.buf.destroy();
      const msg: ToPngTile = { tile: true, pic: t.pic, px, w: rb.w, h: rb.h, bpr: rb.bpr, x, y, W: t.w * t.n, H: t.h * t.n };
      pngWorkerOf().postMessage(msg, [px]);
    })();
    t.posted.push(job);
    pending.add(job); job.finally(() => pending.delete(job));
    if (t.got.size === t.n * t.n && !t.ended) {
      t.ended = true;
      const done = Promise.all(t.posted).then(() => new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
        const id = pngNext++, msg: ToPngEnd = { end: true, id, pic: t.pic, crop: t.crop, mark: t.mark };
        pngWaiting.set(id, { resolve, reject });
        pngWorkerOf().postMessage(msg);
      })).then(async png => {
        log(`[gpu] photo mode's picture from ${t.n} x ${t.n} tiles: ${t.crop[2]}x${t.crop[3]}, ${png.size} bytes`);
        if (t.resolve) t.resolve(png);
        else if (opts.artifacts) {
          const res = await fetch(`${opts.artifacts}${t.name}.png`, { method: 'PUT', body: png });
          log(`[gpu] dump ${t.name}.png ${t.crop[2]}x${t.crop[3]}${res.ok ? ` -> ${opts.artifacts}${t.name}.png` : ` (upload failed: ${res.status})`}`);
        }
      }).catch(x => { log(`[gpu] photo mode's picture in tiles failed: ${x}`); t.resolve?.(new Blob([], { type: 'image/png' })); })
        .finally(() => { if (taking === t) taking = null; });
      pending.add(done); done.finally(() => pending.delete(done));
    }
  };

  type Readback = { buf: GPUBuffer; w: number; h: number; bpr: number };
  const copyOut = (ce: GPUCommandEncoder, t: GPUTexture, r?: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }): Readback => {
    const x = r?.x ?? 0, y = r?.y ?? 0, w = r?.w ?? t.width, h = r?.h ?? t.height;
    const bpr = Math.ceil(w * 4 / 256) * 256;
    const buf = device.createBuffer({ size: bpr * h, usage: GPUBufferUsage.MAP_READ | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST });
    ce.copyTextureToBuffer({ texture: t, origin: [x, y, 0] }, { buffer: buf, bytesPerRow: bpr }, [w, h, 1]);
    return { buf, w, h, bpr };
  };

  // The game's lock buffer gets the texture's rows once the GPU has them, unless the game stopped waiting: it then
  // cancelled the request in rbWant, and the buffer is not the page's to write any more.  The claim, the bytes and
  // rbDone happen in one go.
  const readForGame = (id: number, rb: Readback | null, dst: number, pitch: number, rows: number) => {
    const answer = (px: ArrayBuffer | null) => {
      const I = i32();
      if (Atomics.compareExchange(I, cw + C.rbWant, id, id | P.RB_FLAG) !== id) return;
      // (a memory that grew under a page holding its buffer only: the new buffer came first, or the read fails)
      if (px && rb && dst + pitch * Math.min(rows, rb.h) > mem.buffer.byteLength) px = null;
      if (px && rb) {
        const m = new Uint8Array(mem.buffer), n = Math.min(pitch, rb.w * 4);
        for (let y = 0; y < Math.min(rows, rb.h); y++) m.set(new Uint8Array(px, y * rb.bpr, n), dst + y * pitch);
      }
      Atomics.store(I, cw + C.rbDone, px ? id : id | P.RB_FLAG);
      Atomics.notify(I, cw + C.rbDone);
    };
    if (!rb) { log(`[gpu] texture read back for the game: not there`); answer(null); return; }
    const grown = mem instanceof MemoryBuffer ? mem.until(dst + pitch * Math.min(rows, rb.h)) : null;
    const job = rb.buf.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ).then(() => grown).then(() => { answer(rb.buf.getMappedRange()); rb.buf.unmap(); },
      x => { log(`[gpu] texture read back for the game failed: ${x}`); answer(null); }).finally(() => rb.buf.destroy());
    pending.add(job); job.finally(() => pending.delete(job));
  };

  const linear = device.createSampler({ minFilter: 'linear', magFilter: 'linear' });
  const nearest = device.createSampler({ minFilter: 'nearest', magFilter: 'nearest' });

  // the PNG is made in a worker (png-worker.ts), started at the first dump: here the frame is only copied out
  let pngWorker: Worker | null = null, pngNext = 0;
  const pngWaiting = new Map<number, { resolve: (b: Blob) => void; reject: (e: Error) => void }>();
  function pngWorkerOf(): Worker {
    if (!pngWorker) {
      const w = pngWorker = new Worker(new URL('/gpu/png-worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module', name: 'png' });
      w.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<FromPng>) => {
        const p = pngWaiting.get(e.data.id);
        pngWaiting.delete(e.data.id);
        if ('png' in e.data) p?.resolve(e.data.png); else p?.reject(new Error(e.data.error));
      };
      w.onerror = e => { for (const p of pngWaiting.values()) p.reject(new Error(e.message || 'the PNG worker failed')); pngWaiting.clear(); };
    }
    return pngWorker;
  }
  async function readback(rb: Readback, mark?: boolean): Promise<Blob> {
    await rb.buf.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ);
    const px = rb.buf.getMappedRange().slice(0);
    rb.buf.unmap(); rb.buf.destroy();
    const w = pngWorkerOf(), id = pngNext++, msg: ToPng = { id, px, w: rb.w, h: rb.h, bpr: rb.bpr, scale: opts.dumpScale ?? 1, mark };
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      pngWaiting.set(id, { resolve, reject });
      w.postMessage(msg, [px]);
    });
  }

  // ---- display clock (rAF) ----
  // The refresh rate is the median rAF interval, snapped to a standard rate
  // (rAF timestamps jitter by a few tenths of a millisecond) and changed only
  // after holding for half a second, as metal.m does with the display link.
  const RATES = [24, 30, 48, 50, 60, 72, 75, 90, 96, 100, 120, 144, 165, 180, 240, 360];
  const snap = (hzRaw: number) => { for (const r of RATES) if (Math.abs(hzRaw / r - 1) < 0.025) return r; return Math.round(hzRaw); };
  const iv: number[] = [];
  let lastT = 0, hz = 0, cand = 0, candSince = 0, rafHz = 0, rafId = 0;
  const raf = (t: number) => {
    if (!alive) return;
    if (lastT) {
      const d = t - lastT;
      if (d > 2 && d < 100) { iv.push(d); if (iv.length > 120) iv.shift(); }
      // frames drawn over unseen since the last one (not across a gap: a hidden tab has no rAF)
      if (sinceRaf > 1 && d < 100) { unshown += sinceRaf - 1; winUnshown += sinceRaf - 1; }
    }
    sinceRaf = 0;
    lastT = t;
    if (ageDone.length) { const now = T0 + performance.now(); for (const ti of ageDone) age.raf.push(now - ti); ageDone = []; }
    if (iv.length >= 30) {
      // the median over spans of 4 frames, not of single intervals: Safari on an iPhone or iPad gives rAF times in
      // whole milliseconds, so at 60 Hz an interval is 16 or 17 ms and their median at times said 62.5 Hz ("display
      // 63 Hz"), at 120 Hz always 125: not a standard rate, so the period went out unsnapped and the pacer lost its
      // vsync lock.  Over 4 frames the rounding is a quarter of a millisecond, inside snap()'s 2.5 %.
      const sp: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 3; i < iv.length; i++) sp.push((iv[i] + iv[i - 1] + iv[i - 2] + iv[i - 3]) / 4);
      sp.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const med = sp[sp.length >> 1];
      rafHz = 1000 / med;
      const h = snap(rafHz);
      if (h !== cand) { cand = h; candSince = t; }
      if (cand !== hz && (hz === 0 || t - candSince >= 500)) {
        log(`[gpu] display ${cand} Hz (rAF median ${med.toFixed(3)} ms)`);
        hz = cand; Atomics.store(i32(), vw + P.V.hz, hz);
      }
      // nominal period of the snapped rate, like CADisplayLink.duration;
      // the game measures the real period from the timestamps itself
      const per = RATES.includes(hz) ? 1000 / hz : med;
      const I = i32(), Fv = new Float64Array(mem.buffer);
      Atomics.add(I, vw + P.V.seq, 1);
      Fv[vf + P.V.tsF64] = performance.timeOrigin + t; Fv[vf + P.V.periodF64] = per;
      Atomics.add(I, vw + P.V.seq, 1);
      Atomics.store(I, vw + P.V.visible, document.visibilityState === 'visible' ? 1 : 0);
      Atomics.add(I, vw + P.V.tick, 1); Atomics.notify(I, vw + P.V.tick);
    }
    pump();
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(raf);
  };
  rafId = requestAnimationFrame(raf);

  // ---- doorbell: the game rings it on every handoff and queue flush ----
  (async () => {
    while (alive) {
      const I = i32(), b = Atomics.load(I, cw + C.bell);
      pump();
      const w = Atomics.waitAsync(I, cw + C.bell, b, 500);
      if (w.async) await w.value;
    }
  })();

  // the view: the element's size in device pixels (devicePixelContentBoxSize: exact, follows zoom and screens); the
  // canvas size is the page's choice, or with autoSize that size too
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    for (const e of entries) {
      const d = e.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];
      const w = d ? d.inlineSize : Math.round(e.contentRect.width * devicePixelRatio);
      const h = d ? d.blockSize : Math.round(e.contentRect.height * devicePixelRatio);
      if (!(w > 0 && h > 0)) continue;
      viewW = w; viewH = h;
      if (opts.autoSize && (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h)) { canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h; }
    }
    publishView();
  });
  try { ro.observe(canvas, { box: 'device-pixel-content-box' }); } catch { ro.observe(canvas); }

  return {
    device,
    stats: () => ({ frames, draws: enc.totalDraws, passes: enc.totalPasses, pipelines: enc.pipelinesMade, pipelinesWarm: enc.pipelinesAsync, errors,
      pipelineMs: enc.pipeMs, pipelineMsMax: enc.pipeMsMax, gpuMsAvg: gpuMsN ? gpuMsTotal / gpuMsN : 0, gpuMsMax,
      encodeMsAvg: frames ? encMsTotal / frames : 0, encodeMsLast: encMsLast, drawsLast, passesLast, rafHz, inFlight,
      dumps: u32()[cw + C.dumpsDone], missingTarget: enc.missingTarget, conflicts: enc.conflicts, zMismatch: enc.zMismatch, noVs: enc.noVs,
      ...(enc.msPasses ? { msPasses: enc.msPasses, msRefreshes: enc.msRefreshes } : {}),
      direct: directFrames, screenReadFirst: enc.screenReadFirst, slotWaits, slotWaitMsMax, pokes, unshown,
      texBytes: enc.texBytes, unpackBytes: enc.unpackBytes, astcBytes: enc.astcBytes }),
    window: (reset = false) => {
      const pct = (a: number[]) => {
        if (!a.length) return [];
        const s = a.slice().sort((x, y) => x - y), q = (p: number) => s[Math.min(s.length - 1, Math.round(p * (s.length - 1)))];
        return [q(0.5), q(0.95), q(0.99), s[s.length - 1]];
      };
      const n = winEnc.length;
      const callsAvg: Record<string, number> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(enc.calls)) callsAvg[k] = n ? +((v - winCalls[k as keyof typeof winCalls]) / n).toFixed(1) : 0;
      const w: RendererWindow = { frames: n, encodeMs: pct(winEnc), gpuMs: pct(winGpu), drawsAvg: n ? winDraws / n : 0, passesAvg: n ? winPasses / n : 0, callsAvg };
      if (reset) { winEnc = []; winGpu = []; winDraws = 0; winPasses = 0; winCalls = { ...enc.calls }; }
      return w;
    },
    doneMs: () => { const d = done; done = []; return d; },
    dump: (name: string, mark?: boolean) => new Promise<Blob>(resolve => dumpWaiters.push({ name, mark, resolve })),
    photo: (name: string, mark?: boolean) => new Promise<Blob>(resolve => {
      if (picState === PH_OFF) { dumpWaiters.push({ name, mark, resolve }); return; }
      wantSeq = wantSeq % 0x7fff + 1;                // (the game's own asks, for tests, are 0x8000 on)
      photoWant(wantSeq | maxTiles() << 16);
      const now = performance.now();
      photoWaiters.push({ name, mark, since: now, last: now, id: wantSeq, resolve });
    }),
    photoLook: (l: PhotoLook) => { look = l; },
    photoProgress: () => {
      if (picState === PH_OFF || !pic) return { n: 0, target: 0 };
      const target = picState === PH_ADD || picState === PH_DONE ? pic.target : 0, t = taking;
      // a picture in tiles: the tiles read out and this one's frames, of all of them
      if (t && target) return { n: Math.min(t.got.size * target + (t.got.size < t.n * t.n ? pic.count : 0), t.n * t.n * target), target: t.n * t.n * target };
      return { n: pic.count, target };
    },
    imageRect:() => imgRect ?? { x: 0, y: 0, w: canvas.width, h: canvas.height },
    flush: async () => {
      while (pending.size) await Promise.allSettled([...pending]);
      keepWarm();
    },
    detach: () => {
      if (!alive) return;
      alive = false; cancelAnimationFrame(rafId); clearInterval(warmTimer); ro.disconnect();
      keepWarm();
      // the game stops recording at its next present instead of waiting for a page
      // that is gone; a waiting present or a full resource queue wakes now
      const I = i32();
      Atomics.store(I, cw + C.attached, P.DETACHED);
      for (const w of [C.attached, C.state, C.rqTail, C.bell]) Atomics.notify(I, cw + w);
      for (const d of [...dumpWaiters.splice(0), ...photoWaiters.splice(0)]) d.resolve(new Blob([], { type: 'image/png' }));
      taking?.resolve?.(new Blob([], { type: 'image/png' })); taking = null;
      pic?.destroy(); pic = null;
      // a PNG the worker is making still comes (a screenshot taken just before the game ended)
      void Promise.allSettled([...pending]).then(() => pngWorker?.terminate());
      try { ctx.unconfigure(); } catch { /* already gone */ }
      device.removeEventListener('uncapturederror', onError);
      ownDestroy = true; device.destroy();
      log(`[gpu] renderer detached after ${frames} frames`);
    },
  };
}

// The site's address in the look of the game's menus: bold italic, "nfsu2" white, ".xyz" in their green, with a soft
// shadow.  F12 pictures have it in their corner (png-worker.ts), the title screen under EA's copyright
// (app/titlemark.ts), and the logo files are drawn with it (tools/brand).

type Ctx = CanvasRenderingContext2D | OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D;

export const markFont = (px: number) => `italic 700 ${px}px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`;

/** the address's ink at size px, about the start of its baseline: l left of it, r right of it, a above it, d under it */
export function markBox(g: Ctx, px: number) {
  g.font = markFont(px);
  const m = g.measureText('nfsu2.xyz');
  return { w: m.width, l: m.actualBoundingBoxLeft, r: m.actualBoundingBoxRight, a: m.actualBoundingBoxAscent, d: m.actualBoundingBoxDescent };
}

/** the address at size px, its baseline starting at (x, y), its shadow in the margin round it (0.6 px enough) */
export function drawMark(g: Ctx, px: number, x: number, y: number) {
  g.save();
  g.font = markFont(px);
  g.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)'; g.shadowBlur = px * 0.3; g.shadowOffsetY = Math.max(1, px * 0.06);
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)'; g.fillText('nfsu2', x, y);
  g.fillStyle = '#b8de7d'; g.fillText('.xyz', x + g.measureText('nfsu2').width, y);
  g.restore();
}

{"id": "AT001824", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/src/gpu/photo-picture.ts", "originalBytes": 11748, "originalSha256": "2faadd91ca64075e494ca441f2fde2ba1b8688462b0a0ed860b93603a4308513", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 11748, "utf8TotalBytes": 11748}
