  PAD_X, PAD_Y,
} from './proto';
import { dpadDirs, findHat, hatDirs, usbIds } from './wheel';

/** how the face buttons are labelled: as Nintendo's (A right, B at the bottom) or as Xbox's (A at the bottom) */
export type Face = 'nintendo' | 'xbox';

// the 8BitDo pads labelled as Xbox's, by product id (SDL_GameControllerDB maps their A as the bottom button): the
// Ultimate, Ultimate C, 2C and 2 and those made for Xbox, the Xbox One SN30 Pro, 64, P30, NEOGEO, an M30, the N30
// (NES) and F30 Arcade stick, and the USB adapters (another maker's controller through them)
const XBOX_FACE = new Set(['1003', '1080', '2000', '2002', '2003', '200a', '2019', '2025', '2100', '2101', '2810',
  '3011', '3012', '3013', '3015', '3016', '3017', '3019', '301b', '301c', '301d', '3100', '3105', '3106', '310a', '310b',
  '5006', '5107', '5108', '6012', '9025', '9026']);

// the buttons in the report's order as the pad's (-1: none); L2 and R2 are the triggers' own buttons
const NINTENDO_BUTTONS = [PAD_B, PAD_A, -1, PAD_Y, PAD_X, -1, PAD_LB, PAD_RB, -1, -1, PAD_BACK, PAD_START, PAD_HOME,
  PAD_LS, PAD_RS];
const XBOX_BUTTONS = [PAD_A, PAD_B, -1, PAD_X, PAD_Y, -1, PAD_LB, PAD_RB, -1, -1, PAD_BACK, PAD_START, PAD_HOME,
  PAD_LS, PAD_RS];
const L2 = 8, R2 = 9;

/** an 8BitDo controller's face buttons (its model's), from Gamepad.id; null: not 8BitDo's */
export function eightBitDoFace(id: string): Face | null {
  const u = usbIds(id);
  return u?.vendor !== '2dc8' ? null : XBOX_FACE.has(u.product) ? 'xbox' : 'nintendo';
}

// other makers' HID pads with 8BitDo's report, as vendor:product: the Zikway HID gamepad (a GameSir-made pad; read on
// Linux: A, B, -, X, Y, -, LB, RB, LT, RT, Select, Start, -, LS, RS, the triggers on ABS_GAS and ABS_BRAKE; read as
// the standard mapping its RB was the right trigger, the throttle)
const SAME_AS_8BITDO: Record<string, { face: Face; maker: 'Zikway' }> = { '3537:1041': { face: 'xbox', maker: 'Zikway' } };

/** Xbox's Bluetooth controllers with the newer firmware, by product id */
const XBOX_BT = new Set(['0b13', '0b20', '0b21', '0b22']);

/** a controller whose layout this file knows, read so when the browser gives it no standard mapping: its face
 *  buttons, whose it is, and whether its report has LT before RT; null: none of them (or not on this system) */
export interface KnownPad { face: Face; maker: '8BitDo' | 'Xbox' | 'Zikway'; ltFirst: boolean }
export function knownPad(id: string, ua = globalThis.navigator?.userAgent ?? ''): KnownPad | null {
  const e = eightBitDoFace(id);
  if (e) return { face: e, maker: '8BitDo', ltFirst: false };
  const u = usbIds(id), same = u && SAME_AS_8BITDO[`${u.vendor}:${u.product}`];
  if (same) return { ...same, ltFirst: false };
  if (u?.vendor === '045e' && XBOX_BT.has(u.product) && /Macintosh/.test(ua)) return { face: 'xbox', maker: 'Xbox', ltFirst: true };
  return null;
}

/** where a pad's axes are: the sticks, the triggers (-1: none), the D-pad as one axis (-1: none) or two */
export interface HidAxes {
  lx: number; ly: number; rx: number; ry: number; rt: number; lt: number; hat: number; dpad?: [number, number];
}

/** a known pad's axes placed as the browser does, from where they read (null: every axis 0, not read yet); ltFirst:
 *  its report has LT before RT (Xbox's), else RT before LT (8BitDo's) */
export function placeHidAxes(axes: readonly number[], ltFirst = false): HidAxes | null {
  if (axes.length >= 10) return ltFirst ? { lx: 0, ly: 1, rx: 2, ry: 5, lt: 3, rt: 4, hat: 9 } : { lx: 0, ly: 1, rx: 2, ry: 5, rt: 3, lt: 4, hat: 9 };
  if (axes.every(v => v === 0)) return null;
  const hat = findHat(axes);
  let list = axes.map((_, i) => i).filter(i => i !== hat), dpad: [number, number] | undefined;
  const n = list.length, centred = (i: number) => Math.abs(axes[i]) < 0.5;
  if (hat < 0 && n >= 6 && centred(n - 2) && centred(n - 1)) { dpad = [n - 2, n - 1]; list = list.slice(0, -2); }
  const at = (i: number) => list[i] ?? -1;
  return { lx: at(0), ly: at(1), rx: at(2), ry: at(3), rt: at(ltFirst ? 5 : 4), lt: at(ltFirst ? 4 : 5), hat, ...(dpad ? { dpad } : {}) };
}

const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;

/** A known pad without the standard mapping read as the pad.  Its axes are placed once they have been read (Chrome
 *  on macOS shows every axis 0 before the first report); a trigger's axis counts once it has read anything but 0,
 *  until then its button is the trigger, pressed all the way. */
export class HidPadReader {
  private at: HidAxes | null;
  private live = [false, false];             // R2's axis, L2's

  /** ltFirst, maker: as knownPad gives them (an 8BitDo pad's by default) */
  constructor(readonly face: Face, axes0: readonly number[], private ltFirst = false, private maker: KnownPad['maker'] = '8BitDo') {
    this.at = placeHidAxes(axes0, ltFirst);
  }

  /** the pad's buttons (1 << PAD_*) and axes LX, LY, RX, RY, LT, RT from the controller's */
  read(axes: readonly number[], pressed: readonly boolean[]): { buttons: number; axes: number[] } {
    const a = this.at ??= placeHidAxes(axes, this.ltFirst), table = this.face === 'xbox' ? XBOX_BUTTONS : NINTENDO_BUTTONS;
    let buttons = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < table.length && i < pressed.length; i++) if (pressed[i] && table[i] >= 0) buttons |= 1 << table[i];
    if (a && a.hat >= 0) buttons |= hatDirs(axes[a.hat]);
    if (a?.dpad) buttons |= dpadDirs(axes[a.dpad[0]], axes[a.dpad[1]]);
    const stick = (i: number) => {
      const v = axes[i];
      return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) && Math.abs(v) <= 1.05 ? clamp(v, -1, 1) : 0;
    };
    const trigger = (k: number, i: number, button: number) => {
      const v = axes[i];
      if (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) && v !== 0 && Math.abs(v) <= 1.05) this.live[k] = true;
      return this.live[k] ? clamp((stick(i) + 1) / 2, 0, 1) : pressed[button] ? 1 : 0;
    };
    return { buttons, axes: [stick(a ? a.lx : 0), stick(a ? a.ly : 1), stick(a?.rx ?? -1), stick(a?.ry ?? -1),
      trigger(1, a?.lt ?? -1, L2), trigger(0, a?.rt ?? -1, R2)] };
  }

  /** a short line for the log: where its axes are */
  describe(): string {
    const a = this.at, ax = (i: number) => i >= 0 ? `${i}` : '-';
    const who = `${this.maker === 'Zikway' ? 'a' : 'an'} ${this.maker} controller (${this.face} buttons)`;
    if (!a) return `${who}, its axes not read yet`;
    return `${who}, sticks on axes ${a.lx} ${a.ly} and ${ax(a.rx)} ${ax(a.ry)}, ` +
      `triggers L2 ${ax(a.lt)} R2 ${ax(a.rt)} (or their buttons), D-pad ${a.dpad ? `axes ${a.dpad.join(' and ')}` :
      a.hat >= 0 ? `axis ${a.hat}` : 'none'}`;
  }
}

/**
 * Xbox's One S on Bluetooth with its 2016 firmware (045e 02e0), and the pads that give its id (the AceGamer Aurora2),
 * under Chrome on Android.  Android's own key layout for that id (frameworks/base data/keyboards
 * Vendor_045e_Product_02e0.kl, since 2017) turns its report into the usual key codes already: A, B, X, Y, L1, R1,
 * SELECT, START, THUMBL, THUMBR and MODE, the sticks on X Y and Z RZ, the triggers on LTRIGGER and RTRIGGER (a tester
 * app shows every input right).  Chrome maps it still as if Android had not (GamepadMappings.java
 * XboxOneS2016FirmwareMappings, 16 buttons): X from BUTTON_C, Y from BUTTON_X, LB from BUTTON_Y, RB from BUTTON_Z,
 * View and Menu from L1 and R1, the sticks' buttons from L2 and R2, LT and RT from Z and RZ as (v + 1) / 2 once each
 * read anything but 0, the right stick from RX and RY.  So in its standard mapping X and RB were dead, Y was X, LB Y,
 * View and Menu LB and RB, LT and RT the right stick's X and Y (pushed down: the throttle), and its triggers, View,
 * Menu, the sticks' buttons and Xbox were nowhere (a player's report: LT and RT did nothing, the right stick drove and
 * braked, Y gave nitrous, X changed the camera).  Read here from where Chrome put them: A 0, B 1, X 3, Y 4, LB 8, RB
 * 9, the D-pad 12 to 15, the left stick as it is, the right stick from the triggers' values.  What Chrome never reads
 * no page can have: such a pad has no triggers, View, Menu, stick buttons or Xbox button in the browser (the game's
 * Joypad Configuration can put the throttle and the brake on buttons).  On a big tablet asking for desktop sites Chrome
 * says Linux (gamepad.ts androidLayout); Chrome on a Linux computer maps the id its own way, with 17 buttons.
 */
export function oneS2016Android(g: Pick<Gamepad, 'id' | 'mapping' | 'buttons'>, ua = globalThis.navigator?.userAgent ?? '',
                                touch = globalThis.navigator?.maxTouchPoints ?? 0): boolean {
  if (g.mapping !== 'standard' || g.buttons.length !== 16 || !/\(STANDARD GAMEPAD Vendor: 045e Product: 02e0\)$/i.test(g.id)) return false;
  return /Android/.test(ua) || (/X11; Linux/.test(ua) && touch > 0);
}

// Chrome's places of such a pad's buttons (its standard mapping's index -> the pad's)
const ONE_S_2016: [number, number][] = [[0, PAD_A], [1, PAD_B], [3, PAD_X], [4, PAD_Y], [8, PAD_LB], [9, PAD_RB],
  [12, PAD_DUP], [13, PAD_DDOWN], [14, PAD_DLEFT], [15, PAD_DRIGHT]];

/** Such a pad (oneS2016Android) read as the pad.  The right stick's X and Y come as Chrome's LT and RT values, 0 until
 *  Chrome saw the stick's axis move (then (v + 1) / 2): a value counts once it has read anything but 0, until then the
 *  stick is at rest. */
export class OneS2016Reader {
  private live = [false, false];             // the right stick's X (Chrome's LT), its Y (RT)

  read(axes: readonly number[], buttons: readonly ({ pressed: boolean; value: number } | null | undefined)[]): { buttons: number; axes: number[] } {
    let out = 0;
    for (const [i, b] of ONE_S_2016) { const x = buttons[i]; if (x && (x.pressed || x.value > 0.5)) out |= 1 << b; }
    const stick = (v: unknown) => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? clamp(v, -1, 1) : 0;
    const right = (k: number) => {
      const v = buttons[6 + k]?.value;
      if (typeof v !== 'number' || !isFinite(v)) return 0;
      if (v !== 0) this.live[k] = true;
      return this.live[k] ? clamp(v * 2 - 1, -1, 1) : 0;
    };
    return { buttons: out, axes: [stick(axes[0]), stick(axes[1]), right(0), right(1), 0, 0] };
  }

  /** a short line for the log */
  describe(): string {
    return 'Xbox\'s One S with its 2016 firmware under Chrome on Android: Chrome maps it as if Android had not, so its ' +
      'buttons are read from where Chrome put them and the right stick from its trigger places; its triggers, View, ' +
      'Menu, stick buttons and Xbox button never reach the browser (Throttle and Brake can go on buttons in the game\'s ' +
      'Joypad Configuration)';
  }
}

// Keyboard, mouse, game pads and the app lifecycle for the game, through the
// HostMailbox in shared memory (runtime/web/input_proto.h, input_web.c).
//
// Keys:  KeyboardEvent.code gives the key's position (DirectInput scan code,
//        layout independent) and its Windows virtual-key code; e.key gives
//        the characters the layout typed (WM_CHAR, cp1252).  The C side
//        applies keyboard_mac.m's delivery rules (Alt and SYS messages,
//        autorepeat, keys whose release was lost, keys held through a
//        release, which their next autorepeat presses again).  Every key
//        the game uses has its browser default prevented; Meta combinations
//        stay the browser's, and Meta going down releases every held key
//        because macOS browsers send no keyup for keys released while Cmd
//        is held.
// Mouse: positions relative to the shown image (the C side maps them into
//        the game's client area and HUD), buttons with pointer capture, the
//        wheel in WHEEL_DELTA units.  The OS cursor is hidden over the game.
// Touch: one finger is the mouse, so a tap is a left click (the game's menus
//        take clicks); two are a middle-button drag (the garage turns the
//        car); other fingers are left alone.  Where the first finger lands
//        is marked (IKF_TOUCH): the C side makes the cursor arrive with a
//        move the menus see, also on the spot it already is.
// Text:  the game's text entry while it is up (a seqlock the game writes at
//        each Present), and characters typed with no key (a phone's
//        keyboard, app/textentry.ts) as WM_CHAR.
// Pads:  polled every frame (gamepad.ts), with the page's share (padPage) and
//        the touch controls' virtual controller merged in (touchPad).
// Life:  blur and a hidden page deactivate the game (it parks, as after an
//        alt-tab on Windows) and release everything held (a key still down
//        is pressed again by its next autorepeat); focus and a visible
//        page reactivate it; requestQuit() is WM_CLOSE.  Fullscreen locks the
//        keyboard (navigator.keyboard.lock) so Escape and the browser's
//        reserved shortcuts reach the game; holding Escape leaves fullscreen.
// Use:   lastInput() is when the player last pressed a key, moved or clicked
//        the mouse anywhere on the page, pressed a controller button or moved
//        a stick or trigger (the app's away check, away.ts).
// Test:  the autotest's ns* requests become DOM events (synth.ts).
import type { GameProcess } from '../host/process';
import { HostKind } from '../host/abi';
import { CODES, cp1252, isMeta, keyChars, keyVk, PAGE_CODES } from './keymap';
import { PadPoller, type PadPage, type TouchPad } from './gamepad';
import { SynthDriver } from './synth';
import { AltGrCtrl } from './altgr';
import {
  IEV_FOCUS, IEV_KEY_DOWN, IEV_KEY_TAP, IEV_KEY_UP, IEV_LOG, IEV_MOUSE_DOWN, IEV_MOUSE_MOVE, IEV_MOUSE_UP, IEV_QUIT, IEV_SMS,
  IEV_PHOTO, IEV_NAME, INAME_SEAT2, IEV_LOBBY, IEV_TRAVEL, TRAVEL_FRIEND, IEV_RELEASE_ALL, IEV_TEXT, IEV_WHEEL, IKF_ALT, IKF_CTRL, IKF_DEAD, IKF_REPEAT, IKF_SHIFT, IKF_SYNTH, IKF_TOUCH, IM_ATTACHED,
  IM_EV_DROP, IM_EV_R, IM_EV_W, IM_EVENTS, IM_GAME_INACTIVE, IM_HDR_WORDS, IM_KEYS_HELD, IM_MAGIC, IM_MOUSE_X,
  IM_MOUSE_Y, IM_NAMES_GEN, IM_OFF_EV, IM_OFF_NAMES, IM_OFF_SYN, IM_QUIT_REQ, IM_SYN_R, IM_SYN_W, IM_TEXT,
  IM_TEXT_KIND, IM_TEXT_LEN, IM_TEXT_MAX, IM_TEXT_SEQ, IM_MENU_SCALE, IM_VERSION, IM_VIEW_ROLL, INPUT_EV_N, INPUT_MAGIC, INPUT_NAME_LEN,
  INPUT_SYN_N, INPUT_TEXT_BYTES, INPUT_VERSION, IREASON_ELEMENT, IREASON_FULLSCREEN, IREASON_META, IREASON_PAGE,
  IREASON_PAGEHIDE, IREASON_SCRIPT, IREASON_VISIBILITY, IREASON_WINDOW,
} from './proto';

export interface ViewRect { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }
export interface InputOptions {
  /** the game image inside the element, CSS px relative to its border box (default: all of it) */
  viewRect?: () => ViewRect;
  hideCursor?: boolean;              // default true
  gamepads?: boolean;                // default true
  /** where key events are listened for (default window, capture phase) */
  keyboardTarget?: EventTarget;
  /** the platform's conventions (Cmd/Option, Caps Lock events); default: detected */
  mac?: boolean;
  /** events the page's own UI should keep (default: editable fields, [data-nfsu2-ui], and
   *  anything while a modal dialog is open or aimed inside an open dialog) */
  ignore?: (e: Event) => boolean;
  /** what Cmd-F (macOS) puts in full screen (default: the element) */
  toggleFullscreen?: () => void;
  /** keys whose browser default is kept (default F11, F12) */
  passThrough?: string[];
  /** the page's own use of the controller: its menu and dialogs (gamepad.ts) */
  padPage?: PadPage;
  log?: (s: string) => void;
}
export interface InputStats {
  attached: boolean; events: number; dropped: number; keysHeld: number; gameInactive: boolean;
  quitRequested: boolean; cursor: [number, number]; pad: string | null;
}
/** the numeric counters (the app's overlay contract: names to numbers) */
export interface InputCounters { [k: string]: number; 'input events': number; 'keys held': number; 'pad connected': number }
/** the game's text entry (runtime/web/input_web.c): the most characters it takes, its kind (which characters
 *  besides letters and digits), its text now */
export interface TextEntry { max: number; kind: number; text: string }
export interface InputHandle {
  /** WM_CLOSE to the game.  Before the game's mailbox exists (the first ~0.2 s
   *  after the start) the request waits and is sent when it registers.  false:
   *  it cannot reach the game (detached, or the event ring is not the page's). */
  requestQuit(): boolean;
  /** whether requestQuit() can still reach the game */
  canQuit(): boolean;
  /** Download log: the game writes how long ago it drew its last frame, after a while what every thread is doing,
   *  then "[watchdog] log download ready" (runtime/watchdog.c).  false: it cannot reach the game */
  logReport(): boolean;
  /** a text message of ours for the game's phone (runtime/sms.c), by its number.  false: it cannot reach the game */
  sms(id: number): boolean;
  /** photo mode (runtime/photo.c): what (its PH_* number) and its values.  false: it cannot reach the game */
  photo(what: number, a?: number, b?: number): boolean;
  /** a new name for free roam and Online mode, now (the operator took the old one away: runtime/web/roam_web.c
   *  roam_plat_name), or (seat2) co-op player 2's in free roam (roam_plat_name2).  false: it cannot reach the game */
  name(name: string, seat2?: boolean): boolean;
  /** free roam's race lobby (runtime/roam_game.c mp_act): what (proto.ts LB_*), and for an invite's Join the lobby's
   *  host's id, the lobby's id and its race's hash.  false: it cannot reach the game */
  lobby(what: number, host?: number, lobby?: number, race?: number): boolean;
  /** the page menu's Tracks: a trip to where (runtime/travel.c: 0 the city, 1.. a race track's spot; the game says
   *  in its status's "travel" whether it goes).  false: it cannot reach the game */
  travel(where: number): boolean;
  /** the page menu's Friends, Join: a trip to the friend whose name has this hash (players.ts roomHash), at that spot
   *  (tracks.ts friendSpot, 0 the city; the game says how it went in its status's "travel_said").  false: it cannot
   *  reach the game */
  travelFriend(name: number, spot: number): boolean;
  enterFullscreen(): Promise<boolean>;
  exitFullscreen(): Promise<void>;
  toggleFullscreen(): Promise<void>;
  releaseAll(): void;
  /** everything, for test pages and logs */
  status(): InputStats;
  /** numbers only, for the app's detailed overlay */
  stats(): InputCounters;
  /** performance.now() of the player's last key, mouse or controller input (the attach before any); null
   *  while the game's own driver writes the event ring (an input script without the page's input) */
  lastInput(): number | null;
  /** a key the page presses or lets go for the player (the touch controls), by KeyboardEvent.code; Enter and Escape
   *  also type their characters, as a keyboard's do */
  key(code: string, down: boolean): void;
  /** the touch controls' virtual controller, merged with a real one (null: none) */
  touchPad(t: TouchPad | null): void;
  /** the touch controls' level horizon: the phone's tilt the game's 3D view turns against, radians, + = clockwise */
  viewRoll(rad: number): void;
  /** the menus' small buttons' size, 1 = the game's own (touch.ts: the Menu button size): the scroller arrows', and
   *  with bar the help bar's too (else it keeps the game's own) */
  menuScale(s: number, bar: boolean): void;
  /** performance.now() of a real controller's last button press (0: none) */
  padPressed(): number;
  /** the game's text entry while it is up, else null */
  textEntry(): TextEntry | null;
  /** characters typed with no key (a phone's keyboard), cp1252: WM_CHAR each, 8 deletes, 13 accepts */
  text(chars: number[]): void;
  /** diagnostic: n empty events, each timed from the page's write until the
   *  input thread has handled it (busy-waits on the main thread, max 20 ms each);
   *  returns the times in microseconds */
  probeLatency(n?: number): number[];
  detach(): void;
}

/** what counts as the player's use of keyboard and mouse (lastInput) */
const USE_EVENTS = ['keydown', 'pointerdown', 'pointermove', 'wheel'];

/** the characters a key the page presses types, as a keyboard's does: the game's text fields and some of its prompts
 *  take Enter and Escape only as characters (runtime/dinput_pad.c fe_keys) */
const PAGE_KEY_CHARS: Record<string, number[]> = { Enter: [13], Escape: [27] };

const detectMac = () => {
  const p = (navigator as unknown as { userAgentData?: { platform?: string } }).userAgentData?.platform ?? navigator.platform ?? '';
  return /mac/i.test(p);
};
const detectWindows = () => {
  const p = (navigator as unknown as { userAgentData?: { platform?: string } }).userAgentData?.platform ?? navigator.platform ?? '';
  return /^win/i.test(p);
};
interface KeyboardApi { lock?(codes?: string[]): Promise<void>; unlock?(): void; getLayoutMap?(): Promise<Map<string, string>>;
  addEventListener?(t: string, f: () => void): void }
const keyboardApi = () => (navigator as unknown as { keyboard?: KeyboardApi }).keyboard;

export function attachInput(proc: GameProcess, element: HTMLElement, opts: InputOptions = {}): InputHandle {
  const log = opts.log ?? ((s: string) => console.log(s));
  const mac = opts.mac ?? detectMac();
  const kbTarget = opts.keyboardTarget ?? window;
  const pass = new Set(opts.passThrough ?? ['F11', 'F12']);
  const altGr = new AltGrCtrl(!mac && detectWindows(), log);     // Windows' AltGr: its Left Ctrl kept from the game
  let h: Int32Array | null = null, u8: Uint8Array | null = null, i32: Int32Array | null = null, base = 0;
  let layout: Map<string, string> | null = null;
  let active: boolean | null = null;
  let pads: PadPoller | null = null, synth: SynthDriver | null = null;
  let raf = 0, timer = 0, detached = false;
  const f32 = new Float32Array(1), f32Bits = new Int32Array(f32.buffer);   // a float's bits for a mailbox word
  let menu = 0;                     // the menus' size asked for (0: none; negative: the arrows' alone), written once the mailbox is there
  const putMenu = () => { if (h && !detached && menu) { f32[0] = menu; Atomics.store(h, IM_MENU_SCALE, f32Bits[0]); } };
  // the mailbox was not ours (another writer, another layout): requests cannot reach the game
  let refused = false;
  // quit requests made before the mailbox registered: sent once it does
  let quitPending = 0;
  const dropped = { n: 0 };
  // the game's text entry: the last consistent copy (kept while the game is writing it)
  let textNow: TextEntry | null = null;
  const win1252 = new TextDecoder('windows-1252');
  let lastUse = performance.now();
  const onUse = () => { lastUse = performance.now(); };

  // ---- the event ring -------------------------------------------------------
  function push(type: number, dik = 0, vk = 0, flags = 0, chars: number[] = [], a = 0, b = 0) {
    if (!h || !u8 || !i32) return;
    const w = Atomics.load(h, IM_EV_W), r = Atomics.load(h, IM_EV_R);
    if (((w - r) >>> 0) >= INPUT_EV_N) { Atomics.add(h, IM_EV_DROP, 1); dropped.n++; return; }
    const o = base + IM_OFF_EV + (w & (INPUT_EV_N - 1)) * 16;
    u8[o] = type; u8[o + 1] = dik; u8[o + 2] = vk; u8[o + 3] = flags;
    u8[o + 4] = Math.min(chars.length, 3); u8[o + 5] = chars[0] ?? 0; u8[o + 6] = chars[1] ?? 0; u8[o + 7] = chars[2] ?? 0;
    i32[(o + 8) >>> 2] = a | 0; i32[(o + 12) >>> 2] = b | 0;
    Atomics.store(h, IM_EV_W, (w + 1) | 0);       // publishes the record (a sequentially consistent store)
    Atomics.notify(h, IM_EV_W, 1);
  }
  const setActive = (on: boolean, reason: number) => {
    if (active === on) return;
    active = on;
    push(IEV_FOCUS, 0, 0, 0, [], on ? 1 : 0, reason);
  };

  // ---- keys ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const ignored = (e: Event) => {
    if (opts.ignore) return opts.ignore(e);
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    // a modal dialog (the page's menu, a confirmation) has the keyboard: Tab,
    // Enter, Space and Escape must work its buttons, not drive the game
    if (document.querySelector('dialog[open]:modal')) return true;
    if (!t || !(t instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
    return t.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName) || !!t.closest?.('[data-nfsu2-ui], dialog[open]');
  };
  const flagsOf = (e: KeyboardEvent | MouseEvent) =>
    (e.altKey ? IKF_ALT : 0) | (e.ctrlKey ? IKF_CTRL : 0) | (e.shiftKey ? IKF_SHIFT : 0) | (e.isTrusted ? 0 : IKF_SYNTH);
  const vkOf = (code: string, e: KeyboardEvent, vk: number) => keyVk(code, e, vk, layout);
  const charsOf = (code: string, e: KeyboardEvent) => keyChars(code, e, mac, layout);
  /** the key's code; a modifier's from its key and side where the browser gave it no code of ours (a privacy mode
   *  writes codes from a US table and blanks some: a player's Alt and Shift did nothing in Firefox, 2026-11-05) */
  let codeless = false;
  const codeOf = (e: KeyboardEvent): string => {
    if (CODES[e.code]) return e.code;
    const side = e.location === 2 ? 'Right' : 'Left';
    const c = e.key === 'Shift' ? `Shift${side}` : e.key === 'Control' ? `Control${side}` : e.key === 'Alt' ? `Alt${side}`
      : e.key === 'AltGraph' ? 'AltRight' : '';
    if (c && !codeless) { codeless = true; log(`[input] a key with no code of ours (code "${e.code}", key ${e.key}, side ${e.location}): taken as ${c}`); }
    return c || e.code;
  };
  function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (detached || ignored(e) || e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return;
    if (isMeta(e.code) || e.key === 'Meta') {
      altGr.flush();
      if (!e.repeat) push(IEV_RELEASE_ALL, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_META);
      return;
    }
    if (e.metaKey) {
      // the browser's shortcut, except Cmd-F, which toggled fullscreen in the Mac port
      if (mac && e.code === 'KeyF' && !e.repeat) { e.preventDefault(); if (opts.toggleFullscreen) opts.toggleFullscreen(); else void api.toggleFullscreen(); }
      return;
    }
    const code = codeOf(e), k = CODES[code];
    if (!k) return;
    if (!pass.has(code)) e.preventDefault();
    if (mac && code === 'CapsLock') { push(IEV_KEY_TAP, k.dik, k.vk, flagsOf(e)); return; }
    const { chars, dead, sys } = charsOf(code, e);
    const vk = vkOf(code, e, k.vk), flags = flagsOf(e) | (e.repeat ? IKF_REPEAT : 0) | (dead ? IKF_DEAD : 0);
    altGr.key({ code, key: e.key, repeat: e.repeat }, true, () => push(IEV_KEY_DOWN, k.dik, vk, flags, chars, 0, sys));
  }
  function onKeyUp(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    // every release goes to the game, even one aimed at the page's own UI:
    // the key may have gone down while the game had the keyboard (the C side
    // ignores releases of keys the game does not hold)
    if (detached) return;
    if (isMeta(e.code) || e.key === 'Meta') return;
    const code = codeOf(e), k = CODES[code];
    if (!k) return;
    if (!pass.has(code) && !ignored(e)) e.preventDefault();   // also keeps Alt from opening a menu bar
    if (mac && code === 'CapsLock') { push(IEV_KEY_TAP, k.dik, k.vk, flagsOf(e)); return; }
    const flags = flagsOf(e);
    altGr.key({ code, key: e.key, repeat: e.repeat }, false, () => push(IEV_KEY_UP, k.dik, k.vk, flags));
  }

  // ---- mouse -------------------------------------------------------------------
  let buttons = 0, wheelAcc = 0;
  function pos(e: MouseEvent): [number, number] {
    const rc = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    const v = opts.viewRect?.() ?? { x: 0, y: 0, w: rc.width, h: rc.height };
    const x = (e.clientX - rc.left - v.x) / Math.max(1, v.w), y = (e.clientY - rc.top - v.y) / Math.max(1, v.h);
    return [Math.round(x * 65536), Math.round(y * 65536)];
  }
  function syncButtons(e: PointerEvent | MouseEvent) {
    // DOM buttons mask: 1 left, 2 right, 4 middle, 8 back, 16 forward = DirectInput's 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
    const now = e.buttons & 31;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const bit = 1 << i;
      if ((now & bit) !== (buttons & bit)) push(now & bit ? IEV_MOUSE_DOWN : IEV_MOUSE_UP, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], i);
    }
    buttons = now;
  }
  function onPointerMove(e: PointerEvent) {
    if (detached) return;
    if (e.pointerType === 'touch') { onFingerMove(e); return; }
    const [x, y] = pos(e);
    push(IEV_MOUSE_MOVE, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], x, y);
    if ((e.buttons & 31) !== buttons) syncButtons(e);
  }
  function onPointerDown(e: PointerEvent) {
    if (detached) return;
    if (e.pointerType === 'touch') { onFingerDown(e); return; }
    try { element.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch { /* a synthetic pointer */ }
    const [x, y] = pos(e);
    push(IEV_MOUSE_MOVE, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], x, y);
    syncButtons(e);
    if (document.activeElement !== element && element.tabIndex >= 0) element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  function onPointerUp(e: PointerEvent) {
    if (detached) return;
    if (e.pointerType === 'touch') { onFingerUp(e); return; }
    syncButtons(e);                                        // a release is delivered even outside the image
    try { element.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch { /* not captured */ }
  }

  // ---- touch: one finger is the mouse, two turn the car --------------------------------
  // A tap is a move, a press and a release within a frame or two; the game
  // takes mouse changes one a frame (runtime/web/input_web.c), so it sees the
  // cursor arrive, then the button go down, then up, however slow its frames.
  // A second finger makes the two a middle-button drag, the PC game's way to
  // turn the car in the garage (its only use of that button, 0x4a5d90): the
  // first finger's button goes up, the cursor to the point between them, then
  // the middle button goes down and the cursor follows that point.  When one of
  // the two lifts, the button goes up and no finger is the mouse until all are.
  // Any two fingers make it, whichever came first (iPhones: the second finger's
  // pointerdown can come before the first's, and the car never turned), and the
  // browser keeps no two-finger touch for itself (touchmove's default prevented:
  // Safari's own pinch cancelled the page's pointers, the drag ended at once).
  // A new gesture's first finger forgets what one the browser cancelled unseen
  // left (fingers not heard of for STALE_MS; a fresh one is this gesture's).
  let finger = -1, second = -1, twoAt = 0, twoMoves = 0, twoLogged = 0;
  const fingers = new Map<number, [number, number]>(), heard = new Map<number, number>();
  const STALE_MS = 300;
  const between = (): [number, number] => {
    const a = fingers.get(finger)!, b = fingers.get(second)!;
    return [Math.round((a[0] + b[0]) / 2), Math.round((a[1] + b[1]) / 2)];
  };
  function onFingerDown(e: PointerEvent) {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (e.isPrimary && [...heard.values()].some(t => now - t > STALE_MS)) {
      if (second >= 0) push(IEV_MOUSE_UP, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], 2);
      else if (buttons & 1) push(IEV_MOUSE_UP, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], 0);
      buttons &= ~5; fingers.clear(); heard.clear(); finger = second = -1;
    }
    fingers.set(e.pointerId, pos(e)); heard.set(e.pointerId, now);
    if (second < 0 && fingers.size >= 2) {
      const other = [...fingers.keys()].find(id => id !== e.pointerId)!;
      if (finger < 0) finger = other;
      second = e.pointerId === finger ? other : e.pointerId;
      if (buttons & 1) push(IEV_MOUSE_UP, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], 0);
      push(IEV_MOUSE_MOVE, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], ...between());
      push(IEV_MOUSE_DOWN, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], 2);
      buttons = (buttons & ~1) | 4;
      twoAt = performance.now(); twoMoves = 0;
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    if (!e.isPrimary || finger >= 0) return;
    finger = e.pointerId;
    push(IEV_MOUSE_MOVE, 0, 0, flagsOf(e) | IKF_TOUCH, [], ...pos(e));
    push(IEV_MOUSE_DOWN, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], 0);
    buttons |= 1;
    if (document.activeElement !== element && element.tabIndex >= 0) element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  function onFingerMove(e: PointerEvent) {
    if (!fingers.has(e.pointerId)) return;
    fingers.set(e.pointerId, pos(e)); heard.set(e.pointerId, performance.now());
    if (second >= 0) { if (e.pointerId === finger || e.pointerId === second) { push(IEV_MOUSE_MOVE, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], ...between()); twoMoves++; } }
    else if (e.pointerId === finger) push(IEV_MOUSE_MOVE, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], ...pos(e));
  }
  function onFingerUp(e: PointerEvent) {
    fingers.delete(e.pointerId); heard.delete(e.pointerId);
    if (second >= 0 && (e.pointerId === finger || e.pointerId === second)) {
      finger = second = -1;
      push(IEV_MOUSE_UP, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], 2);
      buttons &= ~4;
      if (twoLogged < 5) {
        twoLogged++;
        log(`[touch] a two-finger turn: ${twoMoves} moves, ended by ${e.type === 'pointercancel' ? 'the browser (pointercancel)' : 'a finger lifted'} after ${Math.round(performance.now() - twoAt)} ms`);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.pointerId !== finger) return;
    finger = -1;
    push(IEV_MOUSE_UP, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], 0);
    buttons &= ~1;
  }
  function onWheel(e: WheelEvent) {
    if (detached) return;
    e.preventDefault();                                    // no page scroll or Ctrl+wheel zoom
    const lines = e.deltaMode === 1 ? e.deltaY : e.deltaMode === 2 ? e.deltaY * 3 : e.deltaY / 100;
    wheelAcc += -lines * 120;                              // + = away from the user, as WM_MOUSEWHEEL
    const dz = Math.trunc(wheelAcc);
    wheelAcc -= dz;
    if (dz) push(IEV_WHEEL, 0, 0, flagsOf(e), [], dz);
  }
  const onContextMenu = (e: Event) => e.preventDefault();

  // ---- lifecycle -------------------------------------------------------------------
  const onBlur = () => setActive(false, IREASON_WINDOW);
  const onFocus = () => { if (!document.hidden) setActive(true, IREASON_WINDOW); };
  const onVisibility = () => {
    if (document.hidden) setActive(false, IREASON_VISIBILITY);
    else if (document.hasFocus()) setActive(true, IREASON_VISIBILITY);
  };
  const onPageHide = () => push(IEV_RELEASE_ALL, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_PAGEHIDE);
  const onElementBlur = () => push(IEV_RELEASE_ALL, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_ELEMENT);
  const onFullscreen = () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement) return;
    // leaving fullscreen (a held Escape, the browser's own key) can swallow key ups
    push(IEV_RELEASE_ALL, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_FULLSCREEN);
    keyboardApi()?.unlock?.();
  };

  // ---- key names of the layout (the Controls page) -----------------------------
  async function loadLayout() {
    try { layout = (await keyboardApi()?.getLayoutMap?.()) ?? null; } catch { layout = null; }
    if (!h || !u8) return;
    const names: string[] = [];
    if (layout) for (const [code, ch] of layout) {
      const k = CODES[code];
      if (!k || ch.length !== 1 || ch.charCodeAt(0) < 0x21) continue;
      names[k.dik] = ch.toUpperCase().length === 1 ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch;
    }
    if (!mac) Object.assign(names, { 0x38: 'Alt', 0xB8: 'Right Alt', 0xDB: 'Windows', 0xDC: 'Right Windows', 0x45: 'Num Lock' });
    for (let dik = 0; dik < 256; dik++) {
      const s = names[dik] ?? '', o = base + IM_OFF_NAMES + dik * INPUT_NAME_LEN;
      let n = 0;
      for (const c of s) { const b = cp1252(c.codePointAt(0)!); if (n >= INPUT_NAME_LEN - 1) break; u8[o + n++] = b > 0 ? b : 0x3F; }
      u8[o + n] = 0;
    }
    Atomics.add(h, IM_NAMES_GEN, 1);
  }

  // ---- synthetic requests and pad polling, every frame -----------------------------
  let synF32: Float32Array | null = null;
  function drainSynth() {
    if (!h || !u8 || !synth) return;
    let r = Atomics.load(h, IM_SYN_R);
    const w = Atomics.load(h, IM_SYN_W);
    const f32 = synF32 ??= new Float32Array(u8.buffer, base + IM_OFF_SYN, INPUT_SYN_N * 4);
    while (r !== w) {
      const o = base + IM_OFF_SYN + (r & (INPUT_SYN_N - 1)) * 16, fo = (o - base - IM_OFF_SYN) >> 2;
      const q = { type: u8[o], dik: u8[o + 1], mods: u8[o + 2], ch: i32![(o + 4) >> 2] >>> 0, a: f32[fo + 2], b: f32[fo + 3] };
      r = (r + 1) | 0;
      Atomics.store(h, IM_SYN_R, r);
      try { synth.handle(q); } catch (x) { log(`[input] synthetic event failed: ${x}`); }
    }
  }
  const frame = () => { if (detached) return; pads?.poll(); drainSynth(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); };
  const tick = () => { drainSynth(); if (document.hidden) pads?.poll(); };

  // ---- fullscreen and quit -------------------------------------------------------------
  const api: InputHandle = {
    requestQuit() {
      if (!api.canQuit()) return false;
      if (h) push(IEV_QUIT, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_PAGE);
      else { quitPending++; log('[input] quit requested before the game\'s input is up: sent when it is'); }
      return true;
    },
    canQuit() { return !detached && !refused; },
    logReport() {
      if (!h || !api.canQuit()) return false;
      push(IEV_LOG, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_PAGE);
      return true;
    },
    sms(id) {
      if (!h || !api.canQuit()) return false;
      push(IEV_SMS, 0, 0, 0, [], id, IREASON_PAGE);
      return true;
    },
    photo(what, a = 0, b = 0) {
      if (!h || !api.canQuit()) return false;
      push(IEV_PHOTO, what, 0, 0, [], a, b);
      return true;
    },
    name(name, seat2 = false) {
      if (!h || !api.canQuit()) return false;
      // its printable ASCII (Your name's own rule), in pieces of 11 bytes: three chars, then a and b (little-endian)
      const b = [...name].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0)).filter(c => c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f).slice(0, 32);
      if (!b.length) return false;
      for (let off = 0; off < b.length; off += 11) {
        const p = b.slice(off, off + 11);
        while (p.length < 11) p.push(0);
        const le = (i: number) => p[i] | p[i + 1] << 8 | p[i + 2] << 16 | p[i + 3] << 24;
        push(IEV_NAME, off, b.length, seat2 ? INAME_SEAT2 : 0, p.slice(0, 3), le(3), le(7));
      }
      return true;
    },
    lobby(what, host = 0, lobby = 0, race = 0) {
      if (!h || !api.canQuit()) return false;
      push(IEV_LOBBY, what, race & 0xff, (race >>> 8) & 0xff, [(race >>> 16) & 0xff, (race >>> 24) & 0xff], host, lobby);
      return true;
    },
    travel(where) {
      if (!h || !api.canQuit()) return false;
      push(IEV_TRAVEL, where, 0, 0, [], 0, 0);
      return true;
    },
    travelFriend(name, spot) {
      if (!h || !api.canQuit()) return false;
      push(IEV_TRAVEL, TRAVEL_FRIEND, 0, 0, [], name | 0, spot);
      return true;
    },
    async enterFullscreen() {
      try {
        if (document.fullscreenElement !== element) await element.requestFullscreen({ navigationUI: 'hide' });
        // all keys: Escape and the browser's reserved shortcuts (Ctrl+W, Alt+Tab ...)
        // reach the game; holding Escape leaves fullscreen
        try { await keyboardApi()?.lock?.(); } catch (e) { log(`[input] keyboard lock refused: ${e}`); }
        return true;
      } catch (e) { log(`[input] fullscreen refused: ${e}`); return false; }
    },
    async exitFullscreen() { keyboardApi()?.unlock?.(); if (document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen(); },
    async toggleFullscreen() { if (document.fullscreenElement) await api.exitFullscreen(); else await api.enterFullscreen(); },
    releaseAll() { push(IEV_RELEASE_ALL, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_PAGE); },
    probeLatency(n = 20) {
      const res: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n && h; i++) {
        const before = Atomics.load(h, IM_EVENTS), t0 = performance.now();
        push(0);                                          // an event type the input thread ignores
        while (Atomics.load(h, IM_EVENTS) === before && performance.now() - t0 < 20) { /* spin */ }
        res.push(Math.round((performance.now() - t0) * 1000));
      }
      return res;
    },
    status(): InputStats {
      const z = (i: number) => (h ? Atomics.load(h, i) >>> 0 : 0);
      return { attached: !!h, events: z(IM_EVENTS), dropped: dropped.n, keysHeld: z(IM_KEYS_HELD), gameInactive: !!z(IM_GAME_INACTIVE),
        quitRequested: !!z(IM_QUIT_REQ), cursor: [z(IM_MOUSE_X) | 0, z(IM_MOUSE_Y) | 0], pad: pads?.current() ?? null };
    },
    stats(): InputCounters {
      const s = api.status();
      return { 'input events': s.events, 'keys held': s.keysHeld, 'pad connected': s.pad ? 1 : 0, 'input dropped': s.dropped };
    },
    lastInput() { return refused ? null : lastUse; },
    key(code, down) {
      const k = CODES[code] ?? PAGE_CODES[code];
      if (k && !detached) push(down ? IEV_KEY_DOWN : IEV_KEY_UP, k.dik, k.vk, 0, down ? PAGE_KEY_CHARS[code] ?? [] : []);
    },
    touchPad(t) { pads?.setTouch(t); },
    viewRoll(rad) { if (h && !detached) { f32[0] = rad; Atomics.store(h, IM_VIEW_ROLL, f32Bits[0]); } },
    menuScale(s, bar) { menu = bar ? s : -s; putMenu(); },
    padPressed() { return pads?.lastPress ?? 0; },
    textEntry() {
      if (!h || !u8) return null;
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 4; tries++) {
        const s0 = Atomics.load(h, IM_TEXT_SEQ);
        if (s0 & 1) continue;
        const max = Atomics.load(h, IM_TEXT_MAX), kind = Atomics.load(h, IM_TEXT_KIND);
        const len = Math.min(Atomics.load(h, IM_TEXT_LEN), INPUT_TEXT_BYTES), o = base + IM_TEXT * 4;
        const bytes = u8.slice(o, o + len);
        if (Atomics.load(h, IM_TEXT_SEQ) !== s0) continue;
        textNow = max > 0 ? { max, kind, text: win1252.decode(bytes) } : null;
        break;
      }
      return textNow;
    },
    text(chars) {
      if (detached) return;
      for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i += 3) push(IEV_TEXT, 0, 0, 0, chars.slice(i, i + 3));
    },
    detach() {
      if (detached) return;
      // whatever the game holds is let go (it may outlive the page's input, e.g. a test page)
      push(IEV_RELEASE_ALL, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_PAGE);
      api.viewRoll(0);
      if (h) Atomics.compareExchange(h, IM_ATTACHED, 1, 0);   // only our own claim (2 = the C ns* driver)
      detached = true; quitPending = 0; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); clearInterval(timer); altGr.cancel();
      pads?.dispose(); pads = null; synth = null;
      h = null; u8 = null; i32 = null; synF32 = null;     // no view of the old process's memory stays reachable
      kbTarget.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown as EventListener, { capture: true });
      kbTarget.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp as EventListener, { capture: true });
      for (const [t, f] of listeners) element.removeEventListener(t, f);
      removeEventListener('blur', onBlur); removeEventListener('focus', onFocus); removeEventListener('pagehide', onPageHide);
      for (const t of USE_EVENTS) removeEventListener(t, onUse, { capture: true });
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
      document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFullscreen);
      (keyboardApi() as { removeEventListener?(t: string, f: () => void): void } | undefined)?.removeEventListener?.('layoutchange', onLayout);
    },
  };

  kbTarget.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown as EventListener, { capture: true });
  kbTarget.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp as EventListener, { capture: true });
  const listeners: [string, EventListener][] = [
    ['pointermove', onPointerMove as EventListener], ['pointerdown', onPointerDown as EventListener],
    ['pointerup', onPointerUp as EventListener], ['pointercancel', onPointerUp as EventListener],
    ['contextmenu', onContextMenu], ['blur', onElementBlur],
  ];
  for (const [t, f] of listeners) element.addEventListener(t, f);
  element.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
  listeners.push(['wheel', onWheel as EventListener]);
  // two fingers on the game are the page's (the garage's turn): not the browser's pinch or pan
  const onTwoTouch = (e: TouchEvent) => { if (e.touches.length >= 2 && e.cancelable) e.preventDefault(); };
  for (const t of ['touchstart', 'touchmove']) { element.addEventListener(t, onTwoTouch as EventListener, { passive: false }); listeners.push([t, onTwoTouch as EventListener]); }
  addEventListener('blur', onBlur); addEventListener('focus', onFocus); addEventListener('pagehide', onPageHide);
  // the page's own menus and dialogs count too: the player is there
  for (const t of USE_EVENTS) addEventListener(t, onUse, { capture: true, passive: true });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFullscreen);
  const onLayout = () => void loadLayout();
  keyboardApi()?.addEventListener?.('layoutchange', onLayout);
  if (opts.hideCursor ?? true) element.style.cursor = 'none';
  element.style.touchAction = 'none';

  proc.registered(HostKind.Input).then(reg => {
    if (detached) return;      // detached before the game registered its mailbox
    const buf = proc.memory.buffer as unknown as SharedArrayBuffer;
    const view = new Int32Array(buf, reg.ptr, IM_HDR_WORDS);
    const unquittable = () => { if (quitPending) log('[input] the quit request cannot reach the game'); quitPending = 0; };
    if (view[IM_MAGIC] !== INPUT_MAGIC || view[IM_VERSION] !== INPUT_VERSION) {
      log(`[input] mailbox at 0x${reg.ptr.toString(16)}: magic 0x${(view[IM_MAGIC] >>> 0).toString(16)} version ${view[IM_VERSION]}, not ours: no input`);
      refused = true; unquittable();
      return;
    }
    // the event ring has one writer: the page, unless the game's own driver
    // for the autotest's ns* input claimed it first (input_web.c: no page input)
    const owner = Atomics.compareExchange(view, IM_ATTACHED, 0, 1);
    if (owner !== 0) {
      log(`[input] the event ring is already written by ${owner === 2 ? 'the game (ns* input)' : 'another page'}: no page input`);
      refused = true; unquittable();
      return;
    }
    h = view; u8 = new Uint8Array(buf); i32 = new Int32Array(buf); base = reg.ptr;
    putMenu();
    synth = new SynthDriver({
      element, mac, layout: () => layout, log,
      // nsfocus: the page's blur/focus path, sent even if the page state already matches
      focus: (on) => { active = on; push(IEV_FOCUS, 0, 0, 0, [], on ? 1 : 0, IREASON_SCRIPT); },
    });
    if (opts.gamepads ?? true)
      pads = new PadPoller(h, u8, base, () => dispatchEvent(new Event('nfsu2-gesture')), log, onUse, opts.padPage);
    void loadLayout();
    // the game starts active (CreateWindowEx posts the activation): tell it
    // if the page is not
    active = true;
    if (document.hidden) setActive(false, IREASON_VISIBILITY);
    else if (!document.hasFocus()) setActive(false, IREASON_WINDOW);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    timer = setInterval(tick, 4) as unknown as number;
    log(`[input] attached: mailbox 0x${reg.ptr.toString(16)}, ${mac ? 'macOS' : 'Windows/Linux'} key conventions, ` +
        `page ${document.hidden ? 'hidden' : 'visible'}, ${document.hasFocus() ? 'focused' : 'not focused'}`);
    if (quitPending) log(`[input] sending the quit request${quitPending > 1 ? `s (${quitPending})` : ''} made before the game's input was up`);
    for (; quitPending > 0; quitPending--) push(IEV_QUIT, 0, 0, 0, [], 0, IREASON_PAGE);
  });
  return api;
}

/** the touch controls' Drift and Horn (app/touch.ts, through the input layer's key()): keys no keyboard has and the

 *  horn.c DIK_TOUCH_*); no window message (vk 0) */

/** the first code of every DIK, for synthetic events */

export const isMeta = (code: string) => code === 'MetaLeft' || code === 'MetaRight' || code === 'OSLeft' || code === 'OSRight';
export const isLetterCode = (code: string) => code.length === 4 && code.startsWith('Key');

/** Unicode -> Windows code page 1252, -1 if it has no place there */
export function cp1252(u: number): number {
  if (u < 0x80 || (u >= 0xA0 && u <= 0xFF)) return u;
  const hi = [0x20AC, 0, 0x201A, 0x0192, 0x201E, 0x2026, 0x2020, 0x2021, 0x02C6, 0x2030, 0x0160, 0x2039,
    0x0152, 0, 0x017D, 0, 0, 0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201C, 0x201D, 0x2022, 0x2013, 0x2014, 0x02DC,
    0x2122, 0x0161, 0x203A, 0x0153, 0, 0x017E, 0x0178];
  const i = hi.indexOf(u);
  return i >= 0 && u !== 0 ? 0x80 + i : -1;
}

// US layout: [plain, shifted] characters
export const US: Record<string, [string, string]> = {

  Quote: ["'", '"'], Comma: [',', '<'], Period: ['.', '>'], Slash: ['/', '?'], Space: [' ', ' '], IntlBackslash: ['§', '±'],
};

/** KeyboardEvent.key for a synthetic event on code, given the modifiers;
 *  layout: navigator.keyboard.getLayoutMap() when the browser has it */
export function keyFor(code: string, shift: boolean, caps: boolean, mac: boolean, layout: Map<string, string> | null): string {
  if (NAMED[code]) return NAMED[code];
  if (/^F\d+$/.test(code)) return code;
  if (NUMPAD[code]) return NUMPAD[code];
  const base = layout?.get(code) ?? US[code]?.[0];
  if (base === undefined) return 'Unidentified';
  if (isLetterCode(code) && base.length === 1 && base.toLowerCase() !== base.toUpperCase()) {
    // macOS: Caps Lock gives capitals with or without Shift; Windows inverts
    const upper = mac ? shift || caps : shift !== caps;
    return upper ? base.toUpperCase() : base.toLowerCase();
  }
  if (!shift) return base;
  return layout?.has(code) && layout.get(code) !== US[code]?.[0] ? base.toUpperCase() : US[code]?.[1] ?? base;
}

/** what index.ts needs of a KeyboardEvent (a plain object in the unit tests) */
export interface KeyEventLike {
  key: string; ctrlKey: boolean; altKey: boolean; metaKey: boolean;
  getModifierState(k: string): boolean;
}

/** the key's own (unshifted) character on the layout, '' for a named key */
export function baseChar(code: string, e: KeyEventLike, layout: Map<string, string> | null): string {
  return layout?.get(code) ?? US[code]?.[0] ?? (e.key.length === 1 ? e.key.toLowerCase() : '');
}

/** the Windows virtual-key code: letters follow the layout (AZERTY's A key gives VK_A), as on Windows */
export function keyVk(code: string, e: KeyEventLike, vk: number, layout: Map<string, string> | null): number {
  if (!isLetterCode(code)) return vk;
  const b = baseChar(code, e, layout), u = b.toUpperCase();
  if (u.length === 1 && u >= 'A' && u <= 'Z') return u.charCodeAt(0);
  return ({ ',': 0xBC, '.': 0xBE, '-': 0xBD, ';': 0xBA } as Record<string, number>)[b] ?? vk;
}

/**
 * WM_CHAR bytes for a key down; sys = the plain character for WM_SYSCHAR when
 * Alt makes it a command.  runtime/web/input_web.c (cs_key) does the same for
 * the autotest's keys on a page without this layer, for synthetic events on
 * the US layout with macOS rules (web/test/input-chars.test.mjs compares them).
 */
export function keyChars(code: string, e: KeyEventLike, mac: boolean, layout: Map<string, string> | null):
    { chars: number[]; dead: boolean; sys: number } {
  switch (code) {
    case 'Enter': case 'NumpadEnter': return { chars: [0x0D], dead: false, sys: 0 };
    case 'Backspace': return { chars: [0x08], dead: false, sys: 0 };
    case 'Escape': return { chars: [0x1B], dead: false, sys: 0 };
    case 'Tab': return { chars: [0x09], dead: false, sys: 0 };
  }
  if (e.key === 'Dead') return { chars: [0x3F], dead: true, sys: 0 };       // the spacing character is not exposed
  const cps = [...e.key];
  if (cps.length !== 1 || e.metaKey) return { chars: [], dead: false, sys: 0 };
  const altGr = e.getModifierState('AltGraph');
  const plain = baseChar(code, e, layout);
  const sysc = plain.length === 1 ? Math.max(0, cp1252(plain.codePointAt(0)!)) : 0;
  if (e.ctrlKey && !altGr && !e.altKey) {
    // Ctrl+letter types a control character, as TranslateMessage does
    const u = e.key.toUpperCase();
    return { chars: u.length === 1 && u >= 'A' && u <= 'Z' ? [u.charCodeAt(0) - 0x40] : [], dead: false, sys: 0 };
  }
  if (e.altKey && !altGr && !e.ctrlKey) {
    // Windows/Linux: Alt+key is a command (WM_SYSKEYDOWN + WM_SYSCHAR).  macOS:
    // Option+key that types something else than the key's own character is text
    if (!mac || e.key === plain || e.key === plain.toUpperCase()) return { chars: [], dead: false, sys: sysc };
  }
  const c = cp1252(cps[0].codePointAt(0)!);
  return { chars: [c >= 0 ? c : 0x3F], dead: false, sys: sysc };
}

/** the key (and Shift) that types ch, for nstype; null if none on this layout */
export function strokeFor(ch: string, layout: Map<string, string> | null): { code: string; shift: boolean } | null {
  switch (ch) {
    case '\r': case '\n': return { code: 'Enter', shift: false };
    case '\b': return { code: 'Backspace', shift: false };
    case '\t': return { code: 'Tab', shift: false };
    case '\x1b': return { code: 'Escape', shift: false };
  }
  const codes = Object.keys(US);
  for (const code of codes) {
    const base = layout?.get(code) ?? US[code][0];
    if (base === ch) return { code, shift: false };
  }
  for (const code of codes) {
    const base = layout?.get(code) ?? US[code][0];
    const shifted = isLetterCode(code) ? base.toUpperCase() : layout?.has(code) && base !== US[code][0] ? base.toUpperCase() : US[code][1];
    if (shifted === ch) return { code, shift: true };
  }
  return null;
}

// Shared-engine split-screen input. Each physical pad owns at most one seat.
// START claims a seat; disconnecting preserves its place until a controller
// explicitly claims it. Joining buttons must be released before driving.
import type { PadSnapshot } from './gamepad';
import {
  INPUT_LOCAL_PADS, IM_LOCAL_WORDS, IM_OFF_LOCAL_PADS, IM_LOCAL_SEQ, IM_LOCAL_CONNECTED,
  IM_LOCAL_BUTTONS, IM_LOCAL_FAMILY, IM_LOCAL_AXIS, IM_LOCAL_NAME, IM_LOCAL_INDEX, IM_LOCAL_JOIN, IM_LOCAL_COOP,
} from './proto';

type Owner = { index: number; id: string; waiting: boolean };
export class LocalSeats {
  owners: (Owner | null)[] = Array.from({ length: INPUT_LOCAL_PADS }, () => null);
  private starts = new Map<number, { id: string; down: boolean }>();
  readonly joins = Array(INPUT_LOCAL_PADS).fill(0);

  poll(pads: readonly (Gamepad | null)[]): (Gamepad | null)[] {
    const live = pads.filter((g): g is Gamepad => !!g?.connected && g.mapping === 'standard');
    const present = (o: Owner | null) => o && live.find(g => g.index === o.index && g.id === o.id);
    for (const g of live) {
      const down = !!g.buttons[9]?.pressed || (g.buttons[9]?.value ?? 0) > 0.5;
      const was = this.starts.get(g.index);
      if (down && !(was?.id === g.id && was.down)) {
        let seat = this.owners.findIndex(o => o?.index === g.index && o.id === g.id);
        if (seat < 0) {
          seat = this.owners.findIndex(o => !present(o));
          if (seat >= 0) this.owners[seat] = { index: g.index, id: g.id, waiting: true };
        }
        if (seat >= 0) this.joins[seat] = (this.joins[seat] + 1) >>> 0;
      }
      this.starts.set(g.index, { id: g.id, down });
    }
    for (const index of this.starts.keys()) if (!live.some(g => g.index === index)) this.starts.delete(index);
    return this.owners.map(o => {
      const g = present(o);
      if (!o || !g) { if (o) o.waiting = true; return null; }
      if (o.waiting) {
        if (g.buttons.some(b => b.pressed || b.value > 0.5)) return null;
        o.waiting = false;
      }
      return g;
    });
  }
}

/** One record per seat in the SAME game's shared memory, not six processes. */
export class LocalPadWriter {
  private seats = new LocalSeats();
  private words: Int32Array;
  private bits = new Float32Array(1);
  private ints = new Int32Array(this.bits.buffer);
  constructor(buffer: SharedArrayBuffer | ArrayBuffer, base: number) {
    this.words = new Int32Array(buffer, base + IM_OFF_LOCAL_PADS, INPUT_LOCAL_PADS * IM_LOCAL_WORDS);
  }
  /** the controllers (Gamepad.index) the game keeps for co-op free roam's player 2: they drive nothing else */
  reserved(): Set<number> {
    const out = new Set<number>();
    this.seats.owners.forEach((o, seat) => { if (o && Atomics.load(this.words, seat * IM_LOCAL_WORDS + IM_LOCAL_COOP) === 1) out.add(o.index); });
    return out;
  }
  poll(pads: readonly (Gamepad | null)[], read: (g: Gamepad) => PadSnapshot, muted = false) {
    this.seats.poll(pads).forEach((g, seat) => {
      const state = g && !muted ? read(g) : null;
      const at = seat * IM_LOCAL_WORDS, w = this.words;
      const seq = Atomics.load(w, at + IM_LOCAL_SEQ);
      Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_SEQ, (seq + 1) | 0);
      Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_CONNECTED, state ? 1 : 0);
      Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_BUTTONS, state?.buttons ?? 0);
      Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_FAMILY, state?.family ?? 0);
      Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_INDEX, g?.index ?? -1);
      Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_JOIN, this.seats.joins[seat]);
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        this.bits[0] = state?.axes[i] ?? 0;
        Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_AXIS + i, this.ints[0]);
      }
      const name = (state?.name ?? '').slice(0, 63);
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        let value = 0;
        for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) value |= ((name.charCodeAt(i * 4 + b) || 0) & 255) << (b * 8);
        Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_NAME + i, value);
      }
      Atomics.store(w, at + IM_LOCAL_SEQ, (seq + 2) | 0);
    });
  }
}

// Valve's controllers read from the controller itself through WebHID, for the game's virtual pad (gamepad.ts): the
// Steam Controller of 2015 (on its cable or through its dongle), the Steam Controller of 2026 (on its cable, over
// Bluetooth or through its dongles) and a Steam Deck's own controls.
//
// None of them is a gamepad to the browsers.  Left alone each acts as a mouse and a keyboard ("lizard mode": a pad
// moves the pointer, the buttons are Enter, Esc and arrow keys), and its controls come in Valve's own reports on an
// interface of its own, which the Gamepad API never lists: the page saw no controller unless Steam made one of it
// (Steam Input's gamepad layout, a virtual Xbox pad).  Chrome and Edge open such an interface through WebHID once the
// player picked the controller in the browser's list (connectSteamPad, from a click: the Controls sheet's), and on
// later visits without asking (navigator.hid.getDevices).  While the game runs (useSteamPads: the PadPoller's) the
// page opens them; while the game also has the page visible and focused, lizard mode is off and each controller is a
// Gamepad with the standard mapping, at index 16 and up beside the browser's own (allPads), which gamepad.ts reads as
// it reads any other.  Without the focus, or once the game ends, lizard mode comes back, so the controller is a mouse
// on the desktop again: the 2015 controller is told so, the others bring it back themselves a few seconds after the
// page stops telling them to keep it off (their firmware's watchdog).
//
// The reports and the commands are SDL's (zlib licence: src/joystick/hidapi/SDL_hidapi_steam.c, SDL_hidapi_steamdeck.c,
// SDL_hidapi_steam_triton.c, steam/controller_structs.h and controller_constants.h), as are the buttons' places:
// Valve labels A, B, X and Y as Xbox does.  The 2015 controller has one stick: its right pad is the right stick (where
// the thumb touches it, as SDL has it), the left pad's click the D-pad, its grips extra buttons.  The Deck's and the
// 2026 controller's pads do nothing here; their back buttons and the "..." button come after the standard mapping's,
// for the page alone (the game's pad has none of them).  Rumble: the Deck's and the 2026 controller's motors (the 2015
// controller's pads only click, SDL leaves them be: no rumble).  Not read: the 2015 controller over Bluetooth (its
// reports come in pieces), gyros, the pads' touch.

/** a WebHID device, as much of it as this file uses (TypeScript's DOM types have none) */

  readonly productName: string;

  sendFeatureReport(reportId: number, data: BufferSource): Promise<void>;
  receiveFeatureReport(reportId: number): Promise<DataView>;
}
interface HidReportEvent extends Event { readonly reportId: number; readonly data: DataView }
interface HidConnectionEvent extends Event { readonly device: HidDevice }
interface Hid extends EventTarget {
  getDevices(): Promise<HidDevice[]>;
  requestDevice(o: { filters: { vendorId: number; productId?: number }[] }): Promise<HidDevice[]>;
}
const hid = (): Hid | null => (globalThis.navigator as unknown as { hid?: Hid } | undefined)?.hid ?? null;

/** a controller's Gamepad.id, written as Chrome writes a gamepad's (gamepad.ts familyOf and wheel.ts usbIds read it) */

/** a button's place in Gamepad.buttons: the standard mapping's, then Valve's extras (the 2015 controller's grips are
 *  L4 and R4, the back buttons the others) */
export const SB = { A: 0, B: 1, X: 2, Y: 3, LB: 4, RB: 5, LT: 6, RT: 7, BACK: 8, START: 9, LS: 10, RS: 11, UP: 12, DOWN: 13,
  LEFT: 14, RIGHT: 15, HOME: 16, L4: 17, R4: 18, L5: 19, R5: 20, QAM: 21 } as const;

/** a trigger counts as pressed past this (Chrome's threshold for an analog button) */
const PRESSED = 30 / 255;

/** a controller's state as the standard mapping has it: buttons as 1 << SB.*, the sticks -1..1 with +y down, the
 *  triggers 0..1 */
export interface SteamState { buttons: number; lx: number; ly: number; rx: number; ry: number; lt: number; rt: number }
/** what a report said: the state, or that a dongle's controller came ('on') or went ('off') */
export type SteamReport = SteamState | 'on' | 'off' | null;

const axis = (v: number) => v <= -32767 ? -1 : v >= 32767 ? 1 : v / 32767;
const unit = (v: number) => v <= 0 ? 0 : v >= 1 ? 1 : v;
/** bits of a controller's report -> 1 << SB.* */
const mapBits = (m: number, table: readonly (readonly [number, number])[]) => {
  let b = 0;
  for (const [bit, to] of table) if (m & bit) b |= 1 << to;
  return b;
};
/** a trigger's button: pressed past PRESSED or clicked all the way */
const triggerBits = (lt: number, rt: number, lclick: boolean, rclick: boolean) =>
  (lclick || lt > PRESSED ? 1 << SB.LT : 0) | (rclick || rt > PRESSED ? 1 << SB.RT : 0);

// ---- the Steam Controller of 2015 ("D0G"): 64-byte reports, no report id

const D0G = {
  RT: 0x1, LT: 0x2, RB: 0x4, LB: 0x8, Y: 0x10, B: 0x20, X: 0x40, A: 0x80, UP: 0x100, RIGHT: 0x200, LEFT: 0x400, DOWN: 0x800,
  MENU: 0x1000, STEAM: 0x2000, ESCAPE: 0x4000, GRIP_L: 0x8000, GRIP_R: 0x10000, LPAD_CLICK: 0x20000, RPAD_CLICK: 0x40000,
  LPAD_TOUCH: 0x80000, RPAD_TOUCH: 0x100000, STICK_CLICK: 0x400000, LPAD_AND_STICK: 0x800000,
} as const;
