// A local stand-in for Cloudflare's proxy in front of the server, for tests
// only (nothing here opens anything to the internet; it listens on 127.0.0.1):
//   browser --TLS--> this proxy --HTTP--> the server --behind-proxy (127.0.0.1)
// It does what the edge does to a request and a response that matter here:
//   - terminates TLS with a test certificate (makeTestCerts)
//   - sets CF-Connecting-IP to the client (replacing whatever the client
//     sent), appends it to X-Forwarded-For, sets X-Forwarded-Proto, CF-Visitor,
//     CF-Ray, CF-IPCountry, and keeps the Host the browser asked for
//   - passes WebSocket upgrades through, and cuts a WebSocket that stays
//     quiet in both directions for wsIdleMs (Cloudflare: about 100 s)
//   - adds a Server: cloudflare header and CF-Ray to responses
// fakeClientIp: the address it reports as the client's (the tests run on one
// machine, where every client is 127.0.0.1).
//
//   node web/test/cf-sim.mjs --port 8527 --target 8627 --dir <cert dir> [--fake-client-ip 198.51.100.7] [--ws-idle-ms 100000]
import http from 'node:http';
import https from 'node:https';
import net from 'node:net';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ssl = (args) => execFileSync('openssl', args, { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });

/**
 * A test CA and a server certificate for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and nfsu2.test,
 * made once in dir.  Returns paths, the PEMs and the SPKI hash Chrome's
 * --ignore-certificate-errors-spki-list takes.
 */
export function makeTestCerts(dir) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const f = n => path.join(dir, n);
  if (!fs.existsSync(f('server.crt'))) {
    ssl(['req', '-x509', '-newkey', 'ec', '-pkeyopt', 'ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1', '-nodes', '-keyout', f('ca.key'), '-out', f('ca.crt'),
      '-days', '30', '-subj', '/CN=NFSU2 deploy test CA', '-addext', 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0', '-addext', 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign']);
    fs.writeFileSync(f('server.ext'), 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,DNS:nfsu2.test,IP:127.0.0.1\nbasicConstraints=CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n');
    ssl(['req', '-newkey', 'ec', '-pkeyopt', 'ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1', '-nodes', '-keyout', f('server.key'), '-out', f('server.csr'), '-subj', '/CN=nfsu2.test']);
    ssl(['x509', '-req', '-in', f('server.csr'), '-CA', f('ca.crt'), '-CAkey', f('ca.key'), '-CAcreateserial', '-out', f('server.crt'), '-days', '30', '-extfile', f('server.ext')]);
    // the chain a server sends: leaf, then the CA
    fs.writeFileSync(f('chain.crt'), fs.readFileSync(f('server.crt')) + fs.readFileSync(f('ca.crt')));
  }
  const spki = (crt) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(new crypto.X509Certificate(fs.readFileSync(crt)).publicKey.export({ type: 'spki', format: 'der' })).digest('base64');
  return { dir, ca: f('ca.crt'), cert: f('chain.crt'), key: f('server.key'), caPem: fs.readFileSync(f('ca.crt')),
    spki: [spki(f('server.crt')), spki(f('ca.crt'))] };
}

export function startCfSim({ port, target, certs, fakeClientIp = null, wsIdleMs = 100_000, host = '127.0.0.1' }) {
  const stats = { requests: 0, upgrades: 0, wsIdleCuts: 0 };
  const edgeHeaders = (q) => {
    const client = fakeClientIp ?? String(q.socket.remoteAddress).replace(/^::ffff:/, '');
    const h = { ...q.headers };
    for (const k of Object.keys(h)) if (k.startsWith('cf-')) delete h[k];          // the edge sets these, a client cannot
    h['cf-connecting-ip'] = client;
    h['x-forwarded-for'] = h['x-forwarded-for'] ? `${h['x-forwarded-for']}, ${client}` : client;
    h['x-forwarded-proto'] = 'https';
    h['cf-visitor'] = '{"scheme":"https"}';
    h['cf-ray'] = crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') + '-AMS';
    h['cf-ipcountry'] = 'NL';
    return h;
  };
  const srv = https.createServer({ key: fs.readFileSync(certs.key), cert: fs.readFileSync(certs.cert) }, (q, s) => {
    stats.requests++;
    const up = http.request({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: target, method: q.method, path: q.url, headers: edgeHeaders(q) }, r => {
      s.writeHead(r.statusCode, { ...r.headers, server: 'cloudflare', 'cf-ray': 'sim' });
      r.pipe(s);
    });
    up.on('error', () => { if (!s.headersSent) { s.writeHead(502, { server: 'cloudflare' }); s.end('502 from cf-sim'); } else s.destroy(); });
    q.pipe(up);
  });
  // WebSockets: replay the handshake to the origin, then pipe both ways, cut when idle
  srv.on('upgrade', (q, sock, head) => {
    stats.upgrades++;
    const o = net.connect(target, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const h = edgeHeaders(q);
      o.write(`${q.method} ${q.url} HTTP/1.1\r\n${Object.entries(h).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v}`).join('\r\n')}\r\n\r\n`);
      if (head?.length) o.write(head);
      let last = Date.now();
      const touch = () => { last = Date.now(); };
      o.on('data', touch); sock.on('data', touch);
      const t = setInterval(() => { if (Date.now() - last > wsIdleMs) { stats.wsIdleCuts++; sock.destroy(); o.destroy(); } }, 1000);
      const done = () => { clearInterval(t); sock.destroy(); o.destroy(); };
      o.on('close', done); sock.on('close', done);
      o.pipe(sock); sock.pipe(o);
    });
    o.on('error', () => sock.destroy()); sock.on('error', () => o.destroy());
  });
  srv.listen(port, host);
  return { srv, stats, ready: new Promise(r => srv.listening ? r() : srv.once('listening', r)),
    close: () => new Promise(r => { srv.close(r); srv.closeAllConnections?.(); }) };
}

// ---- as a program ----
if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const a = (n, d) => { const i = process.argv.indexOf(n); return i > 0 ? process.argv[i + 1] : d; };
  const certs = makeTestCerts(a('--dir', path.join(process.env.TMPDIR || '/tmp', 'nfsu2-cf-sim')));
  const sim = startCfSim({ port: +a('--port', 8527), target: +a('--target', 8627), certs, fakeClientIp: a('--fake-client-ip', null),
    wsIdleMs: +a('--ws-idle-ms', 100_000) });
  await sim.ready;
  console.log(`cf-sim: https://127.0.0.1:${a('--port', 8527)}/ -> http://127.0.0.1:${a('--target', 8627)}/  (test CA ${certs.ca}; SPKI ${certs.spki.join(',')})`);
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => sim.close().then(() => process.exit(0)));
}

// The start page's storage check (web/src/app/checks.ts checkStorage): which browsers can keep the game's files.
//   node --test web/test/checks-storage.test.mjs
// A fake navigator.storage per case, and FileSystemFileHandle with or without createWritable (Safari before 26).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const out = await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(HERE, '../src/app/checks.ts')], bundle: true, write: false, format: 'esm', platform: 'neutral' });
const C = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(out.outputFiles[0].text).toString('base64'));

const IOS18 = 'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 18_6 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/18.6 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1';
const CHROME = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';

/** the storage check of one browser; opfs: it has an origin private file system here; writable: its file handles
 *  have createWritable (handle: false, no FileSystemFileHandle at all) */
function storage({ ua = CHROME, opfs = true, writable = true, handle = true, persisted = true }) {
  Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'navigator', { configurable: true, writable: true, value: {
    userAgent: ua, maxTouchPoints: 0,
    storage: {
      getDirectory: async () => { if (!opfs) throw new DOMException('no', 'SecurityError'); return {}; },
      persisted: async () => persisted, persist: async () => persisted,
    },
  } });
  if (handle) globalThis.FileSystemFileHandle = class { getFile() {} };
  else delete globalThis.FileSystemFileHandle;
  if (handle && writable) globalThis.FileSystemFileHandle.prototype.createWritable = function () {};
  return C.checkStorage();
}

test('a browser that writes files from the page: no problem', async () => {
  const c = await storage({});
  assert.equal(c.state, 'ok');
  assert.equal(c.code, undefined);
});

test('Safari before 26 (no createWritable): Play stays off, with STORAGE-OLD', async () => {
  const c = await storage({ ua: IOS18, writable: false });
  assert.equal(c.state, 'fail');
  assert.equal(c.code, 'STORAGE-OLD');
  assert.match(c.detail, /iOS 26/);
});

test('no FileSystemFileHandle at all: STORAGE-OLD too', async () => {
  const c = await storage({ handle: false });
  assert.equal(c.state, 'fail');
  assert.equal(c.code, 'STORAGE-OLD');
});

test('a window that stores nothing says so first (STORAGE-NONE), old or not', async () => {
  const c = await storage({ ua: IOS18, opfs: false, writable: false });
  assert.equal(c.code, 'STORAGE-NONE');
});

/** a blank page with the module and a stand-in /names: `mine` the passphrase's claim (null: none), `states` what
 *  each name is (lower case; anything else is free) */
async function page() {
  const p = await browser.newPage();
  // (localhost: a secure context, as the page's own, for crypto.subtle's digits)
  await p.route('http://localhost/', r => r.fulfill({ contentType: 'text/html', body: '<div class="set"><div class="set-control"><input id="name" placeholder="profile name"></div></div>' }));
  await p.goto('http://localhost/');
  await p.addScriptTag({ content: js });
  await p.evaluate(() => {
    const w = /** @type {any} */ (window);
    w.mine = null; w.states = {}; w.linked = true; w.asked = []; w.claimed = []; w.saved = []; w.kept = undefined; w.questions = 0;
    w.down = false; w.heard = null;
    w.claims = {
      here: true,
      async check(name) {
        w.asked.push(name);
        if (w.down) return null;
        const state = name ? w.states[name.toLowerCase()] ?? 'free' : 'invalid';
        return { name: name || null, state, ...(state === 'old' ? { until: Date.now() + 5 * 86_400_000 } : {}), ...(w.linked && w.mine ? { mine: w.mine } : {}) };
      },
      async claim(name) {
        w.claimed.push(name);
        w.mine = { name, until: Date.now() + 730 * 86_400_000, next: Date.now() + 7 * 86_400_000 };
        return { ok: true, mine: w.mine };
      },
    };
    w.play = typed => w.U.settleName({
      claims: w.claims, seed: () => 'seed', linked: () => w.linked, log: () => {},
      choose: async () => { w.questions++; return 'cancel'; }, save: async n => { w.saved.push(n); }, claimed: () => w.heard,
    }, typed, '/save', async () => null);
    w.row = new w.U.NameRow({
      claims: w.claims, seed: () => 'seed', linked: () => w.linked, enable: async () => null, showPassphrase: async () => {},
      profileName: async () => 'Profile1', save: async n => { w.saved.push(n); document.getElementById('name').value = n; },
      writable: () => true, kept: n => { w.kept = n; }, say: () => {}, log: () => {},
    });
    const input = document.getElementById('name');
    w.row.attach(input.closest('.set'), input, input.parentElement);
  });
  return p;
}

/** Your name typed, and the line once the server answered */
async function typed(p, name) {
  return p.evaluate(async n => {
    const w = /** @type {any} */ (window), input = document.getElementById('name');
    input.value = n;
    await w.row.ask();
    const line = document.getElementById('set-roam_name-claim'), btn = input.parentElement.querySelector('button.btn');
    return { text: line.hidden ? null : line.textContent, cls: line.className.replace('set-state ', ''), button: btn.hidden ? null : btn.textContent, placeholder: input.placeholder };
  }, name);
}
const set = (p, o) => p.evaluate(x => Object.assign(window, x), o);
const take = (p, k) => p.evaluate(x => /** @type {any} */ (window)[x].splice(0), k);

test('Play: a claimed name is the one played, whatever Your name says, and the claim never moves', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  await set(p, { mine: { name: 'Speedy', until: Date.now() + 700 * DAY, next: 0 }, states: { taken1: 'taken', name: 'default', speedy: 'yours', older: 'old' } });
  await take(p, 'asked');
  for (const typed of ['Racer_X_99', 'Taken1', 'NAME', 'Older', '', 'Hitler']) {
    assert.equal(await p.evaluate(t => /** @type {any} */ (window).play(t), typed), 'Speedy', JSON.stringify(typed));
  }
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).play('SPEEDY')), 'SPEEDY', 'the claimed name in the case typed');
  assert.deepEqual(await take(p, 'claimed'), [], 'no claim made or moved');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).questions), 0, 'no question about the typed name');
  assert.deepEqual(await take(p, 'asked'), ['Racer_X_99', 'Taken1', 'NAME', 'Older', '', '', 'SPEEDY'], 'the server asked (a refused name: for the claim only)');
  // no answer at Play: the claimed name as the page heard it before, else as typed
  await set(p, { down: true, heard: 'Speedy' });
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).play('Racer_X_99')), 'Speedy');
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).play('speedy')), null, 'the same name: as typed');
  await set(p, { heard: null });
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).play('Racer_X_99')), null);
  await set(p, { heard: 'Speedy', linked: false });
  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => /** @type {any} */ (window).play('Racer_X_99')), null, 'no passphrase here: nothing heard counts');
});

test('the slur filter on the name as typed and on its Online form', () => {

test('the digits: the same for one browser and name, the end of the name replaced', async () => {
  const a = await C.digitsFor('NAME', 'seed-1');
  assert.match(a, /^NAME\d{4}$/);
  assert.equal((await C.digitsFor('name', 'seed-1')).slice(4), a.slice(4), 'the same digits in any case');
  assert.equal(await C.digitsFor('NAME', 'seed-1'), a);
  const others = new Set(await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => C.digitsFor('NAME', `seed-${i}`))));
  assert.ok(others.size > 15, 'other browsers, other digits');
  assert.match(await C.digitsFor('Alex the Great', 's'), /^Alex_the_Gr\d{4}$/);
  // a cut that reads as a slur: Player's digits
  const d = await C.digitsFor('AbcdefghFagxyz', 's');
  assert.match(d, /^(Player\d{4}|AbcdefghFag\d{4})$/);
  assert.ok(!C.readsAsSlur(d), d);
});

test('/names: asked with the token, read as the page reads it', async () => {

  let token = null;
  const c = new C.NameClaims(async () => token, f);
  assert.deepEqual(await c.check('Alex', 'Alex4821'), { name: 'Alex', state: 'free', captcha: 'site' });
  assert.equal(calls[0].url, '/names?name=Alex&alt=Alex4821');
  assert.equal(calls[0].init.headers.authorization, undefined, 'no keyphrase: no token');
  assert.equal(c.here, true);
  token = 'A'.repeat(43);
  await c.check('Alex');
  assert.equal(calls[1].init.headers.authorization, `Bearer ${'A'.repeat(43)}`);
  // a claim on a name the operator took away: as none
  answer = { status: 200, body: { name: 'Other', state: 'free', mine: { name: 'Alex', until: 1, next: 0, blocked: true } } };
  assert.deepEqual(await c.check('Other'), { name: 'Other', state: 'free' });
  answer = { status: 200, body: { name: 'Other', state: 'free', mine: { name: 'Alex', until: 1, next: 0 } } };
  assert.equal((await c.check('Other')).mine.name, 'Alex');
  answer = { status: 404, body: {} };
  assert.equal(await c.check('Alex'), null);
  assert.equal(c.here, false, 'a server without claims');
  // a claim: the name and Cloudflare's answer; refusals as the server says them
  answer = { status: 200, body: { state: 'yours', mine: { name: 'Alex', until: 1, next: 0 } } };
  assert.deepEqual(await c.claim('Alex', 'cf-answer'), { ok: true, mine: { name: 'Alex', until: 1, next: 0 } });
  const post = calls.at(-1);
  assert.equal(post.init.method, 'POST');
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(post.init.body), { name: 'Alex', captcha: 'cf-answer' });
  answer = { status: 429, body: { error: 'soon', next: 99 } };
  assert.deepEqual(await c.claim('Racer', null), { ok: false, error: 'soon', next: 99 });
  answer = { status: 429, body: {} };
  assert.deepEqual(await c.claim('Racer', null), { ok: false, error: 'busy' });
  answer = { status: 409, body: { error: 'taken' } };
  assert.deepEqual(await c.claim('Racer', null), { ok: false, error: 'taken' });
  const broken = new C.NameClaims(async () => token, async () => { throw new Error('offline'); });
  assert.equal(await broken.check('Alex'), null);
  assert.deepEqual(await broken.claim('Alex', null), { ok: false, error: 'net' });

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const js = (await esbuild.build({
  stdin: { contents: `export * from './web/src/app/copy.ts';`, resolveDir: ROOT, loader: 'ts' },
  bundle: true, format: 'iife', globalName: 'C', write: false, platform: 'browser',
})).outputFiles[0].text;

async function page() {
  const p = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 800, height: 600 } });
  await p.setContent(`<style>${css}</style><button id="mid" style="position:fixed;left:380px;top:300px;width:40px;height:40px"></button>
    <button id="top" style="position:fixed;left:380px;top:4px;width:40px;height:40px"></button>
    <button id="edge" style="position:fixed;left:772px;top:300px;width:24px;height:40px"></button>
    <dialog id="dlg"><button id="inner" style="width:40px;height:40px">x</button></dialog>`);
  await p.addScriptTag({ content: js });
  return p;
}
/** a toast at button id, and the toasts there are once it has settled (its fade-in moves it 4 px) */
const toast = (p, id, text, ms) => p.evaluate(async ([id, text, ms]) => {
  /** @type {any} */ (window).C.copyToast(document.getElementById(id), text, ms);
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
  const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('.copy-toast')];
  return els.map(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return { text: e.textContent, x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.width, h: r.height, below: e.classList.contains('below'), top: e.matches(':popover-open') }; });
}, [id, text, ms]);

test('a toast at the button: over it, under it with no room above, inside the window, one a button, then gone', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  const [t] = await toast(p, 'mid', 'Copied', 1000);
  assert.equal(t.text, 'Copied');
  assert.ok(t.top, 'in the top layer');
  assert.equal(t.y + t.h, 300 - 8, '8 px over the button');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(t.x + t.w / 2 - 400) <= 1, 'over its middle');
  assert.equal(t.below, false);
  const again = await toast(p, 'mid', 'Copied again', 1000);
  assert.deepEqual(again.map(x => x.text), ['Copied again'], 'the new one in the old one\'s place');
  const top = (await toast(p, 'top', 'At the top', 300)).find(x => x.text === 'At the top');
  assert.ok(top && top.below && top.y === 4 + 40 + 8, 'no room above: under it');
  const edge = (await toast(p, 'edge', 'Copied a long name here', 300)).find(x => x.text.startsWith('Copied a long'));
  assert.ok(edge.x + edge.w <= 800 - 8 && edge.x >= 8, 'inside the window');
  await p.waitForTimeout(1300);
  assert.equal(await p.$$eval('.copy-toast', es => es.length), 0, 'gone after its time');
  await p.close();
});

test('a button in a modal dialog: the toast over the dialog', async () => {

  assert.equal(await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll(':modal, :popover-open')].map(e => e.id || e.className).join(' ')), 'dlg copy-toast on');
  await p.close();
});

test('copyText: the Clipboard API, else the old way; false when neither copies', async () => {
  const p = await page();
  const r = await p.evaluate(async () => {
    const w = /** @type {any} */ (window), got = [];
    const clip = ok => Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'clipboard', { configurable: true, value: { writeText: async s => { got.push(['api', s]); if (!ok) throw new Error('no'); } } });
    clip(true);
    const a = await w.C.copyText('one');
    clip(false);
    document.execCommand = cmd => { got.push(['old', cmd]); return true; };
    const b = await w.C.copyText('two');
    document.execCommand = () => false;
    const c = await w.C.copyText('three');
    return { a, b, c, got, left: document.querySelectorAll('textarea').length };
  });
  assert.deepEqual(r, { a: true, b: true, c: false, got: [['api', 'one'], ['api', 'two'], ['old', 'copy'], ['api', 'three']], left: 0 });
  await p.close();
});

test('the crews\' colours: the value bundle.m\'s K_RGBS takes', () => {
  // at most 4 entries, each blanks (spaces, tabs), none or 6 hex digits of any case, blanks

  for (const v of ['3cd2ff, ff4646, a078ff, ff4646, 4f7dff', ',,,,', '3cd', '#3cd2ff', '3cd2ff0', 'xyz', '3cd2 ff', '3cd2ff\v', '\v3cd2ff', '3cd2ff\r',
    'ggggggg', '3cd2ff;', '3cd2fg', '３cd2ff'])
    assert.equal(C.rgbsOk(v), false, JSON.stringify(v));
  // the setting: a "; comment" cut off first, as for the other free-roam keys
  assert.equal(S.keyDef('roam_crew_colours').env, 'NFSU2_ROAM_CREW_RGB');

  assert.deepEqual(S.checkSetting('roam_crew_colours', '3cd2ff #1'), { ok: true, env: 'NFSU2_ROAM_CREW_RGB', value: '3cd2ff' }, 'a # after a blank is a comment');
  const bad = S.checkSetting('roam_crew_colours', '3cd2ff, #ff4646');
  assert.equal(bad.ok, true, 'there too: "3cd2ff," is what is left');
  assert.equal(S.checkSetting('roam_crew_colours', '3cd2ff,#ff4646').ok, false, 'a # inside an entry');
  assert.match(S.checkSetting('roam_crew_colours', 'red').reason, /is not a list of up to 4 colours of 6 hex digits \(rrggbb\), separated by commas/);
  // the crews with their colours: entry i, else the place's default; a refused value counts as none
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewsOf('Blue Room, Night Owls, Drift', 'FF4646'), [{ name: 'Blue Room', rgb: 'ff4646' }, { name: 'Night Owls', rgb: 'ff50c8' }, { name: 'Drift', rgb: 'a078ff' }]);
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewsOf('a, b', ', 4f7dff, 3cf0f0'), [{ name: 'a', rgb: '3cd2ff' }, { name: 'b', rgb: '4f7dff' }], 'an empty entry: the default; one past the crews: unused');
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewsOf('a, A, b', '111111, 222222'), [{ name: 'a', rgb: '111111' }, { name: 'b', rgb: '222222' }], 'by the crews the game takes (a repeat has no entry)');
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewsOf('a', 'bogus').map(c => c.rgb), ['3cd2ff']);
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewsOf('', '3cd2ff'), []);
  assert.deepEqual(C.rgbWords(C.crewsOf('a, b', '3cd2ff, ff4646')), [0x3cd2ff, 0xff4646]);
});

test('the crews\' colours stay with their crews: Leave, Join, a colour picked', () => {
  // as the panel and the menu change them (settings-ui.ts crewControl): a Leave keeps the others' colours, a Join takes
  // the first colour no crew has, and the line is written with every crew's colour
  let list = C.crewsOf('Blue Room, Night Owls, Drift', '');
  assert.deepEqual(list.map(c => c.rgb), ['3cd2ff', 'ff50c8', 'a078ff'], 'the defaults by place');
  list = list.filter(c => c.name !== 'Blue Room');
  assert.equal(C.rgbsValue(list), 'ff50c8, a078ff', 'a Leave: the others keep theirs, written');
  const back = C.crewsOf(C.crewsValue(list.map(c => c.name)), C.rgbsValue(list));
  assert.deepEqual(back, list, 'and read back the same');
  list = [...list, { name: 'Red', rgb: C.freeColour(list) }];
  assert.equal(list[2].rgb, '3cd2ff', 'a Join: the first colour no crew has (the defaults first)');
  list = [...list, { name: 'Four', rgb: C.freeColour(list) }];
  assert.equal(list[3].rgb, 'ff4646');
  assert.equal(C.freeColour([{ name: 'a', rgb: '3cd2ff' }, { name: 'b', rgb: 'ff50c8' }, { name: 'c', rgb: 'a078ff' }, { name: 'd', rgb: 'ff4646' }]), '4f7dff', 'past the defaults');
  // a colour picked; two crews may share one
  list = list.map((c, i) => i === 0 ? { ...c, rgb: 'a078ff' } : c);
  assert.equal(C.rgbsValue(list), 'a078ff, a078ff, 3cd2ff, ff4646');
  const v = S.checkSetting('roam_crew_colours', C.rgbsValue(list));
  assert.equal(v.ok, true);
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewsOf(C.crewsValue(list.map(c => c.name)), v.value), list);
  // the defaults at their places are written too (a later Leave moves the crews up a place)
  assert.equal(C.rgbsValue(C.crewsOf('a, b', '')), '3cd2ff, ff50c8');
});

test('settings.ini: roam_crew to NFSU2_ROAM_CREW', () => {
  assert.equal(S.keyDef('roam_crew').env, 'NFSU2_ROAM_CREW');
  assert.equal(S.DEFAULTS.get('roam_crew'), '', 'in the template, empty');
  const ini = S.settingsPut(S.TEMPLATE, 'roam_crew', 'Blue Room, Night Owls');
  assert.match(ini, /^roam_crew = Blue Room, Night Owls$/m);
  assert.doesNotMatch(ini, /^#roam_crew =/m, 'in the template line\'s place');
  assert.equal(S.resolveEnv(ini, {}, {}).env.NFSU2_ROAM_CREW, 'Blue Room, Night Owls');
  // a free-roam key: "; comment" after a blank is cut off
  assert.deepEqual(S.checkSetting('roam_crew', 'Blue Room, Night Owls ; ours'), { ok: true, env: 'NFSU2_ROAM_CREW', value: 'Blue Room, Night Owls' });
  // 24 characters each (characters, not bytes: 24 ü are 48)
  assert.equal(S.checkSetting('roam_crew', `${'x'.repeat(24)}, ${'ü'.repeat(24)}`).ok, true);
  const long = S.checkSetting('roam_crew', `Blue, ${'y'.repeat(25)}`);
  assert.equal(long.ok, false);
  assert.match(long.reason, /is not a list of crew names \(at most 24 characters each, separated by commas\)/);
  assert.equal(S.checkSetting('roam_crew', 'a\x01b').ok, false, 'no control characters');
  assert.equal(S.checkSetting('roam_crew', 'a, b, c, d, e, a').ok, true, 'more than 4, and repeats: the game takes the first 4');
  const r = S.resolveEnv(`roam_crew = Blue, ${'y'.repeat(25)}\n`, {}, {});
  assert.equal(r.env.NFSU2_ROAM_CREW, undefined, 'a refused line sets nothing');
  assert.ok(r.file.roam_crew.refused);
  // a file of an older version gets the option's paragraph (only that one), commented out
  const para = /^# Your crews,[^]*?^#roam_crew =\n/m.exec(S.TEMPLATE)[0];
  const old = S.TEMPLATE.replace(para + '\n', '');
  assert.notEqual(old, S.TEMPLATE);
  const up = S.settingsUpgrade(old);
  assert.deepEqual(up.added, ['roam_crew']);
  assert.ok(up.text.endsWith('did not list yet) ----\n\n' + para), up.text.slice(-800));
  assert.equal(up.text.split('\n').filter(l => l.startsWith('#roam_room')).length, 1, 'not the other free-roam options again');
  // and without the colours' paragraph either: both, in the template's order
  const para2 = /^# Each crew's colour,[^]*?^#roam_crew_colours =\n/m.exec(S.TEMPLATE)[0];
  const up2 = S.settingsUpgrade(S.TEMPLATE.replace(para + '\n', '').replace(para2 + '\n', ''));
  assert.deepEqual(up2.added, ['roam_crew', 'roam_crew_colours']);
  assert.ok(up2.text.endsWith('did not list yet) ----\n\n' + para + '\n' + para2), up2.text.slice(-800));
});

test('what the box lets join', () => {
  const list = ['Blue Room', 'Night Owls'];
  assert.deepEqual(C.checkCrew('', list), { ok: false, why: null }, 'nothing typed: nothing to say');
  assert.deepEqual(C.checkCrew('  \t ', list), { ok: false, why: null });
  assert.deepEqual(C.checkCrew('  Red  Line ', list), { ok: true, name: 'Red Line' }, 'trimmed');
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('Red, Line', list).why, 'No commas, # or ; in a crew name.');
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('#1', list).why, 'No commas, # or ; in a crew name.');
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('a;b', list).why, 'No commas, # or ; in a crew name.');
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('y'.repeat(25), list).why, 'At most 24 characters.');
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('y'.repeat(24), list).ok, true);
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('ü'.repeat(24), list).ok, true, 'characters, not bytes');
  assert.deepEqual(C.checkCrew('blueroom', list), { ok: false, why: 'Already in your crews: {name}.', name: 'Blue Room' }, 'a repeat by hash');
  assert.deepEqual(C.checkCrew('NIGHT OWLS', list), { ok: false, why: 'Already in your crews: {name}.', name: 'Night Owls' });
  assert.deepEqual(C.checkCrew('Zoë', ['zoË']), { ok: false, why: 'Already in your crews: {name}.', name: 'zoË' }, 'capitals past A to Z small too');
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('Fifth', ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']).why, 'Up to 4 crews: leave one to join another.');
  assert.equal(C.checkCrew('', ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']).why, 'Up to 4 crews: leave one to join another.', 'said with nothing typed too');
  // a name that reads as a slur (names.mjs, as a player's name) is no crew; the words round them still are
  for (const typed of ['N1gg 4', 'f4g_42', 'XxCoonXx', 'Paki Crew', 'ｆａｇ'])
    assert.equal(C.checkCrew(typed, list).why, 'Not a crew name: it reads as a slur.', typed);
  for (const typed of ['Mustafa GS', 'Raccoon', 'Van Dyke', 'Spice Girls']) assert.equal(C.checkCrew(typed, list).ok, true, typed);
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewList('Blue Room, XxCoonXx, Night Owls'), ['Blue Room', 'Night Owls'], 'a hand-written one left out, as the game does');
  assert.deepEqual(C.crewsOf('a, f4g_42, b', '111111, 222222, 333333').map(c => c.name), ['a', 'b'], 'and it takes no place');
  // whatever joins makes a value the game reads back the same
  let crews = [];
  for (const typed of [' Blue Room', 'night owls', 'Ünïcode ✓', 'x'.repeat(24)]) {
    const c = C.checkCrew(typed, crews);
    assert.equal(c.ok, true, typed);
    crews = [...crews, c.name];
    const v = S.checkSetting('roam_crew', C.crewsValue(crews));
    assert.equal(v.ok, true);
    assert.deepEqual(C.crewList(v.value), crews);
  }
});

test('the Room setting: a name that reads as a slur is refused, as Your name is', () => {
  assert.equal(S.keyDef('roam_room').kind, 'room');
  assert.deepEqual(S.checkSetting('roam_room', 'Team ; ours'), { ok: true, env: 'NFSU2_ROAM_ROOM', value: 'Team' });
  assert.equal(S.checkSetting('roam_room', 'Mustafa GS').ok, true);
  for (const v of ['XxCoonXx', 'f4g_42 ; mine', 'ｆａｇ']) {
    const r = S.checkSetting('roam_room', v);
    assert.equal(r.ok, false, v);
    assert.equal(r.why, '"{value}" is not a world name (it reads as a slur)', v);
  }
  assert.match(S.checkSetting('roam_room', 'z'.repeat(64)).reason, /is not text of 1 to 63 bytes/);
  assert.equal(S.resolveEnv('roam = on\nroam_room = XxCoonXx\n', {}, {}).env.NFSU2_ROAM_ROOM, undefined, 'no room at Play');
});

test('Reset all settings keeps the crews and their colours', () => {
  let ini = S.TEMPLATE;
  for (const [k, v] of [['roam_name', 'Lessis'], ['roam_crew', 'Blue Room, Night Owls'], ['roam_crew_colours', 'ff4646, 3cd2ff'], ['fps', '60'], ['roam_room', 'x']]) ini = S.settingsPut(ini, k, v);

// The server's /data-blocks/ (runs of 1 MiB blocks of a game file, compressed) against a made-up game folder,
// so it runs anywhere:
//   node --test web/test/data-blocks.test.mjs
// The manifest names it; every encoding gives back the file's exact bytes; a run that does not compress goes
// as it is (judged per run); requests out of bounds, outside the game's files or past the end are refused; a client holding all
// its compressors gets the rest as they are (never refused, never queued), and gets them back when it lets go; past
// the 128 compressors of all clients, the next client gets its runs as they are until one is given back.  A
// shared cache (Cloudflare's) may keep a run only when its address names this version of the file and it is as
// small as it gets.  One block to a client that takes br goes as the server keeps it once it does (compressed at
// brotli's best: the manifest names these at /data-blocks/v2/), and until then a shared cache keeps it a while only.

// random bytes (AES-CTR over zeros), or bytes of 2 bits each that compress to about a quarter
const bytes = (size, seed, packs) => {
  const b = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-128-ctr', crypto.createHash('sha256').update(seed).digest().subarray(0, 16), Buffer.alloc(16)).update(Buffer.alloc(size));
  if (packs) for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) b[i] = (b[i] & 3) * 0x41;
  return b;
};
const DATA = path.join(TMP, 'game');
const FILES = { 'SPEED2.EXE': bytes(3 * M + 17, 'exe', false), 'TRACKS/L4RA.BUN': bytes(8 * M + 5, 'track', true),
  'MOVIES/INTRO.VP6': bytes(2 * M, 'movie', false),
  // a first block that does not compress before two that do (as the game's music): judged per run
  'PFDATA/MIX.MUS': Buffer.concat([bytes(M, 'mix0', false), bytes(2 * M, 'mix1', true)]) };
for (const [p, b] of Object.entries(FILES)) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(DATA, p)), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(DATA, p), b); }

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(TMP, 'game.wasm'), Buffer.alloc(8));

/** the server; `compress`: the threads that keep blocks at brotli's best (none: the answers compressed as they are sent) */
async function server({ compress = 0 } = {}) {
  const st = path.join(TMP, `state${compress}`);
  const srv = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', DATA, '--http-port', String(PORT), '--state', st, '--wasm', path.join(TMP, 'game.wasm')]),
    { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env: { ...process.env, NFSU2_COMPRESS_THREADS: String(compress) } });
  await new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let out = '';
    const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start: ' + out)), 15000);
    srv.stdout.on('data', d => { out += d; if (out.includes('  access    :')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
    srv.on('exit', c => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error('server exited ' + c + ' ' + out)); });
  });
  return { stop: async () => { const gone = srv.exitCode !== null ? null : new Promise(r => srv.once('exit', r)); srv.kill(); await gone; } };
}
/** an answer, its body as it came over the wire, and that body decoded */
function get(p, { ae = 'gzip, deflate, br, zstd', method = 'GET' } = {}) {
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const q = http.request({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: PORT, path: p, method, headers: { host: `localhost:${PORT}`, 'accept-encoding': ae } }, r => {
      const c = []; r.on('data', d => c.push(d));
      r.on('end', () => {
        const wire = Buffer.concat(c), enc = r.headers['content-encoding'];
        const body = enc === 'zstd' ? zlib.zstdDecompressSync(wire) : enc === 'br' ? zlib.brotliDecompressSync(wire) : enc === 'gzip' ? zlib.gunzipSync(wire) : wire;
        res({ status: r.statusCode, headers: r.headers, wire, body });
      });
    });
    q.on('error', rej); q.end();
  });
}
const slice = (file, b, n) => FILES[file].subarray(b * M, Math.min(FILES[file].length, (b + n) * M));
/** each file's mtime as the manifest names it (the m of a run's address) */
const mtimes = async () => Object.fromEntries(JSON.parse((await get('/data-manifest', { ae: 'identity' })).body).files.filter(f => !f.d).map(f => [f.p, f.m]));
const KEEP = 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable', WHILE = 'public, max-age=600';
/** what a shared cache is told: 'keep' (for good, both CDN headers), 'while' (10 minutes) or 'no' (no-store) */
const edge = r => r.headers['cdn-cache-control'] === KEEP && r.headers['cloudflare-cdn-cache-control'] === KEEP ? 'keep'
  : r.headers['cdn-cache-control'] === WHILE && r.headers['cloudflare-cdn-cache-control'] === WHILE ? 'while'
  : r.headers['cdn-cache-control'] === 'no-store' && r.headers['cloudflare-cdn-cache-control'] === 'no-store' ? 'no' : JSON.stringify(r.headers);

test('/data-blocks/: a client holding all its compressors gets the rest as they are, and gets them back when it lets go', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const s = await server();

test('/data-blocks/: past the 128 compressors of all clients, the next client gets its runs as they are until one is given back', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const s = await server();
  const held = [];

    assert.equal(await open(17), 'none');

    for (let i = 0; i < 40 && enc === 'none'; i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); enc = await open(17); }
    assert.notEqual(enc, 'none', 'compressed again once one of the 128 is given back');

//   dot files, symbolic links out of the folder)
// - limits (methods, bodies, header size, slow headers, Expect, /lan per
//   address, WebSocket message size, players)
// - --dev gating and the start-up refusals
// - trusted proxies: CF-Connecting-IP / X-Forwarded-* believed only from a
//   trusted peer (checked from this machine's LAN address, which is not one)
// - HSTS only over a real certificate or a proxy that says https
// - the Cloudflare simulation (web/test/cf-sim.mjs): TLS at the proxy, real
//   client address from CF-Connecting-IP, byte ranges and the brotli module
//   through it, the switch's WebSocket kept alive past a 40 s idle cut
// - availability (the phase-2 deploy review): a WebSocket ping flood, queued
//   (pipelined) requests, TLS handshakes that never finish, connections per
//   address, the keep-alive of peers that are not Cloudflare's, IPv6
// The tests run one after another, except the three that wait on the server's
// own clocks (the keep-alives of 65 and 905 s, the proxy's idle cut, the
// once-a-minute certificate check): they run beside the others, each on ports
// of its own (one after another the file took 271 s).
// Ports: NFSU2_TEST_PORT1 (8527), NFSU2_TEST_PORT2 (8627), and for the three
// beside them NFSU2_TEST_PORT3 to 6 (8535 to 8538); temporary files in
// $TMPDIR.  Needs the game folder (NFSU2_DATA) and a built web/dist and
// out/web/nfsu2.wasm; skipped without them.
import test, { describe } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import net from 'node:net';
import tls from 'node:tls';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';

import { WebSocket, WebSocketServer } from 'ws';
