  assert.equal(r.read(ff, press(15, 0)).buttons, bit(P.PAD_A));
  assert.equal(r.read(ff, press(15, 3)).buttons, bit(P.PAD_X));
  assert.equal(r.read(ff, press(15, 4)).buttons, bit(P.PAD_Y));
  assert.equal(r.read(ff, press(15, 6, 7, 10, 11, 13, 14)).buttons, bit(P.PAD_LB, P.PAD_RB, P.PAD_BACK, P.PAD_START, P.PAD_LS, P.PAD_RS));
  assert.match(r.describe(), /^an Xbox controller \(xbox buttons\), sticks on axes 0 1 and 2 3, triggers L2 4 R2 5/);
  // where Chrome places them by usage (no mapping of its own): LT on 3, RT on 4, as Chromium's MapperXboxBluetooth
  assert.deepEqual(D.placeHidAxes([c, c, c, -1, -1, c, 0, 0, 0, H], true), { lx: 0, ly: 1, rx: 2, ry: 5, lt: 3, rt: 4, hat: 9 });
});

// Xbox's One S with its 2016 firmware's id (045e 02e0) under Chrome on Android: Android's own key layout for the id
// (Vendor_045e_Product_02e0.kl) gives the usual key codes, and Chrome's XboxOneS2016FirmwareMappings (GamepadMappings.java)
// maps those as if they were the raw ones.  chromeOneS2016() is that mapping, over what the pad sends through the key
// layout: keys by Android's names (A B X Y L1 R1 SELECT START THUMBL THUMBR MODE), the sticks x y and z rz, the
// triggers lt rt, the hat hx hy.
const ONE_S_2016 = 'Xbox Wireless Controller (STANDARD GAMEPAD Vendor: 045e Product: 02e0)';
function chromeOneS2016() {
  let lt = false, rt = false;                      // Chrome's "activated": AXIS_Z, AXIS_RZ read anything but 0
  return ({ keys = [], x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, rz = 0, hx = 0, hy = 0 } = {}) => {
    const k = n => keys.includes(n) ? 1 : 0, b = Array(16).fill(0);
    if (z !== 0) lt = true;
    if (rz !== 0) rt = true;
    b[0] = k('A'); b[1] = k('B'); b[2] = k('C'); b[3] = k('X'); b[4] = k('Y'); b[5] = k('Z');
    b[8] = k('L1'); b[9] = k('R1'); b[10] = k('L2'); b[11] = k('R2');
    b[6] = lt ? (z + 1) / 2 : 0; b[7] = rt ? (rz + 1) / 2 : 0;
    b[14] = hx < -0.5 ? 1 : 0; b[15] = hx > 0.5 ? 1 : 0; b[12] = hy < -0.5 ? 1 : 0; b[13] = hy > 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
    // AXIS_RX and RY: nothing of the pad's goes there through the key layout
    return { axes: [x, y, 0, 0], buttons: b.map(v => ({ pressed: v > 0.12, value: v })) };
  };
}

test('Xbox\'s One S 2016 id under Chrome on Android: which pads are read so', () => {
  const g = (id, mapping = 'standard', n = 16) => ({ id, mapping, buttons: Array(n).fill({ pressed: false, value: 0 }) });
  assert.ok(D.oneS2016Android(g(ONE_S_2016), ANDROID_UA, 5));
  assert.ok(D.oneS2016Android(g(ONE_S_2016), DESKTOP_SITE_UA, 5));          // a big tablet asking for desktop sites
  assert.ok(!D.oneS2016Android(g(ONE_S_2016), DESKTOP_SITE_UA, 0));         // a Linux computer: Chrome's own mapping there
  assert.ok(!D.oneS2016Android(g(ONE_S_2016, 'standard', 17), ANDROID_UA, 5)); // not that mapping (it has no Home)
  assert.ok(!D.oneS2016Android(g(ONE_S_2016, ''), ANDROID_UA, 5));
  assert.ok(!D.oneS2016Android(g(ONE_S_2016), 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/157.0.0.0 Safari/537.36', 0));
  assert.ok(!D.oneS2016Android(g('45e-2e0-Xbox Wireless Controller'), ANDROID_UA, 5));   // Firefox's id
  for (const p of ['0b13', '0b20', '02fd'])                                   // the other Xbox ids: Chrome maps them right
    assert.ok(!D.oneS2016Android(g(`Xbox Wireless Controller (STANDARD GAMEPAD Vendor: 045e Product: ${p})`), ANDROID_UA, 5), p);
});

test('Xbox\'s One S 2016 id under Chrome on Android: its buttons where they belong, the right stick a stick (a report: LT and RT dead, the right stick drove)', async () => {
  const G2 = await load('web/src/input/gamepad.ts');
  await onBrowser(ANDROID_UA, 5, async (pads) => {
    const buf = new SharedArrayBuffer(P.IM_BYTES), h = new Int32Array(buf), f = new Float32Array(buf), logs = [];
    const chrome = chromeOneS2016(), g = { id: ONE_S_2016, index: 0, mapping: 'standard', connected: true, ...chrome() };
    pads.push(g);
    const p = new G2.PadPoller(h, new Uint8Array(buf), 0, () => {}, s => logs.push(s));
    const send = (raw) => { Object.assign(g, chrome(raw)); p.poll(); };
    const pad = () => ({ buttons: h[P.IM_PAD_BUTTONS], axes: Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => +f[P.IM_PAD_AXIS + i].toFixed(2)) });
    const press = (...keys) => { send({ keys }); return pad().buttons; };
    // read as the standard mapping it was the report: X was Y, Y LB, LB View, RB Menu
    const bare = (raw) => { const c = chromeOneS2016(); return G2.mapStandard({ ...g, ...c(raw) }); };
    assert.equal(bare({ keys: ['X'] }).buttons, bit(P.PAD_Y));
    assert.equal(bare({ keys: ['Y'] }).buttons, bit(P.PAD_LB));
    assert.equal(bare({ keys: ['R1'] }).buttons, bit(P.PAD_START));
    assert.equal(bare({ rz: 1 }).axes[P.PAD_AXIS_RT], 1);                     // the right stick down: the throttle
    // now
    assert.deepEqual([press('A'), press('B'), press('X'), press('Y')], [bit(P.PAD_A), bit(P.PAD_B), bit(P.PAD_X), bit(P.PAD_Y)]);
    assert.equal(press('L1', 'R1'), bit(P.PAD_LB, P.PAD_RB));
    send({ hx: 1 }); assert.equal(pad().buttons, bit(P.PAD_DRIGHT));
    send({ hy: -1 }); assert.equal(pad().buttons, bit(P.PAD_DUP));
    // what Chrome never reads: View, Menu, the sticks' buttons, Xbox
    assert.equal(press('SELECT', 'START', 'THUMBL', 'THUMBR', 'MODE'), 0);
    // the right stick: down and right, back to rest, all the way left and up; never a trigger
    const axes = (rx, ry) => { const a = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]; a[P.PAD_AXIS_RX] = rx; a[P.PAD_AXIS_RY] = ry; return a; };
    send({ z: 0.5, rz: 1 }); assert.deepEqual(pad().axes, axes(0.5, 1));
    send({}); assert.deepEqual(pad().axes, axes(0, 0));
    send({ z: -1, rz: -1 }); assert.deepEqual(pad().axes, axes(-1, -1));
    // the left stick as it is
    send({ x: -0.5, y: 0.25 });
    assert.equal(pad().axes[P.PAD_AXIS_LX], -0.5); assert.equal(pad().axes[P.PAD_AXIS_LY], 0.25);
    assert.equal(h[P.IM_PAD_FAMILY], P.PADF_XBOX);
    assert.ok(logs.some(s => /read as Xbox's One S with its 2016 firmware under Chrome on Android/.test(s)));
    p.dispose();
  });
});

test('Xbox\'s One S 2016 id: before Chrome saw the right stick move, its trigger places at 0 are the stick at rest', () => {
  const r = new D.OneS2016Reader(), chrome = chromeOneS2016(), none = { pressed: false, value: 0 };
  const read = (raw) => { const c = chrome(raw); return r.read(c.axes, c.buttons).axes; };
  assert.deepEqual(read({}), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
  assert.deepEqual(read({ rz: 0.5 }), [0, 0, 0, 0.5, 0, 0]);               // Y moved: its place counts, X's not yet
  assert.deepEqual(read({ z: -1, rz: 0.5 }), [0, 0, 0, 0.5, 0, 0]);       // X all the way left first: 0, read as rest
  assert.deepEqual(read({ z: -0.5, rz: 0.5 }), [0, 0, -0.5, 0.5, 0, 0]);  // until it moves
  assert.deepEqual(r.read([0, 0], [none]).axes, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);       // fewer buttons than it should have: no throw
});

test('a phone controller with a touch pad for its right stick under Chrome on Android: a still stick off centre reads as let go (a report: one tap turned the view for good)', async () => {
  const G2 = await load('web/src/input/gamepad.ts');
  const realNow = performance.now;
  let t = 1000;
  performance.now = () => t;
  try {
    await onBrowser(ANDROID_UA, 5, async (pads) => {
      const buf = new SharedArrayBuffer(P.IM_BYTES), h = new Int32Array(buf), f = new Float32Array(buf), logs = [];
      // the player's tester screen: 17 buttons, 9 axes, no mapping; after a tap axes 2 and 3 stayed at -0.97
      const g = { id: 'GT NX Controller-T (Vendor: 4131 Product: 0009)', index: 0, mapping: '', connected: true,
        axes: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) };
      pads.push(g);
      const p = new G2.PadPoller(h, new Uint8Array(buf), 0, () => {}, s => logs.push(s));
      const rs = () => [+f[P.IM_PAD_AXIS + P.PAD_AXIS_RX].toFixed(2), +f[P.IM_PAD_AXIS + P.PAD_AXIS_RY].toFixed(2)];
      const at = (ms, x, y) => { t += ms; if (x !== undefined) { g.axes[2] = x; g.axes[3] = y; } p.poll(); return rs(); };
      at(0);
      assert.deepEqual(at(16, -0.4, 0.2), [-0.4, 0.2]);           // a finger on the pad
      assert.deepEqual(at(16, -0.9671, -0.9685), [-0.97, -0.97]);  // its last place, the finger off
      assert.deepEqual(at(1900), [-0.97, -0.97]);                   // still read for 2 s: a stick held there
      assert.deepEqual(at(200), [0, 0]);                            // then as let go
      assert.ok(logs.some(s => /right stick stayed at \[-0\.97 -0\.97\] for 2 s/.test(s)));
      assert.deepEqual(at(16, -0.9671, -0.9684), [-0.97, -0.97]);  // it moves: read again
      assert.deepEqual(at(16, 0, 0), [0, 0]);
      assert.deepEqual(at(5000), [0, 0]);                           // at rest: nothing to do
      p.dispose();
    });
  } finally { performance.now = realNow; }
});

// The start page's horns (web/src/app/horn-preview.ts, Settings' Listen button) against the game's (runtime/horn.c):
//   node --test web/test/horn-preview.test.mjs        (the comparison needs wasi-sdk in deps/)
// 1. every kind renders: sound, no overload, and as long as it should be; tapped, every one (a recorded one too) fades
//    out within the first eight's release, and a recorded one sounds as the dual horn without its clip;
// 2. every kind as horn.c renders it (tests/horn_render.c, built for wasm as the game is) and as the port does, held
//    the same time: the same length, and the same sound sample for sample (the port does horn.c's float arithmetic:
//    identical but where expf, sinf, cosf or exp2f round a last bit differently), so a horn changed in one and not
//    the other fails here.  The recorded kinds' clips: web/src/static/horns.dat, which horn.c embeds.
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const REPO = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const js = (await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(REPO, 'web/src/app/horn-preview.ts')], bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false, platform: 'neutral' })).outputFiles[0].text;
const H = await import('data:text/javascript,' + encodeURIComponent(js));
const WASI = fs.readdirSync(path.join(REPO, 'deps')).filter(d => d.startsWith('wasi-sdk-')).map(d => path.join(REPO, 'deps', d)).pop();
const CC = WASI && path.join(WASI, 'bin/clang');
const OUT = path.join(REPO, 'out/web/test'); fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
// the game build's target and code generation (web/build.sh), as web/test/roam-wasm.test.mjs builds
const FLAGS = ['--target=wasm32-wasip1-threads', '-pthread', '-O3', '-msimd128', '-mbulk-memory', '-mnontrapping-fptoint',
  '-mtail-call', '-ffp-contract=off', '-Iruntime', '-Iruntime/web'];
const LINK = ['-Wl,--import-memory,--export-memory,--shared-memory,--initial-memory=67108864,--max-memory=268435456'];
const dB = x => 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(x, 1e-9));
const peak = a => a.reduce((m, x) => Math.max(m, Math.abs(x)), 0);
const BIN = fs.readFileSync(path.join(REPO, 'web/src/static/horns.dat'));
H.setHornClips(BIN);

test('every horn renders', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(H.HORN_NAMES, ['dual', 'single', 'truck', 'train', 'klaxon', 'cucaracha', 'clown', 'trombone',
    'dixie', 'oldcar', 'broken', 'sputter', 'thecar', 'thecar_long'], "horn.c's kinds, in its order");
  for (const name of H.HORN_NAMES) {
    const pcm = H.renderHorn(name), held = H.previewHold(name), p = dB(peak(pcm));
    assert.ok(pcm.every(Number.isFinite), `${name}: finite`);
    assert.ok(p > -19 && p < -6, `${name}: peak ${p.toFixed(1)} dBFS`);   // (the lowest: dixie, a dense recording)
    assert.ok(pcm.length / 48000 > held && pcm.length / 48000 < held + 1.6, `${name}: ${(pcm.length / 48000).toFixed(2)} s for ${held.toFixed(2)} s held`);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(H.renderHorn('kazoo', 0.5), H.renderHorn('dual', 0.5), 'a kind the game does not have: the dual horn');
  // tapped for 0.1 s: silent as soon as the first eight are (those but the Klaxon under 0.7 s, the Klaxon 1.36 s: its
  // pitch sweeps down when let go), a recorded one as soon as the dual horn
  const tap = name => H.renderHorn(name, 0.1).length / 48000, slowest = tap('klaxon');
  for (const name of H.HORN_NAMES) assert.ok(tap(name) <= slowest, `${name} let go after 0.1 s: ${tap(name).toFixed(2)} s`);
  for (const name of ['dixie', 'oldcar', 'broken', 'thecar'])
    assert.ok(tap(name) <= tap('dual') + 0.01, `${name} let go after 0.1 s: stops (${tap(name).toFixed(2)} s, dual ${tap('dual').toFixed(2)} s)`);
  assert.ok(tap('thecar_long') < 0.9, 'thecar_long stops when let go');
  H.setHornClips(new Uint8Array(0));
  assert.deepEqual(H.renderHorn('dixie', 0.5), H.renderHorn('dual', 0.5), 'a recorded kind without its clip: the dual horn');
  H.setHornClips(BIN);
});

test("the page's horns are horn.c's", { skip: !CC && 'no wasi-sdk in deps/' }, () => {
  const w = path.join(OUT, 'horn_render.wasm');
  execFileSync(CC, [...FLAGS, '-o', w, 'tests/horn_render.c', ...LINK], { cwd: REPO, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(OUT, 'horn-'));
  try {
    for (const name of H.HORN_NAMES) for (const [held, rate] of [[H.previewHold(name), 48000], [0.275, 44100], [3.3, 44100]]) {
      execFileSync(process.execPath, [path.join(REPO, 'web/test/wasi-run.mjs'), w, name, String(held), String(rate), `/tmp/${name}.f32`],
        { encoding: 'utf8', env: { ...process.env, WASI_DIR: `/tmp=${dir}` }, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], timeout: 120_000 });
      const b = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, `${name}.f32`));
      const c = new Float32Array(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.length / 4), t = H.renderHorn(name, held, rate);
      let diff = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(c.length, t.length); i++) diff = Math.max(diff, Math.abs(c[i] - t[i]));
      const at = `${name} held ${held.toFixed(2)} s at ${rate} Hz`;
      console.log(`${at}: ${(c.length / rate).toFixed(2)} s, peak ${dB(peak(c)).toFixed(1)} dBFS, largest difference ${dB(diff).toFixed(1)} dBFS`);
      assert.equal(t.length, c.length, `${at}: as long`);
      assert.ok(dB(diff) < -100, `${at}: the same sound (largest difference ${dB(diff).toFixed(1)} dBFS)`);
    }
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

//   node --test web/test/i18n.test.mjs
// 1. Every text the page shows is one the extraction reads (web/tools/i18n-keys.mjs): N() and tn() of literals only.
// 2. Every language's file (web/src/app/lang/<language>.json) has every text in use and nothing else, each with the
//    English's {name}s (a plural's one form may say {n} in words) and <n> tags, plural forms of its own language.
//    A new or changed English text fails here until each language has it: `node web/tools/i18n-keys.mjs <language>`
//    lists what one lacks, `node web/tools/i18n-keys.mjs --check` what is wrong.
// 3. t(), tn() and tvars() as the page calls them: English as written, a language's text and plural forms once its

import test from 'node:test';

import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

test('the texts in use are literals the extraction reads', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(bad, []);

  assert.ok(keys.has('Fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Electronic Arts.'), 'index.html data-i18n');
  assert.ok(keys.has('Post the log in <0>#bug-reports on our Discord</0>, with what you were doing.'), 'index.html data-i18n-html');
  assert.ok(keys.get('{n} laps')?.plural, 'tn()');

  test(`${lang}: every text, as the English has it`, () => {
    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(langFile(lang)), `web/src/app/lang/${lang}.json`);
    assert.deepEqual(check(lang, keys), []);
  });
}

test('t(), tn() and tvars(): English, then a language\'s text and plural forms', async () => {
  const out = await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(HERE, '../src/app/i18n.ts')], bundle: true, write: false, format: 'esm', platform: 'neutral' });
  const I = await import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(out.outputFiles[0].text).toString('base64'));
  assert.deepEqual([...I.LANGUAGES].filter(l => l !== 'english').sort(), [...LANGUAGE_FILES].sort());
  for (const l of I.LANGUAGES) assert.ok(I.LOCALE[l] && I.NATIVE[l], l);
  assert.equal(I.t('Saved: {what}, {value}.', { what: 'Movies', value: 'off' }), 'Saved: Movies, off.');
  assert.equal(I.tn(1, '{n} lap', '{n} laps'), '1 lap');
  assert.equal(I.tn(5, '{n} lap', '{n} laps'), '5 laps');
  const pl = { '{n} laps': { one: '{n} okrążenie', few: '{n} okrążenia', many: '{n} okrążeń', other: '{n} okrążenia' }, 'the browser': 'przeglądarka',
    'Saved: {what}, {value}.': 'Zapisano: {what}, {value}.', '{Browser} asks': '{Browser} pyta' };
  globalThis.fetch = async url => ({ ok: url === '/lang/polish.json', status: 404, json: async () => pl });
  const log = [];
  assert.equal(await I.setLanguage('polish', s => log.push(s)), true);
  assert.equal(I.language(), 'polish');
  assert.equal(I.tn(1, '{n} lap', '{n} laps'), '1 okrążenie');
  assert.equal(I.tn(3, '{n} lap', '{n} laps'), '3 okrążenia');
  assert.equal(I.tn(5, '{n} lap', '{n} laps'), '5 okrążeń');
  assert.equal(I.t('Saved: {what}, {value}.', { what: 'Filmy', value: 'wyłączone' }), 'Zapisano: Filmy, wyłączone.');
  assert.equal(I.t('Not in the file'), 'Not in the file');
  assert.equal(I.tvars('{Browser} asks', { Browser: 'the browser' }), 'przeglądarka pyta');
  assert.equal(I.listOf(['a', 'b', 'c']), 'a, b i c');
  // a file that does not load leaves the page as it was
  assert.equal(await I.setLanguage('german', s => log.push(s)), false);
  assert.equal(I.language(), 'polish');
  assert.match(log.join('\n'), /german texts did not load \(Error: HTTP 404\)/);
  assert.equal(await I.setLanguage('english'), true);
  assert.equal(I.tn(5, '{n} lap', '{n} laps'), '5 laps');
  assert.equal(I.listOf(['a', 'b', 'c']), 'a, b and c');
});

const haveClang = spawnSync('clang', ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).status === 0;

// stdin: records of (stream length, output size, stream); stdout per record: 1 or 0, and FNV-1a of what it unpacked
const HARNESS = `#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "inflate.h"
int main(void){
    uint32_t h[2];
    while (fread(h, 4, 2, stdin) == 2){
        uint8_t *in = malloc(h[0] ? h[0] : 1), *out = malloc(h[1] ? h[1] : 1);
        if (!in || !out || fread(in, 1, h[0], stdin) != h[0]) return 2;
        int ok = inflate_raw(in, h[0], out, h[1]);
        uint32_t f = 2166136261u;
        if (ok) for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h[1]; i++) f = (f ^ out[i]) * 16777619u;
        printf("%d %08x\\n", ok, f);
        free(in); free(out);
    }
    return 0;
}
`;
const fnv = b => { let f = 2166136261; for (const x of b) f = Math.imul(f ^ x, 16777619) >>> 0; return f.toString(16).padStart(8, '0'); };

let seed = 11;
const rnd = n => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };
/** the kinds of bytes a pack holds and some others: noise, text, zeros, runs, and DXT5-like 16-byte blocks that
 *  repeat (a map's flat areas), with an XOR delta's mostly-zero blocks */
function samples() {
  const s = [];
  s.push(['empty', Buffer.alloc(0)], ['one byte', Buffer.from([7])]);
  const noise = n => { const b = Buffer.alloc(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = rnd(256); return b; };
  s.push(['noise 70 KB', noise(70000)]);
  s.push(['zeros 300 KB', Buffer.alloc(300000)]);
  const words = ['map', 'road', 'Bayview', 'shortcut', 'the ', 'and ', '\n', '2048', 'DXT5'];
  let t = ''; while (t.length < 200000) t += words[rnd(words.length)] + (rnd(4) ? ' ' : '');
  s.push(['text 200 KB', Buffer.from(t)]);
  const runs = Buffer.alloc(150000); for (let i = 0, v = 0; i < runs.length; i++) { if (!rnd(200)) v = rnd(256); runs[i] = v; }
  s.push(['runs 150 KB', runs]);
  const blocks = [noise(16), noise(16), noise(16), noise(16)];
  const dxt = Buffer.alloc(16 * 40000);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40000; i++) (rnd(10) ? blocks[rnd(4)] : noise(16)).copy(dxt, i * 16);
  s.push(['DXT-like 640 KB', dxt]);
  const delta = Buffer.alloc(16 * 40000);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40000; i++) if (!rnd(9)) noise(16).copy(delta, i * 16);
  s.push(['XOR delta 640 KB', delta]);
  return s;
}

test('inflate.h unpacks what zlib packs, and refuses short, long and broken streams', { skip: !haveClang && 'no clang' }, () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(OUT, 'inflate-c-'));
  try {
    const src = path.join(dir, 'inflate_check.c'), bin = path.join(dir, 'inflate_check');
    fs.writeFileSync(src, HARNESS);
    const san = spawnSync('clang', ['-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-x', 'c', '-o', path.join(dir, 'x'), '-'],
      { input: 'int main(void){return 0;}' }).status === 0 ? ['-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all'] : [];
    execFileSync('clang', ['-O1', '-g', ...san, '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-I', path.join(REPO, 'runtime/web'), '-o', bin, src]);
    const cases = [];                       // [what, stream, output size, expected FNV or null for refused]
    for (const [what, data] of samples()) {
      for (const [how, opt] of [['stored', { level: 0 }], ['fixed codes', { level: 6, strategy: zlib.constants.Z_FIXED }],
        ['level 1', { level: 1 }], ['level 9', { level: 9, memLevel: 9 }], ['Huffman only', { level: 6, strategy: zlib.constants.Z_HUFFMAN_ONLY }],
        ['RLE', { level: 6, strategy: zlib.constants.Z_RLE }]]) {
        const z = zlib.deflateRawSync(data, opt);
        cases.push([`${what}, ${how}`, z, data.length, fnv(data)]);
        if (data.length > 1 && how === 'level 9') {
          cases.push([`${what}, ${how}, one byte short`, z.subarray(0, z.length - 1), data.length, null]);
          cases.push([`${what}, ${how}, a byte too few out`, z, data.length - 1, null]);
          cases.push([`${what}, ${how}, a byte too many out`, z, data.length + 1, null]);
          for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) {        // a flipped bit: refused, or (rarely) other bytes, but never out of bounds
            const bad = Buffer.from(z); const at = rnd(bad.length); bad[at] ^= 1 << rnd(8);
            cases.push([`${what}, ${how}, bit flipped at ${at}`, bad, data.length, 'any']);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const input = Buffer.concat(cases.flatMap(([, z, n]) => { const h = Buffer.alloc(8); h.writeUInt32LE(z.length, 0); h.writeUInt32LE(n, 4); return [h, z]; }));
    const lines = execFileSync(bin, { input, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 120_000, maxBuffer: 1 << 24 }).trim().split('\n');
    assert.equal(lines.length, cases.length);
    const wrong = [];
    cases.forEach(([what, , , want], i) => {
      const [ok, f] = lines[i].split(' ');
      if (want === 'any') return;
      if (want === null ? ok !== '0' : ok !== '1' || f !== want) wrong.push(`${what}: ${lines[i]}`);
    });
    assert.deepEqual(wrong, []);
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

// The autotest's ns* keys on a page without the input layer (the suite's
// headless page): runtime/web/input_web.c translates them in C, and must
// write the same key-down records as the page's own path (synth.ts's
// synthetic KeyboardEvent through index.ts: keymap.ts keyFor, keyChars,
// keyVk), US layout, macOS rules.
//   node --test web/test/input-chars.test.mjs        (needs wasi-sdk in deps/)
// web/test/input_unit.c prints the C driver's record for every key, Caps Lock
// off and on, and every Shift/Ctrl/Alt combination (plus Cmd); this test
// computes the page's record for the same keystroke and compares all of them
// (the review of corefix found Option+Shift on a non-letter typed text on the
// page and was a command in C).
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const REPO = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const WASI = fs.readdirSync(path.join(REPO, 'deps')).filter(d => d.startsWith('wasi-sdk-')).map(d => path.join(REPO, 'deps', d)).pop();
const CC = WASI && path.join(WASI, 'bin/clang');

// web/build.sh's target, features and defines
const FLAGS = ['--target=wasm32-wasip1-threads', '-pthread', '-O2', '-msimd128', '-mbulk-memory', '-mnontrapping-fptoint',
  '-mtail-call', '-mexception-handling', '-mllvm', '-wasm-enable-sjlj', '-mllvm', '-wasm-use-legacy-eh=false',
  '-D_WASI_EMULATED_MMAN', '-D_WASI_EMULATED_SIGNAL', '-D_WASI_EMULATED_PROCESS_CLOCKS', '-fno-delete-null-pointer-checks',
  '-include', 'runtime/web/compat/wasm_plat.h', '-Iruntime/web/compat', '-Iruntime', '-Iruntime/web'];
const LINK = ['-Wl,--import-memory,--export-memory,--shared-memory,--initial-memory=67108864,--max-memory=268435456',

// web/src/input/proto.ts
const ISYN_SHIFT = 1, ISYN_CTRL = 2, ISYN_ALT = 4, ISYN_META = 8;
const IKF_ALT = 2, IKF_CTRL = 4, IKF_SHIFT = 8, IKF_DEAD = 16, IKF_SYNTH = 32;

async function keymap() {
  const out = await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: [path.join(REPO, 'web/src/input/keymap.ts')], bundle: true, format: 'esm',
    write: false, platform: 'neutral', logLevel: 'silent' });
  return import('data:text/javascript;base64,' + Buffer.from(out.outputFiles[0].text).toString('base64'));
}

/** index.ts onKeyDown for synth.ts's event: the key-down record, or null (none pushed) */
function pageRecord(m, dik, mods, caps) {
  const code = m.CODE_OF_DIK[dik];
  const shift = !!(mods & ISYN_SHIFT), ctrl = !!(mods & ISYN_CTRL), alt = !!(mods & ISYN_ALT), meta = !!(mods & ISYN_META);
  if (meta) return null;                                   // the browser's shortcut
  const e = { key: m.keyFor(code, shift, !!caps, true, null), ctrlKey: ctrl, altKey: alt, metaKey: meta,
    getModifierState: k => k === 'CapsLock' ? !!caps : false };
  const { chars, dead, sys } = m.keyChars(code, e, true, null);
  const flags = (alt ? IKF_ALT : 0) | (ctrl ? IKF_CTRL : 0) | (shift ? IKF_SHIFT : 0) | IKF_SYNTH | (dead ? IKF_DEAD : 0);
  const ch = [chars[0] ?? 0, chars[1] ?? 0, chars[2] ?? 0];
  return { vk: m.keyVk(code, e, m.CODES[code].vk, null), flags, nch: Math.min(chars.length, 3), ch, sys };
}

test('ns* keys: the C driver (input_web.c) writes what the page would', { skip: !CC && 'no wasi-sdk in deps/' }, async () => {
  const w = path.join(OUT, 'input_unit.wasm');
  execFileSync(CC, [...FLAGS, '-o', w, 'web/test/input_unit.c', 'runtime/web/thread_exit.c', ...LINK],
    { cwd: REPO, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  const out = execFileSync(process.execPath, [path.join(REPO, 'web/test/wasi-run.mjs'), w], { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], timeout: 120_000 });
  const c = new Map();
  for (const l of out.split('\n')) {
    const f = l.split(' ');
    if (f[0] !== 'K') continue;
    const [dik, mods, caps, vk, flags, nch, c0, c1, c2, sys] = f.slice(1).map(Number);
    c.set(`${dik} ${mods} ${caps}`, { vk, flags, nch, ch: [c0, c1, c2], sys });
  }
  assert.match(out, /input_unit: \d+ key-down records/, 'input_unit ran to the end');
  const m = await keymap();
  const MODS = [0, ISYN_SHIFT, ISYN_CTRL, ISYN_ALT, ISYN_SHIFT | ISYN_CTRL, ISYN_SHIFT | ISYN_ALT, ISYN_CTRL | ISYN_ALT,
    ISYN_SHIFT | ISYN_CTRL | ISYN_ALT, ISYN_META, ISYN_META | ISYN_SHIFT];
  const isMod = code => /^(Shift|Control|Alt|Meta|OS)(Left|Right)$/.test(code) || code === 'CapsLock';
  const bad = [];
  let n = 0, keys = 0;
  for (let dik = 1; dik < 256; dik++) {
    const code = m.CODE_OF_DIK[dik];
    if (!code || isMod(code)) continue;
    keys++;
    for (const caps of [0, 1]) for (const mods of MODS) {
      const id = `${dik} ${mods} ${caps}`, want = pageRecord(m, dik, mods, caps), got = c.get(id) ?? null;
      n++;
      if (JSON.stringify(got) !== JSON.stringify(want))
        bad.push(`${code} mods ${mods} caps ${caps}: C ${JSON.stringify(got)}, page ${JSON.stringify(want)}`);
      c.delete(id);
    }
  }
  for (const id of c.keys()) bad.push(`C wrote a record the page has no key for: ${id}`);
  console.log(`${keys} keys, ${n} keystrokes compared, ${bad.length} differ${bad.length ? ':\n  ' + bad.slice(0, 30).join('\n  ') : ''}`);
  assert.ok(keys >= 100, 'every key compared');
  assert.deepEqual(bad, []);
  // the review's cases, spelled out
  const opt = (dik, mods) => pageRecord(m, dik, mods, 0);
  assert.deepEqual([opt(0x02, ISYN_ALT | ISYN_SHIFT).nch, opt(0x02, ISYN_ALT | ISYN_SHIFT).ch[0]], [1, 0x21], 'Option+Shift+1 types "!"');
  assert.deepEqual([opt(0x0C, ISYN_ALT | ISYN_SHIFT).nch, opt(0x0C, ISYN_ALT | ISYN_SHIFT).ch[0]], [1, 0x5F], 'Option+Shift+Minus types "_"');
  assert.deepEqual([opt(0x1E, ISYN_ALT).nch, opt(0x1E, ISYN_ALT).sys], [0, 0x61], 'Option+A is a command (WM_SYSCHAR a)');
  assert.deepEqual([opt(0x02, ISYN_ALT).nch, opt(0x02, ISYN_ALT).sys], [0, 0x31], 'Option+1 is a command');
});

// which names it takes:
//   node --test web/test/invite.test.mjs
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import * as esbuild from 'esbuild';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const entry = `export * from './web/src/app/invite.ts'; export { roomHash } from './web/src/app/players.ts';
  export { settingsPut, resolveEnv, TEMPLATE } from './web/src/app/settings.ts';`;
const js = (await esbuild.build({ stdin: { contents: entry, resolveDir: ROOT, loader: 'ts' }, bundle: true, format: 'esm', write: false, platform: 'neutral' })).outputFiles[0].text;

test('a room\'s link, and a crew\'s with the sender\'s room if any', () => {
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { room: 'Blue Room' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#room=Blue%20Room');
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { crew: 'Night Owls', room: 'Blue Room' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#crew=Night%20Owls&room=Blue%20Room');
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { crew: 'Night Owls', room: '' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#crew=Night%20Owls', 'in no room: the crew alone');
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { crew: 'Night Owls' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#crew=Night%20Owls');
  // letters past ASCII as they are (a chat shows them); the URL's own signs and what a chat cuts off a link's end coded
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { room: 'Комната' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#room=Комната');
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { room: 'A&B=C#1?' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#room=A%26B%3DC%231%3F');
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { room: 'Team (2).' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#room=Team%20%282%29%2E');
  assert.equal(I.inviteLink(O, { room: '100%!' }), 'https://nfsu2.xyz/#room=100%25%21');

/** the worker, as a game process has it: its memory, control words and RPC slots; the notes it writes */
async function start(opts) {
  let memory = opts.offPage ? null : new WebAssembly.Memory({ initial: 4, maximum: 4, shared: true });
  const ctlBuf = new SharedArrayBuffer(CTL_INTS * 4), rpc = new SharedArrayBuffer(RPC_SLOT * MAX_THREADS);
  const w = new Worker(world + bundle, { eval: true, workerData: opts });
  const notes = [], msgs = [];
  const ready = new Promise((ok, no) => w.on('message', m => {
    if (m.t === 'log') notes.push(m.s); else msgs.push(m);
    if (m.t === 'io-ready') ok();
    if (m.t === 'io-error') no(new Error(m.msg));
  }));
  w.on('error', e => notes.push(`worker error: ${e}`));
  w.postMessage({ ...(opts.offPage ? { tries: [{ initial: 4, maximum: 64 }] } : { memory }), ctl: ctlBuf, rpc, cfg: { args: [], env: {}, dataBase: '/data/', manifestUrl: '/data-manifest', saveDir: 'save',
    ...opts.memory ? { saves: 'memory', memFiles: opts.memFiles ?? [] } : {} } });
  await ready;
  if (opts.offPage) { const ch = new MessageChannel(); const got = new Promise(r => ch.port2.once("message", r)); w.postMessage({ t: "give", port: ch.port1, slot: 0 }, [ch.port1]); memory = await got; ch.port2.close(); }
  const ctl = new Int32Array(ctlBuf), i32 = new Int32Array(rpc), i64 = new BigInt64Array(rpc), dv = new DataView(memory.buffer);
  /** a request from slot 0, as game-worker.ts io posts it; resolves with the WASI result when the worker answers */
  async function call(op, ...args) {
    i32[1] = op; i32[3] = args.length;
    args.forEach((a, i) => { i64[2 + i] = BigInt(a); });
    Atomics.store(i32, 0, RPC_POSTED);
    Atomics.add(ctl, CTL_IO_DOORBELL, 1); Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL_IO_DOORBELL);
    for (let v; (v = Atomics.load(i32, 0)) !== RPC_DONE;) await Atomics.waitAsync(i32, 0, v, 200).value;
    const r = i32[2]; Atomics.store(i32, 0, RPC_IDLE); return r;
  }
  async function open(p) {
    new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).set(new TextEncoder().encode(p), 1024);
    assert.equal(await call(OP.PathOpen, 3, 0, 1024, p.length, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2048), 0);
    return dv.getUint32(2048, true);
  }
  /** n bytes at pos (pread), into memory at 65536 */
  async function pread(fd, pos, n) {
    dv.setUint32(4096, 65536, true); dv.setUint32(4100, n, true);
    assert.equal(await call(OP.FdPread, fd, 4096, 1, pos, 4200), 0);
    return new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).slice(65536, 65536 + dv.getUint32(4200, true));
  }
  /** a file of /save opened (fd 4) with oflags, for writing: the WASI result, and the fd */
  async function openSave(p, oflags) {

    return { r, fd: dv.getUint32(2048, true) };
  }

  /** a file of /save read whole (its first 4 KB): its text, or the WASI error of its open */
  async function readAll(p) {
    const { r, fd } = await openSave(p, 0);
    if (r) return r;
    const t = new TextDecoder().decode(await pread(fd, 0, 4096));
    await call(1 /* FdClose */, fd);
    return t;
  }
  /** a file of /save written whole, as the game's CREATE_ALWAYS does (made, emptied, written, closed) */
  async function writeAll(p, text) {
    const { r, fd } = await openSave(p, 1 | 8);

    dv.setUint32(4096, 70000, true); dv.setUint32(4100, str(70000, text), true);
    assert.equal(await call(4 /* FdWrite */, fd, 4096, 1, 4200), 0);
    assert.equal(await call(1 /* FdClose */, fd), 0);
  }

  const unlink = async p => call(22 /* PathUnlinkFile */, 4, 1024, str(1024, p));
  const rename = async (a, b) => call(23 /* PathRename */, 4, 1024, str(1024, a), 4, 1536, str(1536, b));
  const dump = () => new Promise(res => { const h = m => { if (m.t === 'dumped') { w.off('message', h); res(m.files); } }; w.on('message', h); w.postMessage({ t: 'dump' }); });
  /** the blocks fetched so far ({ track, b, t }, t on the worker's clock) and the worker's time now */
  const fetches = () => new Promise(res => { const h = m => { if (m.t === 'fetches') { w.off('message', h); res(m); } }; w.on('message', h); w.postMessage({ t: 'fetched' }); });

const expect = (pos, n) => Uint8Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => ((pos + k) * 7 + ((pos + k) >> 11)) & 255);

async function readv(io, fd, pos, lens) {
  const memory = io.memory, dv = new DataView(memory.buffer);
  let at = 120000;
  lens.forEach((n, i) => { dv.setUint32(8192 + 8 * i, at, true); dv.setUint32(8192 + 8 * i + 4, n, true); at += n + 64; });
  new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).fill(0xEE, 120000, at);
  assert.equal(await io.call(OP.FdPread, fd, 8192, lens.length, pos, 4300), 0);
  const got = dv.getUint32(4300, true);
  const parts = []; at = 120000;
  for (const n of lens) { parts.push(new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).slice(at, at + n)); at += n + 64; }
  return { got, parts };
}
const want = (pos, lens) => { const out = []; let p = pos; for (const n of lens) { out.push(expect(p, n)); p += n; } return out; };

for (const offPage of [false, true]) {
  test(`readv iovecs [64, 0, 64]: from the server, then from the cache file (offPage ${offPage})`, { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
    const io = await start({ offPage });
    try {
      const fd = await io.open('CARS/A.BIN');
      const lens = [64, 0, 64];
      const a = await readv(io, fd, 100, lens);       // blocks path (fetched, kept)
      assert.equal(a.got, 128); assert.deepEqual(a.parts, want(100, lens), 'blocks path');
      const b = await readv(io, fd, 100, lens);       // cache path (readKept)
      assert.equal(b.got, 128);
      assert.deepEqual(b.parts, want(100, lens), 'cache path (readKept)');
    } finally { await io.stop(); }
  });
  test(`a read over a block's end, both kept; one kept and one not (offPage ${offPage})`, { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
    const io = await start({ offPage });
    try {
      const fd = await io.open('CARS/A.BIN');
      assert.deepEqual(await io.pread(fd, 10, 16), expect(10, 16));          // block 0 kept
      const lens = [40, 3000];
      const a = await readv(io, fd, M - 20, lens);                            // block 1 not kept: through blocks
      assert.equal(a.got, 3040); assert.deepEqual(a.parts, want(M - 20, lens));
      const b = await readv(io, fd, M - 20, lens);                            // both kept: readKept
      assert.equal(b.got, 3040); assert.deepEqual(b.parts, want(M - 20, lens));
      // to the file's end: short
      const c = await readv(io, fd, SIZE - 10, [64]);
      assert.equal(c.got, 10); assert.deepEqual(c.parts[0].slice(0, 10), expect(SIZE - 10, 10));
      const d = await readv(io, fd, SIZE - 10, [64]);
      assert.equal(d.got, 10); assert.deepEqual(d.parts[0].slice(0, 10), expect(SIZE - 10, 10));
    } finally { await io.stop(); }
  });
}

test('offPage: memory message, then mem after the memory grows; latency', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const io = await start({ offPage: true });
  try {
    const m0 = io.msgs.find(m => m.t === 'memory');
    assert.ok(m0 && m0.buf instanceof SharedArrayBuffer && m0.buf.byteLength === 4 * 65536, JSON.stringify(io.msgs.map(m => m.t)));
    const t0 = performance.now();
    io.memory.grow(2);
    while (!io.msgs.some(m => m.t === 'mem') && performance.now() - t0 < 2000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2));
    const mm = io.msgs.find(m => m.t === 'mem');
    assert.ok(mm, 'no mem message');
    assert.equal(mm.buf.byteLength, 6 * 65536);
  } finally { await io.stop(); }
});

/** the worker, as a game process has it: its memory, control words and RPC slots; the notes it writes */
async function start(opts) {
  const memory = new WebAssembly.Memory({ initial: 4, maximum: 4, shared: true });
  const ctlBuf = new SharedArrayBuffer(CTL_INTS * 4), rpc = new SharedArrayBuffer(RPC_SLOT * MAX_THREADS);
  const w = new Worker(world + bundle, { eval: true, workerData: opts });
  const notes = [], msgs = [];
  const ready = new Promise((ok, no) => w.on('message', m => {
    if (m.t === 'log') notes.push(m.s); else msgs.push(m);
    if (m.t === 'io-ready') ok();
    if (m.t === 'io-error') no(new Error(m.msg));
  }));
  w.on('error', e => notes.push(`worker error: ${e}`));
  w.postMessage({ memory, ctl: ctlBuf, rpc, cfg: { args: [], env: {}, dataBase: '/data/', manifestUrl: '/data-manifest', saveDir: 'save',
    ...opts.memory ? { saves: 'memory', memFiles: opts.memFiles ?? [] } : {} } });
  await ready;
  const ctl = new Int32Array(ctlBuf), i32 = new Int32Array(rpc), i64 = new BigInt64Array(rpc), dv = new DataView(memory.buffer);
  /** a request from slot 0, as game-worker.ts io posts it; resolves with the WASI result when the worker answers */
  async function call(op, ...args) {
    i32[1] = op; i32[3] = args.length;
    args.forEach((a, i) => { i64[2 + i] = BigInt(a); });
    Atomics.store(i32, 0, RPC_POSTED);
    Atomics.add(ctl, CTL_IO_DOORBELL, 1); Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL_IO_DOORBELL);
    for (let v; (v = Atomics.load(i32, 0)) !== RPC_DONE;) await Atomics.waitAsync(i32, 0, v, 200).value;
    const r = i32[2]; Atomics.store(i32, 0, RPC_IDLE); return r;
  }
  async function open(p) {
    new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).set(new TextEncoder().encode(p), 1024);
    assert.equal(await call(OP.PathOpen, 3, 0, 1024, p.length, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2048), 0);
    return dv.getUint32(2048, true);
  }
  /** n bytes at pos (pread), into memory at 65536 */
  async function pread(fd, pos, n) {
    dv.setUint32(4096, 65536, true); dv.setUint32(4100, n, true);
    assert.equal(await call(OP.FdPread, fd, 4096, 1, pos, 4200), 0);
    return new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).slice(65536, 65536 + dv.getUint32(4200, true));
  }
  /** a file of /save opened (fd 4) with oflags, for writing: the WASI result, and the fd */
  async function openSave(p, oflags) {
    new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).set(new TextEncoder().encode(p), 1024);
    const r = await call(OP.PathOpen, 4, 0, 1024, p.length, oflags, 0x40, 0, 0, 2048);
    return { r, fd: dv.getUint32(2048, true) };
  }
  const str = (at, text) => { const b = new TextEncoder().encode(text); new Uint8Array(memory.buffer).set(b, at); return b.length; };
  /** a file of /save read whole (its first 4 KB): its text, or the WASI error of its open */
  async function readAll(p) {
    const { r, fd } = await openSave(p, 0);
    if (r) return r;
    const t = new TextDecoder().decode(await pread(fd, 0, 4096));
    await call(1 /* FdClose */, fd);
    return t;
  }
  /** a file of /save written whole, as the game's CREATE_ALWAYS does (made, emptied, written, closed) */
  async function writeAll(p, text) {
    const { r, fd } = await openSave(p, 1 | 8);
    assert.equal(r, 0, `open ${p}`);
    dv.setUint32(4096, 70000, true); dv.setUint32(4100, str(70000, text), true);
    assert.equal(await call(4 /* FdWrite */, fd, 4096, 1, 4200), 0);
    assert.equal(await call(1 /* FdClose */, fd), 0);
  }
  const mkdir = async p => call(20 /* PathCreateDirectory */, 4, 1024, str(1024, p));
  const unlink = async p => call(22 /* PathUnlinkFile */, 4, 1024, str(1024, p));
  const rename = async (a, b) => call(23 /* PathRename */, 4, 1024, str(1024, a), 4, 1536, str(1536, b));
  const dump = () => new Promise(res => { const h = m => { if (m.t === 'dumped') { w.off('message', h); res(m.files); } }; w.on('message', h); w.postMessage({ t: 'dump' }); });
  /** the blocks fetched so far ({ track, b, t }, t on the worker's clock) and the worker's time now */
  const fetches = () => new Promise(res => { const h = m => { if (m.t === 'fetches') { w.off('message', h); res(m); } }; w.on('message', h); w.postMessage({ t: 'fetched' }); });
  return { w, notes, msgs, ctl, open, openSave, call, pread, readAll, writeAll, mkdir, unlink, rename, dump, fetches, stop: () => w.terminate() };
}
const expect = (pos, n) => Uint8Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => ((pos + k) * 7 + ((pos + k) >> 11)) & 255);

// The track's reading ahead (readAhead) and a friend's car (a 20 Mbit/s line, 2026-11-05: in a meet's first 30 s a block
// read ahead started in each gap between the car's reads, about half of what the line carried): no block is read ahead
// until the game has fetched nothing for AHEAD_QUIET_MS (2 s), then the rest of the track comes.  Before (db588c0e)
// the rest of the track was asked for at once, beside the car's reads.
test('the track is read ahead only once the game has fetched nothing for 2 s', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const io = await start({ track: 6 });
  try {
    const tr = await io.open('TRACKS/STREAML4RA.BUN'), car = await io.open('CARS/A.BIN');
    await io.pread(tr, 0, 64);                       // the game's own read of the track: the reading ahead begins
    // a friend's car: a read, a pause, a read (two blocks of its file)
    await io.pread(car, 0, 64);
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600));
    await io.pread(car, M + 5, 64);
    const { list, now } = await io.fetches();
    const lastGame = Math.max(...list.filter(f => !f.track || f.b === 0).map(f => f.t));
    assert.deepEqual(list.filter(f => f.track && f.b > 0), [], `read ahead while the car loaded: ${JSON.stringify(list)}`);
    assert.ok(now - lastGame < 1500);
    // then, quiet: the rest of the track, the first of it about 2 s after the car's last block
    let all;
    for (const t0 = performance.now(); performance.now() - t0 < 10_000;) {
      all = (await io.fetches()).list.filter(f => f.track && f.b > 0);
      if (all.length >= 5) break;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
    }
    assert.equal(all.length, 5, `the rest of the track read ahead: ${JSON.stringify(all)}`);
    const first = Math.min(...all.map(f => f.t));
    assert.ok(first - lastGame >= 1900 && first - lastGame < 3000, `read ahead from ${(first - lastGame).toFixed(0)} ms after the game's last block`);
  } finally { await io.stop(); }
});

test('a cache file that never opens: given up after 10 s, its reads come from the server, the log says so', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const io = await start({ hangOpen: true });
  try {
    const fd = await io.open('CARS/A.BIN');
    const t0 = performance.now();
    assert.deepEqual(await io.pread(fd, 100, 64), expect(100, 64));
    const s = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000;
    assert.ok(s >= 9 && s < 20, `the first read came after ${s.toFixed(1)} s`);
    assert.ok(io.notes.some(n => /CARS\/A\.BIN: its cache file did not open in 10 s; this game reads it from the server/.test(n)), io.notes.join('\n'));
    // the file stays given up: the next read (another block) does not wait for its cache file again
    const t1 = performance.now();
    assert.deepEqual(await io.pread(fd, M + 5, 32), expect(M + 5, 32));
    assert.ok(performance.now() - t1 < 2000, 'the second read waited for the cache file again');
  } finally { await io.stop(); }
});

test('a read that never comes back: written in the log after 20 s, with its file and what it waits for; the loop runs on', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const io = await start({ hangFetch: true });
  try {
    const fd = await io.open('CARS/A.BIN');
    void io.pread(fd, 0, 16).catch(() => {});        // never answered: the worker is stopped at the end

    const t0 = performance.now();

    while (!(line = io.notes.find(n => n.startsWith('[io] '))) && performance.now() - t0 < 40_000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
    assert.ok(line, `no [io] line in 40 s:\n${io.notes.join('\n')}`);
    assert.match(line, /^\[io\] fd_pread of \/data\/CARS\/A\.BIN unanswered for 2\d s; waiting: CARS\/A\.BIN#0: the server for 2\d s/);
    assert.ok(Atomics.load(io.ctl, CTL_IO_BEAT) - beat0 > 100, 'the I/O worker\'s loop did not beat while the read waited');
  } finally { await io.stop(); }
});

test('a file of the save folder that will not open, the folder still there (Firefox 159, 2026-11-04): refused, said once in the log and once to the page, no recovery', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {

// Playing without saving (shell.ts askNoSave: the save folder did not answer, the player started anyway; review of
// 2f61632b): /save is in the I/O worker's memory.  On 2f61632b both fail: the game's writes went to the browser's storage.
const PAGE_NEWS = ['saved', 'removed', 'lost', 'save-gone', 'save-trouble'];

test('playing without saving: /save in memory, the save folder\'s files that read; the game\'s writes, new folders, renames and deletes stay there, the browser\'s storage untouched', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const saveFiles = { 'settings.ini': '# mine\n', 'registry.txt': 'd A=1\n', 'NFS Underground 2/AAA/AAA': 'aaa', 'bad.bin': 'x' };
  const io = await start({ memory: true, readFail: 'bad.bin', saveFiles,
    memFiles: [{ path: 'registry.txt', text: 'd DEFAULT=1\n' }, { path: 'autotest-script.txt', text: 'quit\n', over: true }] });
  try {
    const before = await io.dump();
    // reads: the save folder's own (its registry, not the page's defaults), the page's where it gave none; one that did not read is not there
    assert.equal(await io.readAll('registry.txt'), 'd A=1\n');
    assert.equal(await io.readAll('autotest-script.txt'), 'quit\n');
    assert.equal(await io.readAll('NFS Underground 2/AAA/AAA'), 'aaa');
    assert.equal(await io.readAll('bad.bin'), 44 /* E.NOENT */);
    // the game's writes: a profile over its own, a new profile in a new folder, the registry by its .tmp, a delete
    await io.writeAll('NFS Underground 2/AAA/AAA', 'AAA2');
    assert.equal(await io.mkdir('NFS Underground 2/BBB'), 0);
    await io.writeAll('NFS Underground 2/BBB/BBB', 'bbb');
    await io.writeAll('registry.txt.tmp', 'd A=2\n');
    assert.equal(await io.rename('registry.txt.tmp', 'registry.txt'), 0);
    assert.equal(await io.unlink('settings.ini'), 0);
    assert.deepEqual([await io.readAll('NFS Underground 2/AAA/AAA'), await io.readAll('NFS Underground 2/BBB/BBB'), await io.readAll('registry.txt'),
      await io.readAll('settings.ini'), await io.readAll('registry.txt.tmp')], ['AAA2', 'bbb', 'd A=2\n', 44, 44]);
    // the browser's storage: as before, byte for byte; the page heard of no save (no "Progress saved", nothing for the cloud)
    assert.deepEqual(await io.dump(), before);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(before).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('save/')).map(([k, v]) => [k.slice(5), v])), saveFiles);
    assert.deepEqual(io.msgs.filter(m => PAGE_NEWS.includes(m.t)), []);
    assert.ok(io.notes.some(n => /^\[save\] playing without saving: \/save is in this game's memory, 3 files of the save folder copied in .*, 1 that did not read left out; nothing is written/.test(n)), io.notes.join('\n'));
  } finally { await io.stop(); }
});

test('playing without saving in a browser whose storage gives nothing at all: the game starts, its /save the page\'s files alone', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {

  '-mtail-call', '-mexception-handling', '-mllvm', '-wasm-enable-sjlj', '-mllvm', '-wasm-use-legacy-eh=false',
  '-D_WASI_EMULATED_MMAN', '-D_WASI_EMULATED_SIGNAL', '-D_WASI_EMULATED_PROCESS_CLOCKS', '-fno-delete-null-pointer-checks',
  '-include', 'runtime/web/compat/wasm_plat.h', '-Iruntime/web/compat', '-Iruntime', '-Iruntime/web'];
const LINK = ['-Wl,--import-memory,--export-memory,--shared-memory,--initial-memory=67108864,--max-memory=268435456',
  '-Wl,-z,stack-size=1048576', '-lsetjmp', '-lwasi-emulated-mman', '-lwasi-emulated-signal', '-lwasi-emulated-process-clocks'];

test('lan_unit on wasm (winsock.c + net_lan.c)', { skip: !CC && 'no wasi-sdk in deps/' }, () => {
  const w = path.join(OUT, 'lan_unit.wasm');
  execFileSync(CC, [...FLAGS, '-o', w, 'web/test/lan_unit.c', 'runtime/winsock.c', 'runtime/web/net_lan.c', 'runtime/web/sha256.c',
    'runtime/mem.c', 'runtime/web/thread_exit.c', ...LINK], { cwd: REPO, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(REPO, 'web/test/wasi-run.mjs'), w], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 120_000 });
  const out = run.stdout ?? '', err = run.stderr ?? '';
  if (run.status !== 0) console.log(err);
  console.log(out.trim().split('\n').filter(l => /FAIL|lan_unit:/.test(l)).join('\n'));
  const m = /lan_unit: (\d+) passed, (\d+) failed/.exec(out);
  assert.ok(m, 'lan_unit ran to the end');
  assert.equal(+m[2], 0, 'no failed check');
  assert.ok(+m[1] >= 80, 'every check ran');
  // the page closing its link at exit is logged as that, not as a lost switch
  const tail = err.slice(err.indexOf('lan_unit: the page closes the link'));
  assert.ok(err.includes('lan_unit: the page closes the link'), 'the test closed the link');
  assert.match(tail, /\[net\] virtual LAN closed/, 'a "closed" line');
  assert.doesNotMatch(tail, /reconnecting/, 'no "reconnecting" line');
  // the page letting the switch go when no network session wants it is logged as that too
  const idle = err.slice(err.indexOf('lan_unit: the page lets go'), err.indexOf('lan_unit: the page closes the link'));
  assert.match(idle, /\[net\] virtual LAN idle: no network session/, 'an "idle" line');
  assert.doesNotMatch(idle, /reconnecting/, 'no "reconnecting" line');
});

// The virtual LAN switch's /lan upgrade on the real server, when the game folder is there: the Origin check, and
// /lan?resume giving a departed player's address back only to its token (the audit's F1):
//   node --test web/test/lan.test.mjs
// The switch itself (addresses, peer lists, routing, the limits, keepalive, bundles, the page's net code against it)
// is tested in its crate, web/server-rs/crates/lan/tests.
// Port: NFSU2_TEST_PORT (8528).
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { WebSocket } from 'ws';
import { serverCommand } from '../tools/server-cmd.mjs';

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
const DATA = process.env.NFSU2_DATA || path.join(os.homedir(), 'projects/nsfu2/Need for Speed - Underground 2');

test('the server: /lan accepts its own pages and tools, refuses other sites; an address only back to its token', { skip: !fs.existsSync(path.join(DATA, 'SPEED2.EXE')) && 'no game folder' }, async () => {
  const hport = +(process.env.NFSU2_TEST_PORT || 8528);
  const st = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(process.env.TMPDIR || os.tmpdir(), 'lantest-'));
  const srv = spawn(...serverCommand(['--data', DATA, '--http-port', String(hport), '--state', st]), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  try {
    await new Promise((res, rej) => {
      let out = '';
      const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('server did not start: ' + out)), 15000);
      srv.stdout.on('data', d => { out += d; if (out.includes('  access    :')) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } });
      srv.on('exit', c => { clearTimeout(t); rej(new Error('server exited ' + c + ' ' + out)); });
    });
    const open = (headers, q = '', first = null, keep = false) => new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://127.0.0.1:${hport}/lan${q}`, { headers });
      setTimeout(() => rej(new Error(`no welcome and no close in 5 s (${q || 'no query'})`)), 5000).unref();
      if (first) ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify(first)));
      ws.on('message', (d, bin) => { if (!bin) { const m = JSON.parse(String(d)); if (m.t === 'welcome') { res(keep ? { ...m, ws } : m); if (!keep) ws.close(); } } });
      ws.on('error', () => res(null)); ws.on('unexpected-response', () => res(null)); ws.on('close', () => res(null));
    });
    assert.ok(await open({}), 'no Origin (a tool): accepted');
    assert.ok(await open({ origin: `http://127.0.0.1:${hport}` }), 'the server\'s own page: accepted');
    assert.equal(await open({ origin: 'https://evil.example' }), null, 'another site: refused');
    // an address back only with its token
    const a = await open({}, '', null, true);
    const vip = a.vipStr;
    a.ws.close();
    await sleep(100);
    const thief = await open({}, `?vip=${vip}&resume`, { t: 'hello', name: 'thief', vip, token: 'A'.repeat(22) });
    assert.notEqual(thief.vipStr, vip, '?vip= or a wrong token: never the departed player\'s address');
    const back = await open({}, '?resume', { t: 'hello', name: 'player', vip, token: a.token });
    assert.equal(back.vipStr, vip, 'its own token: the address back');
  } finally {
    // the server saves its addresses as it stops: remove the folder only after it is gone
    const gone = srv.exitCode !== null || srv.signalCode !== null ? null : new Promise(res => srv.once('exit', res));
    srv.kill(); await gone;
    fs.rmSync(st, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});
